jobs.title: Managing Editor (Freelance)
jobs.excerpt: A Contently Managing Editor is responsible for supervising and coordinating a team of freelance journalists to manage the timely delivery of quality content for client projects.
jobs.description:
A Contently Managing Editor is responsible for supervising and coordinating a team of freelance journalists to manage the timely delivery of quality content for client projects. The Managing Editor provides updates to the Account Manager as a freelance editor assigned to projects w/ monthly, weekly, or daily assignments. The Managing Editor is responsible for maintaining strict quality and style standards; managing assignments and the editorial calendar; and coordinating communication between the Clients (Publishers) and writers.

Contently maintains strict quality standards and relies on the Managing Editor to control the quality of content, request revisions from freelance journalists and make staff changes when required. As such, the Managing Editors success is judged primarily on the quality of the content.

The position is freelance, performed remotely, typically range from 5 hours to 20 hours per week. Pay is competitive.

Contently Managing Editor tasks include

  • Bring big ideas to the table

  • Help the clients and journalists generate new pitches

  • Assign articles

  • Prepare, rewrite and edit copy to improve readability

  • Detect and correct errors in spelling, punctuation, and syntax

  • Verify facts, dates, and statistics, using standard reference sources

  • Ensure compliance to the publication's style, editorial policy, and publishing requirements

  • File brief stories and blog posts when necessary

Contently Managing Editors should have experience hiring and managing freelance journalists; assigning news and feature articles for a monthly, weekly, or daily publication; fact checking and editing news copy; editing for publication style.

The position is freelance, performed remotely, and can range from 4 hours to 20 hours per week. Pay is competitive.

If interested, apply online at Contently.com/jobs.

About Contently

Contently ( a venture-backed startup in New York City, empowers brands and journalists to connect and tell stories. Our solution combines the largest network of vetted, ready-to-work journalists with a workflow platform designed to help brands more efficiently manage their content programs. Clients currently include some of the world's largest brands, agencies and media companies.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Security Monitoring / SIEM Analyst to support enterprise cybersecurity operations within a federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. This role provides continuous monitoring of security events, log analysis, threat detection, and incident escalation in order to protect mission-critical systems. The analyst will review SIEM alerts, correlate data across multiple log sources, assess anomalous behavior, and support the investigative process for potential threats.

The Security Monitoring / SIEM Analyst plays a critical role in maintaining situational awareness, enhancing detection capabilities, and strengthening cyber defense through proactive log analysis and coordination with incident response and engineering teams.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Security Monitoring / SIEM Analyst will:

  • Monitor SIEM dashboards and event queues for suspicious or anomalous cybersecurity activity.
  • Correlate logs from multiple security data sources, including firewalls, endpoints, cloud services, and authentication platforms.
  • Investigate events and alerts to determine severity, threat likelihood, and required escalation paths.
  • Support information gathering and preliminary triage for cybersecurity incidents.
  • Analyze user activity, authentication logs, and system behavior for potential compromise indicators.
  • Assist with tuning SIEM rules, correlation logic, thresholds, and suppression patterns to improve detection accuracy.
  • Document security event details, timelines, and investigative findings.
  • Escalate confirmed or high-risk events to the incident response team with detailed analysis.
  • Maintain daily and weekly reporting on events, trends, and identified threats.
  • Participate in continuous monitoring and security operations cycles aligned with DoD RMF requirements.
  • Contribute to the creation and refinement of SOC playbooks, detection use cases, and monitoring procedures.

Must hold an active Top Secret clearance, supported by a Tier 5 background investigation.

Education (Required)

Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Information Technology, Digital Forensics, or a related field.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in security monitoring, SOC operations, threat analysis, or cybersecurity investigation.
  • Experience analyzing logs and events from SIEM platforms.
  • Experience identifying suspicious activity, anomalous behavior, or indicators of compromise (IOCs).
  • Experience correlating data from multiple systems to assess potential threats.
  • Experience documenting findings and escalating incidents to senior cybersecurity staff.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

  • Strong understanding of SIEM platforms, log aggregation tools, and event correlation.

jobs.excerpt: SUMMARYWe are looking for a Machine Learning Scientist who is passionate about applying AI and ML to solve high-impact societal challenges.
jobs.description:
SUMMARY

We are looking for a Machine Learning Scientist who is passionate about applying AI and ML to solve high-impact societal challenges. The ideal candidate will have a strong research and/or applied background with 6+ years of relevant experience or a PhD, and expertise in designing and implementing machine learning models, data analysis, and simulations. Candidates with experience in Automated Speech Recognition (ASR) are preferred for this role. They should be skilled in mentoring junior researchers, working in cross-functional teams, and contributing to both practical deployments and academic research. A demonstrated commitment to social good, strong communication skills, and the ability to translate complex problems into deployable ML solutions are essential.

Preferred Location - Delhi

ABOUT US -

Wadhwani AI is a nonprofit institute building and deploying applied AI solutions to solve critical issues in public health, agriculture, education, and urban development in underserved communities in the global south. We collaborate with governments, social sector organizations, academic and research institutions, and domain experts to identify real-world problems and develop practical AI solutions to tackle these issues with the aim of making a substantial positive impact.

We have over 30+ AI projects supported by leading philanthropies such as Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation and Google. With a team of over 200 professionals, our expertise encompasses AI/ML research and innovation, software engineering, domain knowledge, design and user research.

In the Press:

  • Our Founder Donors are among the Top 100 AI Influencers

  • G20 India’s Presidency: AI Healthcare, Agriculture, & Education Solutions Showcased Globally.

  • Unlocking the potentials of AI in Public Health

  • Wadhwani AI Takes an Impact-First Approach to Applying Artificial Intelligence - data.org

  • Winner of the H&M Foundation Global Change Award 2022

  • Indian Winners of the 2019 Google AI Impact Challenge, and the first in the Asia Pacific to host Google Fellows

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • As an ML Scientist, you will be responsible for building machine learning solutions to problems of societal importance, and mentoring other team members in this effort. You will participate in problem definition and the development and execution of algorithms and solutions to the problems.

  • As an ASR expert, you will also be assisting in the design of evaluations for ASR solutions submitted for funding to the India AI mission at the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MEITy). You will play an advisory role in the execution of these evaluations.

  • In order to apply machine learning and related technologies for social good, you will need to understand user challenges and their context, curate and transform data, train and validate models, run simulations, and broadly derive insights from data. In doing so, you will work in cross-functional teams spanning engineering, solutions, domain experts, and designers. You will also work closely with social sector organisations, and are encouraged to collaborate with researchers across the world.

  • You will be encouraged to drive fundamental advances to the technology domains themselves as part of the efforts towards their application, present your work in technical and other forums of interest, and publish in leading conferences and journals.

  • At Wadhwani AI, excellence as an individual contributor goes hand-in-hand with good teamwork and collaboration. You will mentor junior researchers and interns, and participate in recruiting and hiring activities. You will also be expected to interact with external partners of Wadhwani AI when required, and to make periodic visits to the communities from where challenges are derived and where the solutions will be deployed.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Vulnerability Management Analyst to support enterprise cybersecurity operations across a federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. This role conducts vulnerability scanning, patch verification, security analysis, prioritization of findings, mitigation tracking, and updates to Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms). The analyst will help ensure systems remain compliant with DoD and federal cybersecurity controls by continuously identifying, validating, and monitoring vulnerabilities across cloud and on-premise environments.

The Vulnerability Management Analyst plays a key role in enhancing the security posture of mission systems by providing actionable insights, collaborating with engineering teams, and maintaining visibility into risk trends and remediation progress.

This position is fully remote.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Vulnerability Management Analyst will:

  • Conduct ACAS vulnerability scans across enterprise systems, applications, and cloud workloads.
  • Validate vulnerability scan results, confirm patch levels, and verify remediation status across environments.
  • Analyze vulnerabilities for exploitability, potential impact, and relevance to mission systems.
  • Prioritize vulnerabilities based on severity, risk scoring, operational context, and DoD guidance.
  • Coordinate with engineering, system administration, and cloud teams on mitigation steps and remediation timelines.
  • Update, track, and maintain POA&Ms with accurate vulnerability details and milestone progress.
  • Provide vulnerability summaries, dashboards, and reporting to cybersecurity leadership and government stakeholders.
  • Support continuous monitoring activities and reporting cycles in accordance with DoD RMF requirements.
  • Validate STIG-related findings and support configuration compliance checks.
  • Maintain ACAS scanning schedules, asset coverage, and scan completeness across environments.
  • Contribute to incident response efforts when vulnerabilities are linked to active threats.

Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • Experience updating POA&Ms, tracking mitigation progress, and supporting RMF continuous monitoring.
  • Experience performing patch verification and configuration-compliance checks.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

You are welcome to stay as a technical support engineer for as long as you'd like. However, we are open to working with you to transition you to a full time software engineering, pre-sales, or post-sales engineering role after 6-12 months.

jobs.description:
Marketing Lead

Role type: 1099 independent contractor, full time Location: Fully remote, LATAM

About First Principles

First Principles is a product consultancy founded by startup and enterprise product leaders. Our focus is AI-first product management training. We help enterprise product and technology teams put AI to work in the jobs they already do, responsibly and productively. Almost every large company is trying to solve this problem right now.

Our programs are customizable, not custom. Clients choose from a catalog of practitioner-led classes across AI foundations, AI-first product management, and building AI products. We shape the program around their budget, goals, timeline, approved tools, and governance rules. A program can be a few focused sessions or a full 12 to 16 week certification. It can run virtually, on-site, or as a mix of both, for cohorts ranging from dozens of people to a couple hundred.

So far we have run three cohorts for Elsevier Health and a product and design focused program for another enterprise client. We also just launched a hybrid program with a national healthcare company. Healthcare is where we started, not where we plan to stop.

The Role

You will be our first dedicated marketer, and you will own marketing for the training business from strategy through execution.

The job starts with making us look like the firm we actually are. That means a website, materials, and proof that hold up in front of senior enterprise buyers. From there, you build a top of funnel that gives our sales team real conversations to work with. You keep a steady rhythm going, measure what works, and cut what does not.

We want a brand that stands on the firm itself, not on any single person's voice. That brand rests on three things: our client results, our program, and the many practitioners who design and teach it.

We teach AI-first product work, so our marketing has to show that we practice it. We expect you to use AI heavily to research, produce, and adapt content, and to keep messaging consistent across channels. But our website, content, and strategy cannot read like AI slop. AI can do a lot of the heavy lifting on production. You make the calls on the story, the positioning, and what ships.

This is not a role where someone hands you a plan. You tell us what success looks like, how you will get there, and then you get it done.

Responsibilities

Website. Own our website end to end. It is a modern code-based site, not a drag-and-drop builder, and you will maintain it yourself using AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex. Your first big project is to:

  • pivot the site to be training-first
  • bring it up to date with how our programs work now: flexible length; virtual, on-site, or hybrid delivery; and the "customizable, not custom" framing
  • own conversion paths, forms, page speed, SEO basics, and analytics

Positioning and packaging. Work with the people who design and deliver our programs to turn a broad catalog into a few clear program shapes that are easy to describe, compare, and buy. Then write the language that goes with them.

Proof. Build a library of case studies, outcome data, and testimonials from the programs we run, within what our client agreements allow. Proof is our strongest marketing asset, and today we have published far less of it than we have earned.

Sales enablement and lead magnets. Partner with sales on the materials they use and the offers that start conversations. That includes the pitch deck, one-pagers, sample curricula, proposal templates, and lead magnets that give a product leader something genuinely useful. Sales brings what buyers are asking for. You bring the craft to make it sharp.

Channel mix. Define which channels we invest in and why, then execute. Shift the mix as the data comes in.

Measurement. Own our signal metrics, such as website traffic, engagement, followers, email list growth, inbound leads, and meetings sourced. Share a short weekly report. Run small, fast experiments and tell us plainly what is and is not working.

Budget. Own a monthly budget in the four to low five figures for tools, ads, materials, events, and outside specialists when you truly need them. Within that budget, you decide how to spend it. You do not need sign-off on every line item.

Partnership with sales. Work side by side with sales on target accounts, campaigns, follow-up, and messaging. They will tell you what they hear from buyers, and you will turn that into material that helps them close.

Know the space. Build and keep current your understanding of three things:

  • how product teams work
  • how AI is changing their work
  • where enterprises are getting stuck on AI adoption

Our team will help you get up to speed.

jobs.excerpt: Company overview:Blue Orange Digital is a data engineering and AI consultancy that builds production-grade data platforms, ML systems, and analytics solutions for companies that take their data seriously.
jobs.description:
Company overview:

Blue Orange Digital is a data engineering and AI consultancy that builds production-grade data platforms, ML systems, and analytics solutions for companies that take their data seriously. We are not a staff augmentation shop or a slide-deck consultancy. We are builders. Our teams embed directly into client engineering organizations, shipping code alongside their engineers to accelerate delivery and build lasting capability.

Our clients include Fortune 500 enterprises and high-growth startups across industries. We partner with Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, GCP, and Azure to deliver battle-tested solutions that drive measurable ROI.

About the Role

We are hiring the person who owns Databricks at Blue Orange Digital. Not a portion of it. All of it.

This role sits at the intersection of three things most companies split across three people. You architect the solution in the room with the prospect, you lead the build on the accounts that matter most, and you own the relationship with Databricks itself. That combination is deliberate. Clients buy from the architect who will actually be on their engagement, and Databricks field teams co-sell with partners whose technical leads they trust. One person carrying all three closes the gap between what we promise in the sales cycle and what we ship in production.

Day to day, you sit in discovery calls and technical deep-dives translating messy business problems into Lakehouse architectures that hold up under scrutiny. You write the architecture sections of our proposals and defend them to client CTOs and platform teams. When a deal closes on a major account, you stay on it as lead architect through design and into production, then hand off a system the client’s team can run without us.

The partnership half of the job puts you in front of Databricks account executives, solutions architects, and partner managers across regions. You build the co-sell motion, drive our tier and specialization roadmap, and make Blue Orange Digital the partner Databricks reps call first when an account needs implementation help. You will also raise the Databricks bar across our engineering org through internal enablement, certification paths, and reusable architecture patterns.

You will report to our Head of Delivery and work directly with the CEO and Head of Sales on partnership strategy. This is a senior seat with real authority over a growing part of the business.

What You Will Do

Pre-Sales Solutions Architecture

  • Lead technical discovery on Databricks opportunities, running architecture sessions with client engineering and data leadership

  • Design Lakehouse reference architectures covering Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, workflow orchestration, and Mosaic AI, sized to the client’s data volume, governance posture, and cost constraints

  • Own the technical content in proposals and SOWs, including architecture diagrams, migration approach, team composition, and effort estimates

  • Run proof-of-concept builds and technical bake-offs that demonstrate working code, not slideware

  • Serve as the technical authority in competitive evaluations against Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, and in-house Spark platforms, presenting trade-offs honestly rather than selling past the truth

  • Partner with Sales on qualification, flagging deals where Databricks is the wrong answer before we invest in a proposal

Delivery Leadership on Key Accounts

  • Act as lead architect on our largest Databricks engagements, staying accountable from kickoff through production handoff

  • Set the technical direction for engagement teams of three to six engineers, reviewing designs and code against Blue Orange Digital delivery standards

  • Resolve the hard problems: Spark performance tuning, Delta Lake optimization, Unity Catalog migration and governance design, cost runaway, and streaming architectures under real SLAs

  • Drive knowledge transfer so client teams operate what we build independently after handoff

  • Own escalations on strategic accounts and keep executive stakeholders informed with direct, unvarnished status

Databricks Channel Partnership Ownership

  • Serve as the primary technical relationship owner with Databricks field, partner, and product teams

  • Build and run the co-sell motion, generating partner-sourced pipeline and supporting Databricks-sourced opportunities end to end

  • Drive our partner tier advancement and Brickbuilder specialization roadmap, including the certification coverage and validated customer references each level requires

  • Represent Blue Orange Digital at Data + AI Summit, partner enablement sessions, and regional Databricks events

  • Produce technical marketing that earns credibility with the Databricks field: reference architectures, benchmarks, case studies, and conference talks

  • Build internal enablement so our engineers reach and maintain Databricks certification, and so every engagement team starts from proven patterns instead of a blank page

What You Bring

  • Eight or more years in data engineering, data architecture, or platform engineering, with at least four years architecting on Databricks in production environments

  • Solutions Architect level depth on the Databricks platform. You can whiteboard a multi-workspace Unity Catalog governance model, explain when Photon earns its cost, diagnose a skewed join from a Spark UI screenshot, and reason about Delta Lake file layout and liquid clustering under real workloads

  • Hands-on command of Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows, Delta Live Tables, MLflow, and Mosaic AI, plus fluency in at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and infrastructure as code

  • Demonstrated pre-sales experience. You have led technical discovery, authored proposal architecture, and won deals against credible competition

  • Delivery track record on enterprise engagements, including at least one large-scale migration to Databricks from a legacy warehouse, Hadoop, or a homegrown Spark platform

  • Executive communication skills. You hold your own with a CTO on strategy in one meeting and pair with a platform engineer on a notebook in the next

  • Experience working with or inside a technology partner ecosystem, whether at a consultancy, an SI, or a cloud or data platform vendor

  • Willingness to travel roughly 25 percent for client work, partner meetings, and industry events

Nice to Haves

  • Databricks Solutions Architect Champion accreditation, or the Data Engineer Professional, ML Engineer Professional, or Platform Architect certifications

  • Prior experience at Databricks, or at a Gold or Platinum tier Databricks consulting partner

  • Track record building a partner practice from early stage to a named tier or specialization

  • Production GenAI and agent work on Databricks, including RAG systems, Vector Search, Model Serving, and agent evaluation

  • Snowflake depth alongside Databricks, so you can advise clients running both platforms

  • Public technical presence: conference talks, published reference architectures, open source contributions, or a following in the Databricks community

  • Vertical depth in PE, financial services, healthcare, retail, or manufacturing

How We Measure Success

  • First 90 days: Ramped on our active Databricks engagements, introduced to the Databricks partner team, leading technical discovery on live opportunities

  • First 6 months: Owning the architecture on our largest Databricks account, running a defined co-sell motion, internal certification program underway

  • First 12 months: Measurable partner-sourced pipeline, a documented advance on tier or specialization, and a Databricks practice that scales past any single person

Compensation

Base salary plus a partnership performance bonus tied to Databricks-sourced pipeline and closed revenue. We benchmark Principal-level architect compensation against the top of the consulting market and pay for the credential, not the title.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base plus a bonus directly tied to the partnership you build

  • Full ownership of a growing practice, with executive support and no layers between you and the decision-makers

  • Work on production Databricks problems at real enterprise scale, across industries

  • Builder culture where engineers lead and ship, and where architecture decisions are made by people who write code

  • Professional development budget with certification support, conference attendance, and speaking opportunities

  • Flexible remote work environment

  • Collaborative team that values production-grade craftsmanship over billable theater

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • Paid parental/bereavement leave

Background checks may be required for certain positions/projects.

JOB TITLE: Coder - Outpatient

STATUS: Full-Time

SUMMARY

Review clinical documentation and diagnostic results to extract data and apply appropriate ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS codes for billing, internal and external reporting, research, and regulatory compliance. Demonstrate knowledge of reimbursement methodologies and apply these to assigned charts to optimize reimbursement and/or resolve regulatory edits. Resolve error reports associated with the billing process, identify and report error patterns, and, when necessary, assist in the design and implementation of workflow changes to reduce billing errors.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Abides by the Standards of Ethical Coding as set forth by the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA), adheres to official coding guidelines, and keeps abreast of coding changes and interpretation of codes.
  • Performs detailed review of Inpatient record documentation to identify & assign diagnosis & procedure codes using ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS.
  • Meets established departmental productivity guidelines with 95% accuracy on a consistent basis.
  • Utilizes Care Connect, UDS, and Clintegrity systems proficiently to obtain ICD10 codes and DRG assignment.
  • Formulates compliant Physician Coding Queries when documentation is inadequate, ambiguous, or unclear for coding purposes.
  • Corrects failed claim errors to billing edits, accounts misclassified and/or other errors identified through various auditing processes in a timely manner.
  • Provide assistance to customers (physicians, clinical quality staff) regarding clinical documentation opportunities, coding reimbursement issues, and quality improvement review process.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • One of the following certifications is required: Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Coding Specialist - Physician Based (CCS-P), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Professional Coder Hospital Based (CPC-H), Certified Medical Coder (CMC), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), Certified Professional Coder Apprentice CPC-A, or a specialty coding certification.
  • Candidates with an Associate degree from an accredited American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) are required to sit for the Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) exam within 1 year of hire.
  • At least 2 years of progressive coding experience in a hospital or multi-specialty physician practice setting preferred.
  • Full CPC certification must be obtained within 24 months if employee holds CPC-A from the American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC) at time of hire.
  • For HOMECARE: Homecare Diagnosis Coding Specialist (HCS-D) certification required within 16 months of hire.

Grandfather Clause: If hired on or before September 30, 2018, 2 years of relevant work experience and one of the following coding certification credentials: Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Coding Specialist - Physician Based (CCS-P), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Professional Coder - Hospital Based (CPC-H), Certified Medical Coder (CMC), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), or a specialty coding certification and Associate’s degree in Health Information Management are required.

EDUCATION:

AS: Health Information Management (Required)

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS:

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Sedentary - Sedentary roles are primarily office-based and require prolonged sitting (67–100% of the workday) with minimal physical effort and lifting limited to under 10 lbs. Fine motor skills are necessary for computer work, writing, and telephone use, supported by clear visual and auditory ability. Cognitive and emotional demands are high due to extended concentration, frequent interruptions, independent decision-making, and information processing. Although physical exposure is low, administrative areas within healthcare environments may occasionally involve contact with infectious agents. Some roles may require flexible hours, TB screening, or a valid driver’s license.

For disease specific care programs refer to the program specific requirements of the department for further specifications on experience and educational expectations, including continuing education requirements.

Any physical requirements reported by a prospective employee and/or employee’s physician or delegate will be considered for accommodations.

$20.75 - $29.50

Rochester

Kraus Hamdani Aerospace is seeking a hands-on IT & Systems Manager to own and scale the company's internal technology environment as we continue to grow.

This is a foundational role responsible for both the day-to-day delivery of employee IT support and the development of a secure, reliable, and scalable IT infrastructure. The successful candidate will manage end-user technology, systems administration, access and identity management, hardware and software lifecycle management, IT vendors, and core business applications while continuously identifying opportunities to improve automation, security, reliability, and employee experience.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys operating in a growing environment where they can both solve today's technical problems and build the systems and processes that prevent tomorrow's problems.

Key Responsibilities

IT Operations & Employee Support

  • Serve as the primary internal point of contact for employee IT support, troubleshooting hardware, software, account, connectivity, and access issues.
  • Own the employee technology onboarding and offboarding process, ensuring equipment and system access are provisioned or removed accurately and on time.
  • Configure, deploy, maintain, and support company laptops, peripherals, mobile devices, and other endpoint equipment.
  • Establish reliable processes for equipment procurement, configuration, shipping, recovery, replacement, and lifecycle management.
  • Maintain accurate hardware, software, licensing, warranty, and asset inventory records.
  • Develop service standards and escalation processes to ensure employees receive timely and consistent IT support.

Systems Administration & Identity Management

  • Administer the company's core technology platforms, user accounts, permissions, groups, licenses, and application access.
  • Establish and maintain scalable identity and access management practices, including role-based access, MFA, SSO, and least-privilege principles where appropriate.

  • Lead the planning and execution of the company's migration from Google Workspace Enterprise to Microsoft 365, including email, calendars, files, collaboration tools, identity and access considerations, data integrity, and user transition support.
  • Partner with functional leaders to understand system requirements and ensure employees have appropriate access to the tools required for their roles.
  • Support integrations and information flow between company systems where appropriate.

IT Infrastructure & Scalability

  • Assess the current IT environment and develop a prioritized roadmap for infrastructure, systems, tools, policies, and processes as the company scales.
  • Identify technology gaps, redundancies, manual processes, security risks, and opportunities for consolidation or automation.
  • Design systems and processes that can support increasing headcount, additional locations, remote employees, contractors, and international operations.
  • Establish consistent IT standards across company locations while accommodating legitimate site-specific requirements.
  • Evaluate new technology platforms and recommend solutions based on scalability, security, usability, cost, and business requirements.
  • Develop appropriate documentation, system inventories, architecture records, operating procedures, and administrative runbooks.

Security & Risk Management

  • Implement and maintain practical security controls across endpoints, accounts, applications, and company systems.
  • Manage endpoint security, patching, device configuration, encryption, authentication, and related administrative controls.
  • Regularly review user access and administrative privileges and address unnecessary or outdated permissions.
  • Support company cybersecurity, information-security, and compliance initiatives in partnership with leadership and other responsible stakeholders.
  • Assist with security incident response, account compromise, device loss, and other IT-related incidents.
  • Help develop and maintain business continuity, backup, recovery, and technology resilience practices.
  • Support security and compliance readiness appropriate to an aerospace and defense environment.

SaaS & Business Systems Administration

  • Maintain administrative oversight of the company's growing portfolio of business applications and technology vendors.
  • Establish clear ownership, access, licensing, renewal, and administrative standards for company systems.
  • Support the implementation, configuration, administration, and ongoing optimization of Salesforce, including user access, permissions, workflows, reporting, and integrations with other business systems.
  • Work with functional owners across Operations, Engineering, Manufacturing, Finance, People/Talent, and other teams to optimize system configuration and utilization.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive administrative workflows and improve integrations between systems.
  • Monitor software utilization and licensing to eliminate unnecessary cost and reduce application sprawl.

Vendor & Technology Management

  • Manage relationships with IT service providers, hardware suppliers, software vendors, carriers, and other technology partners.
  • Hold vendors accountable for service levels, delivery commitments, security requirements, and cost.
  • Evaluate when capabilities should be handled internally versus through external specialists or managed service providers.
  • Maintain visibility into IT spending and assist leadership with technology budgeting and forecasting.
  • Coordinate specialized outside resources when requirements exceed internal expertise.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in IT administration, systems administration, IT operations, infrastructure, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience independently supporting a broad employee technology environment.
  • Strong hands-on experience administering user accounts, permissions, endpoints, software, and cloud-based business systems.
  • Experience managing employee onboarding/offboarding and IT asset lifecycle processes.
  • Working knowledge of identity and access management, MFA, SSO, endpoint security, device management, patching, encryption, and backup/recovery principles.
  • Experience administering cloud productivity and collaboration platforms such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or comparable environments.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience planning, leading, or executing a migration from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365, including the migration of email, calendars, files, and collaboration services.
  • Experience with endpoint/device management technologies and modern SaaS administration.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot technical issues across hardware, software, networking, accounts, and applications.
  • Experience documenting systems, establishing repeatable procedures, and improving immature or highly manual IT processes.
  • Strong vendor-management and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities independently in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to support employees with varying levels of technical proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, administering, and optimizing Salesforce, including workflow automation, reporting, permissions, integrations, and platform enhancements.
  • Experience building or scaling the IT function within a startup, growth-stage company, or similarly dynamic environment.
  • Experience supporting a distributed workforce across multiple offices, remote employees, and international locations.
  • Aerospace, defense, government contractor, advanced manufacturing, robotics, or other highly technical industry experience.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity and compliance frameworks applicable to government contractors or regulated environments, such as NIST 800-171, CMMC, or related requirements.
  • Experience with automation, scripting, APIs, or low-code workflow tools.
  • Experience implementing or administering SSO/IAM, MDM, endpoint protection, ticketing, asset-management, and monitoring platforms.
  • Experience participating in technology audits, security assessments, or compliance-readiness initiatives.
  • Experience selecting and implementing new IT platforms rather than solely administering established environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Hands-on builder: Comfortable moving between strategic planning and direct technical execution.
  • Process-oriented: Looks beyond individual problems to identify and correct the process that allowed them to occur.
  • Scalability-minded: Considers whether today's solution will continue to work as headcount, locations, and complexity increase.

About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

Job Title: Principal AI Solutions Architect

Job Summary:As a Principal AI Solutions Architect, you will lead the design, construction, and deployment of AI solutions that combine the power of graph databases and AI. You will act as a trusted advisor to our strategic customers, guiding them through complex data challenges and delivering transformative business value. You will have a great understanding of graph technologies, LLMs, and AI frameworks, and will be able to translate customer needs into production-ready AI applications grounded in real-world context using Neo4j Knowledge Graphs.

Key Responsibilities:

Solution Architecting:

  • You will engage with technical leaders, stakeholders, and strategic partners to shape and guide the successful implementation of Graph+GenAI solutions, serving as a trusted advisor and thought partner to decision-makers throughout complex, high-impact engagements.
  • You will design and advocate for robust, scalable solution architectures, leading the deployment of Graph+GenAI systems aligned with complex enterprise requirements and industry best practices driving architectural excellence and long-term value.
  • You will collaborate closely with customer leadership to deeply understand their strategic objectives, translating them into high-impact AI solutions that harness the synergy of graph databases and LLMs. This includes leading the discovery of requirements, assessing enterprise data ecosystems, and identifying innovative opportunities to apply graph-based AI at scale.
  • You will lead stakeholder engagement across all levels to steer project scope, align on priorities, mitigate risks, and ensure timely delivery—ensuring alignment between technical execution and business outcomes while maintaining a focus on measurable impact

Solution Engineering:

  • You will develop, test, and deploy production-ready AI applications that integrate graph databases with LLMs and orchestration frameworks. This involves writing production-level code, optimizing for performance and scalability, and ensuring seamless integration with customer systems.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve the performance, scalability, and efficiency of deployed AI applications, incorporating new techniques and technologies as they emerge.

Education & Enablement:

  • You will work with other teams at Neo4j (Product and Marketing) to influence the roadmap and provide insights from the field, and package approaches, best practices, and lessons learned into thought leadership, methodologies, and published assets.
  • You will share your expertise internally with other Neo4j teams and also with customers through workshops, training sessions, and documentation to empower them to effectively utilize, maintain, and reproduce the AI solutions you deliver.
  • Maintain continuous learning and stay up-to-date with the rapidly evolving GenAI landscape, proactively seeking knowledge of new trends and technologies.

Required Qualifications:

  • Enterprise Application Architecture: 10+ years of experience architecting and delivering enterprise-grade applications, with a deep understanding of the full software development lifecycle and the ability to guide teams through complex design and implementation decisions.
  • LLM Proficiency: 5+ years of Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and integrating LLMs into applications. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of different LLM providers and their strengths and limitations, as well as open-source ones).
  • Programming Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in at least one major programming language (e.g., Java, JavaScript, Python, or C#), with a proven track record of delivering clean, maintainable, and scalable code within complex systems.
  • Deployment and Version Control: Deep hands-on experience with deployment tooling across Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes environments, along with expert-level use of version control systems (e.g., Git, SVN) in enterprise development workflows.
  • Cloud Computing Expertise: Demonstrated expertise in deploying and scaling applications across cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), with a strategic understanding of cloud-native architecture and DevOps best practices.
  • Generative AI Ecosystem Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of the generative AI ecosystem, including frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack) and familiarity with cloud-native AI platforms (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure ML), enabling you to architect end-to-end AI solutions.
  • Data & Analytics Fluency: Strong background in data engineering, analytics, or data science, with the ability to design data pipelines and workflows across structured and unstructured data. Hands-on experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Hive) and database systems (SQL and NoSQL)
  • Graph Database Authority: Deep expertise in graph data modeling and query languages (e.g., Cypher), along with practical experience working with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph) or triple stores (e.g., Ontotext, Stardog), enabling advanced knowledge graph applications
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills: Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and align technical decisions with business goals.
  • Problem-Solving and Analytical Abilities: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to break down complex problems, architect AI solutions, and mentor teams through implementation
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% to engage with customers, lead strategic discussions and ensure successful project execution.

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

About the Commercial Finance Manager role:

The Commercial Finance Manager is responsible for leading Royal Voluntary Service's (RVS) commercial finance, investment appraisal and business partnering activities, ensuring that strategic investment decisions are underpinned by robust financial analysis and deliver maximum value for the organisation.

Reporting to the Head of Finance Business Partnering, the role provides commercial finance leadership across the organisation, partnering closely with Executive Directors and operational leaders to improve financial performance, strengthen investment decision-making and maximise return on investment.

The role will lead Finance Business Partnering for Retail whilst also acting as the organisation's centre of excellence for investment appraisal, pricing strategy, treasury optimisation and commercial financial modelling.

This is a highly visible role requiring strong commercial acumen, analytical capability and the ability to influence strategic decisions across the organisation.

Hours:35 hours a week, Monday to Friday
Location: Home based within the UK, with occasional national travel

What you'll bring as our Commercial Finance Manager:

We are looking for someone who combines strong commercial finance expertise with excellent business partnering skills.

  • Strong financial modelling capability.
  • Excellent influencing skills.
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Strong analytical capability.
  • A collaborative approach.
  • Commercial curiosity.
  • Excellent communication skills.

Sales Enablement

Please click here to apply through our internal career site Find Jobs - Elekta.

We don’t just build technology. We build hope for everyone dealing with Cancer.


Elekta is shaping the standard of care, together with healthcare providers, by developing precision radiation medicine that brings advanced radiotherapy into routine clinical practice. Our solutions support consistent, efficient and personalized care, addressing evolving patient needs. Through adaptive radiotherapy, precision treatment delivery and integrated workflows, Elekta supports care teams across a range of clinical settings. Each year more than 2 million patients are treated using Elekta solutions across over 130 countries. Elekta is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, with over 4,000 employees and offices in more than 40 countries. The company is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. For more information, visit elekta.com.

Customer Growth & Success Director – Cancer Registry

What You’ll Do At Elekta

As Customer Growth & Success Director – Cancer Registry, you will lead customer success across Elekta’s Cancer Registry business area, helping strengthen customer relationships, retention, adoption, growth and long-term value.

Reporting to the Head of Cancer Registry and working as part of the Cancer Registry management team, you will serve as a key voice of the customer within the business. You will build trusted relationships across our customer base, develop a deep understanding of customer priorities and challenges, and translate those insights into practical solutions, commercial opportunities and actionable product feedback.

This is a highly customer-facing role for someone who combines deep Cancer Registry expertise with a proactive approach to problem-solving and strong commercial judgment. You will work closely with customers and collaborate across Sales, Application Support, Service, Product Management, Engineering and Marketing to improve customer outcomes and help shape the continued development of our Cancer Registry business.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute a customer success strategy focused on customer relationships, retention, win-back, expansion, adoption and long-term customer value.
  • Build trusted relationships through frequent and proactive engagement with customers, developing a current understanding of their priorities, satisfaction, risks, adoption barriers and opportunities.
  • Establish effective customer health and engagement practices and use customer insights to identify emerging needs, risks and opportunities.
  • Gather and assess feedback from customers and customer-facing teams, distinguishing individual requests from broader patterns and prioritizing opportunities based on urgency, business impact and strategic relevance.
  • Work directly with customers to understand operational, workflow, product and data challenges, identify root causes and develop practical solutions.
  • Coordinate with internal specialists when additional expertise is needed, maintaining clear customer communication, momentum and accountability through resolution.
  • Partner closely with Sales to support customer retention, win-back, upsell, cross-sell and new business opportunities.
  • Apply customer, market and competitive insights to strengthen Elekta’s positioning and identify opportunities to create additional customer value.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of Cancer Registry operations, reporting and accreditation requirements, customer workflows, METRIQ, Registry Informatics and related solutions, integrations, market developments and competitors.
  • Translate field insights into actionable input for Product Management, Engineering, Marketing and Sales.
  • Share Cancer Registry expertise through customer working sessions, webinars, forums, communications and educational content.
  • Represent the Cancer Registry business at NCRA and other relevant industry events, and partner with Marketing on customer advocacy, messaging and customer stories.
  • Track customer success measures including retention, win-back, expansion, customer health, satisfaction, adoption and commercial opportunities, using these insights to prioritize action and improve outcomes.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
  • At least 8 years of relevant experience in Cancer Registry operations, customer success, sales, account management, service, oncology informatics, healthcare IT or a related healthcare data field.
  • Strong knowledge of Cancer Registry operations, workflows, reporting requirements, accreditation and regulatory environments, and the needs of registry professionals and healthcare organizations.
  • Understanding of the Cancer Registry and healthcare data ecosystem, including software platforms, integrations, data exchange, third-party services, market trends and competitive solutions.
  • Experience with cancer registry software; familiarity with METRIQ, Registry Informatics or comparable platforms is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted customer relationships and work through complex operational, product, workflow and data challenges toward practical solutions.
  • Strong analytical and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance urgency, customer and business impact, strategic relevance and available resources.
  • Ability to communicate customer feedback, emerging risks and changing customer sentiment clearly, objectively and constructively.
  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to connect customer needs, domain expertise and competitive insight with retention, growth and sales opportunities.
  • A proactive, resourceful, and action-oriented approach, combined with a collaborative and credible customer presence.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex registry, product, workflow and data topics accessible to technical, operational and executive audiences.

What You’ll Get

  • Opportunity to work with a proactive and supportive team
  • Excellent Medical, Dental and Vision coverage
  • 401k, paid Vacation and Holiday
  • A health of additional benefits including wellness reimbursement, tuition reimbursement and flexible spending account , or health savings account
  • Opportunity to work on cutting edge in medical advancement
  • Close-knit company culture
  • Upward mobility

Salary:

The US base salary range for this position is $135,000-$165,000

Application Process

We look forward to receiving your application. Please submit your resume in English via the “Apply” button. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Here at Elekta, you will make a difference. We are a MedTech company that provides software and hardware to hospitals and clinics all over the world.

We have a responsibility toward our partners and customers to deliver solutions in a secure and sustainable way. Both when it comes to financial and environmental matters, but also for our employees to feel that they bring value, wherever in the organization they may work.

Salesforce Developer

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Developer to design, develop, enhance, and maintain Salesforce solutions supporting a large-scale federal healthcare modernization program.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flow, integrations, and modern Salesforce development practices.

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain Salesforce applications and enhancements.
  • Develop custom functionality using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, and Salesforce Flow.
  • Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications using REST/SOAP APIs and other integration technologies.
  • Translate functional and technical requirements into efficient Salesforce solutions.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Architects to implement solutions aligned with enterprise architecture and platform standards.
  • Develop reusable components, services, and frameworks that improve scalability and maintainability.
  • Participate in code reviews and follow established Salesforce development standards.

  • Support unit, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing activities.
  • Develop and maintain appropriate technical documentation.
  • Support Salesforce releases, deployments, environment management, and production implementations.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with DevSecOps teams to support automated build, testing, and deployment processes.
  • Work with administrators and business teams to determine when declarative versus custom development is appropriate.
  • Ensure solutions align with applicable federal security, privacy, accessibility, and governance requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of software development experience, including significant hands-on Salesforce development experience.
  • Strong proficiency with Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Experience with Salesforce Flow and declarative platform capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of SOQL, SOSL, Salesforce data models, and platform security.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with external applications using REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Experience developing solutions within Salesforce Lightning Experience.
  • Experience with version control and source-driven development.
  • Experience supporting Salesforce testing, releases, and production deployments.
  • Knowledge of object-oriented programming and software development best practices.
  • Experience working within Agile development environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting federal government, federal healthcare, or health IT programs.
  • Experience with Salesforce Government Cloud or Salesforce implementations within highly regulated environments.
  • Experience with Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Health Cloud.
  • Experience with MuleSoft or other enterprise integration platforms.
  • Experience with Salesforce DX and modern DevOps/CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub, or similar delivery tools.
  • Experience supporting enterprise modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.

Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II
  • Salesforce Platform App Builder
  • Salesforce JavaScript Developer I
  • Other relevant Salesforce certifications

Job purpose:

The GSK global corporate web estate is a central and vital hub in our digital communications ecosystem owned and managed by Communications and Government Affairs. It is a dynamic channel for providing essential company information to reflect GSK’s focus on delivering growth and accelerating R&D. Our commitment to continuous improvement through thoughtful design, strong functionality and seamless user experience ensures we set a high benchmark for digital communications.

As digital delivery manager you will ensure the GSK.com platform remains a nimble and technically excellent communications platform serving both human visitors and AI models. You will be the bridge between CGA and Tech, supporting communication goals, running the development cycle, ensuring compliance, security, optimal performance, and rapid troubleshooting by effectively orchestrating relevant teams.

Key responsibilities:

  • Deliver digital web projects across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Provide expert web content management support with technical proficiency in Umbraco CMS and guidance on digital quality best practices.
  • Support environment infrastructure and cloud hosting decisions identifying technical requirements, overseeing website migrations, and optimizing performance with cache strategies and CDNs.
  • Mitigate cybersecurity risks through secure codebase practices and implementing robust testing protocols for new technologies.
  • Leverage expertise in data analytics platforms including Google Business Intelligence to inform decisions and translate requirements into technical development and content changes.
  • Engage with GSK Tech on mandatory technology infrastructure rollouts to support seamless delivery to the corporate web estate.
  • Provide support for rapid issue resolution impacting the corporate web estate’s ability to deliver time sensitive communications and compliance obligations to external audiences.

Why You?

  • 10+ years with demonstrable technical qualifications and experience in web delivery.
  • Experience of pharmaceutical industry and operating in a highly regulated environment.
  • Experience of working cross-functionally and using networks across GSK.
  • Experience providing expert web content management support with technical proficiency in Umbraco CMS.
  • Experience driving continuous improvement across web performance, accessibility and visibility leveraging AI where appropriate.
  • Able to support environment infrastructure and cloud hosting decisions by identifying technical requirements, overseeing website migrations, optimizing performance with cache strategies and CDNs, and mitigating cybersecurity risks through secure codebase practices and robust testing protocols for new technologies.
  • Expertise in data analytics platforms including Google Business Intelligence to inform decisions and translate requirements into channel development improvements.
  • Proven ability in rapid issue resolution across web applications

  • Flexible mindset to adapt and deliver channel priorities for GSK.

CMS: Umbraco, a leading open-source .NET CMS

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Position Type:

Permanent

If you’re looking for a fulfilling career that can make a real difference in your life, and the lives of others, you’ve come to the right place.

As a national health solutions partner, we put people first in everything we do — and that begins with our team of 8,000+ professionals who bring a cross-section of diverse life experiences and career expertise to Medavie. By collaborating and innovating together, our employees are creating industry-leading solutions in insurance, primary care and emergency medical services that impact millions of lives in Canada each year.

Our mission is to improve the wellbeing of Canadians so that every life can be lived to the fullest — and it’s reflected in our award-winning culture. We celebrate individuality and value the diverse perspectives and skills our employees contribute. We go beyond providing competitive pay and comprehensive benefits to offer opportunities for personal and professional growth, flexible work options, meaningful experiences, and supportive leadership. Medavie is where employees can be their best selves, feel they belong, and achieve their full potential. Be part of it by applying for a position with us today.

The Opportunity

Medavie is maturing our information technology procurement practice and is seeking an IT Procurement Specialist who is passionate about enterprise technology strategic sourcing and procurement activities. The work aligns procurement activities with business objectives, technology roadmaps, and organizational priorities to deliver measurable business value.


The successful candidate will approach procurement as a strategic capability that enables business success through effective partnerships, efficient processes, and value-driven decision making. The IT Procurement Specialist works closely with internal and external partners to advise, manage procurement pathways, ensure appropriate commercial conditions, and make purchases that balance value, risk, speed. This role requires a customer-centric approach with a skillset in strategic sourcing, negotiation, market research, cost-effective deals, contract optimization, supplier management, stakeholder engagement, and continuous improvement.


Our IT Procurement team is evolving; we're looking for another team member who embraces continuous improvement, brings fresh perspectives, and is excited to contribute to the advancement of our procurement capabilities.

  • Manage IT Procurement Activities: Coordinate the procurement and renewal of IT hardware, software, and services while ensuring compliance and supporting business objectives.
  • Support Supplier Management: Build and maintain supplier relationships, monitor performance, contribute to contract negotiations, and help drive improvements in value, quality, innovation, and risk management.
  • Identify Cost Optimization Opportunities: Analyze spending and support initiatives that improve commercial outcomes through contract optimization, standardization, consolidation, and demand management.

  • Enhance Processes and Tools: Identify opportunities to streamline, standardize, and automate procurement processes while maintaining documentation, templates, training materials, and playbooks.

  • Ensure Compliance: Help ensure procurement activities comply with legal, regulatory, and organizational requirements.

What You Bring

  • Experience: Minimum 4 years of experience in IT procurement and supplier management, with a proven track record of managing complex IT procurements
  • Certification: Certification in procurement or supply chain management (PMAC/SCMP/ISM/CTPE) are nice to have.

Skills:

  • Commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and communication skills
  • Expertise in spend analysis, demand management, and sourcing strategies
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Proficiency in procurement methodologies, software and tools
  • Knowledge of IT products and services
  • Expertise in legal and regulatory requirements
  • Strong customer-service and relationship management skills
  • Demonstrated continuous improvement mindset (process, procurement methodologies, operating model) and ability to lead change initiatives
  • Experience developing procurement policies, playbooks, or training material
  • Excellent coordination and organizational skills

Language Skills: English, written and spoken required. French, written and spoken would be considered an asset.


Security Clearance Requirement

  • In conjunction with our contract with the Federal Government, you will be required to have Reliability Status Clearance (Enhanced Level B). This includes Fingerprinting, Criminal Record Check, Credit Check and you must have resided in Canada for at least 5 years and hold Permanent Resident or Citizenship Status

What’s in it for you?

What makes us a different kind of employer? Our award-winning culture, a team who really cares, unmatched training and support are all dedicated to ensuring you are set up for success.

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

The Zscaler Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals who are passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing their expertise to lead a secure, cloud-enabled digital future and further cement our position as the world leader in cloud security. Sales, Customer Success, Sales Enablement, Solution Architects, Business Development, Transformation, and Technology Partnerships all work together to demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation to the world.

About the Role

We are looking for an Account Executive in Higher Education, covering the Southeast, to join our Sales and Go-to-Market team. Reporting to the Regional Director. You will be part of a global group of professionals passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. By demonstrating the power and agility of cloud transformation, you will help cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Build relationships with important internal and customer stakeholders, including c-suite decision-makers

  • Create a long-term account strategy aligned with customer goals

  • Collaborate with internal teams to meet customer needs and contribute to comprehensive account planning

  • Act as a trusted advisor by understanding client businesses and aligning technical solutions with their strategic goals

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)
