jobs.excerpt: About TuringTuring’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress.
jobs.description:
About Turing

Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at .

Role: Senior DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer

Location: Brazil

Experience Level: 5+ years in cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering

Work Model: Remote within Brazil, with regular working-hour overlap with U.S. Pacific Time and participation in a global on-call rotation

Why Join Turing?

Join Turing's global Infrastructure Engineering team and help build the cloud infrastructure and developer platform that power our business. You will make the systems engineers rely on more reliable, secure, scalable, and efficient as the company grows.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys turning manual work into durable automation, solving difficult production problems, and raising the bar for operational excellence. You will work across cloud infrastructure, reliability, developer tooling, and security in close partnership with application and security teams.

You will have meaningful ownership in a globally distributed team: working regularly with colleagues in U.S. Pacific Time, participating in the shared on-call rotation, and building systems that allow engineers to ship faster with confidence.

As the Senior DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer, You Will

Own Multi-Cloud Reliability

Operate and continuously improve production infrastructure across GCP, AWS, and Azure. Lead incident response, troubleshoot complex issues, drive root-cause remediation, and improve monitoring, logging, alerting, performance, capacity, and cloud-cost efficiency.

Build the Developer Platform

Build and support engineering platforms, release pipelines, and deployment automation using GitHub Actions, Google Cloud Build, Jenkins, and related tooling. Develop reusable Terraform modules and automate workflows with Python, Go, Shell, or similar technologies.

Operate Production Kubernetes

Run production Kubernetes and GKE environments across deployment, scaling, networking, security, observability, and troubleshooting. Build infrastructure that is secure and scalable without making engineering teams slower.

Secure Infrastructure by Default

Design and troubleshoot cloud networking, including VPCs, firewalls, load balancers, routing, DNS, and WAFs. Partner with security and engineering teams on identity and access management, secrets management, network security, and broader infrastructure-security controls.

Raise the Operating Standard

Use AI-assisted engineering tools to improve log analysis, debugging, troubleshooting, and optimization. Collaborate on scalable architectures and production best practices, mentor engineers, and lead initiatives that improve reliability, security, and developer productivity.

The Anti-Sell

On-call is part of the job: You will participate in a shared global on-call rotation, respond to production incidents, and carry work through root-cause analysis and durable remediation.

Broad infrastructure ownership: This is not a narrow CI/CD or cloud-administration role. You will work across GCP, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, developer tooling, networking, security, and reliability.

Hands-on engineering required: The role is for a builder who can write automation, develop Terraform modules, troubleshoot production systems, and make technical decisions directly.

Global-team cadence: Regular working-hour overlap with U.S. Pacific Time is expected. Clear communication and dependable collaboration across time zones are core to the role.

Our Senior DevOps & Infrastructure Engineers Typically Have

Production GCP experience: Typically 5+ years in cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including hands-on ownership of GCP production environments.

Infrastructure-as-code and delivery fluency: Independent experience with Terraform, CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Cloud Deploy, or equivalents, and production Kubernetes.

Cloud and networking depth: Strong knowledge of cloud architecture, distributed systems, VPCs, firewalls, load balancers, WAFs, and securing cloud environments.

Automation capability: Strong scripting or programming skills in Python, Go, Shell, or equivalent technologies, with a bias toward replacing manual work with repeatable systems.

Operational ownership: Experience handling complex incidents, conducting root-cause analysis, communicating clearly, and following through on improvements that prevent recurrence.

Top-Tier Candidates Will Have

  • Independent operational experience in AWS or Azure alongside GCP.
  • Experience with configuration-management tooling such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet.
  • Experience securing containers across Docker, Kubernetes, or GKE.
  • Experience with advanced GCP controls, including Organization Policies, VPC Service Controls, Access Context Manager, and Binary Authorization.
  • Google Cloud Professional certifications or comparable cloud credentials.

Values

  • We are client first: We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are AI forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

  • Work at the frontier of AI, helping the world’s leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first-of-a-kind benchmarks.
  • Contribute to leading-edge AI research and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.
  • Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real-world business challenges.
  • Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies.
  • Move at the pace of AI innovation, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup.

jobs.description:
COMPANY:

At BioCryst, we share a deep commitment to improving the lives of people living with hereditary angioedema (HAE) and other rare diseases. We leverage our expertise in structure-guided drug design to develop first-in-class or best-in-class oral small-molecule and injectable protein therapeutics. Our global headquarters is in Durham, North Carolina, we have a regional office in Boston, Massachusetts, and our employees span the globe across sites in multiple countries. We are proud of our culture of engagement and accountability that rewards people for innovative thinking and achievement of key objectives. For more information, please visit our website at or follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.


JOB SUMMARY:


The Director, Scientific Communications serves as a senior leader responsible for developing and executing scientific engagement priorities across assigned therapeutic areas, assets, and lifecycle stages, including launch execution in highly competitive environments. This role requires deep Medical Affairs experience and the ability to translate clinical evidence, disease-state expertise, external insights, and business priorities into strategic scientific direction.

Working across Medical Affairs and in close partnership with Medical Education & Communication and other cross-functional partners, this leader will drive external expert engagement, advisory board planning, stakeholder strategies, insight-generation activities, and scientific input to launch and lifecycle planning. The role ensures alignment between external scientific engagement, Medical Affairs objectives, communication planning, and organizational priorities while supporting compliant scientific exchange.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Lead scientific engagement priorities for assigned assets, indications, or therapeutic areas across disease-state strategy, launch planning, lifecycle management, and evidence dissemination.
  • Interpret clinical, translational, real-world, and competitive evidence into strategic scientific direction that informs Medical Affairs planning and priorities along with external engagement.
  • Lead external expert engagement, advisory board planning, KOL and stakeholder strategies, and insight-generation activities to inform scientific and medical priorities.
  • Lead Medical Education and Communications direct reports and related activities to ensure scientific engagement insights, external expert perspectives, and Medical Affairs priorities are reflected in communication planning and related deliverables.
  • Provide strategic scientific input to congress planning, medical education, field medical resources, and external communication planning in collaboration with Medical Education and Communications and cross-functional partners.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Publications, Regulatory, Commercial, Market Access, Field Medical, and Patient Advocacy to ensure scientific alignment and coordinated execution.
  • Advance launch readiness and lifecycle excellence in highly competitive environments by aligning external insights, stakeholder engagement priorities, scientific direction, field medical enablement, congress strategy, and Medical Affairs planning.
  • Monitor the scientific, clinical, regulatory, and competitive landscape to identify implications for scientific engagement, education, stakeholder planning, and lifecycle priorities.
  • Ensure scientific engagement activities and related inputs are accurate, balanced, evidence-based, strategically aligned, and compliant with applicable policies and review processes.
  • Oversee agency and vendor partners supporting scientific engagement activities, including scope development, budget stewardship, timeline management, quality oversight, and performance feedback.
  • Ensure finance & governance discipline to scientific engagement and medical education and communication activities, including budget forecasting, resource prioritization, compliant review processes, and responsible management of project spend.
  • Serve as a scientific advisor and subject matter expert, supporting leadership decision-making and executive-level communication of complex scientific topics.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:


Basic Qualifications and Experience:

  • Advanced scientific or clinical degree required, such as PharmD, PhD, MD, DO, or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in Medical Affairs, scientific engagement, field medical, medical education, publications, Clinical Development, or related pharmaceutical/biotechnology functions.
  • Demonstrated success leading scientific engagement initiatives that support disease-state education, external expert engagement, launch readiness, evidence dissemination, and lifecycle priorities.
  • Advanced scientific acumen, with the ability to interpret complex clinical, translational, real-world, and competitive evidence and translate data into strategic scientific direction.
  • Experience developing and executing KOL, external expert, advisory board, stakeholder engagement, and insight-generation plans within a compliant Medical Affairs environment.
  • Substantial experience supporting launch readiness, launch execution in highly competitive environments, or lifecycle optimization through external insights, stakeholder engagement, field medical enablement, congress input, and Medical Affairs planning.
  • Proven ability to partner effectively with Medical Education and Communications and collaborate across Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Publications, Regulatory, Commercial, Market Access, Field Medical, external experts, and agency partners.
  • Comprehensive understanding of pharmaceutical industry compliance requirements, medical/legal/regulatory review processes, and ethical standards governing scientific exchange.
  • Exceptional communication, collaboration, project leadership, and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to influence effectively in a matrixed environment.
  • Ability to operate with executive presence, strategic agility, and rigorous attention to scientific accuracy, operational excellence, compliance, and business priorities.

Preferred Qualifications and Experience:

  • Experience in rare disease, immunology, or other relevant therapeutic areas; preferred experience across multiple therapeutic areas with the ability to quickly develop disease-state fluency and apply scientific engagement approaches across diverse clinical landscapes.
  • Prior leadership experience in Medical Affairs roles focused on scientific engagement, external expert engagement, advisory board planning, insight generation, or field medical enablement.
  • Experience partnering with Medical Education and Communications, Publications, or agency partners to translate scientific insights and Medical Affairs priorities into aligned communication planning.
  • Experience working in matrix environments, including collaboration with priority markets and cross-functional launch teams.
  • Experience with evidence generation planning, real-world evidence interpretation, advisory board planning, or investigator-sponsored research processes.
  • Demonstrated success providing oversight of agency partners, managing budgets, and delivering high-quality scientific engagement activities within established timelines.

The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Job Summary

The Director of Business Development (BDR) is a senior go‑to‑market leader accountable for building, scaling, and optimizing a global inbound and outbound BDR organization. This role owns top‑of‑funnel strategy and execution, delivering predictable, high‑quality pipeline through improved conversion, velocity, and tight alignment with Sales, Marketing, Product Marketing, Communications, and Revenue Operations.

The Director leverages AI, data, and modern enablement platforms to increase BDR productivity and quality, effectiveness, and insight and ensure consistent, high‑quality execution across public sector (SLED/SMG), Enterprise, and Destination Marketing segments. The mandate is to power revenue growth through a disciplined, scalable, insight‑driven pipeline engine while developing a high‑performing team and strengthening cross‑functional GTM cohesion. That includes:

  • Driving pipeline creation across new and existing accounts

  • Multi‑threading outreach across buying groups and decision‑makers
  • Accelerating pipeline by re‑engaging stalled or at‑risk opportunities
  • Routing buyers into compounding marketing motions, including events, demand generation, and ABM programs across multiple segments.
  • Building an amazing team culture focused on collaboration and shared accountability.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • Strategy, Pipeline & Market Development

    • Drive predictable pipeline growth across inbound and outbound channels; improve stage‑to‑stage conversion using data‑driven experimentation.
    • Identify new markets, segments, and partnership opportunities; provide market and customer insights to refine messaging and targeting.
    • Leverage AI and automation to improve prioritization, personalization, rep efficiency, and pipeline velocity.
    • Understand the differing requirements for your team to engage Executive (C-Suite) and functionally led persona’s.

    • Lead and develop a ~60‑person global BDR organization, including frontline managers and team leads; hire, ramp, coach, and promote top talent.
    • Establish KPIs, quotas, operating cadences, and accountability systems to drive consistent performance.
    • Maintain a culture of execution excellence, inclusion, and career progression into AE/CSM roles.
  • Execution Quality & Operational Excellence
    • Own and improve playbooks, call scripts, persona‑based sequences for Executives (C-Suite) vs. Functional leaders, automation vs. manual operating models, qualification standards, and handoff processes.
    • Ensure execution quality through coaching, QA reviews, speed‑to‑lead adherence, and segment specific messaging alignment.
    • Oversee technology adoption (Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft, Gong, ZoomInfo) and partner with RevOps on data integrity and analytics
  • Cross‑Functional GTM Alignment
    • Partner with Sales leadership on coverage models, ICP alignment, AE handoff, MEDDPICC and Challenger methodologies, and early‑stage deal progression.
    • Collaborate with Marketing and PMM to develop integrated campaigns, sequences, and feedback loops that improve relevance and ROI.
    • Translate market and customer insights into actionable GTM improvements and executive‑ready reporting.

    You Will Love This Job If You Have

    • 10+ years in business development, sales development, or revenue leadership within SaaS or technology
    • Demonstrated success leading large, distributed BDR/SDR teams and delivering measurable pipeline growth
    • Strong command of outbound, inbound, ABM/ABS motions, pipeline analytics, and conversion optimization
    • Experience implementing AI‑driven or data‑driven tools to enhance prospecting, prioritization, and coaching.
    • Expertise with Salesforce and modern sales engagement platforms.
    • Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and cross‑functional collaboration skills
    • Direct experience in public sector, GovTech, or regulated markets, including Federal, State, and Local government
    • Experience supporting international GTM motions across distributed, geographically diverse teams

    Pay Range

    USD $120,000.00 - USD $130,000.00 /Yr.

If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

We believe that focusing on the small stuff, pixel-by-pixel and task-by-task, leads to big gains.

Blue River Technology works within John Deere’s vision to “innovate on behalf of humanity” by quickly identifying and solving high-value, high-uncertainty challenges in the fields of AI, machine learning, computer vision, and robotics. BRT acts as a research and development flywheel, building not only new products but new platforms that reliably create value for both Deere and its customers. From fully autonomous machines to highly precise farming equipment, BRT & Deere are partnering to create technical breakthroughs across industries like agriculture, construction, and commercial mowing.

Our people are at the heart of what we do. Through cross-disciplinary collaboration, this mission-driven team is eager to define the new frontier of robotics. We ask hard questions, iterate quickly, and get our boots in the field to figure it out. We won’t give up until we’ve made a tangible and positive impact on the planet!

Blue River Technology is based in Santa Clara, CA.

Autonomous machines are revolutionizing large-scale agriculture. At John Deere, we’re not starting from scratch; we’re building on proven leadership to scale autonomous machines globally. We are seeking an experienced product manager to define what great autonomous products look like, partner closely with engineering leaders, and work with commercial teams to accelerate growth. To succeed in this role, you’ll need to love making sense out of ambiguous problems, thrive when charting a new course, and possess the cultural athleticism to work effectively in both the worlds of hard iron and Silicon Valley. jobs.description:
Role Title: Semiconductor Engineering Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay:$80- $185/hour

Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role

Location: Fully remote

You’ll need: Master’s or PhD in electrical engineering, materials, physics, or a closely related field, plus principal-level industry experience or a faculty appointment

Your tasks: Build challenging technical problems from your own domain and define what makes an answer correct

You'll be working on

The problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking solution is quietly wrong. You’ll build those problems, provide the correct analysis, and define what separates a right answer from one that only looks righ

What you’ll do

  1. Design difficult technical problems from your own area — device physics, process integration, circuit design, lithography, packaging, yield and reliability — with realistic constraints and supporting data.
  2. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there.
  3. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another expert reviewing the work would reach the same verdict.
  4. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method.
  5. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them.

What we’re looking for

  1. Master’s or PhD in electrical engineering, materials science, applied physics, or a closely related field.
  2. Principal, staff, or fellow-level experience at a major semiconductor company, or a faculty appointment at a leading university.
  3. Deep technical depth in at least one semiconductor subdomain, with hands-on ownership of the work.
  4. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another engineer could verify it.
  5. Publications, patents, or a record of technical leadership is a strong plus.
  6. AI or LLM evaluation experience is a plus, but not required.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions
  2. Complete the AI interview for this role — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client
  3. Profile review
  4. Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up

As an embedded Data Engineer, you will work directly building foundations for products that transform merchants' lives. You'll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of professionals that can include Product Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, and Product Management. The data you shape will be used to power product analysis, dashboards, and reports. You will also contribute by performing product analysis and creating dashboards and reports yourself from time to time. You should be an independent thinker who can solve complex problems and handle a bit of chaos without breaking a sweat.

As an Operations Engineer, you'll apply AI at the forefront of BizTech's operational health: using LLM-powered triage and intelligent automation to resolve tickets, speed up incident response, and build self-healing observability that catches problems before they escalate. Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

About the Role

CENSUS is looking for a iOS Vulnerability Researcher to join our security research team, focused on vulnerability discovery and exploitation across the iOS userland attack surface.

You’ll spend your time reverse engineering proprietary Apple software, identifying security boundaries and interesting attack surfaces, developing fuzzers and instrumentation, and turning promising primitives into reliable vulnerability research.

This is a hands-on research role for someone who enjoys working close to the metal, understands Apple's ecosystem and is comfortable operating without complete documentation.

Previous iOS or macOS vulnerability research.

Familiarity with arm64e Apple specific internals

Familiarity with jailbreak-era or modern iOS research tooling is useful, but not required.

undocumented platform changes.

Experience with reversing Objective-C binaries.

Experience with iOS/macOS IPC mechanisms, such as mach messages, MIG, and XPC

jobs.description:
Sr Director, Product Management, Dealer Marketing Solutions (Autopoint)

Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms, and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

The Role

AutoPoint is how thousands of dealerships stay connected to their customers between visits. Today that means On Demand and Journey, proven owner marketing programs that drive service revenue and retention. Tomorrow it means a modern, omni-channel dealer marketing platform that follows the customer across the full relationship, from first lead through sale, service, and repurchase.

As Senior Director, Product Management for Dealer Marketing Solutions, you will own both. You will run and grow the current business while discovering, defining, and delivering the platform that replaces it. This is a hands-on product management role: customer discovery, problem definition, requirements, prioritization, and the discipline to say no. You will work shoulder to shoulder with development and marketing operations, and you will pull the AutoPoint roadmap across the entire Dealer Solutions portfolio so dealers get one connected customer experience from lead marketing to sales marketing to service marketing.

What You’ll Do

Current Portfolio Ownership

  • Own the roadmap, performance, pricing, and customer outcomes for On Demand and Journey, the live owner marketing programs that generate revenue and serve dealers today.
  • Manage the P&L for the dealer marketing portfolio, including program economics, campaign margin, and the levers that move retention and service revenue for dealer customers.
  • Protect and improve the running business while the next platform is being built; no degradation in service levels, campaign performance, or dealer satisfaction during the transition.
  • Serve as the executive product point of contact for strategic dealer groups and the escalation path for product performance issues.

Discovery and Customer Insight

  • Lead structured discovery with dealers, dealer groups, marketing agencies, OEM programs, and internal fulfillment teams to understand what actually drives service and sales conversion at the store level.
  • Spend meaningful time in dealerships observing how marketing is planned, executed, and measured, and translate what you see into validated problem statements backed by evidence.
  • Size opportunities with data, separating what dealers ask for from what they will pay for, and build the business cases that justify platform investment.
  • Establish an always-on voice of customer motion including advisory councils, design partners, and win/loss analysis that feeds the roadmap continuously.
  • Maintain a rigorous view of the competitive landscape across dealer marketing, CRM-attached marketing, and agency service providers.

Platform Definition and Roadmap

  • Define the target state for the next generation dealer marketing platform: campaign orchestration across email, SMS, direct mail, digital, and in-store, plus audience management, segmentation, automation, and measurement dealers trust.
  • Write clear, testable product requirements and acceptance criteria; own the backlog, the prioritization framework, and the tradeoff decisions behind both.
  • Decide what carries forward from today, what gets rebuilt, and what gets retired, and sequence the build so value ships incrementally rather than in one large release.
  • Define the migration path for existing On Demand and Journey dealers, including packaging, pricing, communication, and the operational plan to move them without disruption.
  • Define success metrics up front for every major release and hold the product accountable to them after launch.

Delivery with Development and Marketing Operations

  • Partner daily with engineering on scope, architecture tradeoffs, estimation, and release sequencing; be present in the details rather than handing off documents.
  • Work directly with marketing operations and fulfillment teams on the execution realities that make or break a campaign, including data hygiene, deliverability, print and mail production, creative workflow, and compliance review.
  • Drive the operating cadence for the product: roadmap reviews, release planning, launch readiness, and post-launch performance reviews.
  • Partner with sales, customer success, and enablement to ensure every release lands with the field and reaches dealers.

Cross-Portfolio Customer 360

  • Work across the Dealer Solutions portfolio (DealerSocket CRM, iDMS, Automate, DealerFire, RedCap) to unify the customer record and connect lead marketing to sales marketing to service marketing.
  • Define the data, identity, and consent requirements needed to deliver one customer profile and one coordinated set of conversations across the dealership.
  • Collaborate with peer product leaders to build joint solutions that are more valuable together than apart, and quantify that value for dealers and for Solera.
  • Influence platform and data investment decisions so dealer marketing needs are represented in shared roadmap priorities.

Leadership

jobs.excerpt: Department: Finance and Operations Engagement type: Independent contractor (1099), part-time, hourly Reports to: Chief of Staff, with priorities set by the CEO Work arrangement: RemoteSummary of RoleThe Data and Reporting Analyst gives Ultra's leadership direct, reliable access to the numbers that run the business.
jobs.description:
Department: Finance and Operations
Engagement type: Independent contractor (1099), part-time, hourly
Reports to: Chief of Staff, with priorities set by the CEO
Work arrangement: Remote

Summary of Role

The Data and Reporting Analyst gives Ultra's leadership direct, reliable access to the numbers that run the business. The analyst turns payroll, accounting, Salesforce, and Projector PSA data into structured Excel datasets, pivot tables, and reports that leadership can use, refresh, and trust, replacing static snapshots and one-time extracts with live, documented reporting. This is an independent contractor (1099) engagement, with an initial build followed by ongoing maintenance and analysis.
The analyst works with Ultra's leadership to decide what the business needs to see, defines the underlying structure (the dimensions, such as department, GL account, date, client, and sales executive, and the facts, such as hours, quantities, and dollar amounts), and builds reporting on top of it. Initial priorities are lead and bookings reporting from Salesforce, a payroll compendium built from payroll register data, and finance and forecast reporting that combines accounting data with Projector PSA data. The role requires comfort analyzing data, spotting what does not add up, and explaining what the numbers mean in plain language.

Primary Responsibilities

Data Foundation and Reporting Design

  • Meet with leadership to understand the questions they need answered, and define the dimensions (such as department, GL account, date, client, project, and sales executive) and facts (such as hours, quantities, and dollar amounts) that each report will use. Document the definitions so that everyone reads the numbers the same way.
  • Extract data from source systems and organize it into clean, structured Excel datasets that refresh reliably and feed pivot tables, so that reporting no longer depends on manual rework or one-time extracts.
  • Build and maintain pivot tables that let leadership analyze results by period, department, client, person, and other dimensions without requesting a new report each time.
  • Document data sources, refresh steps, formulas, and report logic so that reporting can be maintained and, if needed, handed to someone else.
  • Validate reports against source totals before they are shared, and note any differences, assumptions, or data limitations.

Payroll Reporting

  • Extract payroll data from the payroll provider's reports, including the payroll register, into a structured format, and build and maintain a payroll compendium that leadership can analyze year to date and by pay period.
  • Report gross pay, net pay, and earnings types (regular earnings, bonus, commission, incentive, and other) by employee, department, and period, and reconcile totals to the payroll provider's company-level summary.
  • Support compensation and cost analysis requested by leadership, handling the data with strict confidentiality.

Finance Reporting

  • Convert accounting data and projections from the outsourced accounting team into pivot-ready form, and build finance reports such as profit and loss by period, expense by function, and actual versus projected results.
  • Build and maintain expense and projection models that separate fixed and variable costs by function, and update them as periods close.
  • Support the periodic forecasting process by assembling revenue and cost views from Projector and accounting data, comparing forecast to actual, and explaining variances.
  • Identify cost, margin, and cash trends and bring them to leadership's attention with a view of what is driving them.

Sales and Lead Reporting (Salesforce)

  • Build and maintain Salesforce reports and extracts covering leads, MQLs, SALs, and SQLs, conversion by lead source and type, and the history of lead assignments by sales executive.
  • Report bookings by period, client, and sales executive, separating new logos, follow-on work, and change orders, and track average deal size and win rates over time.
  • Report pipeline by stage and expected close period, and highlight data gaps (such as missing stages, dates, or sources) to Revenue Strategy and Operations so that records are corrected.
  • Support Salesforce data cleanup so that reports are based on complete, consistent records.

Projector PSA Reporting

  • Build reports and extracts from Projector PSA on revenue by client, project, resource, and week or period; hours; budgets versus actuals; utilization; and project stage and pipeline category.
  • Maintain the Excel workbooks that use Projector data, including revenue forecasts and by-client views, keep their pivot tables and totals accurate, and investigate unexpected changes.
  • Work with Revenue Strategy and Operations and Service Delivery leadership to understand how projects are set up and scheduled in Projector so that reports reflect how the business actually works.

Analysis and Communication

  • Analyze trends and explain their drivers, such as changes in lead volume and conversion, average deal size, follow-on work, utilization, margin, and cost.
  • Summarize findings in clear written notes and simple visuals that a business leader can read quickly, and answer follow-up questions.
  • Use AI tools approved by Ultra, such as Microsoft Copilot, to speed up analysis where appropriate, and verify the results before sharing them.
  • Respond to ad hoc requests, meet reporting deadlines tied to the company's weekly and period cycles, and tell leadership early when data is late, incomplete, or unreliable.

Reporting Scope

The analyst owns the accuracy, documentation, and usability of the reports and datasets assigned to the role. Source systems remain with their business owners: Revenue Strategy and Operations for Salesforce data and sales reporting definitions, Revenue Strategy and Operations and Service Delivery leadership for Projector PSA, the outsourced accounting team for accounting records, and Ultra's HR and operations team for payroll. The analyst does not make accounting entries, change payroll, or approve financial decisions; the role provides the reporting and analysis that informs them.

Required Knowledge and Qualifications

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, structured tables, Power Query or other data connections, lookup functions (such as XLOOKUP or INDEX and MATCH), conditional formulas (such as SUMIFS), data cleaning, and charts.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize large data sets (tens of thousands of rows) into structured, refreshable models and to keep them accurate over time.
  • Experience analyzing business data and presenting findings to executives, including explaining what changed and why.
  • Working knowledge of financial data, including profit and loss reporting, general ledger accounts, and payroll data, and the ability to reconcile reports to source totals. Familiarity with QuickBooks reports is helpful.
  • Experience building reports and dashboards in Salesforce and extracting lead, opportunity, and booking data, with an understanding of the lead-to-opportunity sales funnel.
  • Familiarity with reporting in Projector PSA, including revenue, hours, budget, and utilization reports. Experience with a comparable professional services automation tool may be considered for a candidate who can demonstrate the ability to learn Projector quickly.
  • Strong attention to detail, with the habit of checking numbers against the source and questioning results that look wrong.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to translate business questions into data requirements.
  • Ability to work independently as a contractor, manage time and priorities, and deliver on agreed dates.
  • Discretion and integrity with confidential payroll, compensation, financial, and client information.
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in professional services or consulting, where utilization and project revenue are tracked closely.
  • Experience with Power BI or a similar analytics tool, and basic SQL.
  • Experience with payroll provider reports (for example, TriNet) and QuickBooks.
  • Experience with FP&A work, such as budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Experience using AI assistants such as Microsoft Copilot for analysis, with careful validation of the results.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.

Performance Expectations

Performance is assessed through the accuracy of reports against source data; delivery by agreed dates; whether datasets refresh reliably and are documented well enough for others to maintain; how well leadership can use the reports on its own; responsiveness to requests; and the quality of the insight that explains the results. Priorities, deliverables, and timelines are agreed with Ultra leadership in the statement of work, beginning with an initial build phase.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None. This role has no direct reports.

Work Environment and Expectations

Ultra is a remote organization. Contractors are expected to maintain a reliable internet connection, be available during agreed working hours with reasonable response times, and comply with Ultra's requirements for confidentiality, conduct, and data privacy and security. A signed subcontractor agreement and nondisclosure agreement and completed onboarding are required before system access is granted.
This role has access to payroll, compensation, and financial information, so access is limited to the systems and reports needed for the work. Company and client data may be used only with tools approved by Ultra and may not be placed in unapproved external or AI tools. No client travel is expected, although occasional participation in virtual company meetings may be requested. Occasional work outside regular hours may be needed around period close or for urgent reporting deadlines.

About Ultra Consultants

Founded in 1994, Ultra Consultants is an independent, vendor-agnostic consulting firm serving mid-market manufacturing and distribution companies. Ultra helps clients improve business performance through business process improvement, ERP and technology selection, implementation management, project management, and organizational change management.

Engagement and Compensation

Ultra's remote team collaborates through virtual company meetings. The company values high-quality client service, professional expertise, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
  • Independent contractor (1099) engagement. The contractor is not an employee and is responsible for their own taxes and insurance; employee benefits do not apply.
  • Hourly rate based on experience and scope, with hours and deliverables agreed in the statement of work: a defined initial build, followed by an ongoing maintenance cadence.
  • Part-time, flexible schedule with agreed deadlines tied to the company's reporting cycles.
  • Direct work with company leadership and a meaningful role in how the business is measured. The engagement may continue or expand based on business needs and performance.

Work Authorization and Engagement Information

Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States. Ultra does not sponsor individual work visas. Security clearance is not required.
Classification: Independent contractor (1099)
Ultra is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All applicants will be considered for engagement without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

Presales Director

Elemica, a global leader in digital supply chain automation, is seeking experienced Presales Director to grow our business and strengthen our partnerships with existing top enterprise clients. This is an opportunity to join a growing company of talented and committed individuals, unified in the common goal of exceeding our client’s expectations.

This role will have a competitive total compensation package and recognition for overachievement of sales goals.

Our Values

At Elemica, we believe that embodying our values is essential for all team members. These qualities show up in our interactions with each other, our clients, and our collective community:


  • Curiosity – we delight in the discovery of new challenges and feel compelled to solve them
  • Integrity – We are relatable and trustworthy; steadfast in our commitment to our colleagues, clients, and partners
  • Accountability – We show up and deliver measurable, meaningful business value. Consistently.

What’s In It For You?

  • Industry impact: Help Fortune 1000 companies digitize over $1 trillion in annual commerce
  • End-to-end solutions: work across procurement, order automation, and logistics on a single SaaS platform
  • Collaborative team: join a highly experienced, globally connected commercial organization
  • Flexibility & exposure: remote-first role with global client interactions and cross-functional partnerships
  • Customer-centric work
  • Cutting-edge supply chain technology and innovation

Role & Responsibilities

Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Presales, the Presales Director is the primary presales contact for opportunities, primarily in EMEA. You’ll engage directly with enterprise clients to understand their business goals, uncover process challenges, and design tailored solutions that drive digital transformation.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the lead presales consultant for new client opportunities and expansions, supporting account executives across industries
  • Collaborate with clients to understand supply chain pain points and demonstrate how Elemica’s solutions address them through procurement, order-to-cash, and logistics operations
  • Deliver high-impact workshops, solution walkthroughs, and value-aligned presentations for stakeholders across IT, supply chain, and business functions

What You’ll Need

  • 10–15+ years of experience in presales, solution consulting, or business analysis for enterprise supply chain or SaaS platforms
  • Proven expertise in at least one area: procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, or transportation/logistics with broad understanding of end-to-end supply chain operations
  • Strong familiarity with ERP systems (especially SAP) and complementary supply chain software such as Blue Yonder, Coupa, Esker, Conexiom, Oracle, or Kinaxis
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage senior business and technical stakeholders

Who We Are

Elemica is a leading provider of Digital Supply Chain Management solutions and the premier multi-enterprise collaboration network for global process manufacturing industries. Its portfolio of SaaS-based, network-powered digitization and visibility solutions automate critical information flows, enable multi-channel data strategies, and improve end-to-end supply chain performance. Elemica solutions connect many of the world’s largest manufacturers to their direct material suppliers, logistics service providers and end customers, helping them realize the promise of, and return on, their investments in supply chain digitization. Today, global leaders—including Arkema, BASF, Continental, Dow, Goodyear, Michelin, and Shell—use Elemica, driving over $1 trillion in commerce annually.

It is the responsibility of all Elemica employees to ensure the security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy of Elemica systems and data and the data of our customers. Role Title: Principal Engineer / Professor — Technical Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay:$80- $185/hour

Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role

Location: Fully remote

You’ll need: Master’s or PhD in an engineering or physical science field, plus principal-level industry experience or a faculty appointment

Your tasks: Build challenging technical problems from your own domain and define what makes an answer correct

micro1 is engaging principal-level engineers, scientists, and faculty to design the technical problems that measure what AI systems can actually do. Your domain expertise is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

We’re building this across four areas: aerospace, semiconductors, manufacturing and industrial engineering, and materials science. If your work sits in one of those — or across two of them — this is for you.

The work draws on what you already know: the problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking solution is quietly wrong.

What you’ll do

  1. Design difficult technical problems from your own area, with realistic constraints and supporting data.
  2. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there.
  3. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another expert reviewing the work would reach the same verdict.
  4. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method.
  5. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them.

What we’re looking for

  1. Master’s or PhD in engineering, physics, materials, or a closely related field.
  2. Principal, staff, or fellow-level experience at a major engineering organization, a national lab, or a faculty appointment at a leading university.
  3. Deep technical depth in at least one area, with hands-on ownership of the work.
  4. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another expert could verify it.
  5. Publications, patents, or a record of technical leadership is a strong plus.

How the selection process works

  2. Complete the AI interview for this role
  3. Profile review

jobs.description:
We’re expanding across Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and Peru, and we’re looking for a Project Support Specialist to join our growing team!

The Project Support Specialist II (PSS II) serves as a member of the project team providing cross-functional support with the goal of making a positive impact on the studies to which they are assigned. The PSS II is a solid team member who can execute, with some oversight, all core responsibilities consistently across several studies using independent judgment and critical thinking. The PSS II effectively collaborates with their cross-functional team members and will take on new or expanded responsibilities when appropriate and with proper training. The PSS II prioritizes their work and collaborates with the project team to ensure a consistent understanding of the timing for completion of work products.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Manages the meeting lifecycle including scheduling internal and external meetings, preparing, and circulating agendas, taking meeting minutes, circulating, and updating meeting minutes based on team member input, and filing meeting agendas and minutes in the Trial Master File.
  • Assists with creation and maintenance of the project timeline in MS Project or similar system. Collects updates from team members, captures and documents these updates, and ensures updates are communicated to the cross-functional study team.
  • Performs an array of activities and tasks in clinical systems applicable to their role and project scope..
  • Manages study-specific training lifecycle by collecting, tracking, and loading training materials, assigning team members to appropriate training, and documenting completion of study-specific training in appropriate systems. Manages the maintenance of training records and files records in the Trial Master File.

  • Establishes a study-level Share Point site or similar shared working space and ensures appropriate access to study team, sponsors, and others as appropriate.

  • Manages user access to study systems by submitting user requests to the Helpdesk or similar, by reviewing team member access on a defined periodic basis, and documenting access reviews. Ensure rapid removal of system access for team members no longer affiliated with the study.

Ensures vendor quotes align with invoices for completed binders and consults directly with Project Manager to approve vendor payments.

Our firm helps clients plan for the legal protection and security of their families. In this role, you will help us reach and connect with those who need our services by coordinating marketing projects, creating engaging content, and supporting our business development efforts.

Role Title: Aerospace Engineering Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay:$80- $185/hour

Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role

Location: Fully remote

You’ll need: Master’s or PhD in aerospace or a closely related field, plus principal-level industry experience or a faculty appointment

Your tasks: Build challenging technical problems from your own domain and define what makes an answer correct

You'll be working on

The work draws on what you already know: the problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking solution is quietly wrong. You’ll build those problems, provide the correct analysis, and define what separates a right answer from one that only looks right.

What you’ll do

  1. Design difficult technical problems from your own area — aerodynamics, propulsion, structures, GNC, orbital mechanics, systems engineering — with realistic constraints and supporting data.
  2. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there.
  3. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another expert reviewing the work would reach the same verdict.
  4. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method.
  5. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them.

What we’re looking for

  1. Master’s or PhD in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field.
  2. Principal, staff, or fellow-level experience at a major aerospace organization, or a faculty appointment at a leading university.
  3. Deep technical depth in at least one aerospace subdomain, with hands-on ownership of the work.
  4. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another engineer could verify it.
  5. Publications, patents, or a record of technical leadership is a strong plus.
  6. AI or LLM evaluation experience is a plus, but not required.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions
  2. Complete the AI interview for this role — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client
  3. Profile review
  4. Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

As a Principal SOC Performance Analysis Engineer on the ASIC Engineering SOC Team, you will own performance analysis for a satellite communication System on Chip (SOC) supporting the TeraWave program. This is a senior individual contributor role with technical leadership scope and no direct reports. You will set the performance analysis methodology from pre-silicon modeling through emulation based verification and post-silicon validation, and your results will directly shape architectural decisions across hardware, firmware, and software teams.

jobs.description:
Braincube est spécialisée dans l'optimisation des processus en temps réel qui aide les fabricants à améliorer leurs performances opérationnelles grâce à l'intelligence artificielle, à des capacités avancées en matière de données et à une expertise industrielle approfondie. Notre plateforme permet aux industriels d'augmenter leur rendement, d'améliorer la qualité, d'optimiser leur consommation d'énergie et d'accroître leur débit, à grande échelle et en temps réel, dans le cadre d'opérations complexes impliquant plusieurs sites.

Pour faire évoluer ces solutions, nous recherchons un·e Senior Back-End Software Engineer autonome, capable de prendre le lead sur un sujet et de le mener jusqu’à son aboutissement.

Le poste

Votre rôle : prendre un sujet et le mener à son terme

Vous travaillez au sein d’une équipe de développement et intervenez sur l’ensemble du cycle, du besoin initial au suivi des résultats. Avec vos collègues et le produit, vous clarifiez les objectifs, challengez les options et construisez une solution adaptée. La collaboration au quotidien est essentielle : partager l’avancement, s’entraider, accueillir les retours et prendre les décisions ensemble pour réussir collectivement.

Au quotidien, vous serez amené·e à :

  • Porter des sujets de bout en bout : cadrage, conception, développement, tests, déploiement et suivi en production.

  • Prendre le lead technique : proposer une direction, expliquer les compromis, coordonner les contributions et faire avancer les décisions.

  • Développer des services backend en Java et concevoir des modèles de données et des requêtes SQL performants.

  • Faire fonctionner vos applications dans un environnement Kubernetes et contribuer à leur observabilité, leur fiabilité et leur diagnostic.

  • Anticiper les difficultés, rendre les risques visibles et chercher de l’aide au bon moment.

  • Faire progresser le collectif par les revues de code, le partage de connaissances et l’amélioration des pratiques.

Pour nous, l’ownership signifie rester impliqué·e jusqu’à ce que la solution soit utilisable, observable et réponde au besoin. L’autonomie s’appuie sur la collaboration et une communication claire.

L’IA fait partie de notre façon de développer

Nous construisons un environnement de développement dans lequel les assistants et les agents IA prennent une place croissante. Nous attendons de vous une pratique active de ces outils et la capacité à en tirer un bénéfice concret.

Cela signifie savoir :

  • Utiliser l’IA pour explorer un code existant, préparer une implémentation, développer, tester, refactorer ou documenter.

  • Structurer le contexte et découper un sujet pour déléguer efficacement certaines étapes à des agents.

  • Vérifier les résultats : comprendre le code proposé, tester les comportements et évaluer les conséquences sur la sécurité, les performances et la maintenance.

  • Identifier les usages qui améliorent réellement le travail et partager ces pratiques avec l’équipe.

Votre jugement d’ingénieur reste central : vous êtes responsable de ce que vous livrez, y compris lorsque l’IA contribue à sa réalisation.

Les technologies clés du poste : Java, SQL, Kubernetes, IA Tooling.

Votre expérience sera réussie chez nous si…

  • Vous savez prendre en charge un sujet, clarifier le résultat attendu et l’amener jusqu’en production, en coordonnant les contributions nécessaires.

  • vous comprenez les usages des clients et savez proposer des solutions techniques adaptées, en expliquant les compromis ;

  • vous livrez des évolutions testées et maintenables, et mettez en place les métriques et alertes nécessaires pour suivre leur fonctionnement et leurs performances ;

jobs.title: Senior Website Implementation Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Real opportunities.  Real impact.  Your career, redefined.
jobs.description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we believe that talent knows no boundaries. That’s why we connect the best and brightest professionals with career-defining opportunities that challenge, inspire, and accelerate their career growth. Our community, whom we call Divers, don’t just work—they dive deep, solve complex challenges, and make a real impact with global industry leaders. And in doing so, they don’t just support bold ideas—they expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers.

As a Senior Website Implementation Specialist, you will join a growing multifamily real estate firm supporting a nationwide portfolio of residential properties. You will take hands-on technical ownership of the client’s Drupal CMS ecosystem hosted on Acquia, translating project briefs, visual assets, and content into robust, fully functioning property websites. Because the client’s web infrastructure requires customized configurations rather than simple drag-and-drop templates, you will balance custom backend coding with disciplined content management to deliver reliable digital experiences.

This is a high-ownership, execution-driven role for a disciplined technical specialist. You will become a core pillar of a nimble, high-focus web team, driving new website implementations from scratch, managing ticket queues against strict SLAs, replicating established configurations across expanding property portfolios, and ensuring rigorous quality assurance before handoff. If you excel at autonomous troubleshooting, structured file management, and leveraging modern AI workflows to accelerate backend development, this role will offer direct ownership and substantial impact.

Accountability

As a Senior Website Implementation Specialist, your success will be defined by your ability to accurately build, maintain,and expand property websites within a customized Drupal and Acquia environment while independently managing ticket queues against SLAs and maintaining flawless QA readiness.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Drupal Implementation & Custom Backend Development

  • Build, configure, and maintain residential property websites within the client's Acquia-hosted Drupal architecture.
  • Implement and adapt website templates and structured CMS components using supplied briefs and creative assets.
  • Perform custom backend coding and manual configuration when native CMS functionality or standard modules are insufficient.
  • Troubleshoot technical limitations, backend blockers, and implementation bugs, ensuring strict compatibility with existing environments.
    Follow established Acquia Cloud deployment, staging, and hosting workflows while maintaining clean technical documentation.

New Website Builds, Replication & Portfolio Expansion

  • Execute end-to-end new property website implementations based on briefs provided by project management.
  • Replicate established web architectures across expanding portfolio properties, efficiently reusing templates while customizing property-specific data and content.
  • Configure components, verify asset mappings, and ensure visual and functional consistency across all portfolio sites.
  • Prepare and stage newly built and replicated sites for formal testing, ensuring all features execute seamlessly prior to launch.

Website Ticket Queue & SLA Management

  • Serve as the primary owner of the incoming website support and maintenance ticket queue.
  • Triage, prioritize, and resolve change requests, content updates, and technical adjustments in accordance with established SLAs.
  • Maintain real-time, accurate ticket statuses, track resolution deadlines, and proactively flag potential service-level delays.
  • Balance daily maintenance tickets and recurring support requests alongside active, high-priority website builds.

Quality Assurance, Testing & Asset Governance

  • Conduct thorough functional and visual testing on all website builds and updates prior to QA handoff.
  • Validate content placement, responsiveness, cross-browser performance, and template consistency to eliminate avoidable rework.
  • Address QA feedback systematically, resolving defects and verifying that all technical requirements are fulfilled.
  • Maintain rigorous file and asset organization across repositories, following strict naming conventions and directory standards to ensure zero asset misplacement.

AI-Enabled Engineering & Continuous Process Improvement

  • Incorporate AI tools (such as Claude) into daily technical workflows to investigate code, troubleshoot bugs, and accelerate repetitive implementation tasks.
  • Rigorously review, test, and validate all AI-assisted code suggestions to ensure technical integrity, security, and performance.
  • Identify recurring implementation bottlenecks and propose structured improvements to standardize builds.
  • Develop and update technical setup checklists, SOPs, and repeatable documentation to improve team efficiency as the web platform evolves.

Colleagues

You will work directly with the Website Project Manager as your primary day-to-day operational lead, while collaborating with existing website developers and cross-functional technical stakeholders during standups, testing cycles, and deployments.

At Oceans, you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area, paired with broad curiosity and interests. As a Senior Website Implementation Specialist, your vertical strength will be hands-on Drupal backend development and CMS implementation, while your horizontal capabilities should span ticket queue prioritization, QA discipline, AI-assisted development, and structured technical communication.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: 4+ years of professional web development and CMS implementation experience, with dedicated,hands-on expertise building and maintaining customized Drupal websites.
  • Tools & Systems: Extensive proficiency with Drupal backend architecture, modules, and configurations; hands-on experience operating within the Acquia Cloud ecosystem; familiarity with project management platforms (Notion or similar) and ticketing systems (Jira or similar).
  • Analytics & Process: Demonstrated ability to manage high-volume ticketing queues, monitor SLA commitments,and execute rigorous QA testing protocols. Strong track record of following disciplined documentation, checklist-driven workflows, and standardized file structures.
  • Mindset & Approach: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and disciplined execution style; comfortable operating with low to moderate extraversion in an autonomous, heads-down technical role. Proactive in asking clarifying questions before building rather than relying on unverified assumptions.
  • AI Fluency: Practical comfort integrating AI tools (e.g., Claude) to streamline code investigation, debugging, and task automation, paired with the engineering judgment to validate and test all outputs manually.

During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Drupal Architecture & Custom Backend Coding: How do you navigate, customize, and write backend logic within an established, non-productized Drupal CMS environment?
  • Acquia & Environment Troubleshooting: How do you diagnose and resolve hosting, deployment, or environment-specific issues across connected web infrastructure?
  • Ticket Ownership & SLA Prioritization: How do you balance active, multi-week website builds with incoming,time-sensitive maintenance tickets without missing delivery targets?
  • Quality Assurance & Attention to Detail: What systematic steps and checklists do you employ to ensure builds and asset placements are completely defect-free before QA handoff?
  • AI-Assisted Workflow & Verification: How do you safely leverage tools like Claude to accelerate technical problem-solving while validating accuracy and maintainability?

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].

jobs.description:
Location: UK, remote, with regular overlap with US East Coast hours. Travel to customer sites in the US and Europe, to international conferences, and occasionally to London and Manchester.

About the Role

You'll own a portfolio of mostly US accounts using Biorelate's Galactic AI platform, from large pharma companies to smaller biotech teams. Your job is to make sure their researchers get measurable scientific value from Galactic Data, Web, API, MCP and Co-Scientist, and to build the evidence for renewal and expansion.
This is a hands-on role between science and technology. You'll run workshops and QBRs, and you'll also set up API access, build and test prompts and workflows, and own support for your accounts.

What We Do

Research and Development in the pharmaceutical industry is time-consuming, expensive, and often overlooks valuable data insights. We’re changing that with AI-powered data science solutions that uncover hidden insights to support more efficient and informed drug discovery. Using AI and Natural Language Processing (NLP), our technology extracts and structures data from millions of scientific documents, identifying causal biological relationships and organising them into knowledge graphs. This advanced data science empowers bioinformaticians and biologists with a deeper understanding of the connections between diseases, proteins, and drugs.

Our team consists of biomedical and data science experts with real-world lab and pharmaceutical experience. These specialists ensure that our solutions are scientifically grounded, delivering accurate, reliable data to our customers.

The Company
Biorelate is a venture backed Series A startup (supported by established Tech investors). If you’re eager to collaborate with exceptional scientists, software engineers, and subject matter experts from various fields in a supportive, ego-free environment, Biorelate is the place for you.

Key Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Adoption and Value

  • Own each account from kickoff and onboarding through to measurable scientific outcomes, with an adoption plan for each team and use case.
  • Run use case workshops that turn research problems (target identification, safety assessment, competitive intelligence, literature synthesis) into prioritised use cases.
  • Grow active and chargeable users by developing champions, reaching new teams, and getting researchers to their first real result quickly.

Renewals and Account Health

  • Own renewals and gross revenue retention (GRR), starting renewal planning at least 120 days before each renewal date.
  • Run QBRs and regular check-ins, and keep account plans and health scores current using usage data.
  • Spot declining usage early and lead the recovery plan when an account is at risk.

Technical Enablement and Support

  • Set up and troubleshoot API, MCP and Web deployments, and build prompts and example workflows around customers' own research questions.
  • Check the quality of outputs, and escalate issues to Engineering with clear reproduction details.
  • Answer security and governance questions, and route non-standard work to Forward Deployed Engineering.

Working Across Biorelate

  • Partner with the Account Manager, who owns contracting and expansion deals, by supplying adoption data, ROI evidence and expansion signals.
  • Feed customer feedback to Product, and help roll out betas, launches and training materials.
  • Support technical pre-sales conversations and represent Biorelate at conferences.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

What You'll Bring

  • A PhD in biological or life sciences, or a related field.
  • Experience in a client-facing, post-sale role with pharma, biotech or life sciences customers, ideally in SaaS or data.
  • Familiarity with at least one of: target identification and validation, pharmacovigilance and drug safety, competitive intelligence, or literature synthesis.
  • Comfort working hands-on with APIs, LLM tools and prompt design, and the judgement to tell whether an AI-generated scientific answer holds up.
  • Confidence running workshops and training sessions with scientists and department leads.
  • A track record of moving usage numbers through structured plans, not only managing relationships.

Nice to Have

  • Experience owning renewals or GRR targets with enterprise customers.
  • Experience running QBRs with senior stakeholders.
  • Scripting experience, for example in Python.

How You'll Work

  • You own the plan for your accounts and drive it. Tasks aren't handed down.
  • You're curious about drug discovery, and happy to switch between customer meetings and focused technical work in the same day.
  • You're comfortable in a growth-stage company where processes are still being built, and keen to help build them.

Benefits

This is a rare opportunity to join Biorelate at an inflection point in our growth – and to genuinely shape how the company is seen and heard in the market. You'll work in a supportive team but you will have real autonomy to make this new role your own.
We offer competitive salaries, enhanced family leave, sick leave and significant opportunities for professional development. You’ll work alongside some of the brightest individuals, contributing to meaningful work that has a direct impact on global healthcare.
In addition, you can expect:
  • Genuine Flexibility: We are a fully remote business with colleagues across the globe: manage your schedule, save time and money on commuting, and do your best work from the comfort of your home.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology: You’ll work with the latest software tools and technologies; we’ll push you to genuinely be innovative and find new ways to solve the newest challenges.
