jobs.description:
Gigstreem, a leading Internet Service Provider based in the US, provides innovative technology solutions to residential (Single Family, MDU) and commercial (MTU) clients across various markets nationwide.

SUMMARY

The Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing maintenance and field service projects to ensure operational reliability and customer satisfaction. This role focuses on managing preventive and corrective maintenance initiatives, service upgrades, and field operations projects, delivering all work on time, within budget, and in compliance with safety and quality standards. The Project Manager will collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the project lifecycle, including scope definition, resource planning, implementation, and post-project performance review. Reports directly to the Director of Field Services.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons.

  • Develop and manage project plans for maintenance and field service initiatives, including documenting requirements, setting objectives, and achieving milestones to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery.
  • Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance schedules, ensuring minimal service disruption and compliance with operational standards.
  • Manage cross-functional stakeholders—such as engineering, procurement, and field technicians—through regular communication and project meetings to keep all parties informed and aligned.
  • Assign and delegate responsibilities to field teams; provide direction, motivation, and oversight to ensure efficient use of resources and adherence to safety protocols.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, including progress reports, milestone tracking, and executive summaries for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Evaluate existing maintenance processes and systems; identify opportunities for improvement and implement cost-saving measures without compromising quality.
  • Generate reporting and visibility for leadership to ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Travel occasionally to field sites to inspect work progress, resolve issues, and ensure adherence to project specifications.
  • Communicate directly with clients and property managers to provide updates on maintenance schedules, service interruptions, and project timelines.
  • Review financial data and prepare project budgets to optimize costs and maintain profitability.
  • Collaborate with HR and operations teams to develop and implement guidelines for technician training, performance evaluations, and resource allocation.
  • Achieve strategic goals and KPIs related to maintenance efficiency, service uptime, and customer satisfaction.
  • Oversee telecommunication construction projects, including fiber optic and structured cabling installations, ensuring compliance with industry standards and local regulations.
  • Coordinate permitting, utility locates, and right-of-way requirements for construction activities as necessary.
  • Monitor contractor performance and enforce quality assurance for construction deliverables.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Director of Field Services and Vice President of Operations.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong understanding of maintenance operations, field service workflows, and customer experience principles.
  • Ability to identify and resolve project-impacting issues quickly and effectively.
  • Knowledge of technologies and materials used in telecommunications and field service environments.
  • In-depth knowledge of telecommunication construction practices, including fiber installation, splicing, trenching, and aerial plant work.
  • Familiarity with permitting processes, construction safety standards, and local/state regulations related to telecom infrastructure.
  • Proven leadership skills with the ability to manage teams and drive results in a dynamic environment.
  • Familiarity with budgeting, invoicing, purchase orders, and cost-control practices.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced setting.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for interacting with all organizational levels.
  • Proficiency in CRM, ERP, and maintenance management systems.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite: Project, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

BENEFITS

  • Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance
  • Long-Term Disability and Life Insurance
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Monthly Cell Phone Reimbursement

Salary:$75,000-100,000

Location: Remote

jobs.excerpt: About Code3Code3 is an integrated marketing agency, powering business growth for digital disruptors and Fortune 500 leaders alike.
jobs.description:
About Code3

Code3 is an integrated marketing agency, powering business growth for digital disruptors and Fortune 500 leaders alike. Our power is at the intersection of Connections, Creative and Commerce – that’s what is in our DNA. By harvesting insights and utilizing audience data, we work with our clients to develop scroll-stopping content and creative that performs and elevates the brands we work with across all digital media platforms.

Our people are energized by challenges and sprint to find unorthodox solutions. We plan, activate and measure as one team, and we’re not afraid to push boundaries and test our way to success. Coders are Relentless, Gritty, Nimble humans who are always striving to be better.

With teams across the U.S., you’ll find more than a job at Code3. You’ll find a place to grow, make an impact, and do your best work alongside a team that’s invested in your success.

Paid social has evolved far beyond media buying. Success today requires understanding consumer behavior, creative performance, platform innovation, and how culture influences the way people discover and buy products. Our team partners with clients to build full funnel strategies that connect all of those pieces — combining data, creativity, testing, and measurement to drive meaningful business results.

We believe the best ideas come from people who are endlessly curious, willing to challenge conventional thinking, and excited to experiment. We work collaboratively across media, creative, measurement, strategy, and platform partnerships to continuously push our clients and ourselves forward.

About The Role

The Paid Social Director is responsible for leading paid social strategy, client performance, and team development across a portfolio of eCommerce brands. This person brings deep expertise in performance marketing, a strong understanding of the eCommerce landscape, and the ability to translate complex business challenges into actionable strategies that drive measurable growth.

We're looking for a confident, proactive leader with strong opinions and the expertise to back them up. Someone who takes ownership, challenges conventional thinking, and isn't afraid to push clients and teams toward better solutions. They bring exceptional executive presence, inspire confidence in high-stakes conversations, and balance big-picture thinking with the technical depth to diagnose performance challenges and guide teams toward solutions.

Beyond client leadership, this role plays a critical part in elevating the quality of work across Code3's Paid Social practice. The Director will develop strong managers, establish clear standards for accountability and execution, and foster a culture of curiosity, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

Success in this role requires someone who can lead with conviction, operate with urgency, and empower teams to consistently deliver exceptional work.

Note, hands on keys experience within social UIs is a requirement for this role.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead paid social strategy, performance, and client health across a portfolio of eCommerce brands, overseeing full funnel media planning, creative strategy, testing, measurement, and long-term account growth.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior client stakeholders, confidently leading executive-level conversations, navigating complex challenges, and delivering clear, data-backed recommendations that drive business outcomes.
  • Bring deep technical and strategic expertise to diagnose performance challenges, pressure-test account strategies, identify optimization opportunities, and guide teams toward stronger results across major paid social platforms.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing managers and teams, establishing clear expectations, driving accountability, addressing performance gaps, and fostering a culture of ownership, curiosity, and continuous learning.
  • Establish and scale best practices across campaign execution, budget management, strategic planning, reporting, and client communication while proactively identifying risks and improving operational efficiency across teams.
  • Champion innovation, creative effectiveness, and thought leadership by translating emerging platform capabilities, consumer trends, and measurement advancements into actionable opportunities for clients and the broader agency.

Who will love this role:

  • A highly organized, action-oriented leader who thrives on ownership, brings structure to complexity, and holds themselves and others to high standards.
  • A bold, opinionated strategist who has strong, informed perspectives, challenges the status quo, and isn't afraid to push back when there's a better way forward.
  • An exceptional communicator who commands a room, builds credibility with senior stakeholders, and genuinely enjoys leading complex client conversations.
  • A people-first leader who is passionate about developing talent, building a high-performing team culture, and creating an environment of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • An endlessly curious eCommerce and paid social enthusiast who loves digging into performance, exploring emerging trends, and sharing knowledge to make the entire team stronger.

You should have:

  • 8+ years of paid social experience, including significant agency experience leading strategy and performance for eCommerce brands.
  • Extensive eCommerce expertise, with a proven track record driving profitable growth for DTC and retail brands, and a deep understanding of customer acquisition, ROAS, CAC, LTV, conversion optimization, and full funnel measurement.
  • Advanced hands-on expertise across major paid social platforms, particularly Meta and TikTok, with strong working knowledge of Pinterest, Snapchat, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging platforms.
  • Proven experience managing and developing teams, holding direct reports accountable, addressing performance challenges, and consistently elevating strategic and operational quality.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently audit accounts, diagnose performance trends, develop actionable optimization strategies, and connect media performance to broader eCommerce business outcomes.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with experience building trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and confidently navigating high-pressure situations.
  • Strong understanding of creative strategy, testing methodologies, attribution, incrementality, and performance measurement, with the ability to turn complex data into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables required); experience with eCommerce analytics and attribution platforms such as GA4, Northbeam, or Triple Whale is strongly preferred. Relevant platform certifications are a plus.

Position also offers a bonus based on company and client success.

The base salary range will be determined based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. Certain positions may also be eligible for a bonus, with eligibility and details discussed during the recruitment process. For candidates that are based in California, we encourage you to review this important information for California residents here. For best results, open the link in a new tab.

Salary Range
$134,500—$160,000 USD

Working at Code3

At Code3, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to do their best. We’re proud to offer a competitive rewards package, meaningful opportunities for growth, and a culture that’s collaborative, inclusive, and—most importantly—human.

Here’s what you can expect as a Coder:

  • Remote-first workplace designed to support flexibility and connection
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, plus a generous retirement program
  • Thoughtful parental leave and return-to-work program
  • Flexible Time Off, sabbatical opportunities, paid holidays, quarterly Company “Recharge” Days, and a holiday closure in December
  • Ongoing learning and development opportunities to help you grow your skills and career
  • A commitment to transparent DEIB practices and building a workplace where everyone can thrive

A Few Things to Know

All candidates who receive an offer will be required to successfully complete a background check.

Want to get to know us a little better? Check out Life at Code3 to learn more about our people, culture, and what it’s like to be a Coder.

Our Interview Process

During this first call, we’ll get to know you, learn more about your experience, and talk about what you’re looking for in your next opportunity. We’ll also explore alignment with our company and values, and depending on the role, we may ask a few technical or role-specific questions. From there, the process can look a little different depending on the role. You can expect to meet several members of the team and, for some positions, complete a skills assessment such as a Take-Home Assignment or Live Exercise. We’ll make sure you know what to expect every step of the way. Your Talent Acquisition partner will walk you through the full process during your initial conversation.

Inclusive Workforce

At Code3, we’re committed to creating a culture where people from all backgrounds feel welcome, supported, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. We want every Coder to feel included and have the opportunity to contribute fully to our vision and goals. All applicants will receive fair consideration for employment. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic in the location where the candidate is applying.

If you have an accessibility need or would benefit from an accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know at . We’re happy to work with you to make the process as comfortable and accessible as possible.

For more information about the data we collect and how we use it, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

We use AI technology to help streamline parts of our hiring workflow. People are at the heart of our hiring process, and all candidate decisions are made by our Talent Acquisition Team.

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from third-party recruitment firms.

  • Ability to identify adoption blockers, recommend solutions, and contribute to customer growth through technical discovery and value-based consultation

Success Measures:

  • High customer satisfaction and strong relationships with technical and business stakeholders
  • Successful onboarding and implementation of customers
  • Increased product adoption, usage, and customer value realization
  • Reduced technical blockers and faster resolution of complex customer issues
  • Strong renewal support through successful adoption, risk mitigation, and demonstrated product value

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Head IS Enterprise Architecture

__



Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to define, operate, and continuously improve the enterprise architecture governance framework, standards, and compliance mechanisms. Each day you will ensure architectural consistency, risk reduction, and strategic alignment across ABB’s decentralized operating model, while enabling local autonomy and innovation. You will also act as the custodian of architectural decision making, standards, and guardrails. You will be balancing enterprise coherence with domain and product team agility, making sure that EA rules and practices are embedded into the organization’s operating model. This role has three/ four people reporting into it.

The work model for the role is: #Li_hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Architecture Governance
    • Governing and operating the enterprise architecture governance model, including decision rights, escalation paths, and review forums.
    • Ensuring architecture choices are transparent, traceable, and aligned with enterprise strategy.
    • Embedding governance into delivery processes (e.g., portfolio, product, and investment lifecycles).
    • Overseeing governance boards across the organization and making sure that relevant decentralized governance is in place.
  • Practice Development
    • Defining and maintaining EA practice standards, frameworks, and methodologies aligned with industry best practices (e.g., TOGAF) and organizational strategy.
    • Establishing governance processes for architecture reviews, compliance and selection.
    • Training and support for architects and business consumers.
  • Enablement & Community Building
    • Driving initiatives to strengthen the EA community through training, knowledge sharing, and collaboration platforms.
    • Promoting adoption of EA tools (e.g., Ardoq) and ensuring effective onboarding and usage across domains.
    • Acting as a champion for the EA repository and toolset and driving cultural change by fostering a “community-led architecture” mindset.
  • Standards & Reference Architecture
    • Owning and maintaining enterprise architecture standards and policies across business, data, application, technology, security, and integration domains.
  • Continuous Improvement
    • Measuring governance effectiveness using defined KPIs (e.g., reuse, compliance, time-to-decision), continuously improving standards, governance processes, and tooling and staying current with industry best practices and evolving architectural trends.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, or related field
  • 8+ years in Enterprise Architecture or related roles, with at least 3 years in practice enablement or governance
  • Proven experience in implementing EA frameworks, tools, and governance processes in a global organization
  • Experience in decentralized, multi-domain, or federated operating models
  • Strong understanding of EA domains (business, application, data, technology)
  • Familiarity with architecture modeling tools (e.g., Ardoq, ArchiMate)
  • TOGAF or equivalent EA framework certification preferred
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills
  • Ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels
  • Strong governance, risk, and standards management capability


This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

About SafelyYou

SafelyYou’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person-centered care across senior living through world-leading AI, industry-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities.

Originating in 2015 as the doctoral research of CEO George Netscher—and inspired by his own family's experience with Alzheimer's disease—SafelyYou was spun out of UC Berkeley’s Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, one of the top five AI research groups in the world. And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. All helping ensure that communities can focus on improved care for residents while still reaching their financial goals.

SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation.

Your Role at SafelyYou
SafelyYou's AI+Human-In_Loop solutions (fall detection, mobility, severity tagging, presence, and change detection) powers every product we sell. You own the AI capability roadmap as a platform: the reusable models and signals our customer-facing teams turn into outcomes, and the path by which research becomes production value. You'll ship existing models into production in short cycles, help place a few longer research bets, and keep SafelyYou ahead as AI techniques change fast. AI research leadership sets research direction and customer-facing PMs own customer outcomes; you own what the AI can do, how well, and at what cost.


Key Responsibilities:

The Numbers You'll Own

  • Readiness. Every model release passes an AI-readiness gate (accuracy, false alarms, review cost, rollback) within the next year.

  • Quality and cost. A measurable reduction in with no loss in detection.

  • Leverage.At least one capability reused by two or more product teams, and one research bet taken to a clear continue-or-stop decision.

What You'll Own

  • One capability roadmapacross edge and cloud, ranked by cross-team leverage.

  • How AI is consumed: outputs, confidence thresholds, and latency and accuracy expectations.

  • Model readiness and field performance: criteria from research to shadow deployment to production, then precision, recall, and drift in live communities.

  • Human review economics: a feedback loop with our clinical reviewers that improves models and reduces review per event.

  • Research to value: early-learning milestones for 6–12 month bets, plus data priorities (curation, edge cases, labeling).

  • Emerging AI:track how newer techniques (vision-language and multimodal models, agentic systems, efficient on-device models) change what's possible, and turn the right ones into SafelyYou capabilities, such as richer event understanding and less human review.

  • New sensing modalitieswith Hardware & Sensing: you own what models can extract; they own modality selection and cost.

The Ideal Candidate:

  • Fluency in modern AI/ML (computer vision, multimodal and vision-language models, evaluation), credible with researchers and ML engineers. Engineers who moved into product are welcome.

  • Well versed in how newer AI techniques have emerged, from foundation and vision-language models to agentic systems and efficient on-device models, with a clear point of view on where they apply in care settings and where they don't.

jobs.excerpt: About IFS LogisticsIFS Logistics (built and launched as 7bridges, now part of IFS) is an AI-native enterprise logistics platform.
jobs.description:
About IFS Logistics

IFS Logistics (built and launched as 7bridges, now part of IFS) is an AI-native enterprise logistics platform. We unify transport data, optimise carrier spend, and automate execution for enterprise shippers and logistics companies. We're a small, dedicated team inside IFS, reporting into the commercial organisation rather than central R&D. Pure SaaS, zero consultancy.

The role

This is not a traditional "add AI to an existing system" role. You will own the product surface of our audit product end to end — the checks that tell a customer a delivery was late or a carrier charged them incorrectly, the queue where those findings get reviewed and actioned, and the self-serve configuration that lets a customer build their own checks without us.

Audit & Visibility is becoming a standalone product. A staff engineer leads the squad and brings the backend depth; you bring the product surface. You will set the approach for it, partner directly with the squad's Product Lead on product, and be the second technical voice in the squad. You are also the day-to-day mentor for the Junior engineer joining alongside you — that is part of the job, not an extra.

Your depth is frontend and product engineering. Every engineer here is expected to be genuinely fullstack; the profile describes where your depth is, not a boundary you stay inside. You will write Django, design the API contract you consume, and reason about what BigQuery and dbt are doing underneath your screens.

What you'll work on

  • The audit review queue at real scale — tens of thousands of findings per tenant, filtered, triaged, actioned and evidenced.
  • Self-serve check configuration: customers building, previewing and versioning their own audit checks. "Customers configure and manage it, not IFS" is a product principle, not an aspiration.
  • Explainability for incorrect-charge detection — why this charge was flagged, against which rate card, at which version — reproducible months later for a dispute.
  • The Django endpoints, data contracts and pagination behaviour behind all of it.
  • Where the agent sits in each of these flows: agentic audit creation, human review at minimal, meaningful points, and the guardrails that make that safe against a customer's freight spend.

What we're looking for

  • Around five to eight years building and shipping production software, with real depth in React, TypeScript, state and interaction design at scale.
  • You have owned a product surface end to end including the ambiguity in it — you closed the open questions rather than waiting for someone to close them for you.
  • Genuinely fullstack: you write the Python/Django side, you argue about the API contract, and you know when a client-side answer is the wrong answer.
  • Strong on performance and scale in the interface: pagination, virtualisation, server-side filtering, and knowing which of those the data volume actually demands.
  • You build human-in-the-loop and explainability interfaces and treat auditability as a feature, not logging.
  • You raise the bar on other people's work. Review, pairing and direct feedback are things you do by default, and you are happy mentoring an engineer earlier in their career.
  • AI-native in practice: Cursor and Claude daily, good at giving an agent the right context, better at spotting when its output is confidently wrong.
  • You form and state a view. Ambiguity is the job, not a blocker.

Nice to have

  • Design-system ownership, or working shoulder to shoulder with a designer on a complex data surface.
  • Django REST, BigQuery, dbt, Cube Cloud, GCP.
  • LLM agents, RAG or evals in production.
  • Shipped an agent that does real work, like agentic audit or fulfilment-rule automation, and the instinct to build a simulation to prove the logic first.
  • Logistics, supply chain, freight, or any finance-adjacent domain where being wrong costs money.

Tech stack

React, TypeScript · Python (Django REST) · BigQuery, dbt, Cube Cloud, Superset · Pub/Sub, Datastream · GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD · LLMs, RAG, agent frameworks, evals · Cursor + Claude, Notion (SDD Central), Jira.

What success looks like — first 6 months

  • You own the audit review and configuration surface end to end, and the open questions in it get closed by you.
  • Self-serve check configuration is in production, with preview and versioning, and customers use it without us.
  • The queue performs at the largest tenant's data volume, measured, not assumed.
  • The Junior engineer in the squad is productive and shipping reviewed work independently, and can say what they learned from you.
  • Quality standards in the squad are visibly higher: code review on all merge requests, no direct-to-prod, acceptance criteria per ticket — real, not aspirational.

Why this role exists now

Audit & Visibility is becoming a standalone product and the product surface is where its value is either visible or invisible to a customer. The Staff Engineer holds the backend and leads the squad; they cannot also be the only person setting the approach on the product side. We are shifting from feature-driven engineering to agent-led product architecture, and this is one of the surfaces where that shift has to actually land.

You'll need to be based in either the UK or the Netherlands - we're a remote team with clusters of people in London and Amsterdam.

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. jobs.excerpt: SUMMARYThe Analyst - Data & Analytics role is responsible for owning analytical projects from question to answer, delivering work that holds up under review and is reused by others.
jobs.description:
SUMMARY

The Analyst - Data & Analytics role is responsible for owning analytical projects from question to answer, delivering work that holds up under review and is reused by others. The role operates from established metric definitions and engineering conventions rather than creating new ones, and works directly with business stakeholders up to Director level.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential function listed below.

  • Take a defined problem, produce a plan, and execute it with light review, delivering work that holds up under peer review and is reused by others.
  • Translate business questions into answerable analyses with guidance, selecting appropriate descriptive and inferential methods.
  • Build dashboards and reports for intermediate questions using the team's agreed metric definitions, escalating when a definition is missing rather than creating a competing one.
  • Add transformation models with tests and documentation, following the conventions of the existing version-controlled project.
  • Run a designed test or controlled comparison end to end, covering hypothesis, power calculation, sample sizing, and readout, and communicate uncertainty rather than omitting it.
  • Investigate data quality problems and route them to the teams that own the source, rather than patching around them downstream.
  • Apply data classification and access controls correctly, and raise privacy questions rather than working around them.
  • Use AI tooling to accelerate routine work, verifying output before it is shared and recognizing when it is unreliable.
  • Support the facilitation of ad hoc reporting and data requests by looking for opportunities for self-service and automation, working closely with other members of the analytics team.
  • Present findings clearly to the audience receiving them, and assist in onboarding new members of the team.
  • Perform other related duties and activities as required.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • None.

Minimum Knowledge and Skills required for the Job The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities required to perform the job.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field, or a certificate and portfolio demonstrating equivalent skill
  • Two to four years of relevant experience in reporting and/or analytics

Technical Skills and Abilities:

  • SQL: complex multi-CTE transformations, query tuning, and incremental logic
  • Python or R: functions and modules rather than notebooks alone, with virtual environments and pinned dependencies
  • Version control, testing, and CI: participates in code review, resolves merge conflicts without assistance, and understands why the pipeline runs
  • Power BI and visualization: builds performant Power BI reports on governed semantic models, including Power Query transformations, DAX measures, and row-level security basics. Prior experience in Tableau, Looker, Sigma, or a comparable platform is acceptable background.
  • Statistics and machine learning: linear and logistic regression, hypothesis testing, sample sizing, and standard supervised methods with correct training, validation, and test discipline
  • Cloud, warehouse, and orchestration: comfortable in Snowflake or equivalent, and understands how compute and storage are billed
  • Production and monitoring: hands work off with documentation and a named owner, and understands scheduled refresh and its common failure modes

Other Skills and Abilities:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal skills, presentation skills
  • Demonstrated organizational skills, detail-oriented, and the ability to multitask under pressure
  • Strong commitment to providing quality customer service and client interaction

Other Requirements:

  • Travel as needed

Physical Requirements:

  • Sedentary work. Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.

The regular working hours for this position can be performed remotely; however, due to current business and employment requirements, we are unable to employ individuals in this role who will be working from Alaska, Hawaii, New York, Oregon, South Dakota, Vermont, Washington State, or Washington, D.C. Although the role is primarily remote, occasional in-person and related travel is an essential function of this position.

We access all communities in Nova Scotia in a timely and efficient manner with our fleet of more than 180 ambulances and support vehicles operating out of 60+ stations. We respond to 165,000+ calls annually across the province, which are actively managed through the EHS Operations Medical Communications Centre, the hub of all emergency (911) and non-emergency (hospital transfers) medical calls.

The EHS Operations LifeFlight program provides even greater accessibility by responding to patients on scene or through inter-facility transports by our critical care team via helicopter, fixed wing, or ground ambulance.

In addition, paramedics in Nova Scotia participate in various programs both urban and rural such as community-based paramedic programs, collaborative emergency centres, and emergency preparedness and special operations, to name a few.

There are lots of opportunities waiting for you in Nova Scotia. Apply now to learn more about our service and available positions.

*

TeleHealth provides residents of Nova Scotia and PEI in non-emergency situations a standardized phone number to call and speak about their symptoms or illness with a registered nurse, 24 hours a day, seven days a week. TeleHealth Nurses provide telephone triage, health information and professional nursing care to more than 100,000 patients annually through the use of information and communication technologies, and with the support of computer-based decision support software, clinical guidelines, protocols and other resources.

TeleHealth Nurses work from their private home office. Working 8-hour shifts on a rotating schedule creates a good work-life balance, however, 10- and 12-hour shifts can be accommodated. During a regular work day, the TeleHealth nurse may receive up to 40 calls per shift. No two calls are the same - the TeleHealth Nurse will encounter a wide variety of health care concerns including but not limited to the fields of pediatrics, obstetrics, and geriatrics.

TeleHealth leaderships provide on the job training, frequent feedback and coaching. We understand the challenges that come from working remotely so we ensure that support is available for the nurses 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

We currently have Part-time and Full-time work from home opportunities available in both Nova Scotia and PEI servicing both provinces. Please note you are required to be licensed to practice within the province you reside.

  • Accurately and completely documents clinical and other relevant notes within the computer software program in a timely manner throughout and immediately after the call.
  • Liaises effectively between caller and third party in critical situations, such as need for ambulance transport, police intervention, suicidal caller, suspected or actual child abuse or other situations in which information is not consistent or may be disputed.
  • Adheres to time utilization guidelines and ensures that personal workflow supports the service to better meet the demand for Telecare services.

Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Clinical nursing experience, preferably in an acute care environment, such as Emergency Department, general medical-surgical or intensive care unit, and/or relevant community health setting, such as public health. Minimum 3 years of clinical experience (5 years preferred).
  • An active license and good standing as a Registered Nurse with the provincial nursing body legislated to regulate and license nurses and compliance with all applicable laws pertaining to the practice of nursing in the province.
  • Diploma from recognized and/or accredited nursing school. Bachelor degree is preferred.
  • Excellent communication, telephone and customer relation skills.
  • Good critical thinking, sound clinical decision-making and problem-solving skills.

  • Fluency in English (oral and written) is required and fluency in English and French (oral and written) is preferred.

About the opportunity:

We are looking for an experienced, commercially aware, and regulatory-savvy compliance professional to join us as Head of Compliance and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO).
The role will be instrumental in building the compliance programme from the ground up, and embedding a culture of compliance across the organisation.
Broader team management responsibilities will be added in due course for regulatory strategy, operational execution, and governance.

Key Responsibilities:

Regulatory Engagement

  • Serve as the primary point of contact with relevant regulatory bodies.
  • Ensure the organisation meets all applicable governance requirements, including fit and proper obligations for Approved and Designated Persons.
  • Monitor and interpret regulatory developments relevant to virtual assets, and advise senior management and the Board accordingly.

Compliance Programme Development & Management

  • Design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive compliance framework aligned with local requirements, FATF recommendations, and international best practice for virtual asset service providers (VASPs).
  • Develop, review, and update all internal policies and procedures covering AML/CFT, KYC, customer due diligence (CDD), enhanced due diligence (EDD), transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, data protection, cybersecurity compliance, and safeguarding of client assets.
  • Establish and oversee the compliance monitoring programme, including periodic testing, gap analysis, and reporting to senior management and the Board.
  • Prepare and present regular compliance reports to the Board and relevant committees, including on regulatory changes, compliance breaches, and remediation progress.
  • Ensure compliance considerations are integrated into new product design and operations from the inception phase by driving solutions that balance commercial outcomes and innovation, while maintaining a robust compliance posture using a clear risk-based approach.
  • Review technical documentation, user journeys, and product flows to ensure compliance risks are addressed; provide clear, actionable and solution-focused advice during the product lifecycle.
  • Build and scale compliance policies governing advertising, social media campaigns, influencer partnerships, and product launches.
  • Partner with Legal, Product, and Marketing teams to operationalize a timely review process for client-facing assets and go-to-market materials.

AML/CFT & MLRO Duties

  • Act as the designated MLRO, with full statutory responsibility for overseeing the organisation's AML/CFT framework.
  • Receive, review, and assess all internal Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) from staff, and make informed decisions on whether to file external disclosures with competent local authorities.
  • Oversee and continuously improve the transaction monitoring programme, with support from global compliance and product functions.
  • Ensure robust sanctions screening against all applicable lists, including OFAC, UK OFSI, UN, EU, and applicable local sanctions designations.
  • Oversee customer risk scoring, risk-based KYC/CDD processes, and enhanced due diligence for high-risk customers, politically exposed persons (PEPs), and customers from high-risk jurisdictions.

Governance & Culture

  • Act as a key member of the senior leadership team, providing compliance input on new products, services, partnerships, and business initiatives.
  • Champion a strong compliance culture across the organisation through training, communications, and leadership by example.
  • Design and deliver AML/CFT and compliance training programmes for all staff, ensuring completion records are maintained.
  • Ensure that the organisation's compliance obligations are adequately resourced, and advise the Board on staffing, systems, and budget requirements.
  • Establish and maintain a compliance manual, risk register and oversee the escalation and resolution of compliance incidents and breaches.

Reporting & Recordkeeping

  • Prepare and submit all required regulatory reports and notifications to relevant authorities within stipulated deadlines.
  • Ensure that all compliance records, SAR documentation, KYC files, and transaction monitoring records are maintained in accordance with applicable retention requirements.
  • Support and facilitate any inspections, supervisory visits, or regulatory examinations.

What We Look For in You

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
  • Professional certification in compliance or AML is strongly preferred (e.g. CAMS, ICA Certificate/Diploma in AML or Compliance, CFE, or equivalent).

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in compliance, AML, or financial crime prevention, with at least 3 years in a senior or leadership compliance role.
  • Demonstrated in-house experience working within virtual asset service providers (VASPs), cryptocurrency exchanges, fintech firms, or regulated financial institutions.
  • Prior experience as an MLRO or Deputy MLRO is highly desirable.
  • Experience engaging directly with financial regulators and the financial intelligence unit
  • Hands-on experience building compliance programmes from the ground up in a start-up or scaling environment is a significant advantage.
  • Familiarity with the regional regulatory framework and requirements is strongly preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Deep understanding of FATF Recommendations and their application to virtual asset service providers, including the Travel Rule (FATF Recommendation 16)
  • Strong knowledge of crypto-specific AML typologies.
  • Proficiency with blockchain analytics and transaction monitoring tools (e.g. Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs, or equivalent).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and French.
  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify and articulate complex risk scenarios clearly.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage constructively with regulators, external auditors, and law enforcement.
  • High degree of personal integrity and sound professional judgment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in cryptocurrency or blockchain compliance programs.
  • Experience working in a multi-national financial institution setting.
  • Familiarity with compliance technology and analytics tools.
  • Prior exposure to multi-jurisdictional compliance oversight.
  • In-depth knowledge of crypto products, including spot trading, derivatives, staking, lending/borrowing, DeFi, and stablecoins.

We are expanding our Pilot Experience Solutions, a connected system that brings together flight schools, pilots, and industry partners into a single, data-driven network. This next phase of growth is focused on expanding within our existing customer base, reaching pilots directly, and creating new revenue streams across the ecosystem.

The Pilotbase Customer Success Manager will act as a supportive point of contact and advocate for our customers. This role will engage with an assigned customer portfolio under supervision, helping customers realize value from our products and solutions while learning to identify opportunities for growth. Working closely with senior staff, the CSM will facilitate communication between customers and internal teams to ensure smooth delivery of solutions that meet customer needs. The primary focus of this role is to develop skills in identifying customer needs, communicating effectively, and contributing to a great customer experience.

Role Overview and Responsibilities:

Customer Retention

  • Manage a portfolio of customer accounts
  • Understand customers' business objectives and deliver valuable ROI
  • Review of customer accounts for migration from a month-to-month model to annual contracts
  • Help customers adopt best practices within our software to solve their challenges
  • Mitigate risk with accounts to avoid them churning out

Customer Advocacy

  • Regular proactive communication with customers using one-to-many methods
  • Advocate for customer training to increase product utilization
  • Work cross-functionally with all teams at FSP to advocate for customers’ needs
  • Uncover new best practices, use cases, success stories, and lessons from customers

Customer Growth

  • Build meaningful relationships with customers throughout the customer lifecycle journey
  • Identify growth opportunities in the portfolio of customer accounts and execute on an established target list
  • Generate a Customer Success Qualified Leads pipeline for the established targeted list
  • Ensure growth of MRR in individual portfolio
  • Expand product use to new teams within current companies

Required/Desired Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree in business or related field
  • A zeal for building relationships and helping people
  • Solid organizational and planning skills
  • Good communication skills, both written and oral
  • Experience in customer success management
  • Some experience with HubSpot, Pendo, PowerBI and Google Suite.
  • A positive attitude and a desire to be part of a motivated group doing big things
  • Experience in the Flight training industry and knowledge of aviation terminology is a plus

Benefits:

  • Full benefits package (Medical, Dental, Vision, Short-Term Disability, Life Insurance, 401(k) plan)
  • Equity Appreciation Plan
  • Flexible Time Off policy
  • Seven (7) company-wide paid holidays + two (2) floating holidays
  • Two (2) wellness days
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Home Office Stipend

Compensation:

The salary range for this role has been established at $70,000 - $80,000 annually. The final agreed-upon compensation is based on a number of factors, including but not limited to: individual education, qualifications, skills, prior work experience, competencies, and geographic work location. The above salary range represents the Company’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting.

Travel Requirements:

  • Occasional business travel may be required, up to 25%.

Deadline for Applications:

  • The company will accept ongoing applications until the role is filled. There is no deadline to apply for this position.

Pilotbase is an equal opportunity employer and encourages all qualified individuals to apply. If you're excited about this role, we'd love a chance to review your resume. We value a diverse and inclusive work environment and look for passionate people who are ready to do great things. If there is a required or preferred location for an open role, it will be listed in the job description. All applicants for employment must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Pilotbase does not provide work visa sponsorship at this time.

This employer participates in the Electronic Employment Verification Program. Please visit for more information.

Pilotbase welcomes all direct applicants, but does not utilize recruiting services from external agencies.

jobs.title: Technical Services Sr. Specialist (Michigan)
jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewABS Global, a Genus company, has an exciting opportunity for a Technical Services Sr.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

ABS Global, a Genus company, has an exciting opportunity for a Technical Services Sr. Specialist (Michigan) to provide technical services to strategic accounts in alignment with the ABS global strategy (specific focus on the Strategic Account Segment).

This role partners closely with commercial, genetic, and technical teams to improve customer performance, profitability, and long-term success. Success in this role requires strong dairy production knowledge, relationship-building skills, data analysis capabilities, and a passion for helping customers achieve operational excellence. Additionally, fluency in both English and Spanish is required, as this position regularly supports and collaborates with a diverse customer base and cross-functional teams across multiple regions.

This position is remote based in Michigan, with approximately 50% travel throughout North America. Candidates residing elsewhere in the U.S. are welcome to apply but must be willing to relocate to Michigan. This opportunity is open to U.S.-based candidates only.

The salary range for this position is $95,000 - $120,000 USD. The salary provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. Genus considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

You Will

Planning and execution of the Technical Service (TS) program in the strategic segment:

  • Planning and execution of Technical Service Strategy, in direct coordination with TAG Manager, Technical and Genetic teams, Global Strategic Account Director, and ABS commercial managers. This includes planning of visits and an activity calendar to serve strategic accounts assigned to the TS program.
  • Identification of technical opportunities that optimize profitability of strategic customers and prospects.
  • Implementation of technical solutions and training of farm employees and ABS personnel in dairy technical areas through the preparation and presentation of technical training materials and applied “hands-on” teaching/coaching.
  • Monitoring of progress and impact of technical solutions and farm employee training implemented in each strategic account of the TS program.
  • Prepare and present visit reports, performance summaries, and product validation data to strategic customers and ABS personnel involved in the management of strategic accounts.
  • Maintenance of the Strategic Account list for financial validation.
  • Participate actively in the Global SAM TAG team.

Technical communications and industry presence:

  • Address direct technical questions and concerns from strategic customers, prospects and ABS personnel.
  • Creation of technical communications of current relevant topics for publication on ABS internal and external channels.
  • Collection and sharing of technical data relevant to the performance of our products in the field.
  • Validation of technical tools to demonstrate account performance.
  • Attendance to producer and/or professional meetings to update technical concepts and technologies relevant to our service offering.

Requirements

Basic Qualifications (Required):

  • Degree in Veterinary, Dairy, Animal Science or Agriculture related discipline.
  • 3-5 years of applied technical experience in the areas of dairy reproductive management, genetics, calving and transition cow management, cow comfort, udder health and milk quality, calf and replacement management, basic dairy nutrition, dairy facilities, embryo transfer offering, and general herd health.
  • Applied experience in training/coaching personnel.
  • Applied experience in customer data analysis to validate our product and solution impact.
  • Bilingual- Ability to read, write, and orally communicate effectively in English and Spanish.
  • Ability to prepare reports and technical communications and presentations.
  • Ability to transmit technical knowledge and train/coach personnel.
  • Analytical capacity and knowledge of dairy management software (DC 305, BoviSync, PC Dart and other farm software).
  • Knowledge of basic software (Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook).
  • Excellent interpersonal relationships.

Business Overview

Genus is an agricultural biotechnology pioneer. We are a global FTSE 250 company, headquartered in the UK, and listed on the London Stock Exchange. Genus PLC has a presence in over 70 countries and a global workforce of over 3,000 employees and growing. We are a worldwide leader in porcine and bovine animal genetics, partnering with farmers to transform how we nourish the world – a mission that is important to a sustainable future.

ABS Global is a Genus company and is the world-leading provider of bovine genetics, reproductive services, technologies and udder care products. Marketing in more than 70 countries around the globe, ABS has been at the forefront of animal genetics and technology since its founding in 1941. We are uniquely positioned as a global player with a dedicated research and development function and an international distribution network. We breed and distribute the genes of the world’s best bulls, scientifically selecting livestock whose offspring is designed to increase the profitability of our customers who are some of the world’s biggest farmers and food producers. IntelliGen Technologies is the technology within ABS that develops sexed bovine genetics that helps customers maximize their profitability and reach their end goals in a fast and efficient manner.

Our vision is clear:Pioneering animal genetic improvement to sustainably nourish the world.

Benefits Overview

At Genus we offer a competitive salary. Benefits include health, dental, vision, FSA/HSA, long and short-term disability, 401K, tuition reimbursement, paid holidays and ETO (employee time off). This position will have opportunities for growth.

Equal Employment Opportunities

Genus is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with anti-discrimination law, it is the purpose of this policy to effectuate these principles and mandates. Genus prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Genus conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

Genus plc will never ask you to provide fees or payment for computer, software, or other equipment or supplies during the recruitment and/or onboarding process. If you have any questions about your individual application, please contact the Genus Talent Acquisition team at .

jobs.title: Account Manager — Strategic Communications (Social Impact / Global Health)
jobs.excerpt: About Newton StreetAt Newton Street, our mission is to connect people and ideas that change the world.
jobs.description:
About Newton Street

At Newton Street, our mission is to connect people and ideas that change the world.

We are a women-led strategic communications firm advising global health organizations, philanthropies, high-profile individuals, family offices, for-profit companies, and social impact organizations tackling the most complex issues of our time.

We help our partners shape narratives, elevate ideas, and spark action that drives meaningful change on a global scale.

Our team is collaborative and values-driven, guided by integrity, kindness, curiosity, and a commitment to excellence.

Role Snapshot – Media Engagement + Writing Expertise

We’re seeking an Account Manager with strong earned media experience and a sharp understanding of how media, digital, social, and owned channels work together to advance mission-driven goals.

This is not a marketing, advertising, or sales role. It is an integrated strategic communications role for someone who understands how to work with journalists, develop compelling story angles, shape executive thought leadership, and translate narratives across digital and social platforms. The ideal candidate brings strong media relations judgment and is comfortable advising clients on how earned media, LinkedIn, newsletters, websites, social content, and analytics can work together to build visibility and impact.

You’ll work closely with our founders and senior strategists, leading day-to-day client relationships and driving media-focused communications programs for high-impact organizations.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a trusted day-to-day partner to clients, managing relationships with confidence and care
  • Lead media and digital communications strategies, including:
    • Developing story angles, messaging, and narrative platforms
    • Pitching journalists and editors
    • Securing media coverage, op-eds, interviews, and thought leadership placements
    • Identifying opportunities to extend media moments across digital, social and owned channels
  • Draft and edit high-quality written materials, including:
    • Media pitches and press materials
    • Op-eds and contributed articles
    • Talking points, speeches, and briefing documents
    • Communications strategies, media plans, and digital content
    • LinkedIn posts, executive thought leadership content, newsletter copy, website language, and social media content as needed
  • Support media training and message development for executives and subject-matter experts
  • Advise clients on how earned media, digital platforms, social content, and owned channels can work together to advance strategic goals
  • Collaborate with internal team members to ensure strategic alignment and flawless execution
  • Manage multiple client priorities with clarity, responsiveness, and calm under pressure
  • Contribute ideas that strengthen client impact and help evolve Newton Street’s offerings
  • Track and analyze media and digital performance, delivering clear reports that assess message pull-through, narrative impact, and opportunities for amplification.
  • Monitor media, digital, and social trends and emerging news to identify timely pitching opportunities and position clients within relevant public conversations.

Client Sectors You Could Support

  • Global Health
  • Women’s Health
  • Climate, Environment, and Agricultural Development
  • Economic Opportunity
  • AI for Social Good
  • Philanthropy & Social Impact

What You’ll Bring

  • 6–8 years of experience in public relations, strategic communications, media relations, or integrated communications
  • Demonstrated success securing earned media coverage, op-eds, and thought leadership placements
  • Strong understanding of how journalists work, what makes a story newsworthy, and how media moments can be extended through digital and social channels.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills—clear, persuasive, and purposeful
  • Experience working in or alongside - PR agencies, foundations, social impact or policy-focused organizations
  • Knowledge of one or more core issue areas: climate, global health, women’s health, mental health, economic opportunity, or philanthropy.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects without sacrificing quality or judgment
  • Responsive and proactive while working in a remote office environment
  • Experience in working across teams and collaboratively with other partners or agencies
  • Technologically fluent and proactive, with strong organizational and collaboration skills.
  • Comfort working in global or multicultural contexts
  • Eligibility to work in the United States

Bonus Points

  • Existing media relationships in global health, philanthropy, or policy journalism
  • Experience leading integrated communications campaigns
  • Experience using analytics or performance insights to refine communications strategy
  • Experience mentoring junior team members
  • Background in crisis communications or reputation management
  • Experience advising senior leaders, philanthropists, or public-facing experts

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary ($95,000–$120,000)
  • Comprehensive benefits: medical, dental, vision, disability, accidental death & dismemberment insurance, and retirement plan
  • Generous paid time off and holidays — including a year-end paid break
  • Fully remote, U.S.-based work environment
  • A culture where your voice matters and your impact is visible

Equal Opportunity

Newton Street is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members.

Ready to Shape Change?

If you’re passionate about using strategic communications to advance solutions for the world’s biggest challenges, we’d love to hear from you.

Salary: $95,000- $120,000

jobs.description:
THE·TEAM is proud to provide representation and marketing services to talent, brands and properties across 28 countries and more than 70 cities worldwide. Our brands and properties group partners with iconic brands and rights holders to turn relevance into revenue through integrated strategy and consulting, creative, live experiences and commercialization. We help clients understand, connect to and inspire global audiences by bringing together brands, properties and talent/creators to build meaningful relationships that drive measurable business outcomes.


Shaped by our belief in the unifying power of sports, music and entertainment, THE·TEAM leads with intelligence, ideas and influence. For more information, please visit .


Job Overview:

The Senior Manager, Production is an integral position on THE•TEAM’s Experiential Team responsible for overseeing the successful delivery of various aspects of agency projects, from brief to execution. This role will ensure that all project relevant resources including operations and logistics are allocated and delivered on time, on budget and of a quality

expected by THE•TEAM and its clients.

Additionally, the Senior Manager, Production will contribute to the department operations, processes, budgeting (for live projects and pitches), agency quality control, third-party supplier management as well as continually mentoring and developing the Production team members.

What You’ll Do:

  • Responsible for overseeing and managing various elements of large-scale projects from planning through execution
  • Work in a collaborative manner with all THE•TEAM account teams to ensure flawless project delivery against the client’s objectives and agreed budget
  • Manage vendor relationships with audio, lighting, staging, fabrication, graphics, digital technology, venues, labor, and other project executional vendor partnerships as necessary to ensure that all agency suppliers meet THE•TEAM standards of sustainability, ethical purchasing, diversity, quality control and pricing structure
  • Regular communication with agency team and client team regarding roles and responsibilities, budget, schedules, and project status
  • Develop, manage and reconcile project budgets of $500k+, responsible for ensuring that projects are correctly budgeted for and meet expected financial targets
  • Develop production schedules, run of shows, and enforce deliverable dates key to program success
  • Responsible for building and maintaining effective client relationships, ensuring that all client needs are addressed in a timely fashion throughout the duration of projects
  • Manage and develop the relationships with THE•TEAM trusted suppliers and third parties, throughout the duration of the project
  • Manage the working team across a client account, provide guidance and leadership, communicate a vision, and challenge the team to achieve goals

  • Promote our team environment and provide work direction and guidance including coaching, professional development and training; guides team on deliverables, and establishes best practices with project management

What We’re Looking For:

  • Minimum of a Bachelor's degree
  • 4 – 7 years relevant / increasing operations experience (preferably in the experiential, sports or entertainment field)
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure, work on multiple projects simultaneously and achieve deadlines
  • Demonstrate an in-depth understanding of the experiential landscape and proven ability to deliver projects from the ground up
  • Confidence to present and communicate with senior clients as well as the ability to independently craft complex, nuanced written communications for internal and external outreach
  • Capable of navigating tough issues and influencing those involved toward a desired outcome
  • Must be comfortable working as an integral part of a team environment
  • Continuously demonstrates solution-oriented mentality
  • Lead and inspire other team members, generate positive morale
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize workload while coordinating with others to proactively meet deadlines
  • Strong attention to detail and highly organized
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment and possess a ‘can-do’ attitude at all times
  • Agency experience preferred

jobs.description:
Location:

Remote Position

Hiring Range:

$15.60 - $26.58

This position will be Work From Home - but qualified candidates must reside in Central Time or Eastern Time zones to be considered.

Job Description Summary:

A Managed Care Coordinator serves as the liaison between the Financial Counselor and the Utilization Management and Intake team by coordinating managed care review of benefits, authorizations, referrals and streamlining communication of the managed care components for patient services. Performs the quality control function for pre-certification and prior authorization. The Managed Care Coordinator ensures the patients’ insurance benefits are kept up to date in the electronic medical records (EMR) and billing software while also verifying the patient’s services meet coverage appropriateness.


Primary Job Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Monitors and coordinates internally and externally with the insurance company on the pre-certification and prior authorization processes, including peer-2-peer and appeals, seeking support from provider or pharmacy team when applicable.
  • Review assigned patient(s) and/or Physician schedules for upcoming visits and/or treatment to evaluate coverage criteria with payor guidelines and preferred treatment.
  • Review patients’ treatment plan(s) and identify if insurance benefit coverage is active, all unplanned exceptions are to be communicated to provider/clinic team immediately.
  • Review and identify new treatment orders.
  • Communicate openly and routinely throughout the course of the workday with various teams such as the Financial Counselor Team, Intake Team, UM team and coworkers through Teams, phone calls, emails and in person to discuss items as needed to complete managed cares.
  • Work closely with outside entities to ensure full collaboration and completion of forms and items needed in a timely and sometimes urgent manner.
  • Understand and comply with all Federal and State laws and regulations pertaining to patient care, rights, safety, billing, and collections.
  • Will be expected to work overtime when given sufficient notice of required overtime.
  • Keep work area and records in a neat and orderly manner.
  • Maintain all company equipment in a safe and working order.
  • Adhere to all AON and departmental policies and procedures, including Revenue cycle policies and procedures.
  • Performs other duties and projects as assigned.

Job Qualifications and Requirements:


Education: High school Diploma or GED required. Further education or degree a plus Certifications/Licenses: Previous Experience (including minimum years of experience):

  • A minimum of two-years prior experience in the healthcare field, preferably in a clinical or business office setting required.
  • Prior Medical terminology.
  • Prior Medical insurance verification.
  • Prior Verifying pre-certification and/or prior authorization with medical insurance.
  • Excellent proven verbal and communication skills needed.
  • Proven Insurance knowledge requirements including an understanding of medical terminology, ICD9, ICD10 and CPT codes.
  • Ability to calculate and collect patients’ responsibility and insurance co-pay/coinsurance.

Core Capabilities:

  • Analysis & Critical Thinking: Critical thinking skills including solid problem solving, analysis, decision-making, planning, time management and organizational skills. Must be detailed oriented with the ability to exercise independent judgment.
  • Interpersonal Effectiveness: Developed interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, diplomacy, tact, conflict management, delegation skills, and diversity awareness. Ability to work effectively with sensitive and confidential material and sometimes emotionally charged matters.
  • Communication Skills: Good command of the English language. Second language is an asset but not required. Effective communication skills (oral, written, presentation), is an active listener, and effectively provides balanced feedback.
  • Customer Service & Organizational Awareness: Strong customer focus. Ability to build an engaging culture of quality, performance effectiveness and operational excellence through best practices, strong business and political acumen, collaboration and partnerships, as well as a positive employee, physician and community relations.
  • Self-Management: Effectively manages own time, conflicting priorities, self, stress, and professional development. Self-motivated and self-starter with ability work independently with limited supervision. Ability to work remotely effectively as required.
  • Must be able to work effectively in a fast-paced, multi-site environment with demonstrated ability to juggle competing priorities and demands from a variety of stakeholders and sites.
  • Computer Skills: Proficiency in MS Office Word, Excel, Power Point, and Outlook required.Ability to use multiple screens to perform required job functions.Ability to navigate multiple applications and tab in and out of workflow to complete tasks.

Travel : 0%

Standard Core Workdays/Hours: Monday to Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM. Occasional overtime may be required, and weekend shifts based on location hours and operational needs.

jobs.description:
Job Purpose

Working as a part of the global Sales Operations team, the Operations Analyst will demonstrate integrity and excellence in the provision of support to the Commercial organisation.

The Operations Analyst role will primarily revolve around the calculation, administration and communication of the commission and bonus plans for the global Commercial organisation and will work closely with other departments such as Sales and Finance to ensure that all activities are completed to a high degree of accuracy. The role will also have involvement in in ongoing Commercial reporting requirements as well as helping to maintain dashboards on our BI system (Sisense). The team has a reputation for high standards and high-quality data provision, and this reputation needs to be maintained at all times.

The Operations Analyst is expected to continually evaluate the tasks they undertake and to look for opportunities to improve existing processes. The Junior Operations Analyst will be expected to work as a member of the wider Sales Operations team to implement new ideas and initiatives that support the efficiency of the Commercial organisation.

Job Overview

Key Responsibilities

  • Calculate regular commission and bonus payments and work to strict deadlines to ensure that payments are submitted to payroll on time for processing.
  • Communicate targets and compensation statements in a timely manner.
  • Manage and respond to queries promptly and professionally.
  • Production and collation of all compensation related documentation.
  • Prepare and maintain dashboards and reporting in various platforms.
  • Ensure the integrity and consistency of corporate data.
  • Prepare and distribute various reporting across the Commercial organization.
  • Review team processes and own work methods with a view to improve efficiency and effectiveness of allocated tasks.
  • Create and maintain strong relationships within the Commercial organisation and across the business.

Skills & Experience

  • Highly numerate with excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Able to thrive under pressure in a busy environment.
  • Flexible “Can do” attitude.
  • Organized approach to all tasks.
  • Good team player with the ability to work on own initiative as required.
  • Ability to communicate confidently.
  • Excellent time management and deadline oriented.
  • Experience in working with large volumes of data.
  • Experience with Salesforce Lightning or other CRM systems.
  • Knowledge of and experience with Business Intelligence platforms (e.g. Sisense).
  • Previous experience is a fast-moving, sales orientated company.
  • Strong business acumen.
  • Educated to degree level.

Life at RWS

RWS is a global AI solutions company empowering the world’s most trusted enterprise AI.

Our proprietary Cultural Intelligence Layer, powered by 250,000 data specialists, cultural and language experts and deep domain professionals, backed by 45+ patents, makes enterprise AI culturally fluent, contextually accurate and secure, ensuring every interaction reflects a brand’s tone, context and customer values.

Through our Generate, Transform and Protect segments, we deliver intelligent content, enterprise knowledge, large-scale localization and IP protection for global growth. Trusted by 80+ of the world’s top 100 brands, RWS provides the confidence, governance and expertise organizations need to deploy AI safely, responsibly and at scale.

Headquartered in the UK, RWS is listed on AIM (RWS.L).
