jobs.excerpt: Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure.
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

We are looking for an AI Ethics & Human Impact Lead to join our team. Reporting to the Head of People Risk & Integrity in the People & Culture organization, this position can be hybrid at our Santa Clara, CA headquarters or Bellevue, WA office or Remote with a preference for Chicago, IL based candidates. Sitting within the People Risk & Integrity (PRI) team, this leader will architect and drive our Ethical and Human Impact program, providing the independent judgment and ethical framework necessary to ensure our technological innovation remains fundamentally human-centered. This is not a policy compliance role; it operates at the intersection of philosophy, technology and the future of work.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive AI Ethics Framework for People systems and workforce-adjacent AI, defining our values and decision criteria
  • Serve as an independent ethics authority with the mandate to pause, challenge, or escalate AI initiatives that pose unacceptable risks to employees or candidates
  • Design and lead Human Impact Assessments (HIAs) for AI tools
  • Articulate and maintain our ethical position on the purpose of AI in the workplace, balancing efficiency with human-centered innovation
  • Monitor the evolving global regulatory landscape to ensure proactive compliance and strategic positioning

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You are comfortable building the path as you walk it, seeing dynamic and changing environments as an opportunity to construct something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action, and you operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome.
  • True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range. You possess the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust partner. You thrive on collaborative feedback, matching ambition for the team with direct, respectful communication to build trust.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Advanced understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • An advanced degree or equivalent applied experience in a field requiring sustained ethical reasoning
  • Deep practical literacy in how AI and machine learning systems work, sufficient to interrogate algorithmic design and identify risks
  • Demonstrated subject matter expertise in AI ethics, responsible AI, technology policy, or organizational ethics
  • Proven ability to exercise independent judgment and influence at the executive level with credibility and composure
  • Exceptional ability to translate abstract ethical concepts into clear, actionable language for technical, legal, and business audiences

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Direct experience building or leading an AI ethics or responsible technology function
  • Specific experience with HR technology, people analytics, or workforce-related AI tools
  • Background in labor economics, future of work research, or employment rights

The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations and could be higher or lower based on a multitude of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

Role Summary:

The Principal Technical Account Manager is an architectural visionary and a strategic director for Ping’s most complex, high-risk global accounts. Engaging directly with C-suite and VP-level stakeholders, you will align long-term business vision with technical governance and scale. Beyond individual account management, you own the evolution of global TAM delivery. You will define the strategic KPIs used by the organization, shape company-wide product strategy based on enterprise insights, and drive the integration of predictive AI analytics into global service delivery frameworks.

You will:

  • Direct the technical strategy and governance standards for the most complex global accounts, translating long-term enterprise goals into a cohesive product journey.
  • Influence the C-suite and align their long-term business vision with Ping’s capabilities and roadmap.
  • Own the evolution of global TAM delivery by defining strategic KPIs, creating service frameworks, and driving the strategy for global knowledge sharing.
  • Accountable for critical internal initiatives and leading high-level Get to Green strategies for at-risk global accounts.
  • Define the requirements and functional scope for internal AI productivity tools, ensuring advanced analytics and AI are integrated into the TAM workflow to provide predictive insights.
  • Act as a strategic advocate, shaping company-wide policy and product strategy based on aggregate insights from the world’s largest enterprises.
  • Represent Ping Identity as a Global Thought Leader at major industry summits and executive briefings.

You have:

  • 10+ years of senior-level technical account management, enterprise architecture, or consulting experience.
  • Expert-level mastery of cybersecurity architectures, risk management frameworks, and the ability to design comprehensive, secure enterprise ecosystems aligned with modern security standards.
  • Proven track record of operationalizing AI tools, LLMs, and predictive analytics as a force multiplier across technical teams to scale global service delivery and insight generation.
  • Exceptional executive presence, functioning as the bedrock of trust and ethical clarity for C-suite stakeholders in high-pressure environments.
  • Proven ability to design and implement organizational service frameworks, KPIs, and delivery methodologies on a global scale.
  • Deep architectural mastery of enterprise IAM, security governance, and multi-cloud infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated history of driving technical enablement and talent strategy across large technical organizations.

You have an advantage if:

  • Recognized thought leadership via publications, blogs, or speaking engagements at industry events.
  • Experience conceptualizing and deploying custom AI-driven operational tools in a technical service environment.

$190k to $220k

Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

Simply put, we make it easier for school leaders to increase student achievement. Our experience working with a wide range of schools – from newly authorized charter schools to independent schools with century-long histories, and from microschools to multi-campus networks – allows us to provide high-quality finance, accounting, and student data support across diverse educational environments.

Our team of over 100 professionals currently serves over 100 independent and public charter schools and networks across D.C., Louisiana, Maryland, Missouri, Michigan, New Jersey, and New York. We are serious about being the best possible partners to schools, and it shows in our 93% annual client retention rate. We work hard at being a rewarding, enjoyable workplace where staff can grow professionally and make an impact. We are looking for education focused, accounting and finance loving, collaborative people to join our team.

  • Serve as an outsourced accountant and financial advisor for a portfolio of schools

    • Serve as an integral part of several internal teams demonstrating a strong desire to help.

The Manager, Drug User Health, plays a vital role in expanding the organization’s capacity to address the impacts of the intersecting crises of drug use, HIV/AIDS, and viral hepatitis in community and public health settings, particularly within state and local health departments and Syringe Services Programs (SSPs).

This role will primarily work on identifying, interpreting, and communicating information about the illicit drug supply to inform overdose prevention and response strategies and public health communications across the country. Professional and/or volunteer experience in relevant harm reduction service planning and provision (for example, syringe services programs, community-based drug checking services, overdose prevention sites, or other direct service settings) is required.

Familiarity with federal overdose prevention and response funding and policy landscapes and public health communications strategies is strongly preferred. The Manager’s core activities will advance NASTAD’s efforts to support and strengthen community-based drug user health programs by providing direct funding grants, technical assistance (TA), and training on topics such as effective drug user health strategies and how to connect people who use drugs to HIV and hepatitis prevention and treatment programs. This is an individual contributor role that reports to the Associate Director, Drug User Health.

  • Provide TA and capacity-building to state and local health department and community-based programs, including consultation, training, and the development and delivery of peer-to-peer learning opportunities

  • Develop, monitor, and review technical assistance resources that meet the needs of diverse stakeholders.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability, age, or protected veteran status.

jobs.description:
Company overview:

Blue Orange Digital is a boutique data & AI consultancy that delivers enterprise-grade results. We design and build modern data platforms, analytics, and ML/AI Agent solutions for mid‑market and enterprise clients across Private Equity, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Retail.

Our teams work with technologies like Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, and the broader Microsoft ecosystem to turn messy, real-world data into trustworthy, actionable insight.

We’re a builder‑led, client‑first culture that prizes ownership, clear communication, and shipping high‑impact work.

Note: Please submit your resume in English, as all application materials must be in English for review and consideration.

Position overview

Blue Orange Digital is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with genuine agentic systems depth for a full-time, 6-month embedded engagement in a private-capital data environment. This is a deliberately merged role: roughly half senior data engineering — Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, AWS, Python ingestion — and half senior LLM/agentic engineering, spanning production agents, MCP servers, evaluation practice, and observability. You will work on two core initiatives: an AI-Ready Data Catalog & Context Layer built alongside the Data Analytics team, and Unstructured Data Extraction at scale, with agentic implementation, evaluation, and orchestration as the throughline across both. This is not a pipeline-maintenance seat; we are looking for someone who has already shipped agents into production and can tell us candidly what broke.

Responsibilities

Agentic development (primary focus)

Build production agents and multi-step agentic workflows, and design and implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and tool interfaces as the primary integration surface between agents and the data platform — including custom internal MCP servers over proprietary datasets. Make deliberate architectural calls on agent vs. deterministic pipeline, single-agent vs. multi-agent decomposition, and where human-in-the-loop checkpoints belong.

Agent evaluation and observability

Stand up an evaluation practice from scratch — eval datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing — and define and track the metrics that matter: task success rate, faithfulness, extraction accuracy, tool-call correctness, latency, and cost per run. Instrument tracing and observability across agent runs.

Agentic orchestration

Own agentic workloads in Airflow 3.x on Astronomer — modeling LLM and agent calls as named, independently retriable tasks, using dynamic task mapping for fan-out/fan-in, assets and data-aware scheduling for event-driven triggers, deferrable operators for long-running calls, and human-in-the-loop operators for approvals. Design the workloads that do not belong in a DAG (long-running or interactive agents on AWS ECS/Fargate, queue- and event-driven execution, API-triggered services) and articulate clearly where the orchestration boundary sits and why.

AI-ready catalog and semantic context layer

Model and implement semantic definitions over a Snowflake + dbt estate — metric definitions, entity relationships, business glossary, and ownership — so agents receive governed meaning rather than raw table names. Build and maintain Snowflake Semantic Views and Cortex Analyst semantic models, keeping them in sync with dbt as the source of truth, and establish how context is versioned, tested, and promoted.

Metadata and governance instrumentation

Capture lineage, freshness, column-level descriptions, classification and sensitivity tags, and usage signals; automate description and tag generation with LLMs where it is safe to do so, behind human review gates. Evaluate catalog and metadata tooling and deliver a clear build-vs-buy recommendation.

Unstructured data extraction

Design extraction pipelines for PDFs, decks, spreadsheets, emails, and web content, including layout-heavy financial and operational documents where tables and nested structure matter. Build schema-constrained extraction using structured outputs and tool calling with frontier LLM APIs and Cortex LLM functions, with confidence scoring, citation back to source page, and explicit handling of low-confidence fields. Implement chunking, embedding, and retrieval strategies serving both RAG and agentic retrieval, and design the human review loop — what auto-accepts, what escalates, and how corrections flow back into eval datasets.

Senior data engineering and architecture

Define and implement architectural solutions that ensure the delivery speed and scalability of data pipelines, including tiered/medallion structures; drive best practices for advanced ELT, data governance, and data quality; and define and enforce data security and access-control policies across pipelines and platforms. Build and maintain Python ingestion pipelines (dlt and similar) across REST APIs, SaaS connectors, file drops, and incremental loads into Snowflake, and contribute to dbt models, tests, and documentation — treating dbt metadata as a first-class input to the context layer.

Production operations for non-deterministic systems

Build in the operational basics agents usually lack — idempotency, retry semantics for non-deterministic steps, budget and token caps, circuit breakers, structured logging, and audit trails — under Git-based workflow discipline with code review, CI/CD, and environment promotion.

Technical leadership and client-facing consulting

Serve as a technical leader and key client-facing resource: mentor peers, present complex architectural decisions, write designs down before building them, work independently against ambiguous problem statements, and operate effectively as a contractor embedded in an existing engineering team — asking for context early and communicating status without being asked.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of hands-on industry experience in data engineering or software engineering, with at least 5 years on major cloud platforms. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).

  • Agentic systems (must-have, weighted heaviest): demonstrated experience shipping LLM-powered or agentic systems to production, with concrete examples of what was built, how it was evaluated, and how it failed.

  • Practical command of agent design patterns: tool and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval/RAG, planning loops, multi-agent decomposition, and human-in-the-loop.

  • Experience with agent evaluation and observability as a discipline — eval datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing, tracing, and cost/latency monitoring.

  • Experience with the Anthropic Claude API or comparable frontier model APIs, including prompt and context engineering for reliability rather than novelty; plus experience with an agent framework such as the Claude Agent SDK and/or OpenAI Agents SDK / Assistants API, and a point of view on when to use a vendor framework versus building your own loop.

  • Experience connecting models to enterprise data through MCP and/or comparable tool-integration patterns, and daily working fluency with Claude and ChatGPT as development tools (Claude Code, Projects, Custom GPTs, or equivalent).

  • Mastery of Python — typing, testing, packaging, async — and advanced proficiency in SQL with strong analytical and dimensional data modeling skills.

  • Deep, hands-on Apache Airflow experience: not just authoring DAGs, but debugging schedulers, managing dependencies, and designing retries, idempotency, and task granularity. Airflow 2→3 migration experience and familiarity with Astronomer are a strong plus.

  • Hands-on proficiency with Snowflake (warehouses, RBAC, Snowpark, cost management), dbt, and AWS (ECS/Fargate, IAM, S3, Secrets Manager) with Docker and infrastructure-as-code — the core stack on this engagement. Broader exposure across the major cloud and data platforms (Azure, GCP, Databricks) is valued.

  • Experience designing and building robust CI/CD pipelines, managing Infrastructure as Code, and working under Git-based review and environment-promotion discipline.

  • Production experience extracting structured data from documents at scale, including at least one layout-heavy domain (financial documents, contracts, forms, or scientific papers), with familiarity with modern document parsing tooling and honest views on their tradeoffs.

  • Experience with embeddings, chunking strategies, and vector or hybrid retrieval.

  • Self-driven and autonomous, with excellent problem-solving and critical thinking, the ability to work against ambiguous problem statements, and the discipline to write a design down before building it.

  • Excellent verbal and written professional English, sufficient for technical design discussions, written proposals, and collaboration with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Full availability during US Eastern Time business hours (09:00–17:00 ET).

Preferred qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake Cortex specifically — Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, Cortex Agents, or Cortex AISQL functions.

  • Experience with a semantic layer product (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, AtScale) or a data catalog platform (DataHub, OpenMetadata, Atlan, Collibra, or Snowflake Horizon).

  • Knowledge graph or ontology modeling experience.

  • Experience with dlt specifically, or having authored custom connectors and sources.

  • MLOps depth beyond agents: end-to-end ML lifecycle experience, model deployment and monitoring (e.g., MLflow), and advanced ML techniques such as regression, classification, or Bayesian methods.

  • Experience fine-tuning LLMs and deploying them; publications or active contribution in relevant AI/ML communities; advanced degree in a relevant field.

  • Prior work in private equity, venture capital, or financial services data environments.

  • Prior experience as an embedded contractor or consultant influencing technical direction on client engagements.

*CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED IN THE UNITED STATES OR CANADA**

About SafelyYou

SafelyYou’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person-centered care across senior living through world-leading AI, industry-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities.

Originating in 2015 as the doctoral research of CEO George Netscher—and inspired by his own family's experience with Alzheimer's disease—SafelyYou was spun out of UC Berkeley’s Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, one of the top five AI research groups in the world. And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. All helping ensure that communities can focus on improved care for residents while still reaching their financial goals.

SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation.

Your Role at SafelyYou
In senior living, care is mostly reactive: a change in a resident's needs is often noticed only after a fall, an elopement, or a hospitalization. SafelyYou sees changes in activity, mobility, sleep, and routine that no one else can by using its own data and data from a broad range of integrations. Your mission is to turn those signals into decisions care teams act on, shifting them from reacting to preventing.

This is a 0→1 role. You own the customer outcome for proactive care from validated problem to commercial product, and you keep it through every stage gate. You don't own the models: our AI & Intelligence platform provides the signals, and you define what care teams need from them and how good is good enough. You'll work closely with AI, design, engineering, our clinical team, and Customer Success.

Key Responsibilities:

The Numbers You'll Own

  • A validated product in the market. Proactive care in alpha or beta with design-partner communities within the next year.

  • Earlier detection. A baseline and first improvement in the share of meaningful changes caught before an adverse event.

  • Faster action. A baseline and first improvement in time from change to caregiver action, with precision targets agreed with our clinical team.

What You'll Own

  • Discovery. Uncover needs across executive directors, wellness directors, caregivers, and clinical staff, and test concepts with care staff before committing engineering.

  • MVPs and stage gates.Define MVPs, run alpha and beta programs, and set clear exit criteria at each gate.

  • Insight to action. Design intervention workflows that fit caregiver routines, including inside EHR and eCall systems.

  • Signal quality. Favor precision over volume, never overclaim certainty, and augment clinical judgment rather than replace it.

  • Privacy and dignity.Respect resident privacy, consent, and dignity in every workflow.

  • The business case. Link interventions to fewer hospitalizations, lower liability, longer length of stay, and addressable care gaps, then take proven bets to expansion with Sales and Customer Success.

The Ideal Candidate:

  • The hard requirement:you've taken a product (not a feature) from 0→1 to commercial adoption. Former founders are welcome; this matters more than years (typically 6+ in product or equivalent).

  • Experience building for clinical, caregiving, or other high-stakes operational workflows.

  • Data and ML literacy, including precision/recall tradeoffs, and the ability to make signals clear to non-technical users.

  • A bias for prototyping and testing with real users early.

  • Commercial acumen: you tie outcomes to ROI for enterprise buyers.

  • Strongly preferred:senior living or post-acute experience, a clinical background, or EHR-integrated products

Salary Range:$220,000 - $240,000 USD / $200,000 - $220,000 CAD commensurate with experience

Job Description

At Agilent, you'll help transform the laboratories that are advancing life-changing therapies and expanding our understanding of biological systems. As a UX Designer on our global UX team, you'll create intuitive software and connected workflows that enable scientists to focus on discovery, not technology.

This unique role spans Cell Analysis and next-generation Laboratory Automation, offering the opportunity to shape the software experiences scientists use today while helping define the intelligent, automated laboratories of the future. Based in the Santa Clara area, you'll collaborate closely with scientists, product managers, software engineers, and automation experts across Agilent's global organization.

Key Responsibilities

Cell Analysis

  • Design intuitive software experiences for Cell Analysis instruments, applications, and scientific workflows.
  • Develop a deep understanding of cellular analysis workflows and user needs to create scientifically grounded, user-centered solutions.
  • Translate scientific, technical, business, and user requirements into workflows, prototypes, and intuitive interfaces.
  • Help create a seamless experience across software, instruments, and user touchpoints.
  • Partner with UX researchers and stakeholders to evaluate concepts and improve usability.

Laboratory Automation

  • Conduct UX research to understand how scientists and laboratory teams work today and how automation will shape future workflows.
  • Map end-to-end laboratory processes, identifying pain points, opportunities, dependencies, and automation needs.
  • Engage customers and internal experts through interviews, observations, and workshops to uncover insights.
  • Translate research findings into workflow models, recommendations, and opportunity areas that guide product strategy.
  • Collaborate with scientists, automation specialists, product managers, and development teams to ensure solutions are grounded in real-world needs.

Across Both Areas

  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and UX teams throughout discovery, design, development, and validation.
  • Apply and contribute to Agilent's design system to create consistent, scalable experiences.
  • Leverage modern AI-powered design and prototyping tools to accelerate innovation and communication.
  • Help shape the future of connected, intelligent laboratory software that empowers scientists worldwide.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in UX Design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Human Factors, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of UX design experience in life sciences, laboratory software, medical technology, enterprise software, or other complex technical environments.

  • Strong skills in workflow design, interaction design, information architecture, prototyping, and UI design.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Who We Are

Omnissa is shaping the future of End User Computing. Our innovative solutions, including Workspace ONE and Horizon, empower organizations to deliver seamless, secure digital workspaces. We’re proud to serve a broad base of numerous Fortune 500 companies as well as leading government institutions and agencies, helping them power secure, scalable digital work environments.

As a recently independent company backed by KKR, we’re in high-growth mode—scaling rapidly and building for the future.


At Omnissa, we are committed to maintaining a fair, consistent, and secure hiring process for all candidates. As part of this approach, we use standard interview and verification practices designed to ensure alignment and protect both candidates and the organization. These practices are applied thoughtfully and with respect for candidate privacy.


About This Role


Customer Success Manager — Omnissa

The Customer Success Organization allows you to be flexible in the way you work with your customers. Every day is different as you will partner with your customers to achieve their desired business outcomes. We create long-term impact while driving near-term results.

Success in the Role: What are the performance outcomes over the first 6 months you will work toward completing?

Within 1 month of employment, you will be able to:

  • Successfully develop relationships with key stakeholders within your assigned accounts and the internal account teams.
  • Understand Omnissa's EUC platform and services, including Workspace ONE UEM, Workspace ONE Access, Horizon, and Workspace ONE Intelligence, and how they combine to deliver a unified digital workspace.
  • Get familiar with the internal Customer Success tools and processes.
  • Leverage the attributes of community by reaching out to team members and learning from experience.
  • Effectively facilitate communication between customers and internal teams regarding customer priorities.

Within 3 months of employment, you will be able to:

  • Think strategically about customer success and adapt your approach based on individual and customer needs.
  • Manage a variety of customers across industries and product lifecycles by combining direct touchpoints and automation.
  • Speak credibly to common EUC deployment patterns — modern management of Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android endpoints with Workspace ONE UEM; virtual desktop and application delivery with Horizon (on-premises and cloud/DaaS); and identity, SSO, and conditional access with Workspace ONE Access.
  • Serve as a customer advocate in driving industry best practices and customer use cases internally.
  • Partner with your customers to build and maintain business outcome focused Success Plans mapped to their adoption of the Omnissa platform.

Within 6 months of employment, you will be able to:

  • Proactively identify ways to maximize customer growth, increase consumption, and retention opportunities across the Workspace ONE and Horizon portfolios.
  • Use Workspace ONE Intelligence and DEX (Digital Employee Experience) insights to demonstrate measurable value, identify adoption gaps, and drive data-informed success conversations.
  • Manage multi-level customer engagement that maximizes the relationship and knowledge of the customer.
  • Help develop a roadmap for future deployments based on customers' specific business drivers — for example, expansion from device management into DEX, Horizon modernization, or Zero Trust initiatives leveraging Access and UEM together.
  • Contribute to the library of customer success assets (customer references, case studies, success plans, templates, playbooks) and thought leadership (methodology, point of view, process improvements).
  • Live and breathe Omnissa's values to ensure success.

What type of work will you be doing? What assignments, requirements, or skills will you be performing on a regular basis?

  • Maximize the value of a customer's investment, aim for an increase in utilization, and identify new opportunities while ensuring customer retention.
  • Develop and manage Customer Success Plans for your customers, ensuring accountable parties are on track to deliver on the customer's desired business outcomes.
  • Guide customers through adoption milestones across the Omnissa stack — UEM enrollment and modern management rollouts, Horizon pod/cloud deployments, Access identity integrations, and Intelligence dashboard and automation adoption.
  • Collaborate with the support, engineering, sales, and architect teams to ensure that customers are healthy in their consumption of products and any issues are addressed in a timely manner.
  • Build strategic relationships with customer business decision makers and key stakeholders.
  • Foresee risk and implement mitigation strategies to ensure customer health.
  • Work with the product management team to ensure customer feature requests are addressed.
  • Build and nurture relationships across accounts to firmly secure our partnership and commitment to the customer's success while expanding both relationship and product adoption deeper and wider.
  • Deliver business and technical presentations from admin to an Executive-level audience that articulate the impact of feature adoption and deployment to your customer's transformational business strategies.
  • Travel up to 20% of the time.

Technical Skills & Experience

Required:

  • Working knowledge of the Omnissa EUC portfolio, or equivalent experience with the legacy VMware EUC product line:
    • Workspace ONE UEM — unified endpoint management across Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and rugged/frontline devices; enrollment methods, profiles, compliance policies, and application lifecycle management.
    • Workspace ONE Access — identity management, SSO, multi-factor authentication, conditional access, and integrations with identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta.
    • Horizon — virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) and published applications, both on-premises and cloud-hosted (Horizon Cloud / DaaS); familiarity with instant clones, App Volumes, and Dynamic Environment Manager is a plus.
    • Workspace ONE Intelligence — analytics, automation workflows, and Digital Employee Experience (DEX) management.
  • Understanding of core EUC concepts: modern management vs. legacy PC lifecycle management, BYOD and corporate-owned device strategies, application virtualization and delivery, and Zero Trust security architecture.
  • Familiarity with adjacent enterprise ecosystems: Microsoft 365/Intune coexistence scenarios, Apple Business Manager, Android Enterprise, certificate services (PKI), and common directory/identity platforms.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on administration experience or industry certifications in Workspace ONE or Horizon (e.g., Omnissa/VMware certified professional credentials in EUC).
  • Experience guiding customers through platform migrations (e.g., legacy management to modern management, on-premises Horizon to cloud).
  • Ability to interpret product telemetry and adoption data to build consumption and health narratives.
  • Experience with ITSM and productivity ecosystems commonly integrated with EUC platforms (ServiceNow, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace).

What is the leadership like for this role? What is the structure and culture of the team like?

The EUC Customer Success team is focused on outcomes, not just activity, helping our customers to consume their Omnissa solutions and to gain value from their partnership with Omnissa. We are critical to the success of Omnissa and celebrate our role in the future of the company. We strive to have a diverse, but unified team, one which is entirely focused on our customers and their success. We do the right thing for the customer so when our customers achieve their outcomes, we are successful too. We are an open team who share best practice, and everyone wants their colleagues to succeed and to develop a meaningful career and network within Omnissa and the industry. We support each other and want to give back to each other and our communities so welcome innovation and creativity at all levels to be a meaningful contributor in our countries and societies.


Location: Remote – located in or near Dallas, Texas

Travel: May be required to support customer engagements and business needs.

Education: Bachelor's degreeor equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.


This role is eligible for commission and the typical On-Target Earnings (OTE) range is USD $137,362.50 - $228,937.50 per year. Actual compensation offer may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, skill level, or other relevant factors. In addition to competitive compensation, Omnissa offers a variety of benefits such as employee ownership, health insurance, 401k with matching contributions, disability insurance, paid-time off, growth opportunities, and more

Omnissa is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. jobs.excerpt: The Food Technical Services Manager is responsible for ensuring the successful commercialization of new products, menu innovations, and process improvements by bridging Research & Development with commissary, manufacturing, and restaurant operations.
jobs.description:
The Food Technical Services Manager is responsible for ensuring the successful commercialization of new products, menu innovations, and process improvements by bridging Research & Development with commissary, manufacturing, and restaurant operations. The role oversees the development of technical standards, operational procedures, and Bill of Materials (BOM) to ensure products are scalable, operationally feasible, and consistently executed across all production facilities and restaurant locations.
Working closely with cross-functional teams, the Technical Services Manager drives process standardization, product implementation, operational readiness, food safety compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives that support product quality, operational efficiency, and business growth.
Key Responsibilities:
Product Commercialization
  • Lead the technical commercialization of new products, menu innovations, and product improvements from development through commercial launch.
  • Collaborate with Research & Development during concept creation, product trials, pilot runs, and validation to ensure products are operationally viable and scalable.
  • Evaluate recipes, production methods, equipment requirements, and preparation procedures to support consistent execution across commissaries and restaurant locations.
  • Coordinate production transfer activities to ensure seamless implementation into commercial operations.
Technical Documentation & Process Standardization
  • Develop, implement, and maintain technical manuals, operating procedures, and process documentation that support standardized production and restaurant execution.
  • Establish technical standards covering production workflows, recipe preparation, equipment requirements, material specifications, food safety requirements, quality standards, and operational reference guides.
  • Review and update documentation to reflect product improvements, process changes, and operational requirements.
Bill of Materials & Product Data Management
  • Manage the creation, validation, and maintenance of Bill of Materials (BOM) and product master data within SAP or other ERP systems.
  • Partner with Procurement, Finance, and Research & Development to ensure ingredient specifications, yields, product costing, and material requirements remain accurate.
  • Support inventory planning and production efficiency by maintaining accurate product information and material data.
Operational Support
  • Work closely with Commissary, Manufacturing, and Restaurant Operations to ensure products can be consistently produced and executed across all locations.
  • Participate in production trials, store validations, and operational assessments to identify process improvements and enhance execution consistency.
  • Collaborate with Industrial Engineering and Operations teams on production workflows, equipment selection, and capacity planning for new products and process enhancements.
Quality, Food Safety & Compliance
  • Partner with Quality Assurance and Food Safety teams to establish quality standards, critical control points, and food safety requirements for new and existing products.
  • Ensure technical documentation complies with regulatory requirements and internal quality management systems.
  • Support product investigations and implement corrective actions to address operational or quality-related concerns.
Continuous Improvement
  • Drive initiatives that improve product consistency, operational efficiency, production yields, waste reduction, and cost optimization.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and recommend process enhancements based on operational feedback and performance metrics.
  • Monitor post-launch performance and identify opportunities for continuous product and process improvements.
Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  • Lead and develop the Technical Services team by providing coaching, performance management, and technical guidance.
  • Manage project timelines, technical deliverables, and resource allocation to ensure successful project execution.
  • Build strong partnerships with Research & Development, Procurement, Manufacturing, Operations, Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Finance, and Training teams to ensure successful product implementation.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Nutrition, or a related discipline.
  • At least 8 years of experience in food product development, technical services, process engineering, product commercialization, or related functions within the food manufacturing or restaurant industry.

jobs.description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

As a Clinical Database Programmer (internally referred to as Database Programmer), you will support the development, testing and maintenance of Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems used in clinical trials.

Working within a collaborative and innovative technical team, you will be involved in building clinical studies, developing electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs), configuring edit checks and supporting data integrations, primarily using Medidata Rave.

You will also have opportunities to contribute to new initiatives, explore AI-driven solutions and support continuous improvements in study development and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, test and maintain clinical study databases within EDC systems.

  • Develop and configure eCRFs, edit checks and study-specific database requirements.

  • Support clinical data transfers, integrations and database validation activities.

  • Troubleshoot technical issues and provide ongoing EDC study support.

  • Collaborate with Data Management, project teams and sponsors to ensure successful study delivery.

  • Contribute to process improvements, automation and innovative solutions, including the use of AI.

  • Support multiple clinical studies and progressively take ownership of study builds.

  • Ensure database documentation, quality standards and study timelines are maintained.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • Previous experience in clinical database development, EDC programming or clinical study builds.

  • Previous experience within a CRO or pharmaceutical environment.

  • Knowledge of eCRFs, edit checks, database testing and clinical data management processes.

  • Understanding of programming principles, logic and database development.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills.

  • Experience supporting EDC integrations, technical initiatives or bid defence activities.

  • Proactive team player with excellent communication skills and a continuous improvement mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Medidata Rave, including study builds and configuration.

  • Knowledge of C# programming and development of custom functions within Medidata Rave.

  • Experience with AI tools, automation or AI-assisted programming to improve study development and efficiency.

What We Offer

    • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!

    • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

      • Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

How to Apply

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. jobs.description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

We are hiring a full-stack, technical Sr. Account-Based Marketing (ABM) Manager to own our ABM program end-to-end. You'll start with bespoke 1:1 and 1:few programs against our most strategic enterprise and regulated accounts, then build the operating model and automation to extend what works to 1:many.

This is a builder role, not a project manager role. You'll launch your own ads, build your own pages and workflows, and pull your own data. You reach for an agent or automation before doing anything by hand, and you're a real partner to Sales, with the presence to shape account plans and the discipline to report on shared numbers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the ABM program. Set strategy and run execution for Chainguard's top enterprise and regulated accounts across the full lifecycle: new business, deal acceleration, and expansion. Design and launch 1:1 and 1:few campaigns yourself across paid digital, web, email, gifting, and executive events, with messaging built for CISOs, security engineering, and platform leaders.
  • Build the operating model. Define the playbooks, target account lists, tooling, and measurement framework for how ABM runs here, so programs stay repeatable and high quality as we scale from a handful of accounts to 1:many.
  • Operationalize AI for ABM. Build agents and workflows in Clay, HubSpot, Hightouch, and custom internal apps to research accounts, capture signals, personalize outreach, and orchestrate multi-channel plays. Experiment, productionize what works, and document it.
  • Partner with Sales, BDR, and Partners, and measure what matters. Develop joint account plans with Sales, sales leadership, the BDR team, and the Partner team, ensure coordinated follow-up on every program, and drive rep enablement. Define KPIs for pipeline, penetration, engagement, and acceleration, and report impact with Marketing Ops in Omni and BigQuery.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 5+ years of B2B marketing experience, with 2+ years running ABM programs at a SaaS, security, or infrastructure company, and cross-channel campaigns you shipped end to end that produced pipeline.
  • Full-stack execution across paid media, web, email, and marketing automation, without waiting on a large supporting team. Hands-on experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Clay (or equivalents), familiarity with intent and comfort writing SQL against BigQuery to answer your own questions.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where you're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get things done.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience marketing into regulated industries or the public sector (FedRAMP, financial services, healthcare)
  • Familiarity with the cloud-native and open source ecosystem (Kubernetes, containers, software supply chain security)
  • Experience building and managing CDP-driven audience pipelines, including audience syncs, match rate optimization and suppression workflows.

We know not everyone will check every box on day one. If this role excites you and you've done most of this, we'd like to hear from you.

Base Salary Range
$140,000—$167,500 USD

We live and breathe our company values:

Each team member has the flexibility to choose where they work most effectively each week—whether that's from home, a coffee shop, or the office. While flexibility is key, we also value the power of in-person connection. That’s why we bring our corporate team together in Lincoln each quarter for a week of intentional collaboration, team building, community engagement, and our All-Hands meeting. It’s the best of both worlds: the freedom to work your way, with meaningful opportunities to connect and grow together. Please scroll to the bottom of the job posting to confirm that your state qualifies for the Work Your Way program.

Spreetail is looking for a Director of Procurement, you will serve as the single accountable leader for ~$29M in annual addressable spend across our 8 fulfillment center locations. In this role, you will lead end-to-end operational sourcing strategies—including packaging, pallets, corrugate, business services, and facility supplies—while driving commercial negotiations, cost-saving initiatives, and vendor accountability.

You will lead the on-site non-inventory hourly teams responsible for staging and replenishment, design robust inventory controls, and build cross-functional alignment across Finance, Operations, and carriers.

How you will achieve success:

  • Network Spend Ownership: Serve as the single accountable owner of ~$29M/year in addressable spend across all 8 FC buildings (~$10M pallets and corrugate, ~$17M business services, ~$2M supplies).

  • Strategic RFP Execution: Lead the Q1 2027 pallet RFP across primary partners (KAMPS, 48forty, and emerging alternatives) to secure pallets and corrugate at the lowest total net cost.

  • Carrier S&OP & Credit Recovery: Establish S&OP-driven pallet demand forecasts and operationalize pallet return, regrade, and credit recovery programs with major carrier partners (FedEx, Roadie).

  • On-Site Team Leadership & Kanban Design: Directly lead on-site non-inventory hourly associates across the network who receive, stage, and replenish materials; design and implement lean kanban staging to eliminate fulfillment downtime.

  • Vendor Consolidation & Services Procurement: Negotiate master service agreements, consolidate redundant vendors, enforce rigorous SLA performance across ~$17M in business services, and streamline standard operating ordering flows for facility supplies and maintenance buys.

  • Systems, Approvals & Governance: Own procurement systems and operational controls (vendor onboarding, invoice reconciliation, and approval routing workflows), delivering monthly savings scorecard KPIs to executive leadership.

What experiences will help you in this role:

The Chief Strategy Officer is responsible for defining, developing, and executing the organization's long-term strategic vision. 1. Corporate Strategy Development

  • Partner with business units to ensure effective execution of strategic priorities.
  • Monitor progress and ensure alignment with overall corporate strategy.

3. Market & Competitive Analysis

  • Conduct in-depth analysis of industry trends, competitors, and market opportunities.

  • Identify and evaluate potential investment or expansion opportunities.

5. Performance Management & Reporting

  • Establish KPIs and performance metrics to track strategic initiatives.
  • Monitor organizational performance and recommend improvements.
  • Provide regular strategic updates to the CEO and Board.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with leadership across operations, finance, marketing, IT, and other functions.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination across departments for strategy execution.
  • Drive organization-wide initiatives and transformation programs.

7. Innovation & Transformation

  • Lead innovation initiatives and digital transformation strategies.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity, and competitiveness.
  • Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

8. Stakeholder Engagement

  • Present strategic plans and insights to executive leadership and the Board.
  • Engage with external stakeholders, partners, and industry experts.
  • Represent the organization in strategic discussions and forums.

9. Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and mentor strategy, planning, and analytics teams.
  • Build a high-performance culture focused on strategic thinking and execution.
  • Ensure continuous development of talent and capabilities.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or related field; MBA or equivalent preferred.

Job Summary
We are seeking an Infrastructure Automation Engineer with deep Terraform expertise to design, build, and maintain the infrastructure-as-code foundations that power our cloud and hybrid environments. This role focuses on creating reusable Terraform modules, hardening pipelines, enforcing policy-as-code, and standardizing infrastructure delivery across multiple teams and cloud providers. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering discipline to infrastructure work, has shipped production-grade Terraform at scale, and understands the operational realities of managing thousands of resources across many environments and accounts.

  • Design, develop, and maintain modular, composable Terraform code that codifies the entire infrastructure estate across cloud accounts and environments.

  • Implement Terraform automation pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Atlantis, Terraform Cloud, or Spacelift, with plan/apply gating, drift detection, and policy enforcement.
  • Define and enforce policy-as-code using Sentinel, Open Policy Agent (OPA), Conftest, or Checkov to prevent insecure or non-compliant infrastructure changes.

  • Drive multi-account, multi-region, and multi-cloud infrastructure provisioning strategies with clear isolation, naming, and tagging standards.
  • Implement infrastructure testing including unit tests with terraform-compliance, integration tests with Terratest, and policy tests across pull requests.
  • Collaborate with security, networking, and platform teams to embed guardrails directly into reusable modules and pipelines.
  • Standardize patterns for secrets management, identity federation, and least-privilege IAM through reusable Terraform abstractions.
  • Lead migrations from legacy, ClickOps, or non-IaC infrastructure into managed Terraform footprints with minimal disruption.
  • Drive cost optimization, tagging hygiene, and lifecycle management across the Terraform-managed estate.
  • Mentor engineering teams on Terraform best practices, anti-patterns, and pull-request review standards.
  • Maintain comprehensive runbooks, architecture diagrams, and onboarding materials for the infrastructure platform.
  • Stay current with Terraform, OpenTofu, and broader IaC ecosystem developments and recommend adoption where beneficial.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of experience in cloud infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with significant Terraform focus.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise authoring and maintaining production Terraform across at least one major cloud provider.
  • Strong experience designing reusable Terraform modules with clean APIs and version discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform state management, backends, and large-scale workspace organization.
  • Strong scripting skills in Python, Go, or Bash.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure code and automated policy enforcement.
  • Solid understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security primitives.
  • Strong Git-based workflows including code review, branching, and release management.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with multi-cloud Terraform (AWS + Azure or AWS + GCP).

  • Communicate and coordinate with patients, care coordinators, APPs, and external referral sources to support continuity across the episode of care.
  • Documentation & Compliance
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant clinical documentation in accordance with regulatory, payer, and organizational requirements.
  • Adhere to established clinical protocols, escalation pathways, and quality standards within a value-based care environment.

Must-Haves

  • Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) degree from a CAPTE-accredited program.
  • Active, unrestricted physical therapy license in the state(s) where care will be delivered.
  • Minimum of 3 years of clinical experience, with preference for 5 years.
  • Strong clinical reasoning skills and a patient-first approach to care.
  • Comfort practicing in a virtual environment, including remote evaluations and video-based patient education.

Preferred

  • APTA specialist certification (e.g., OCS, SCS).
  • Residence in PT Compact State
  • Experience delivering care in virtual or telehealth-based models.
  • Experience working in interdisciplinary or integrated care teams alongside medical providers.
  • Spanish language proficiency.

ASNI staff lead efforts to build program, build organizations, and drive resources to key battles across the country, positioning the nationwide organization for future challenges. For over 100 years, the ACLU has worked to defend and preserve the individual rights and liberties guaranteed by the Constitution and laws of the United States. Job Title -Bilingual Grants Specialist

About Us

Zero To One Strategic is a specialized consultancy that helps innovative companies maximize revenue from Canadian R&D and innovation programs. We work with startups and scale-ups across multiple sectors and take a long-term, outcomes-driven approach to non-dilutive funding, including grants, subsidies, and tax credits.

The Grants team works closely with founders and technical leaders to design and execute integrated funding strategies that support R&D, commercialization, and scale. To date, we have helped clients secure millions of dollars in non-dilutive funding and continue to grow as demand increases. We support clients end-to-end, from identifying and matching to the right funding opportunities, through grant writing and submission, to post-award support, delivering a well-rounded, non-dilutive funding experience.

We operate in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are passionate about supporting Canadian innovation and entrepreneurship. Our team works across disciplines and in close partnership with founders to help translate key milestones, technical ideas, and growth plans into funded, scalable outcomes. We look for team members who are equally excited to work alongside founders to help bring ambitious ideas to life.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Bilingual Grants Specialist to manage and execute grant strategies across a large portfolio of active clients. This role focuses on client management, opportunity oversight, and ownership of funding outcomes, not grant writing alone.

You will be responsible for managing 50+ client accounts, staying ahead of new and existing funding opportunities, coordinating contractors and internal resources, communicating with funding agencies, reviewing and editing submissions, and ensuring applications are delivered on time and to a high standard.

This integral role on our Grants team suits someone who is highly organized, tech-savvy, comfortable operating at scale, and confident managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously.

Client / Portfolio Management

  • Own a portfolio of 50+ active clients with ongoing grant strategies

  • Ensure clients are informed of relevant opportunities and timelines
  • Manage active, submitted, and awarded opportunities through to final outcome & reporting

Grants Opportunity Management

  • Monitor federal and provincial funding programs relevant to assigned clients
  • Assess eligibility, effort, timing, and likelihood of success
  • Advise clients on which opportunities to pursue or deprioritize based on eligibility, past success, etc.
  • Maintain visibility across the full grants pipeline for each client
  • Proactively flag risks, dependencies, and resourcing needs

Contractor and Workflow Management

  • Coordinate internal and external grant writers and subject matter experts
  • Provide clear briefs, context, and deadlines
  • Review, edit, and quality check all submissions before final delivery
  • Ensure alignment with client positioning and funder requirements
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success, SR&ED, and other internal teams to ensure a well-rounded, client-first funding experience.

Writing Support

  • Contribute to writing full applications, where appropriate
  • Edit and strengthen drafts written by others for QC, clarity, compliance, and impact
  • Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Claude to support research and drafting with strong human oversight

Process, Documentation, and Follow Up

  • Track deadlines, submission status, and outcomes across your portfolio
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation
  • Support post submission follow ups and funder questions

Qualifications

  • Two or more years of experience in grants, funding advisory, or related roles
  • Experience managing a high volume of clients or projects simultaneously
  • Strong editing, review and QC skills
  • Solid understanding of Canadian government funding programs (e.g., federal, provincial, municipal, sector-specific)
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable using tools such as G Suite, CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot), and modern AI-assisted productivity tools
  • Excellent organization and time management skills
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication
  • English and French speaking and writing skills are required
  • Experience working with startups or scale-ups is a strong plus
  • Exposure to software, AI, med tech, cleantech, or advanced manufacturing is beneficial
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced consulting environment with evolving priorities
  • Experience working with startups or scale-ups is a strong asset

Compensation and Benefits

  • Remote first work environment
  • Opportunities for growth as the grants function scales

WHAT YOU'LL DO

The Enterprise BDR in the LATAM team is the engine behind Braze's large company growth. You'll partner with Account Executives to identify, engage, and qualify prospects at companies with 5,000+ employees, helping leading B2C brands discover how Braze can transform their customer engagement.

This is a high-impact, remote role where you'll blend volume-driven outreach with personalized, consultative prospecting. You'll research strategic accounts, craft relevant messaging, and create opportunities that directly fuel Braze's regional pipeline across LATAM.

WHAT WE OFFER

jobs.description:
Title: Head of Software Systems & Business Enablement

Location: Remote

Reports to: SVP, Enterprise Applications & Digital Platforms

Salary Range: $180,000 - $220,000/yr + $40,000 performance bonus

About The Fedcap Group

Founded in 1935, The Fedcap Group is a $425M global nonprofit organization focused on advancing economic well-being for individuals facing barriers to employment. Headquartered in New York City, Fedcap operates across 106 locations in 29 U.S. states, the U.K., Canada, and Australia serving nearly 332,000 people annually. Fedcap’s mission is to create opportunities for people facing barriers to achieve economic independence, dignity, and become contributing members of society. Through innovative programs, strategic partnerships, workforce development initiatives, and community-based services, Fedcap helps individuals build sustainable pathways to employment and long-term success.

Position Summary

The Fedcap Group (TFG) is seeking a strategic, business-oriented Head of Software Systems & Business Enablement to lead the management, optimization, and lifecycle of all software systems across TFG’s international footprint. This role will ensure our platforms are reliable, well-governed, cost-effective, and positioned to harness innovation and AI so the business can operate efficiently and scale.

Reporting to the SVP, Enterprise Applications & Digital Platforms, the Head of Software Systems & Business Enablement will serve as the bridge between business operations and technology, partnering with business leaders and technology peers to translate business needs into sustainable system capabilities.

Additionally, the Head of Software Systems & Business Enablement, will own a portfolio of 300+ systems and vendors, drive rationalization, adoption, and lifecycle discipline, while shaping the team needed to deliver.

Goals of the Position

The Head of Software Systems & Business Enablement will:

  • Maximize Business Value Through Innovation & AI
    Ensure software systems are configured, adopted, and continuously improved, and identify opportunities to apply AI, automation, and emerging capabilities that improve efficiency, service delivery, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Establish Strong System Ownership & Lifecycle Management
    Create disciplined ownership and lifecycle standards across the software portfolio, from selection through consolidation and retirement.

  • Build a Business-Facing Partnership Model
    Establish trusted partnerships with business units, proactively identifying opportunities to improve processes, increase adoption, reduce manual work, and use technology more effectively.

  • Strengthen Architecture, Integration & Standardization
    Lead the systems and application architecture function, aligned with enterprise-wide standards. Partner with Software Engineering and Data & Analytics to strengthen interoperability, API enablement, and data flows while reducing redundant or fragmented systems.

  • Drive Adoption, Change & Service Excellence
    Establish consistent practices for onboarding, training, change management, service levels, user communications, and feedback so technology changes translate into sustained operational improvement.

  • Cultivate a High-Performing, Business-Focused Team
    Invest in the capabilities and growth of a distributed, high-performing team. Foster a culture of business partnership, accountability, documentation, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Systems Strategy & Leadership

  • Partner with the SVP to define and execute a multi-year systems roadmap aligned with TFG’s growth.
  • Drive platform rationalization and consolidation in alignment with enterprise architecture and technology strategy.
  • Identify, evaluate, and scale AI, automation, and emerging capabilities within TFG’s software platforms, in alignment with enterprise AI governance and security standards.

Systems Oversight

Software Portfolio Management

  • Lead system administration, configuration, and functional support across TFG’s software portfolio, including Oracle Fusion ERP and platforms supporting CRM, case management, student management, electronic health records, and fundraising.
  • Own a portfolio of 300+ systems and vendors with named business and technical owners, documented business purpose, criticality, cost, dependencies, and lifecycle status.
  • Establish standards for configuration, release management, testing, change control, documentation, and production readiness.
  • Design and maintain application role and permission models in partnership with Security and Compliance.
  • Coordinate application vulnerability remediation, upgrades, patches, and vendor-supported maintenance.
  • Execute data archival and destruction in line with retention policy and ensure continuity and disaster recovery requirements for critical applications are documented and tested.

Business Partnership & Service Management

  • Build and lead a business partnership function that serves as the primary relationship layer between technology and business operations.
  • Create a consistent engagement model to understand business processes, pain points, and automation opportunities, and translate them into configuration, workflow, integration, reporting, or development needs.
  • Establish a systems service catalog with standardized intake, prioritization, escalation paths, and measurable satisfaction targets, prioritizing requests with the SVP and business leaders by value, risk, cost, and capacity.

Implementation, Adoption & Change Management

  • Lead software implementations, upgrades, and migrations from requirements through stabilization, including UAT, deployment readiness, training, and post-launch support.
  • Drive change management so new capabilities are embedded in day-to-day operations, not treated solely as technology deployments.
  • Monitor utilization and adoption and develop remediation plans where systems are underused or processes remain manual.

Architecture & Integration

  • Lead the systems and application architecture function, including the systems landscape, application architecture, and integration patterns.
  • Represent the systems domain on the Enterprise Architecture Review Board, providing systems-domain review and sign-off within delegated authority.
  • Own business application integration requirements and interoperability standards, partnering with Software Engineering on technical delivery.
  • Partner with Data & Analytics to improve data quality at the source and enable reliable enterprise reporting.
  • Ensure system changes account for downstream data, reporting, identity, security, and infrastructure dependencies.

Vendor, Licensing, Financial & Compliance Oversight

  • Manage the software vendor lifecycle, including onboarding, performance, licensing, and service levels.
  • Manage the approved systems and software vendor budget in partnership with the SVP and Finance, including forecasting, analysis of license utilization, overlapping functionality, and total cost, and reporting realized savings separately from cost avoidance.
  • Lead quarterly business reviews with strategic vendors and hold vendors accountable to contractual commitments.
  • Partner with Procurement, Finance, and Legal on software negotiations, renewals, and purchasing decisions.
  • Partner with Security and Compliance on logging and audit readiness to meet standards such as HIPAA, SOC 2, PIPEDA, GDPR, and ISO 27001.

Growth, RFP & M&A Support

  • Provide systems expertise and solution architecture input to business proposals and RFP responses.
  • Assess systems, applications, data dependencies, and contracts during pre-acquisition due diligence.
  • Lead post-acquisition systems onboarding, migration, and harmonization using a repeatable integration playbook.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Build, coach, and lead a high-performing team, shaping the roles and capabilities needed to deliver the systems strategy.
  • Establish clear ownership, service standards, priorities, and performance measures across the team.
  • Develop team capability across business applications, business analysis, change management, and vendor management.

Qualifications

Education & Certification

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (advanced degree preferred).
  • ITIL, PMP, Prosci, business analysis, TOGAF, and/or relevant platform certifications preferred.

Professional Experience

  • 10+ years in enterprise applications, business systems, or digital transformation roles, including 5+ years in leadership.
  • Proven success leading major system implementations, migrations, adoption programs, and platform rationalization across multiple business units or entities.
  • Experience managing distributed teams, business-facing technology functions, and third-party software vendors.
  • Experience leading application architecture, integration standards, and architecture reviews across a complex, multi-entity organization preferred.

Technical Competencies

  • Strong working knowledge of Oracle Fusion ERP and enterprise platforms spanning CRM, case management, student management, and EHR, with demonstrated depth in one or more major platforms and familiarity with modern SaaS administration.
  • Understanding of application integrations, APIs, identity and access management, role-based permissions, release management, application security fundamentals, and AI and automation capabilities within software platforms.
  • Strong capability in application portfolio management, software licensing, service management, and technology financial optimization.

Leadership & Communication

  • Business-first leadership style with strong customer orientation and a focus on measurable operational outcomes.
  • Adept at building trusted relationships with executives, operational leaders, technical teams, vendors, and end users.
  • Comfortable operating in a federated, international organization undergoing significant transformation.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision | Life/AD&D & Long-Term Disability | Flexible Spending Account (FSA) | Commuter Benefits | 403(b) | Wellness Program

  • May vary by location and business unit
