jobs.excerpt: Growth Marketer heißt bei uns nicht "ein bisschen von allem".
jobs.description:
Growth Marketer heißt bei uns nicht "ein bisschen von allem".

Es heißt: Du treibst das Wachstum unserer Kunden über den Kanal, der es trägt - Meta Ads. Kein Kanal-Hopping, kein "wir machen jetzt auch TikTok". Wir sind eine Boutique-Agentur für hochpreisigen E-Commerce: Produkte ab mehreren hundert Euro AOV, erklärungsbedürftig, mit Kaufentscheidungen, die Wochen bis Monate dauern. In dieser Nische wollen wir die Besten in Deutschland sein. Dafür suchen wir Leute, die lieber eine Sache auf Weltklasse-Niveau machen als fünf Sachen auf LinkedIn-Niveau.

Zweiter Punkt, bevor du weiterliest: Wir arbeiten AI-nativ. Das schreibt inzwischen jede zweite Agentur, deshalb konkret: Wir bauen eigene AI-Werkzeuge. MCP-Anbindung an unsere Ad-Accounts, automatisierte Audits, Anomalie-Erkennung, eigene Skills für Angle- und Skript-Entwicklung. AI ist bei uns Standard-Werkzeug, nicht Notnagel. Wer 2026 noch jede Analyse von Hand baut, ist uns zu langsam. Wer umgekehrt jede Entscheidung an die AI abgibt, liefert denselben Output wie jeder Wettbewerber mit demselben Modell. Wir suchen die Mitte: Du steuerst, AI beschleunigt.

Wenn dich beides anzieht - Fokus statt Bauchladen, AI als Hebel statt als Ersatz fürs Denken - lies weiter.

Wer wir sind: Divinely, eine Meta-Ads-Boutique für High-AOV E-Commerce mit bewusst kleinem Kundenportfolio. Unsere Kunden kaufen kein Button-Pushing, sondern Urteilsvermögen: dass wir ihr Geschäft verstehen - Marge, Customer Journey, Liquidität - und daraus die richtigen Wachstumsentscheidungen ableiten. Das heißt auch: Bei uns sinkt manchmal der ROAS im Werbeanzeigenmanager, während das Geschäft des Kunden wächst. Und das ist dann genau richtig. Wer in Tages-ROAS denkt, wird bei uns unglücklich.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst das Wachstum deiner Accounts über Meta Ads - von Audit über Hypothese und Test-Roadmap bis Skalierung und Reporting. Strukturiert, nicht aus dem Bauch.
  • Du steuerst nach Total Business Numbers (Net Revenue, CAC, Deckungsbeitrag, MER) und inkrementellen KPIs, nicht nach Plattform-ROAS allein.
  • Du denkst über die Anzeige hinaus: Wenn der Wachstums-Bottleneck nicht in den Ads liegt (Offer, Landingpage, Produkt, Pricing), sagst du es dem Kunden klar und lieferst einen Alternativweg.
  • Du reverse-engineerst die Customer Journey hochpreisiger Produkte: Micro-Conversions als Algo-Futter, Post-Purchase-Surveys, Time-Lag-Messung.
  • Du baust deine Test-Roadmaps mit AI-Unterstützung. Unser Stack liefert dir Audits, Breakdowns und Anomalie-Signale; du lieferst die Hypothese und prüfst den Output, statt ihn blind zu übernehmen.
  • Du entwickelst Wachstums-Hypothesen (Segment → Mechanismus → fehlendes Set-Piece) und liest Creative-Performance jenseits der Vanity-Metriken.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

  • Du hast Meta Ads operativ und strategisch im Griff - Kampagnenarchitektur, Optimierungsziele, Creative-Testing - und kannst deine Entscheidungen einem Founder in Geschäftszahlen erklären.
  • Du denkst in Systemen: Hypothese → Test → Learning → nächster Test.
  • Du arbeitest täglich mit AI - eigene Prompts und Workflows, idealerweise schon mal Tool-Anbindungen oder Automatisierungen genutzt - und kannst konkret erzählen, wo AI dich schneller gemacht hat und wo du ihr bewusst nicht vertraust.
  • Du verstehst Inkrementalität (New-Customer-Steuerung) und warum Last-Click bei langen Journeys täuscht. Oder du willst genau das in den ersten 90 Tagen bei uns lernen und belegen.
  • Du bist konfrontationsfähig: Du nickst "morgen 5x skalieren" nicht ab, sondern führst den Kunden.

Benefits

  • Ein Umfeld, in dem AI-Werkzeuge nicht beantragt, sondern gebaut werden.
  • Ein kleines, hochwertiges Kundenportfolio statt Fließband. Jede deiner Entscheidungen bewegt echtes Budget und echtes Geschäft.
  • Ein herausforderndes und anspruchsvolles Arbeitsumfeld, das stets im Wandel ist und deiner Arbeit Wertschätzung zollt.

jobs.description:
The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward. Since our beginnings in the 1930s to becoming a trusted financial partner across the South and beyond - we are known for combining personal relationships with forward-thinking solutions.

We are committed to helping our team members find their success while maintaining the integrity of our values: building trust, fostering lasting relationships and pursuing excellence. At SouthState, individual contributions are recognized, potential is cultivated and team members are inspired to achieve their greater purpose. Your future begins here!

Summary


The Enterprise Terafina Business Analyst supports strategic Terafina initiatives across digital account opening, onboarding, account maintenance, workflow enhancements, integrations, and enterprise operational improvements. This role leads business analysis activities for high-priority projects by defining business needs, eliciting and documenting requirements, analyzing processes and impacts, supporting solution decisions, and maintaining clear visibility into scope, risks, dependencies, decisions, and outcomes.


This position partners with cross-functional business, technology, risk, and vendor teams to ensure strategic Terafina projects are clearly defined and aligned with organizational objectives, regulatory expectations, and platform capabilities. The Business Analyst owns requirements definition, validation, and ongoing business alignment, while intake administration, cross-functional coordination, test management, and strategic roadmap administration are managed separately within the Enterprise Terafina team.


The ideal candidate is an analytical, highly organized, and collaborative problem-solver who can translate complex strategic needs into actionable business and functional requirements, facilitate decisions across multiple workstreams, identify impacts and gaps, and drive follow-through from discovery through implementation and post-release validation.


Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead requirements discovery and business analysis for strategic Terafina projects by clarifying business objectives, defining problems and opportunities, identifying impacted capabilities and stakeholders, and establishing measurable outcomes and analysis plans.
  • Elicit, analyze, validate, and document enterprise business, functional, data, integration, workflow, control, and reporting requirements using meetings, workshops, process reviews, and other appropriate analysis techniques.
  • Translate strategic objectives into clear scope, current- and future-state processes, user stories or requirements, acceptance criteria, business rules, traceability, and implementation considerations that guide solution design and delivery.
  • Perform enterprise impact, gap, dependency, and risk analysis across Terafina capabilities, processes, integrations, controls, data, operating procedures, and customer or associate experiences; recommend options and mitigation considerations.
  • Facilitate cross-functional working sessions and decision forums to align enterprise stakeholders on requirements, priorities, assumptions, tradeoffs, solution options, ownership, and next steps for strategic initiatives.
  • Maintain business analysis artifacts and requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring approved changes, decisions, dependencies, issues, and open questions are documented and communicated.
  • Partner with Enterprise Team, project managers, product owners, technology teams, developers, vendors, risk, compliance, and operations to evaluate solution feasibility, support planning, resolve requirement gaps, and keep strategic projects aligned to expected business outcomes.
  • Support testing and implementation readiness by defining acceptance criteria, coordinating business validation and UAT inputs, triaging LOB requirement-related defects, confirming stakeholder signoff, and partnering with Test Manager to ensure delivered outcomes meet approved requirements.
  • Assess change impacts and operational readiness for strategic initiatives, including procedures, controls, training, communications, support models, data or reporting needs, and post-implementation monitoring; coordinate handoffs to accountable owners.
  • Provide concise, audience-appropriate analysis and updates for leadership and project stakeholders, including scope and requirements status, key decisions, risks, dependencies, readiness, expected benefits, outcome measures, and recommendations.
  • It is the responsibility of this role to take ownership of all tasks and challenges that they encounter in the operation of their assigned position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Qualifications

Education Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Project Management, or a related field required, or equivalent banking and business analysis experience
  • Business analysis or project management certification, such as CBAP, CCBA, ECBA, or PMP required

Minimum Experience

  • 5+ years of banking, financial services, digital platform, or related business experience required
  • 3+ years of business analysis experience supporting complex, cross-functional, or enterprise strategic projects required
  • Experience eliciting and documenting business and functional requirements, process flows, business rules, user stories, acceptance criteria, impact assessments, and requirements traceability required
  • Experience supporting solution evaluation, testing, UAT, implementation readiness, change impacts, and post-implementation validation preferred
  • Experience working with enterprise business, operations, technology, risk, compliance, data, architecture, project management, and vendor teams preferred

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Advanced business analysis, requirements elicitation, process modeling, facilitation, and requirements management skills
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, root-cause analysis, option assessment, and decision-support capabilities
  • Ability to connect strategic objectives to business capabilities, processes, requirements, risks, and measurable outcomes
  • Strong verbal, written, presentation, workshop facilitation, and executive communication skills
  • Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, resolve ambiguity, and drive decisions without direct authority
  • Knowledge of banking account origination, onboarding, servicing, workflow, integration, data, risk, and control concepts
  • Proficiency with business analysis, requirements, process mapping, collaboration, testing, and project tracking tools

Physical Demands and Work Environment

Physical Demands

  • Ability to communicate in person, on the phone, and through electronic channels
  • Ability to use a computer on a frequent basis, including typing and sustained attention to a monitor
  • Ability to sit, walk, and/or stand for extended periods of time

Work Environment

At Storage Scholars, egos are left at the door, wins are celebrated as a team, and learning never stops.

As an Inbound Sales Specialist (Part Time Internship) at Storage Scholars, your primary responsibility is being a consultative guide for customers seeking solutions for student move-in, move-out, storage, and shipping. As a member of the greater Customer Experience Team, you will be a crucial link between the customer and their understanding and adoption of the services that we offer.

What you’ll do:

  • Field inbound leads from both lead form submissions and inbound calls.
  • Make proactive phone calls to existing and former customers to promote service usage.
  • Provide service estimates for customers via call, SMS, and email.
  • Guide customers through their order flow in our online portal to book their moves.
  • Promote additional services and service upgrades to customers, as well as generate referrals.

  • Strong critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to handle fast-paced changes and intense workloads.
  • Strong phone presence.
  • High emotional intelligence to understand fellow team members and clients alike.
  • Technologically savvy, with the ability to learn new software rapidly.

Preferred:

  • 1–2 years of customer-facing experience (such as retail, hospitality, or customer service).

Scope:

  • Part time, seasonal role: 15–25 hours/week on average, up to 40 hours/week during March - May.
  • The ability to work a flexible schedule on evenings and weekends as necessary during our peak season (March - September).
  • Preferred Start Date: 1/25/27
  • Tentative End Date: 8/1/27

Compensation:

  • Estimated seasonal earnings: $4,500 – $10,000+
  • Base pay plus per-customer commission. Earnings depend on hours worked (15–25 hrs/week) and monthly sales performance.

Other Benefits:

  • Fully Remote
  • Ability to grow with our rapidly growing company and team.

Location:

  • Remote

How Our Core Service Works:

Customers sign up on our web portal to schedule services on their respective campuses. Packing supply kits are shipped out to students as requested. Thanks to our partnership with the university, our staff comes in once the campus is vacant and moves all of the student belongings into a storage facility for the summer. Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

GENERAL FUNCTION:

Individual is responsible for managing the development, execution and leadership of the Credit Risk Review (CRR) Continuous Review program for assigned CRR team and/or line of business units. Primary components of the CRR Continuous Review program include (i) the critical and independent evaluation of the accuracy and effectiveness of credit risk management processes across the Bancorp through an assessment of risk identification/rating, underwriting, new origination, borrower selection and portfolio management practices; compliance with Bancorp loan policies, procedures and applicable laws and regulations; problem asset administration and loan impairments/charge-offs; (ii) a review of credit quality and related trends on a portfolio, industry sector and/or product basis; and (iii) the identification of emerging risks. Attend (as required) regular meetings with executive management, senior leaders, regulators, external auditors and first and second line business personnel.

Responsible and accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns and personally following policies and procedures as defined. Accountable for always doing the right thing for customers and colleagues, and ensures that actions and behaviors drive a positive customer experience. While operating within the Bank's risk appetite, achieves results by consistently identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring, and reporting risks of all types.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Display an advanced background, understanding and technical proficiency in all pertinent lending and credit risk topics, including risk appetite and framework, Bank policies and procedures, and risk monitoring and mitigation practices for assigned areas of responsibility.
  • Maintain awareness of general economic conditions, industry trends and product specific issues. Display an advanced working knowledge of pertinent regulatory issues and sound lending practices and their relative impact on credit risk. Assist CRR management team in ensuring CRR meets regulatory heightened standards expectations.
  • Demonstrate the ability to analyze and assess credit risk in highly complex Commercial borrowers and portfolios and adequately support all conclusions.
  • In conjunction with CRR leadership team, establish key annual goals and risk-based business plans for assigned areas of responsibility and update as necessary throughout the year. Identify, elevate and promptly address variances to plan. Assist in ensuring CRR procedures remain current and correctly reflect actual/desired practices.
  • Complete or ensure the completion of all aspects of required continuous review activities for assigned Commercial portfolios with minimal supervision and in accordance with CRR procedures, deadlines and performance/financial plan objectives. Complete or assist in the preparation and dissemination of all related and required quarterly/ annual summaries of results in an accurate and timely manner, including an annual assessment of credit risk and the overall quality of assigned portfolios.
  • Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of key line of business strategies, risk considerations, portfolio quality trends and open issues and observations for assigned portfolios, while maintaining current and forward-looking views on aggregate portfolio risk levels. Attend applicable Committee, portfolio review, problem asset review and business controls meetings, and hold routine informational meetings with first and second line senior business leaders and personnel to gain and share perspectives on these matters.

Solicit appropriate action plans and responses from responsible management that address root causes, resolve CRR’s concerns and mitigate the overall risk to the Bancorp. Assist CRR management team in promptly resolving any matters requiring attention (MRAs) or issues assigned to CRR with sustainable improvements to business practices.
  • For Commercial roles, manage and execute work processes that review the accuracy of assigned risk ratings (i.e. regulatory, probability of default and loss given default ratings) and accrual status utilizing knowledge of Bancorp policies, risk rating models and definitions.   • Complete quality assurance review activities (i.e. active engagement in effective challenge meetings, secondary reviews of work papers and supporting review process documents, proficiency in providing peer-to-peer feedback, etc.) and assist in sustaining a strong CRR quality assurance program to ensure the consistency and accuracy of CRR work products and review results. Use quality assurance results constructively for employee and personal development and to make recommendations for program enhancements.
  • Assist in driving a continuous improvement approach to process management within CRR, including making appropriate recommendations for change, in order to gain efficiencies and ensure the effectiveness, consistency and relevance of CRR processes. Benchmark best practices with peer institutions and incorporate into CRR procedures as appropriate.
  • Share review findings and emerging risks with Internal Audit and other Risk functions and coordinate work efforts to ensure appropriate coverage and independent oversight of credit risk management processes across the Bancorp.
  • Assume leadership roles and/or participate in due-diligence reviews of potential Bank acquisitions and other special projects as requested.

jobs.description:
Overview

The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.

CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic, with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.

At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work:

CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion, and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture.

Position Overview

CHAI’s Analytics and Implementation Research (AIR) Team is a results-driven team of public health experts strategically positioned at the center of CHAI’s geographic and disease priorities, maximizing health systems, and bringing innovations to scale. AIR has years of experience tackling problems within real-world health systems in resource-limited settings and a long history of well-regarded collaboration with partner governments and CHAI country and global teams.

CHAI is seeking a highly motivated individual with public health experience and analytical skills to work with CHAI’s program and country teams and government counterparts to conduct epidemiological analysis, model program impact and cost-effectiveness, and monitor and evaluate the success of ongoing efforts,. The Research Associate will be responsible for developing and refining cost-effectiveness analyses for candidate programs across CHAI's portfolio; conducting rigorous pressure-tests of program theories of change by critically reviewing literature; and applying quantitative methods to help CHAI country teams identify priority programs, efficiencies, and geographic targeting opportunities.

This role is a unique opportunity to apply advanced epidemiological and quantitative analytics to high-impact health interventions in some of the world's most challenging contexts. You will have the chance to work across CHAI's diverse health programs, contribute to complex analytical work, and directly influence how resources are allocated to save lives at scale.

This role is open to candidates based in any CHAI program country, pending leadership approval and appropriate work authorization. Candidates should be able to accommodate overlapping working hours with US Eastern Time (ET) to facilitate team collaboration.

Responsibilities

Analytics and modelling

  • Apply quantitative and geospatial methods to support CHAI country teams in identifying high-priority programs, geographic targeting opportunities, and health system efficiencies
  • Support creation of cost-effectiveness models to enable evidence-based program decision-making to achieve maximal impact
  • Appropriately utilize large-scale datasets (e.g., GBD, DHS, national surveys, IHME datasets, implementation cost data) to inform program design and prioritization decisions
  • Collaborate across CHAI's disease and geographic programs to gather inputs, validate analytical assumptions, and ensure models reflect on-the-ground program realities
  • Support CHAI's engagement with major funders by preparing evidence-based materials that inform prioritization decisions and funding conversations

Evidence-based program development and technical leadership

  • Support the design and implementation of new pilot programs, leveraging existing evidence and data to ensure interventions are both impactful and cost-effective
  • Conduct rigorous pressure-tests of program theories of change, including critical review of evidence, interrogation of key assumptions, and assessment of causal pathways and counterfactual scenarios
  • Collaborate with CHAI country teams and government partners to ensure feasibility and alignment of interventions within national health systems

Qualifications

Education and experience

  • Postgraduate degree in epidemiology, economics, or related quantitative discipline
  • 3+ years of experience applying quantitative methods to global health or development challenges, including cost-effectiveness analysis, impact evaluations, and mathematical modeling

Technical

  • Exceptional analytical and critical thinking skills, with proven capacity to pressure test complex theories of change
  • Excellent skills in data management and statistical analysis, including use of software such as Stata, R, or SAS
  • Experience in cost-effectiveness modeling and evaluation design (including causal inference using observational data), tailoring methodologies to diverse contexts to generate actionable insights
  • Experience assessing and reconciling data quality issues across large survey and administrative datasets, particularly in multi-country settings
  • Strong understanding of the LMIC health systems context, including data limitations, operational constraints, and the role of government and partner ecosystems

Operational

  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to present complex quantitative findings to donors, government stakeholders, and other diverse audiences
  • Demonstrated fluency in using AI tools to synthesize information and produce high-quality analytical outputs, paired with the judgment to critically evaluate AI-generated work, identifying where it falls short or gets things wrong, and applying sound human reasoning to correct, refine, and strengthen the final product
  • Proven ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Commitment to collaborative work with a remote, geographically dispersed team across multiple time zones
  • Fluency in English

Preferred

  • Experience using geospatial methods to support budget optimization, program targeting, or subnational prioritization analyses is an advantage
  • Proficiency in one or more languages spoken in CHAI countries

  • Perform end-to-end pipeline testing — validating that data flows correctly from ingestion through to the Gold layer and that downstream reporting outputs reflect accurate data
  • Partner with Data Engineers to define acceptance criteria for each sprint’s pipeline and data model deliverables before they are promoted to production

  • Experience working with Azure-based data platforms, including Databricks.
  • Strong understanding of data quality frameworks and testing methodologies for data pipelines.
  • Experience validating ETL/ELT processes and working with layered architectures (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
  • Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing large datasets.
  • Experience implementing automated data validation and reconciliation processes.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting.

  • Proficiency in Lexis+, Lexis+ AI, Protege or other legal research tools highly preferred; experience using data tools such as Tableau and Power BI a plus
  • Strong collaboration, communication, and relationship-building skills to excel in a team-oriented environment

Work in a way that works for you

jobs.description:
INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands. In our Automotive vertical, that means turning complex vehicle data into images and animations that can represent a car across configurators, launch campaigns, print, exhibitions, and promotional videos.

We are looking for a Senior 3D Artist who can turn complex automotive data into polished visual output. You will work from high-poly vehicle assets, build materials, render stills and animations, composite final images, and keep quality consistent across large content sets.

Your impact is visible. You will create content that represents premium automotive brands in configurators, campaigns, launch campaigns, retail tools, and large-format experiences. The work must look beautiful, but it also has to survive scale.

What You Will Do

  • Create automotive CGI that holds up at close range
    Build still images and animations from high-poly vehicle models. Texture, shade, light, render, and composite final content for automotive brands with strict visual standards. You will work on exteriors, interiors, detail crops, accessories, colorways, wheels, trims, and motion sequences.

  • Own the render, not just the task
    Evaluate image quality from a senior production perspective. You can see when a render issue comes from lighting, material response, geometry, camera setup, render settings, or compositing. You will refine clearcoat, metallic flakes, glass, rubber, leather, stitching, displays, brushed metal, chrome, and shadow behavior until the image feels physically and visually right.

  • Work inside scalable production pipelines
    Create scenes and outputs that can survive large content sets. You will follow naming, versioning, render-layer, compositing, and scene-organization standards. You will help keep assets clean, reusable, and ready for configurators, campaign derivatives, market adaptations, and automated content workflows.

  • Improve quality while delivering content
    Implement feedback from art directors, leads, clients, and production teams without losing control of the setup. You will spot recurring issues, improve material libraries, refine lighting templates, document useful fixes, and help reduce manual rework across automotive production.

Requirements

You Have

  • Strong experience in automotive CGI and high-end 3D production. You are comfortable working with complex high-poly models, physically based materials, lighting setups, render passes, compositing workflows, and final image polish.

  • You know 3ds Max, V-Ray, Photoshop, and Nuke or After Effects at a professional level. Your portfolio or showreel demonstrates seniority through visual judgment, technical control, and finished output, not just clean modeling or isolated shots.

  • You can communicate clearly in English with artists, leads, producers, and technical teams. You can explain what is wrong in an image, what needs to change, and what tradeoff is being made.

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than 20 years building visual production systems for global brands. We are not a traditional creative agency and not a pure software vendor. We build the systems that turn physical products into digital twins, production-grade CGI, and scalable content.

Grip extends that work into AI-assisted content orchestration. For a Senior 3D Artist, that means your craft does not disappear into automation. It defines the quality standard the system must reproduce.

You will work across distributed training, GPU infrastructure, inference optimization, simulation environments, and agent execution frameworks, making critical architectural decisions that directly influence research velocity and model performance.

What You'll Do:

  • Develop robust systems for experiment tracking, dataset and model versioning, checkpointing, fault recovery, and observability to improve research reproducibility and operational reliability.

  • Identify and eliminate infrastructure bottlenecks, reducing experiment turnaround time and enabling researchers to run increasingly complex training workloads.

  • Define technical standards, platform interfaces, and architectural patterns that support collaboration across research, infrastructure, and applied engineering teams.

  • Lead critical engineering initiatives from system design through implementation and production operations, mentoring engineers while maintaining direct ownership of technically challenging components.

  • Strong computer science fundamentals, particularly in distributed systems, concurrency, networking, and performance engineering.

  • Extensive experience designing, building, and operating scalable backend systems or distributed computing platforms.

  • Proficiency in Python and at least one systems-oriented programming language, such as C++, Rust, or Go.

  • Hands-on experience with GPU-based machine learning infrastructure, distributed training, model inference, or large-scale compute orchestration.

  • Strong understanding of system performance, including compute utilization, memory efficiency, communication overhead, scheduling, and fault tolerance.

  • Experience designing reliable APIs, services, and infrastructure components that support complex engineering or research workflows.

  • Demonstrated technical ownership, including making architectural decisions, leading cross-functional initiatives, and delivering systems that other engineers depend on.

  • Ability to operate effectively in fast-moving research environments where requirements evolve and infrastructure must support rapid experimentation.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with distributed ML frameworks and technologies such as PyTorch Distributed, DeepSpeed, Ray, Megatron-LM, or similar systems.

  • Familiarity with GPU inference engines and optimization frameworks such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or equivalent technologies.

  • Experience building reinforcement learning infrastructure, rollout orchestration systems, or distributed agent execution environments.

  • Knowledge of CUDA, GPU kernel optimization, NCCL, or low-level GPU performance engineering.

  • Experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, cluster scheduling, and cloud-based GPU infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with simulation platforms, robotics infrastructure, or large-scale agent evaluation systems.

  • Contributions to open-source infrastructure, distributed computing frameworks, or high-performance machine learning systems.

ABOUT ZERO TO THREE

Founded in 1977, ZERO TO THREE works to ensure that babies and toddlers benefit from the early connections that are critical to their well-being and development. Our mission is to ensure that all babies and toddlers have a strong start in life. At ZERO TO THREE, we envision a society with the knowledge and will to support all infants and toddlers in reaching their full potential. Our Core Values Statement: We believe that how we do our work is as important as what we do. To learn more about ZERO TO THREE, please visit our website at zerotothree.org.

SUMMARY

The Senior Professional Development Specialist, IECMH, is part of ZERO TO THREE’s Professional Innovations team within the Communication, Marketing, and Professional Innovations (CMP) Division. Working closely with and supervised by the Senior Professional Development Manager, IECMH, this position supports the implementation, delivery, and continuous improvement of the organization’s professional development portfolio focused on infant and early childhood mental health. The position has primary responsibility for coordinating the DC:0-5™ professional development portfolio, including professional learning, Trainer Certification, faculty consultant support, and implementation resources. The position collaborates across the organization and travels nationally to deliver professional development and represent ZERO TO THREE at meetings, conferences, and other professional events.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support implementation and ongoing maintenance of the DC:0-5™ professional development portfolio in alignment with established strategic plans, including professional learning products, Trainer Certification, and implementation resources.
  • Coordinate day-to-day implementation activities related to DC:0-5™ professional learning offerings, working closely with the Senior Professional Development Manager to ensure timely, high-quality execution.
  • Lead, co-lead, and support delivery of research-based and evidence-informed DC:0-5™ and other IECMH professional learning offerings across multiple learning modalities.
  • Provide day-to-day coordination and operational support for the DC:0-5™ Trainer Certification system, including communications, participant support, logistics, implementation resources, and record maintenance.
  • Coordinate and support DC:0-5™ and other IECMH faculty consultants, including onboarding, communications, scheduling, resource development, and ongoing engagement.
  • Maintain and update professional learning materials, trainer resources, implementation tools, and supporting documentation to ensure alignment with current content and organizational standards.
  • Stay current with emerging research and promising practices related to infant and early childhood mental health, adult learning, workforce development, and implementation to support professional learning delivery and continuous quality improvement.
  • Contribute to continuous quality improvement through the collection, analysis, and synthesis of participant, trainer, and implementation data, providing recommendations to strengthen professional learning products and services.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across CMP and the broader organization to support coordinated planning, communication, implementation, and delivery of professional learning initiatives.
  • Travel nationally, as required, to deliver professional development and represent ZERO TO THREE at meetings, conferences, and other professional events.
  • Performs other duties as assigned to ensure the efficient and effective functioning of Professional Innovations.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of five (5) years of progressively responsible professional experience in infant and early childhood mental health, including direct clinical experience.
  • Current DC:0-5™ Certified Trainer credential preferred. Candidates who are certification-ready and able to successfully complete the DC:0-5™ Trainer Certification process within six (6) months of hire will also be considered.
  • Demonstrated success designing and/or delivering high-quality professional learning across multiple modalities, including in-person and virtual environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to facilitate engaging, learner-centered professional development for diverse adult audiences.
  • Strong knowledge of infant and early childhood mental health, child development, relationship-based practice, application of the DC:0-5™ diagnostic system, and family-centered approaches.
  • Knowledge of adult learning principles, professional development design and delivery, and current research and promising practices related to workforce development.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and timelines.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain productive working relationships with internal and external partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high standards for quality, accuracy, and customer service.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively as part of cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, project management and collaboration platforms, virtual meeting technologies, learning management systems and e-learning platforms, and other technologies used to support professional learning and program implementation.
  • Ability and willingness to travel nationally on a regular basis.

EDUCATION

Master’s degree or higher in infant and early childhood mental health, psychology, social work, counseling, medicine, or a closely related field; current board certification, active clinical license, or equivalent professional credential recognized in the jurisdiction of employment; a minimum of three (3) years of IECMH clinical experience serving children from birth through age five and their families; and a minimum of three (3) years of experience providing professional development to practitioners responsible for assessment, diagnosis, or treatment planning.

Equivalent international credentials and comparable combinations of education, clinical preparation, and directly related professional experience may be considered, provided the candidate demonstrates the qualifications necessary to deliver DC:0-5™ professional development and meets applicable professional and regulatory requirements.

Advanced training, certification, or specialization in IECMH and experience developing and delivering training, consultation, coaching, or reflective practice opportunities for multidisciplinary professionals.

We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Business Analyst to support the BMO Global Asset Management (BMO GAM) business as part of the Investment Solutions and Delivery team.


In this role, you will drive the end-to-end delivery of data-centric investment solutions, from requirements gathering and documentation through data analysis, testing, and final implementation, ensuring solutions enable accurate, timely, and fact-based investment and business decisions.


You will partner closely with Investment teams, Investment Operations, Risk, Compliance, Institutional Sales, Technology, Data Platform teams, external service providers and other business areas to translate business objectives into clear, testable data and solution requirements.


You will help ensure that delivered solutions satisfy approved business outcomes, data requirements, control expectations, and acceptance criteria.


You will also contribute to the strategy and roadmap for investment data quality, data modeling, reporting, and analytics, including clear documentation of data definitions, data lineage, and business processes across the investment data lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:

Requirements Gathering & Documentation

  • Leads requirements gathering sessions with Portfolio and/or Product Managers, Investment Operations, Risk, Compliance, Institutional Sales, Technology, and other stakeholders to understand business objectives, pain points, and data needs.
  • Translates business objectives into clear business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for investment solutions.
  • Documents current- and future-state business processes, data flows, control points, dependencies, and operational procedures, and keeps them up to date.
  • Maintain end-to-end traceability from approved business outcomes and requirements through data rules, solution design, test cases, defects, implementation evidence, and final business acceptance.
  • Assess proposed solutions against the underlying business objective and challenge approaches that do not adequately satisfy approved requirements.

Data Knowledge & Management

  • Serves as a subject-matter expert on investment data, including securities, holdings, transactions, performance, benchmarks, reference data, and related investment datasets.
  • Develops and maintains source-to-target data mappings, data dictionaries, business rules, transformation requirements, and supporting data documentation.
  • Documents end-to-end data lineage from external and internal sources through to downstream reporting and analytics, supporting data governance, controls, and auditability.
  • Perform root-cause analysis of data discrepancies, process breaks, and control issues, working across business, operational, technical and vendor interests to determine underlying causes and appropriate remediation.
  • Analyzes, profiles, and reconciles data from multiple sources using SQL and Python to identify gaps, data quality issues, and root causes, enabling more efficient processes and streamlined reporting.
  • Structures data into multiple dimensions and granularities (e.g. products, positions, transactions) to support reporting and analytics.
  • Rationalizes legacy data sources, ensuring clear stewardship, proper documentation, reduction of technical debt, and alignment with modern data architecture principles.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Plans and coordinates user acceptance testing (UAT), including test strategy, test scenarios, test cases, and test data, and obtains business sign-off prior to production release.
  • Validates data outputs against requirements and source systems and automates validation tests where possible to improve quality and efficiency.
  • Logs, tracks, and manages defects through to resolution in partnership with technology teams and vendors.
  • Assess proposed defect resolutions and workarounds for their impact on business requirements, data quality, operational processes, control, and downstream consumers.
  • Maintain clear traceability between requirements, testing evidence, identified defect, remediation, and business acceptance.

Solution Delivery

  • Supports the design, development, and implementation of data, analytics, and reporting solutions aligned with business strategy and stakeholder needs.
  • Coordinates release readiness, production deployment, and post-implementation validation to ensure solutions are delivered as intended, on time and within scope.
  • Conducts pre- and post-implementation analyses to measure business impact, and monitors solution performance from an end-to-end perspective.
  • Designs reports, dashboards, and visualizations in Power BI and other visualization tools, and develops training materials and user guides to enable self-serve analytics for business users.

Stakeholder Liaison

  • Serves as the trusted data partner and liaison between Investment teams, Investment Operations, Risk, Compliance, Institutional Sales, Technology, Data Platform teams and other business areas ensuring alignment on scope, priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Work with external stakeholders, including custodians, fund administrators, market data vendors, and technology providers, on data requirements, issues, and changes.
  • Challenge external provider requirements, mappings, solution assumptions, proposed workarounds, test evidence, and delivery outcomes where these do not adequately satisfy business requirements.
  • Communicates progress, risks, issues, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
  • Works independently, exercising judgment to identify, diagnose, and solve problems and to handle non-routine situations.
  • Broader work or accountabilities may be assigned as needed.

Qualifications:

  • Typically 7–10 years of relevant experience in business or data analysis, preferably within asset management, investment management, or financial services, and a post-secondary degree in a related field of study or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong knowledge of investment data and asset management operations, including securities, holdings, transactions, performance, and benchmark data across asset classes.
  • Proven experience gathering requirements and producing BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, source-to-target data mappings, and lineage documentation.
  • Hands-on experience planning and executing UAT and data validation and supporting solutions through to production delivery.
  • Advanced SQL skills with demonstrated ability to independently query, profile, reconcile, and validating large and complex datasets.
  • Working knowledge of Python (e.g. pandas) for data analysis, automation, and test validation.
  • Hands-on experience with Power BI and other data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Spotfire) to build reports and dashboards.
  • Experience with Snowflake and other cloud data lake and data warehouse platforms (e.g. Azure Data Lake, Databricks); familiarity with SAS or WebFOCUS is an asset.
  • Familiarity with data governance, data quality, and data lineage practices; experience with Agile delivery methods is an asset.
  • In-depth verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate between business and technical audiences.
  • In-depth collaboration, influence, and stakeholder management skills.
  • In-depth analytical, problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making skills.

About Bizmoni Corp.

Bizmoni is building an AI Business Network designed to help people and businesses connect, earn, learn, and grow in the AI era.

As a seed-stage, pre-revenue company, we are strengthening our platform, growing our global ecosystem, and laying the foundations for future funding and scale. This is an opportunity to join an entrepreneurial, international team and help shape both the product and the business.

About the Role

Architecture and platform build

  • Design and build our LLM infrastructure from scratch: model serving, orchestration, data pipelines, vector storage and observability.
  • Make and document key build-vs-buy decisions, including hosted APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) versus self-hosted open-weight models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen).
  • Stand up scalable, cost-efficient inference using tools such as vLLM, TGI or Triton, on GPU and CPU infrastructure.
  • Build the cloud foundations on [AWS / Azure / GCP] using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar), Docker and Kubernetes.

LLM application engineering

  • Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search and re-ranking.
  • Develop agentic workflows, tool use and function calling for production use cases.
  • Fine-tune and adapt models where it adds value (LoRA/QLoRA, PEFT), and know when prompting or retrieval is the better answer.
  • Expose AI capabilities through well-designed Python APIs (FastAPI or similar) for product and engineering teams.

Quality, reliability and safety

  • Build evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, hallucination, latency and cost, and use them to gate releases.
  • Implement monitoring, tracing and alerting for LLM services (e.g. LangSmith, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana).
  • Put guardrails in place for data privacy, prompt injection, PII handling and GDPR compliance.
  • Own CI/CD and MLOps practices for models, prompts and pipelines.

Leadership and collaboration

  • Set coding standards, write clear technical documentation and review code.
  • Partner with product, data and engineering leads to turn business problems into shipped AI features.
  • Help shape future AI hiring and mentor engineers as the team grows.

What you'll bring

  • Expert, hands-on Python. 5+ years writing production Python daily: async, typing, packaging, testing (pytest) and performance profiling. You write the code, not just the design doc.
  • Built LLM systems in production. At least 2 years shipping LLM-powered products to real users, including at least one platform or major system you built from scratch.
  • Infrastructure depth. Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes and at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP), plus infrastructure-as-code.
  • Model serving and optimisation. Practical knowledge of inference servers, GPU utilisation, batching, quantisation and caching to manage latency and cost.
  • RAG and data. Hands-on with embeddings and vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant or similar) and building reliable data pipelines.
  • ML fundamentals. Solid understanding of transformers, tokenisation and fine-tuning, with experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face.
  • Engineering discipline. CI/CD, observability, API design and writing software others can maintain.
  • Ownership. Comfortable making architectural calls with incomplete information, explaining trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, and working without a ready-made playbook.

Nice to have

  • Experience as the first or founding AI/ML engineer at a start-up or scale-up.
  • Agent frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, DSPy or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Distributed training or multi-GPU work (DeepSpeed, FSDP, Ray).
  • Working in a regulated sector (fintech, healthcare, public sector) and familiarity with the EU AI Act.
  • Some Rust, Go or TypeScript alongside Python.
  • Open-source contributions, published projects or technical writing in the LLM space.

Who Thrives at Bizmoni?

We look for people who demonstrate:

  • Ownership – Taking responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks
  • Results Orientation – Focusing on quality, execution, and impact
  • Continuous Improvement – Always looking for better ways to work and improve quality
  • Collaboration – Partnering effectively across teams and functions
  • Adaptability – Thriving in a dynamic and evolving environment
  • Mission Alignment – Believing in what we're building and its future potential

Compensation & Commitment

Bizmoni currently offers ONLY an equity-based compensation model, aligned with global startup practices that enable early contributors to participate in the company's potential long-term value creation.

The role requires a flexible commitment of approximately 8–16 hours per week, with clear deliverables and results-driven accountability. Contributors may maintain a primary paid role alongside their engagement with Bizmoni. As Bizmoni is currently seed-stage, compensation is provided in company equity. Full terms and conditions will be discussed during the selection process and confirmed in the consulting agreement.

Requirements for Remote Engagement:

  • Personal computer with camera and reliable internet connection
  • Willingness to participate in Bizmoni's equity-based compensation model

Why You'll Love Working at Bizmoni

Discover your 100% YOU with MicroSourcing!

Position: Merchandise Coordinator - Amazon

Why join MicroSourcing?

You'll have:

Your role:

The Merchandise Coordinator – Amazon keeps our brand partners' Amazon catalogs accurate, complete and selling. This role executes the day-to-day merchandising work across Seller Central (3P) and Vendor Central (1P): launching new products, building enhanced listing content, keeping live listings healthy, and resolving catalog errors and support cases quickly.

The Coordinator follows BrandJump's Marketplace SOP — Amazon & 3P closely, works from the Amazon Records as the source of truth, and partners with the Marketplace Manager, Brand Managers, Brand Content Managers and our 3P team so every load reaches the site correctly and on time. Prior hands-on Amazon experience is required. It is an execution-focused role for someone who is meticulous, organized, comfortable in large spreadsheets and portals, and who enjoys solving the puzzle when Amazon rejects a file or suppresses a listing.

Duties & Responsibilities

Product Launches & Catalog Setup

  • Launch new products on Amazon through flat-file templates, Seller Central / Vendor Central portals and the PIM (RiverSand / Syndigo), making sure every requirement is met before submission

  • Build and maintain parent/child variation families so sizes, finishes and colors sit together on one detail page

  • Create ASINs and pass them to the 3P team (Belami, ShopFreely, Cymax) through ClickUp when the Amazon Record shows authorized 3P sellers

  • Know the difference between our 1P (Vendor Central) and 3P (Seller Central) accounts, and follow the right load path for each brand as noted in the Amazon Record

  • Keep the Amazon Record and ClickUp tasks current so the team always sees accurate status

Listing Content

  • Generate enhanced listing content for 100% of new SKUs (Amazon-direct and 3P) using our Amazon enhanced-content skill in Claude, then review it against the Content QA checklist before it goes on the template

  • Follow our Amazon file house rules so listings aren't rejected or suppressed: no HTML in descriptions, no warranty language in bullets, backend search terms under 240 bytes with no repeated words, and consistent wording across a product family

  • Optimize live listings above the fold (titles, bullets, images) as part of catalog-health projects, including Vendor Central clean-ups such as removing model numbers from 1P titles

  • Upload A+ Content and load assets into Amazon Brand Store modules once creative is approved, and clear basic image or system errors

Catalog Health & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor listing health daily: suppressed, inactive, stranded and non-buyable listings, with priority on inactive items that still have inventory

  • Read and resolve Amazon error codes and flat-file processing reports, re-submitting corrected files

  • Open, track and follow up on Seller Support and Vendor Central cases, logging case IDs in our trackers and escalating to the Marketplace Manager when a case stalls

  • Flag catalog-contribution and brand-authority issues (for example, legacy 1P data overriding our updates) so the Marketplace Manager can work them through Brand Registry

  • Run listings, imagery and data audits against the brand's data file and the live detail page, and fix gaps

  • Support seasonal readiness (Prime Day, Prime Big Deal Days, Black Friday / Cyber Monday) by making sure priority listings are live, buyable and accurate ahead of key dates

Communication & Collaboration

  • Work day to day with the Marketplace Manager, who owns Amazon strategy, Brand Registry and the Amazon Records

  • Partner with Brand Content Managers so finished content is stored in the PIM, and with Brand Managers on brand-specific priorities

  • Speak directly with brand partners about their Amazon merchandising: join Zoom meetings to walk through launches, listing health, open issues and recommendations, and send clear, professional email updates when products go live or projects move forward

  • Hand off ASINs and load status to the 3P team so Belami, ShopFreely and Cymax uploads aren't held up

  • Communicate clearly and promptly in English, in writing, inside ClickUp and email, following our response norms: half a business day for external messages, one day for internal ones

  • Raise questions early. If a record, task or brand requirement is unclear, ask the team distro rather than guessing

Project Management

  • Set a weekly agenda in ClickUp every Friday by end of day; check the Marketplace Manager's notes on Monday and adjust priorities if asked (no notes means proceed as planned)

  • Track tasks, timelines and time spent per brand accurately in ClickUp

  • Manage a high volume of loads and ad-hoc requests across multiple brands, prioritizing by deadline and sales impact

  • Meet the KPIs and SLAs set for the Merch team, and suggest process improvements when you see a better way

Skills, Qualifications & Experience

  • Required: 1–3 years of hands-on Amazon merchandising experience. Candidates without direct Amazon Seller Central experience will not be considered; Vendor Central experience is a strong plus

  • Working knowledge of flat-file inventory templates, variation (parent/child) setup, browse nodes and ASIN creation

  • Experience troubleshooting suppressed or inactive listings and working Seller Support cases through to resolution

  • Familiarity with A+ Content, Brand Registry and Brand Stores

  • Basic understanding of Amazon SEO and keyword research; Helium 10 or similar tools a plus

  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, filters, pivot tables, cleaning large data sets)

  • Comfortable using AI tools (we use Claude) to draft content, then carefully checking the output

  • Experience with a PIM system and a project-management tool such as ClickUp is a plus

  • Excellent spoken and written English; confident presenting Amazon merchandising updates to brand clients on Zoom and corresponding with them directly by email

  • Highly detail-oriented with strong follow-through; able to work independently across time zones

  • Experience with home furnishings, lighting or décor products is a plus

Job title: Director, National Accounts - Government

About the Job

Sanofi Vaccines is seeking an exceptional, senior executive to serve as the strategic face of our organization to the United States federal government health ecosystem. The Director, National Accounts – Government is one of the most strategically significant and complex commercial roles within Sanofi's entire portfolio — responsible for leading executive engagement, contract strategy, and revenue growth across a the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Defense Health Agency (DHA). This role demands rare expertise at the intersection of federal procurement, public health policy, and high-stakes relationship management at the highest levels of the U.S. government.


The federal government health ecosystem presents a level of complexity unmatched in the commercial marketplace. This role requires mastery of federal acquisition regulations (FAR), agency-specific contract vehicles, Made in America requirements, and evolving cybersecurity mandates such as CMMC — all while navigating multi-layered decision-making structures that span clinical, administrative, and procurement stakeholders across VA Regions, Veterans Integrated Service Networks (VISNs), VA Medical Centers (VAMCs), and the full DHA command structure. Success demands deep technical expertise in government contracting and sustained relationship capital to influence outcomes at the most senior levels of federal health leadership.


The Director, National Accounts – Government will be the lead executer of strategies designed to capture the potential in market – advancing immunization rates across all agencies, and positioning Sanofi as the undisputed preferred vaccine partner within the federal health ecosystem.


Join the team protecting half a billion lives every year with next-gen science, mRNA innovation, and AI driven breakthroughs. In Vaccines, you’ll help advance prevention on a global scale - and shape the future of immunization.

About Sanofi

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system — and innovative pipeline — enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

Main Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Market Development

  • Lead executive strategy and engagement across the Veterans Affairs (VA), Defense Health Agency (DHA).
  • Build and maintain comprehensive influence maps across the full federal health ecosystem — from national agency leadership to regional and local levels, including VA Regions, VISNs, and VAMCs, as well as within DHA.
  • Lead RFP strategy development and response delivery for federal contract opportunities, ensuring competitive positioning and compliance with all applicable federal requirements.
  • Identify, develop, and capture growth opportunities across all products in the portfolio across the federal health ecosystem.
  • Develop and implement data-driven interventions to close immunization coverage gaps and advance vaccination rates across VA & DHA. Cross collaboration with the various Agencies Innovation Divisions and Sanofi BARDA Team, Specialty and General Meds Teams, is critical.

Executive Relationship Management

  • Cultivate and sustain C-Suite and Key Opinion Leader relationships at the highest levels of the VA & DHA— including agency heads, procurement leaders, senior clinical leadership, and other decision makers.
  • Engage and coordinate across the full spectrum of multi-layered federal decision-making structures, ensuring Sanofi maintains sustained influence at every level of the government health hierarchy.
  • Serve as Sanofi's primary commercial executive liaison to federal government health agencies, representing the full breadth and depth of the Sanofi Vaccines portfolio.

Federal Contracting & Compliance Expertise

  • Navigate complex federal procurement frameworks including FAR, agency-specific contract vehicles, Made in America requirements, and cybersecurity mandates (CMMC) with precision and expertise.
  • Lead government bid processes, contract negotiations, and ongoing compliance management with a deep understanding of federal customers' unique needs, objectives, and regulatory obligations.
  • Ensure rigorous adherence to heightened government oversight requirements, performance metrics, and public transparency standards that govern federal contracting relationships.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Team Leadership

  • Establish and lead a high-performing matrix team model in close partnership with internal Sanofi stakeholders including field sales management, Account Management, Market Access, Marketing, and headquarters leadership to ensure seamless execution of federal account strategies.
  • Coordinate high-level strategy with Sanofi Vaccines headquarters to ensure alignment between federal account strategy and broader commercial objectives.
  • Lead and contribute to special projects that leverage deep market knowledge, market access expertise, and key customer relationships to advance Sanofi's competitive position.

Business Analytics & Performance Management

  • Proactively leverage business analytics, customer intelligence, and market observations to drive solution development, refine sales strategy, and anticipate shifts in the federal contracting and procurement landscape.
  • Maintain deep expertise in contracting and pricing platforms, membership management processes, and data transactions to ensure operational excellence across all federal accounts.
  • Track and report on KPIs including market share, dose volume, contract performance, and revenue growth delivering consistent achievement of sales and marketing objectives.
  • Develop and present executive-level business reviews and strategic recommendations to senior Sanofi leadership and federal agency stakeholders.

About You

Required

  • BS/BA required; MBA strongly preferred.
  • Minimum 10+ years of progressive experience in government/federal sales, national accounts, or related federal healthcare roles.
  • Demonstrated track record of securing, managing, and growing large-scale government contracts with VA, DHA, or equivalent federal agencies.
  • Deep expertise in federal procurement regulations (FAR), government contracting vehicles, and compliance frameworks including Made in America requirements and cybersecurity mandates.
  • Proven ability to build and sustain C-Suite and senior executive relationships within federal agencies at the highest levels of government health leadership.
  • Strong federal and political acumen with demonstrated experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder government environments.
  • Experience with vaccines, biologics, or specialty pharmaceutical products strongly preferred.
  • Ability to travel up to 60% nationally.

Preferred

  • Direct experience with VA, DHA procurement processes, formulary management, and contract vehicles.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and executing complex strategies within a matrixed organizational structure.
  • Familiarity with vaccine portfolios and the federal public health immunization landscape.

Why Choose Us

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness program
  • Work at the forefront of AI-driven research, smart manufacturing, and groundbreaking mRNA platforms that are redefining the future of immunology.
  • Help protect half a billion people every year, contributing to one of the largest global vaccination efforts in healthcare.
  • Develop your career with access to mentoring, international mobility programs, and opportunities to grow across four continents.

jobs.excerpt: We’re hunting for a talented direct response video editor and static designer who can craft paid media ads (video and static) that stop the scroll and sell.
jobs.description:
We’re hunting for a talented direct response video editor and static designer who can craft paid media ads (video and static) that stop the scroll and sell. O’Connell Digital Media Group is an Inc. 5000 direct-response agency that has managed hundreds of millions in profitable ad spend for some of the top direct-response advertisers in the world. You’ll join a veteran team of account directors, media buyers, creative strategists and video editors who share a common goal: generate clicks that convert into high ROAS sales and scale ad spend.

So, if you’re obsessed with performance ads that convert, have edited at high volume in an agency or fast-scaling in-house team, and…

  • You LOVE taking a script and seeing the finished ad in your head before you open Premiere…
  • You LOVE building the first three seconds that stop the thumb…
  • You LOVE sweating the B-roll, the text, the music and the sound until the story lands…
  • You LOVE using AI tools to make ads that were impossible a year ago…
  • You LOVE seeing the numbers on your ads and finding out why one won…

… then please keep reading as you may be the perfect fit.

Especially if you’re tired of assembly-line edits with no feedback on what worked… tired of the freelance hustle chasing your next project… or stuck inside a single brand, cutting the same content over and over.

Note: Please do not apply if your editing experience is limited to weddings, corporate video, organic social or YouTube content, or to stitching UGC clips into a template.

What Are the Key Points?

  • Core Compensation: $1,750 - $2,000 USD per month
  • Location: 100% remote
  • Hours: 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET, Monday to Friday (adjustable for those outside the US)
  • Position: Full-time contractor
  • Culture: Accountable, transparent and obsessed with performance
  • #1 Objective: Deliver ads that convert, on time, on spec and on quality

Note: For those applying outside the US, hours may be adjusted to a heavily overlapping schedule we agree on together.

Who Will You Report To?

Hello, my name is Tom Clayson, Head of Creative at O'Connell Media, and I need your help.

I joined O'Connell Media just under a year ago to transform the creative team into one that can scale to meet the projected client growth demands. Our video editors work in small pods, each led by an Editing Team Lead, and with most of the heavy lifting done, I’m now expanding the editing team for the next leg of growth. That’s where you come in.

The volume of ads we need to ship based on our forecast exceeds our current capacity. It’s a good problem to have… but it’s still a problem. I’m hiring editors who can take a strategist’s script and brief and deliver a finished ad that needs no rescue from anyone downstream. You’ll join a pod, work day to day with strategists, and get coaching from me and your team lead along the way.

What’s the Ideal Candidate’s Background?

You’ve been editing direct-response video ads for paid social (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok) or YouTube for at least two years, in a high-volume agency or a fast-scaling in-house team. Cutting multiple new ads a week is your normal week. You’ve edited for supplement, health or wellness offers that drive traffic to long-form funnels like VSLs and advertorials and/or performance-based e-comm funnels.

You’re an expert in Premiere Pro. After Effects is a strong plus and Photoshop. Plus you’re deeply comfortable with AI in the edit: digital twins, voice cloning, video cloning, AI-generated B-roll and images, and AI captioning. We don’t force a single tool (Higgsfield is our main AI platform today), but we want to know exactly which tools you’re proficient in and what you’ve made with them.

Most importantly… you edit for marketing, not for content. You know the first three seconds decide whether anyone sees the rest. You understand the structure of a persuasive ad, from hook to problem to mechanism to proof to offer to call to action, and you cut so the viewer never has a reason to leave. You study why ads win on your own time because, quite frankly, you simply can’t get enough of this stuff.

What Will You Be Responsible For?

Put simply, you’ll deliver the creative strategist’s brief on time, on spec and on quality. Here’s what that looks like:

  • The Brief: Take the script and brief from the creative strategist in ClickUp, ask the questions that matter before you start, and lock the turnaround date.
  • The Hook: Build thumb-stopping openers. We test the first three seconds, so you’ll often deliver several wildly different openers for the same script.
  • The Story: Choose the B-roll, on-screen text, graphics, music and sound design that make the viewer see themselves in the ad. Not the first clip you find, the right one.
  • The AI Build: Produce digital twins, cloned voices, generated B-roll and other AI assets when the brief calls for them.
  • The Finish: Deliver a fully dialed-in cut with captions, graphics and sound design, checked against our editing checklist, ready for strategist and client approval.
  • The Revisions: Take revision notes from the strategist and your Editing Team Lead, turn them fast, and learn from every round.

How Will Your Time Be Spent?

While any given week varies with client demands, here’s a rough estimate:

  • 65% Editing: Building ads from brief to finished cut
  • 20% Revisions and Polish: Working with your Editing Team Lead and strategists to perfect each ad
  • 15% Learning: Studying winning ads, new formats and new AI tools

What Does Initial Success Look Like?

We hold every ad to a clear standard. Here’s what success looks like as you ramp up:

  • Great-Enough First Cuts: Your first cut matches the brief and the strategist’s vision, so revisions make the ad better instead of fixing it.
  • On Time, On Spec: You hit your weekly ad quota and turnaround dates without letting quality slip.
  • Hooks That Hold: Your openers earn the view and your edits keep attention all the way to the call to action.
  • AI in Real Ads: Within your first month, AI assets you built are running in live ads.

What’s It Like Working at O'Connell Media?

We’ve built the editing team around what the best editors want most: clear direction, fast feedback and the chance to see their work win.

  • A Pod That Has Your Back: You’ll work in a small pod with an Editing Team Lead who reviews your work and coaches you daily.
  • Clear Briefs: Strategists hand you scripts with visual direction, so you’re never guessing what the ad should be.
  • Access to Data: You’ll see how your ads perform, spot the patterns and build on what’s winning.
  • Clear Feedback: Direct feedback from your Editing Team Lead and routine coaching from me.
  • Subject Variety: A range of clients and offers, with fresh subject matter all the time.
  • A Rhythm That Works: A short daily stand-up keeps every ad moving.
  • Room to Grow: Our Editing Team Leads come from inside the team. Your results decide how fast you move up.

Requirements

  • 2+ Years of DR Video Editing: You’ve edited video ads for paid social or YouTube that ran with real spend, ideally for supplement, health or wellness offers.
  • High-Volume Experience: You’ve worked in an agency or fast-scaling in-house team where cutting multiple new ads a week was the norm.
  • Premiere Pro Expert: Premiere Pro is your home. After Effects is a strong plus.
  • AI-Fluent: You’ve used AI tools in real ads for digital twins, voice cloning, video cloning, generated B-roll and captions, and you keep up as the tools change.
  • Visual Storyteller: You turn a script into a sequence of images, text and sound that persuades, and you can explain why each choice is there.
  • Marketing Mindset: You understand what moves hook rate, hold rate, CTR and conversion rate, and you edit to move them.
  • Detail Obsessed: Your cuts arrive double-checked, captioned and compliant. Nobody downstream has to fix your work.
  • Organized Under Pressure: You keep multiple ads moving at once, keep ClickUp current and hit your deadlines.
  • Fluent English: You work effortlessly in an English-speaking team, in writing and on calls.
  • Constant Upskilling: You relentlessly improve by studying winning ads, deconstructing edits and seeking feedback.
