Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.


What you’ll be responsible for:


As a member of the Strategy, Communications, and Policy team, you will be the operational backbone of Circle’s external engagements and manage day-to-day partner and platform relationships across Asia Pacific and beyond. You will help set the standard for how Circle shows up externally, making sure every voice on a stage is prepared, on message, and aligned with our strategic positioning. You will also build and manage regional partnerships and events, including our relationship with GFTN, to deepen Circle’s presence with regulators, financial institutions, and industry bodies.


What you’ll work on:


  • Produce regional events across APAC and help secure speaking and earned platforms for Circle’s senior executives and the Strategy, Policy, and Communications team, putting Circle in front of the region’s regulators, financial institutions, and industry leaders.
  • Manage Circle’s APAC partnerships, including GFTN, industry associations, universities, and think tanks, turning relationships into a deeper, more trusted presence.
  • Provide Circle’s speakers with prep, approved messaging, and post-event feedback so every voice on stage is prepared, on message, and aligned with our strategic positioning.
  • Maintain Circle’s speaking program, from triaging inbound requests to keeping an accurate system of record and messaging library, so Circle says yes to the right stages and shows up consistently.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Legal on the post-event content pipeline, from highlight clips to social drafts, extending the reach of every appearance.
  • Manage budgets, contracts, and renewals for vendors and partners.
  • Provide executive support to the Senior Director of Strategic Positioning, from partner briefs to pipeline tracking and follow-ups.
  • Collaborate with US-based colleagues through a follow-the-sun model.

What you’ll bring to Circle:


Core Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience in communications, policy, partnerships, or program management, ideally in financial services or digital assets.
  • Experience producing events or speaker programs, and managing budgets and vendor contracts.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to prepare crisp, accurate briefs for senior executives.
  • Confidence to work with senior executives and earn their trust.
  • Fluency with generative AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) and prompt development, including agentic workflows.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Established network in APAC fintech or policy circles, or the ability to build one quickly.
  • Experience coordinating across time zones with Marketing, Legal, and business teams.
  • Experience/familiarity with Slack, macOS, and Google Workspace.

Additional Information:

  • This role may require up to 30% travel.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.excerpt: #RunwiththePack At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.
jobs.description:
#RunwiththePack


At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.


We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.


More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.


We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

About the Position:

The Distribution Development Manager II owns a defined subset of Arctic Wolf's developing distribution partners with growth potential within an assigned territory. This role independently leads training, enablement, and activation and builds growth plans that develop those partners into consistent, high-performing members of our partner ecosystem. By acting as a trusted advisor to distributors and aligning internal teams around their growth, this role delivers measurable results for the distribution channel.


**Position is remote, but candidates must be based in the greater Buffalo, NY area or the greater Greenville, SC area



Responsibilities

  • Own a defined subset of developing distribution partners within an assigned territory, working independently on day-to-day activation and enablement.
  • Develop growth strategies for assigned distributors and identify partner development motions that can scale across the territory.
  • Create and drive territory strategy for assigned coverage, identifying growth opportunities that move partners from developing to consistently high performing.
  • Lead partner recruitment, activation, and engagement activities that build distributor sales, marketing, and technical teams into consistent contributors.
  • Deliver training and enablement sessions to distributor teams, adapting content to each partner's stage of development.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to distributor contacts, influencing partner business decisions and growth investments that increase their Arctic Wolf business.
  • Lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs), business reviews, and trainings for assigned distributors, and guide executive discussions with partner leaders.
  • Align stakeholders across sales, marketing, operations, enablement, and distribution to deliver on distributor growth plans.
  • Create, lead, and operationalize new programs or improvements that produce measurable impact beyond assigned distributors.
  • Track distributor activation and performance progress, flagging partners who need additional support and adjusting plans as needed.
  • Coach Distribution Development Manager I team members informally on enablement delivery and partner communication.
  • Address routine distributor concerns and conflicts independently, escalating more complex issues to management as needed.

Who You Are

  • Partner relationship management
  • Pipeline forecasting and customer relationship management (CRM) proficiency
  • Territory and business plan development
  • Presentation and enablement delivery
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Channel and distribution program expertise

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  • Two or more years of experience in channel, partner, or sales roles
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a partner portfolio independently

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with partner business planning processes
  • Experience working with technology distributors
  • Prior experience in a security or software-as-a-service (SaaS) technology company

Benefits


All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:


  • Equity for all employees
  • Flexible time off and paid volunteer days
  • 401(k) contribution and matching
  • Training and career development programs
  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services
  • Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services
  • Fertility support and paid parental leave

Security Requirements 

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

Base Salary

The base salary range for this job family is 52,300 to 179,500 USD annually. This range reflects the base pay the company reasonably expects to offer for this position, aligned to the broader job family base pay structure. Actual base pay may vary based on skills, experience, and location, including job family level. In addition to base pay, Arctic Wolf offers variable incentive compensation, new hire equity grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.title: Marketing & Events Coordinator, Broker & Partnerships
jobs.excerpt: Sidecar Health is redefining health insurance.  Our mission is to make excellent healthcare affordable and accessible for everyone.
jobs.description:
Sidecar Health is redefining health insurance. Our mission is to make excellent healthcare affordable and accessible for everyone. We know that to accomplish this lofty mission, we need driven people who will make things happen.

The passionate people who make up Sidecar Health’s team come from all over, with backgrounds as tech leaders, policy makers, healthcare professionals, and beyond. And they all have one thing in common—the desire to fix a broken system and make it more personalized, affordable, and transparent.

If you want to use your talents to transform healthcare in the United States, come join us!

About the Role

Sidecar Health's Broker & Partnership Marketing team runs a full calendar of national and regional conferences, sponsorships, and broker-facing events (FL SHRM, national SHRM, GA NABIP, GCHR, golf tournaments, and more) that drive pipeline for the broker channel, alongside ongoing broker communications, RSM enablement, and marketing operations work that continues year-round. This role owns end-to-end event execution and flexes into broader marketing support during lighter stretches of the calendar, so the Director can focus on broker relationships, channel strategy, and program growth.

The person in this seat should be able to run a conference with minimal oversight once direction is set, and should bring existing vendor/logistics experience or the ability to build those relationships fast.

Location & Travel: Candidates must reside in GA, OH, TX, or FL. Expect up to 30% travel, heaviest in Q3 and around key sponsored events, with lighter months focused on marketing and collateral support.

What You'll Do

  • End-to-end event execution: own the conference calendar; manage timelines, budgets, and vendor relationships for every event from initial planning through post-event wrap-up.
  • Vendor management & negotiation: source and negotiate with vendors for booth activations, swag, signage, and lead capture activity; own the vendor relationship, not just order-placing.
  • Budget ownership: manage event-specific budgets, track spend against plan, and flag variances proactively.
  • On-site event management: represent Sidecar Health at conferences and sponsorship events (travel required, estimated 20-30%); manage booth setup, staffing coordination, and day-of logistics.
  • Lead capture & RSM handoff: own the post-event pipeline: process booth-captured leads, build and maintain RSM outreach toolkits, and track follow-up cadence completion through to conversion.
  • Sponsorship & partnership logistics: manage sponsorship deliverables (golf tournaments, association partnerships) including gifting, signage, and relationship follow-up with sponsor contacts.
  • Marketing collateral & asset management: maintain the broker collateral library (one-pagers, toolkits, presentations); keep materials current and on-brand between production cycles.
  • Campaign & digital support: assist with email marketing, marketing automation platform upkeep (e.g., HubSpot/Pardot-equivalent tools), and light social/content support as broader marketing needs arise.
  • Cross-functional coordination: partner closely with Sales/RSMs, the CMO's office, and outside vendors; keep Jira/SharePoint project tracking current.
  • Continuous improvement: build repeatable playbooks and vendor spec libraries so each event doesn't start from scratch.

What You'll Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in event planning/coordination or marketing coordination, ideally in B2B, healthcare, or insurance/broker-facing marketing.
  • Proven vendor negotiation experience: has managed budgets and vendor relationships independently, not just executed against someone else's plan.
  • Comfortable traveling to and running events on-site; able to manage high-pressure, fast-turnaround logistics calmly.
  • Strong written communicator, comfortable drafting broker- and RSM-facing communications for review and adapting tone across channels.
  • Basic insurance/broker-channel literacy a plus: familiarity with broker/carrier relationships and awareness that insurance marketing materials often carry compliance or filing considerations (training provided; deep expertise not required).
  • Organized self-starter who can manage multiple concurrent events and marketing deliverables without close supervision, and who can shift between event-heavy and marketing-support work as the calendar demands.
  • Experience with lead capture tools, CRM/pipeline handoff, marketing automation platforms, and project tracking tools (Jira, SharePoint) a plus.
  • Reports directly to the Director of Broker & Partnership Marketing; no direct reports initially, with potential to grow the function

What You'll Get

  • Competitive salary, bonus opportunity, and equity package
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • A 401k retirement plan
  • Paid vacation and company holidays
  • Opportunity to make an impact at a rapidly growing mission-driven company transforming healthcare in the U.S.

Sidecar Health is an Equal Opportunity employer committed to building a diverse team. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status.

jobs.title: Master Scheduler – Capital Projects & Engineering
jobs.excerpt: Valdes Architecture & Engineering is seeking an experienced Master Scheduler to lead project planning, scheduling, forecasting, and schedule performance management for complex engineering and capital projects.
jobs.description:
Valdes Architecture & Engineering is seeking an experienced Master Scheduler to lead project planning, scheduling, forecasting, and schedule performance management for complex engineering and capital projects. This position develops and maintains integrated master schedules, identifies project risks, evaluates schedule performance, and partners with project leadership to implement proactive solutions. The ideal candidate brings advanced Primavera P6 expertise, a strong understanding of engineering and construction project lifecycles, and the ability to translate complex scheduling information into actionable project decisions.

Key Responsibilities

    Master Scheduling & Project Planning

  • Lead development, implementation, and maintenance of Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) using Primavera P6
  • Develop logic-driven schedules encompassing engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout as applicable
  • Establish and maintain Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), baselines, milestones, activity relationships, resources, and critical paths
  • Integrate schedules across engineering disciplines, contractors, vendors, and stakeholders
  • Develop resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules and standardized scheduling templates and reporting practices

    • Schedule Analysis, Forecasting & Risk Management

  • Perform critical path, schedule variance, float, and schedule health analyses to identify delays and opportunities
  • Monitor progress against baselines and develop recovery, mitigation, and corrective action plans
  • Conduct qualitative and quantitative schedule risk assessments, sensitivity analysis, contingency evaluation, and scenario planning
  • Forecast milestones and completion dates and evaluate impacts of scope changes, resource constraints, and procurement delays

    • Project Controls & Performance Management

  • Integrate schedule performance with cost, resource, risk, and change management processes
  • Support Earned Value Management (EVM), including SPI, CPI, and variance reporting
  • Partner with project leadership to evaluate performance and recommend corrective actions
  • Review contractor and subcontractor schedules for accuracy, logic, and contractual alignment
  • Perform schedule impact assessments for change orders, delays, and contract adjustments
  • Maintain baseline and change-control documentation; prepare dashboards, milestone forecasts, and executive reports

    • Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Serve as scheduling subject matter expert to Project Managers, Engineering Leads, and leadership
  • Lead scheduling meetings and communicate performance, risks, and recommendations
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to validate sequencing, durations, dependencies, and resources
  • Mentor scheduling and project controls personnel and improve scheduling methodologies and reporting processes

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 8–10 years of progressively responsible project scheduling experience supporting complex engineering, construction, or capital projects
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Business, or related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience considered
  • Advanced proficiency in Oracle Primavera P6, including development, integration, maintenance, and analysis of complex schedules
  • Demonstrated ownership of Integrated Master Schedules and expertise in CPM scheduling, baselines, resource loading, forecasting, and variance analysis
  • Experience coordinating multiple engineering disciplines, contractors, and project stakeholders
  • Strong understanding of project controls, cost/schedule integration, risk, change management, and performance reporting
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to independently assess risks, recommend corrective actions, and manage competing priorities
  • Valid driver's license
  • Must possess exceptional interpersonal and organizational skills
  • Must be able to work in the US without sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Qualifications

  • Large industrial capital project experience in power generation, utilities, chemical processing, oil and gas, manufacturing, or infrastructure
  • Experience in engineering consulting, EPC, EPCM, or construction management environments
  • Experience across front-end planning, engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning
  • Familiarity with Monte Carlo simulation, schedule risk analysis, and quantitative forecasting
  • Experience with EVM, cost-loaded schedules, and integrated project controls reporting
  • Experience with Deltek Acumen Fuse, Primavera Risk Analysis, or similar schedule quality tools
  • Knowledge of delay analysis, time impact analysis, contract scheduling, and change orders
  • AACE PSP, PMI-SP, PMP, or comparable professional certification
  • Experience mentoring schedulers or establishing scheduling standards

What You’ll Bring to Valdes

  • A proactive approach that anticipates challenges and improves project outcomes
  • Technical scheduling expertise paired with practical business judgment
  • Confidence working with engineers, Project Managers, clients, and leadership
  • Commitment to schedule accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 25% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

The Security Incident Response Team (SIRT) is looking for a Security Engineer who is passionate about solving Twilio’s mission of security and reliability by working across the organization to lead the technical response to security events and incidents across Twilio’s global infrastructure, services and applications by effectively conducting triage, containment, remediation and driving post-incident betterments. You will work within a team that partners with R&D Engineering and R&D Business teams to develop scalable processes and technical solutions.

You will be a valued member of a team of deeply technical Security Engineers to focus on creating bespoke and standard Security response processes, enhancing our capabilities for threat mitigation and incident response, and then automating as much as you possibly can (and more)! You will help us to grow our global, scaled team and program.

Responsibilities

  • Work to improve Twilio’s security and reliability posture by driving identified betterments from security events and incidents.
  • Rapidly acquire new technical skills and knowledge in a fast-paced, highly disruptive industry environment.
  • Own the security incident lifecycle, respond to incidents and participate in on-call rotation and participate in RCAs for security incidents.

  • Provide mentorship, support, and care for the team in a way that enables long-term career development, happiness, and success at scale.

Qualifications

If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

AWS AI/IoT Architect

Redapt Inc. is a pioneering world-class data center infrastructure integrator, technology engineering firm, and cloud services provider. Our teams focus on delivering innovative solutions and services that power our customers' most demanding applications and enable them to extract powerful insights from data that drive true business value.  

We are looking for a Senior AWS IoT Architect to join our Cloud Solutions team. This hands-on role will build and operate secure, multi-tenant IoT platforms on AWS, connecting embedded Linux devices and edge AI hardware to cloud services, and building and deploying generative AI solutions on AWS using Amazon Bedrock.

Our engineers own implementation from device provisioning and on-device software through cloud integration, over-the-air updates, and fleet operations. You will work with cloud, embedded, and hardware teams to deliver reliable solutions and validate them on simulated fleets and physical development boards.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement AWS IoT Core solutions for device onboarding, connectivity, identity, fleet management, and tenant isolation, using per-device X.509 certificates, mutual TLS, fleet provisioning with claim certificates, certificate revocation, and AWS Private CA.
  • Develop AWS IoT Greengrass v2 components, recipes, and deployments for both the Java nucleus and nucleus lite, including on resource-constrained devices, with recovery and state-management behavior suited to the device.
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy AI applications using Amazon Bedrock foundation models and AWS services, including model invocation, inference settings, and integration through AWS SDKs.
  • Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions using Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases or custom retrieval pipelines, including ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector stores and vector search, retrieval quality, grounding in enterprise data, and source citations.
  • Implement AI agents and tool integrations that connect models to enterprise APIs and workflows, with schema validation, controlled execution, error handling, explicit permissions, and human approval where needed.
  • Develop prompts and structured extraction workflows for document understanding, classification, summarization, and business process automation.
  • Build Python services and APIs that integrate AI capabilities with customer applications, databases, and enterprise data sources.
  • Create representative evaluation datasets and automated tests to measure accuracy, grounding, extraction quality, and agent task completion; validate changes before release.
  • Implement layered AI safeguards using Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, IAM, encryption, data access controls, output validation, and protections against prompt injection.
  • Build on-device agents in Python and C/C++ for embedded Linux, build board images with Yocto, integrate systemd services, and cross-compile and package software for Arm and other embedded targets.
  • Implement secure OTA pipelines for applications, models, and supported firmware, with manifests signed using AWS KMS or AWS Signer, verification before installation, staged rollout, health checks, failure recovery, rollback, and anti-rollback controls.
  • Manage static and dynamic thing groups and AWS IoT Jobs, including rollout rates, abort thresholds, retries, and fleet deployment status.
  • Build MQTT telemetry pipelines, topic structures, versioned message schemas, and IoT rules that route data to streaming services and Amazon S3, including buffering, reconnect behavior, and duplicate-message handling.
  • Test at fleet scale with containerized device simulators and real-board lab testing, covering load, connectivity, provisioning, OTA, and recovery; diagnose connectivity, interrupted updates, power-loss recovery, security, and device performance issues.
  • Apply device security practices, including secure boot, debug-port lockdown, least-privilege IoT policies, and hardware-backed keys where the device supports them.

Skills you bring with you

  • Strong Python and software engineering skills, including API development, automated testing, debugging, code review, and maintainable application design.
  • AWS IoT Device Management and AWS IoT Device Defender, including fleet indexing, secure tunneling, and audit checks.
  • Knowledge and experience in developing tenant-aware AWS backend workflows with Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, and DynamoDB partition design for multi-tenant data, with tenant-scoped IAM and IoT policies
  • Practical experience with RAG, embeddings, vector stores, retrieval quality, and grounding responses in enterprise data, including Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases.
  • Experience building agent workflows and tool calling, with schema validation, controlled execution, error handling, and integration with external systems.

Qualifications

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
  • 5+ years of experience in IoT, embedded software, cloud engineering, or related roles, with hands-on responsibility for production systems.
  • Demonstrated delivery of AWS-connected device solutions spanning embedded Linux development, secure device lifecycle management, cloud integration, and production operations.

Additional experience we value

  • Hailo AI processors and accelerators (Hailo-8, Hailo-10H, Hailo-15), including HailoRT, the Dataflow Compiler, and HEF artifacts.
  • Microchip PolarFire SoC, including the VectorBlox SDK, VNNX artifacts, and the PolarFire security features.
  • Hardware-backed device identity and key storage, including TPMs and secure elements such as Microchip ATECC608 or TA100, and approaches for devices with limited hardware key protection.
  • Familiarity with EU Cyber Resilience Act requirements for security updates, vulnerability handling, and software bills of materials (SBOMs).
  • Other IoT platforms, such as Avnet IoTConnect, and migration between IoT platforms.
  • FPGA fundamentals, including secure bitstream packaging, deployment, compatibility validation, and recovery.

Travel required

  • Travel typically 5% or less a year

Equal Employment Opportunity

Redapt is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state, or federal laws. jobs.excerpt: *CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED IN THE UNITED STATES or CANADA** About SafelyYouSafelyYou’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person-centered care across senior living through world-leading AI, industry-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities.
jobs.description:
*CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED IN THE UNITED STATES or CANADA**

About SafelyYou

SafelyYou’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person-centered care across senior living through world-leading AI, industry-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities.

Originating in 2015 as the doctoral research of CEO George Netscher—and inspired by his own family's experience with Alzheimer's disease—SafelyYou was spun out of UC Berkeley’s Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, one of the top five AI research groups in the world. And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. All helping ensure that communities can focus on improved care for residents while still reaching their financial goals.

SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation.

Your Role at SafelyYou
As the SecOps Engineer, you will be a key technical executor and operational anchor within the Security Operations function of the Enterprise Information Technology (EIT) department. This role is designed for a high-level individual contributor who owns the technical execution, systems hardening, and lifecycle management of our internal platforms.

About the Function: This position is being established to drive systemic maturity across our infrastructure. By taking ownership of application onboarding, systems administration, and infrastructure hardening, you will establish a resilient baseline that allows our security function to proactively scale and maintain strong operational rigor.

Our Stack:You'll be operating primarily within an AWS cloud environment and Google Workspace, alongside a modern toolchain spanning infrastructure-as-code for provisioning and change management, identity and access management across enterprise and customer-facing systems, continuous compliance and audit automation, and an observability stack for logging, monitoring, and alerting. This list is illustrative rather than exhaustive — as we scale, there's real opportunity to help evaluate and lead new tooling in growth areas.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Security Project Management: Act as the primary internal technical lead for upcoming third-party security assessments and external vulnerability testing, driving vendor coordination, timeline management, and remediation tracking.

  • SIEM & Log Analysis Architecture:Lead the design, implementation, and ongoing management of our Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) capability. Establish robust log analysis pipelines to ensure comprehensive visibility into environment logs and system telemetry.

  • AI & Automation Integration:Leverage modern AI tools and automation frameworks to streamline incident detection, reduce false positives, and automate routine operational tasks, maximizing the efficiency of our security infrastructure.

  • Threat Intelligence & Dissemination: Contribute to the meaningful development of a proactive threat intelligence review process. Keep the EIT team informed on relevant, emerging security trends and distill this data into actionable guidance for other teams across the company.

  • Secure Provisioning & Hardening: Own the initial setup, secure configuration, and baseline hardening of new infrastructure, applications, and corporate systems across the enterprise.

  • Operational Turnover & Documentation: Develop clean, repeatable documentation and runbooks to seamlessly transition newly hardened systems over to the Support team for day-to-day maintenance, eliminating single points of failure.

  • Operational Systems Engineering:Manage high-level systems work, application onboarding, and lifecycle ownership within EIT to maintain continuous attack surface visibility.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with the IT Support lane to establish seamless handover workflows, share threat intelligence, and collaborate on routine incident response procedures to ensure enterprise-wide operational resilience.

  • DevOps Escalation Triage: Serve as the first point of contact for security-related findings and requests currently escalated ad hoc into DevOps (Shared Services/R&D) tickets. Own initial triage, resolve what can be resolved within SecOps, and only forward to DevOps what genuinely requires their ownership — reducing the unpredictable inbound load this creates for that team today.

Definition of Success

  • Operational Continuity:Success is defined by your ability to streamline systemic workflows, allowing the proactive security function to operate efficiently without operational bottlenecks.

  • Visibility & Telemetry Maturity: Success is measured by the successful deployment of SIEM tooling and the establishment of clear logging standards that reduce our time-to-detection.

  • Seamless Handover: Success is measured by the quality of documentation and training provided to the Support team, ensuring zero friction or security gaps when a system is turned over for routine maintenance.

  • Project Execution: Success is defined by the timely, structured execution of critical compliance and security initiatives, beginning with our upcoming enterprise assessment schedule.

  • DevOps Load Reduction:Success is measured by a reduction in the volume and unpredictability of security-driven tickets landing directly on the DevOps team, with this role established as the first point of triage.

  • The Ideal Candidate:
    Systems-First Security Mindset:    6–8 years of experience in Systems Administration, Systems Engineering, or IT Operations, with a proven track record of shifting your career focus into security operations.

  • SIEM & Telemetry Expertise:Proven experience configuring SIEM platforms, managing log aggregation, and building effective alerting logic.

  • Automation & AI Familiarity:Hands-on experience using automation scripts, tools, or AI-driven capabilities to optimize security operations and workflows.

  • Infrastructure Hardening Expertise:Deep technical knowledge of securing cloud environments, network configurations, identity providers (IdP), and enterprise SaaS ecosystems.

  • Project & Vendor Management:Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical projects, interface with external third-party security vendors, and translate raw vulnerability data into actionable remediation steps.

  • Documentation & Communication Champion:Exceptional ability to break down complex system architectures into clear runbooks, and the communication skills necessary to translate technical threat intel into digestible updates for non-technical company teams.

  • Certifications (Plus):Security-focused certifications (e.g., Security+, CEH, GISF) or Cloud/Systems certifications (AWS, Google) are highly valued.

Why Join Us? You Can Make a Difference!

Salary Range:$115-130K base USD / $110-125K base CDN depending on experience, plus a bonus plan, stock options and benefits.

  • A mission-driven company culture

  • Fully remote

  • Non-accrual PTO

We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce that celebrates diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.description:
Experity is a mission-driven team transforming on-demand healthcare across the U.S., empowering urgent care clinics with industry-leading software that makes care faster, easier, and more patient-focused. Joining us means doing meaningful work that directly improves the healthcare experience for millions—from helping families access care quickly to ensuring clinics run smoothly behind the scenes. If you want to make a real impact alongside innovative, dedicated teammates while contributing to a trusted platform that’s becoming the operating system for on-demand care, Experity is the place to grow your career.


Experity offers the following:

  • Benefits – Comprehensive coverage starts first day of employment and includes Medical, Dental/Orthodontia, and Vision.
  • Ownership - All Team Members are eligible for synthetic ownership in Experity upon one year of employment with real financial rewards when the company is successful!
  • Employee Assistance Program - This robust program includes counseling, legal resolution, financial education, pet adoption assistance, identity theft and fraud resolution, and so much more.
  • Flexibility – Experity is committed to helping team members face the demands of juggling work, family and life-related issues by offering flexible work scheduling to manage your work-life balance.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) - Experity offers a generous PTO plan and increases with milestones to ensure our Team Members have time to recharge, relax, and spend time with loved ones.
  • Career Development – Experity maintains a learning program foundation for the company that allows Team Members to explore their potential and achieve their career goals.
  • Team Building – We bring our Team Members together when we can to strengthen the team, build relationships, and have fun! We even have a family company picnic and a holiday party.
  • Total Compensation - Competitive pay, quarterly bonuses and a 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match to help you save for your future and ensure that you can retire with financial security.

Compensation: Budgeted between $121,400 and $155,000 dependent upon applicable experience.


Remote: Experity offers Team Members the opportunity to work remotely or in an office.


The Salesforce Architect enables Experity's vision by giving the business a quote-to-cash platform it can trust: what Sales quotes is what Implementation activates and what Finance bills, with no manual reconciliation in between.

By designing and building a simpler, scalable Salesforce foundation, this role turns commercial rules into system-enforced controls and lets every revenue team work from one accurate record of what each client bought.


Responsibilities:

  • Assess the current org within the first 90 days and deliver a prioritized simplification plan with measurable targets, retiring legacy automation, fields and objects that no longer earn their place.
  • Turn the existing high-level design into build-ready specifications (object model, external IDs, lifecycle state model) and document key decisions in a lasting decision log.
  • Rebuild CPQ on Experity's newly defined product catalog, including bundles, option constraints, price rules, proration and amendment paths, so a deal cannot be quoted without its required components.
  • Build the entitlement ledger and fulfillment gate that track purchased against consumed capacity and block activation of anything that was never sold, with an approved exception path and audit trail.
  • Own the Salesforce side of the NetSuite integration, including field mapping, payload, error handling and reconciliation, in partnership with the NetSuite administrator and Celigo developer.
  • Build the permission model and system-enforced governance controls (threshold approvals, post-close locking, audit logging), consistent with Experity's HIPAA and least-privilege requirements.
  • Plan and deliver the rebuild end to end, including backlog, CI/CD and releases, data migration, UAT, hypercare and documentation, and report progress and risk to RevOps and Finance leadership.
  • Evaluate long-term quoting platform options, including remaining on Salesforce CPQ or moving to Revenue Cloud Advanced, and design so a future platform change costs as little as possible.
  • Set architecture standards and review the work of anyone building on the platform
  • Other duties as assigned

jobs.description:
About RAW Nutrition

RAW Nutrition and BUM Energy are led by entrepreneur Dr. Domenic Iacovone, six-time Mr. Olympia Champion Chris Bumstead, and renowned bodybuilding coach Matt Jansen. RAW Nutrition has been recognized as the #1 fastest-growing sports nutrition company by Inc. 5000 and recently named Brand of the Year by both GNC and The Vitamin Shoppe.

Whether you’re behind the barbell, behind the camera, or behind the keyboard, you’ll be joining a culture that values grit, growth, and excellence.

Role Summary

We are looking to add a Key Account Manager to be the single owner of our retail business with Target. You will grow sales, distribution, and profit at the account by building the annual plan, selling in new items and promotions, managing the trade budget, and keeping product in stock and on shelf. An existing relationship with, or internal knowledge of, Target's retail business is preferred. This role is remote, but candidates must live in the Minneapolis-St. Paul region.

Key Responsibilities

Account Strategy and Relationship

  • Build the annual business plan for your account, with sales, distribution, share, and profit goals.
  • Build and maintain relationships with the buyers, category managers, and planners at your retailer.
  • Lead regular business reviews and bring category insights that help the retailer grow, not only our brands.

Selling and Distribution

  • Sell in new items, line extensions, and range expansions, including presenting at line reviews and category resets.
  • Win and defend shelf space, secondary placements, end caps, and displays.
  • Manage item setup, cost, and pricing submissions on the retailer's required timelines.

Trade and Promotions

  • Manage the account's trade budget and promotional calendar, tracking spend against plan.
  • Negotiate promotions, price points, and funding that deliver profitable volume.
  • Review promotion results, and shift spend toward events that perform.

Forecasting and Supply

  • Work with Supply Chain and Demand Planning on forecasts, shipment plans, and in-stock levels.
  • Resolve issues quickly, including out-of-stocks, order shortages, deductions, and compliance fines.

Analytics and Reporting

  • Use retailer portal and syndicated data to track sales, velocity, share, in-stock, and promotion lift.
  • Report weekly and monthly performance to leadership, with clear actions on gaps.

Cross-Functional Work

  • Partner with Marketing, Finance, Innovation, Supply Chain, and field sales to align plans and launches.
  • Share retailer feedback internally so the business reacts to what the account needs.

Qualifications

Required

  • 4+ years in CPG sales, account management, or category management, with direct responsibility for a national retail account.
  • Prior experience with the specific retailer you will cover (Target).
  • Experience building account plans, managing a trade budget, and negotiating promotions.
  • Working knowledge of retailer data and tools, such as Retail Link or Partners Online, and syndicated data such as Circana/IRI or Nielsen.
  • Strong Excel and presentation skills, and comfort turning data into a clear recommendation.
  • Clear communication and the confidence to hold productive conversations with buyers.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.

Preferred

  • Experience in food, beverage, or pet, or in a fast-growing brand.
  • Experience with new item launches and line reviews.
  • Willingness to travel to retailer headquarters and to field and trade events.

Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation: The salary range is $150,000-$175,000 with annual bonus; final salary offer based on experience and skillset.
  • Insurance & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, plus savings plans.
  • Retirement Savings: Plan for your future with a 401(k) savings plan featuring a company match.
  • Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need with a flex PTO plan, sick time, and paid holidays.
  • Extra Perks: Monthly stipend to spend on our products and gear and access to the RAW Athletic Clubs in Port St. Lucie and Stuart, FL for our local/hybrid employees.

  • Organize emails and maintain clear folders or labels so payroll correspondence is easy to find.
  • Draft routine acknowledgements and status updates for review before they are sent.

Ticket Tracking & Follow-up

  • Log, track, and update payroll tickets and requests, keeping statuses current.
  • Follow up on open items with the team and relevant stakeholders to support timely completion.
  • Note recurring query types and suggest ideas to improve FAQs and self-service resources.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Assist with Excel-based reports and trackers by preparing, formatting, and refreshing routine reports.
  • Track ticket volumes, categories, and turnaround times, and assist with periodic reporting.
  • Support data entry, clean-up, and validation of payroll-related trackers, as directed by the team.

Process Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Create and maintain quick-reference guides, checklists, FAQs, and process documentation.
  • Keep payroll shared files and knowledge repositories organized and up to date.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize administrative processes.

AI & Process Improvement

  • Explore how AI-powered tools can improve administrative processes, such as drafting, summarizing, and organizing information, and share ideas with the team.
  • Support small process improvement initiatives as required.

Coordination & Administrative Support

  • Maintain trackers and follow up on action items to support timely completion of Payroll activities.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders across Payroll, People Operations, IT, and other teams as required.
  • Provide day-to-day administrative support to the India Payroll team, and keep a training log reviewed regularly with your supervisor.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in any stream (such as B.Com, BBA, BA, or B.Sc); recent graduates are welcome
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Good written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfort working with data, spreadsheets, and reports
  • Basic to intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills
  • Ability to handle employee information with confidentiality and discretion
  • Interest in learning how AI tools can support administrative efficiency
  • Willingness to learn, take guidance and feedback, and follow through on assigned tasks
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams and stakeholders
  • Interest in building a career in Payroll, Human Resources, or Finance Operations
  • No prior payroll experience required; training and ongoing guidance will be provided

How We’ll Support You

You will learn on the job with a supervisor and a team behind you, and every task you take on is reviewed and supported.

  • A named supervisor: the Payroll Manager provides day-to-day guidance and reviews your work.
  • Structured onboarding that introduces India payroll processes, the team’s tools, and ticket handling.
  • On-the-job learning against a training plan, with regular check-ins to review progress and feedback.
  • Practical training in Excel and in using AI tools for administrative work.
  • Clear boundaries: tasks are assigned and reviewed by the team, and you do not independently own payroll activities.
  • Regular touchpoints with the team, so remote working never means working alone.

What You Take Away, and Where Payroll Can Take You

By the end of the programme you will have:

  • A working understanding of the monthly payroll cycle and how a payroll team handles employee queries.
  • Hands-on experience in Excel reporting, ticket tracking, and process documentation, plus practical use of AI tools at work.
  • Experience working with a global, remote-first team and a supervisor who has reviewed your work.
  • A certificate of completion that you can add to your resume.

Payroll experience opens doors to roles that people commonly grow into, such as Payroll Executive or Analyst, Payroll Specialist, Compliance Analyst, HRIS or People Systems Analyst, Compensation and Benefits (Total Rewards) Analyst, and People Analytics or Finance Operations roles. These are illustrative career paths, not commitments.

jobs.title: Director of Growth
jobs.excerpt: *CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED IN THE UNITED STATES**About SafelyYouSafelyYou’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person-centered care across senior living through world-leading AI, industry-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities.
jobs.description:
*CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED IN THE UNITED STATES**

About SafelyYou

SafelyYou’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person-centered care across senior living through world-leading AI, industry-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities.

Originating in 2015 as the doctoral research of CEO George Netscher—and inspired by his own family's experience with Alzheimer's disease—SafelyYou was spun out of UC Berkeley’s Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, one of the top five AI research groups in the world. And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. All helping ensure that communities can focus on improved care for residents while still reaching their financial goals.

SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation.

Your Role at SafelyYou

SafelyYou is hiring a Director of Growth to own the programs that generate and convert pipeline. You will decide where the growth budget goes, run the channels yourself, and make sure every qualified lead reaches sales quickly with enough context to act on it. This is a hands-on leadership role. With one direct report, you will spend much of your time building campaigns, configuring systems, and doing your own analysis to understand and optimize performance, and demonstrate success. We are looking for someone who can connect channel-level decisions to company revenue goals and explain those connections clearly to sales, finance, and the executive team.

Key Responsibilities:

Growth strategy and planning

  • Turn company revenue targets into a growth plan that covers pipeline targets by segment, channel mix, budget allocation, and the assumptions behind each. Revise it quarterly based on results.

  • Own the funnel model from first touch to closed-won. That includes stage conversion benchmarks and the capacity math that tells sales what volume to expect.

  • Manage the growth budget and justify each allocation in terms of pipeline, CAC, and payback.

Channel execution

  • Paid media:Plan, build, and optimize SEM, LinkedIn, trade publication, and retargeting campaigns. You should be able to run these platforms yourself, not only through agencies.

  • Email and nurture:Design drip and lifecycle programs by persona and buying stage. You own segmentation, deliverability, and the triggers that hand leads to sales.

  • Landing pages and conversion optimization: Build and test landing pages. Every experiment should have a stated hypothesis and a sample size large enough to support the decision it informs.

  • Partner marketing: Develop co-marketing programs with technology, channel, and industry partners, with shared goals and tracking.

  • Social media:Own paid social and coordinate organic social strategy with the content team.

  • Direct mail:Add physical touches to ABM and event programs, and track them the same way you track digital channels.

Account-based marketing

  • Define and maintain target account lists and tiers with sales leadership.

  • Run 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many programs tied to account plans.

  • Measure account engagement and progression, not just lead volume.

  • Collaborate closely with Sales to execute.

  • Define and optimize supporting tech stack.

Attribution, analytics, and marketing operations

  • Build an attribution approach that sales and finance trust. Combine system-based attribution with self-reported attribution, and run incrementality tests where volume allows.

  • Maintain reporting on sourced and influenced pipeline, CAC, payback, stage conversion, and channel ROI.

  • Enforce data discipline between marketing automation and Salesforce, including UTM conventions, campaign hierarchy, and lead source integrity.

  • Make sure all marketing data practices follow company privacy and data-handling policies.

Lead flow and sales partnership

  • Own lead scoring, routing, SLAs, and follow-up logic. No qualified lead should sit unworked, and every rep should know what to do with what they receive.

  • Work with SDR leadership on qualification criteria, handoff context, sequence messaging, and feedback loops.

  • Run a regular closed-loop review with sales on lead quality, speed-to-lead, and conversion.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Content: Plan content together against identified funnel gaps, and share performance data that shapes what gets produced next.

  • Product marketing:Turn positioning, messaging, and launches into in-market campaigns, and report back what converts and what doesn't.

  • Sales:Attend pipeline reviews and treat sales as the primary customer of the growth function.

Leadership

Manage and develop one direct report.

Manage agency and contractor relationships, holding them to clear performance standards.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: You have audited the funnel, attribution, and lead flow, and established baseline metrics. You have fixed the most urgent routing and follow-up gaps. Your 12-month growth plan has been approved.

  • By month 6:Sales and finance have adopted your attribution model. Speed-to-lead and MQL-to-SQL conversion have measurably improved. ABM programs are live against Tier 1 accounts.

  • By month 12:Marketing-sourced pipeline is at 100% of target, and you’ve established a reliable, repeatable pipeline from core growth channels rather than relying on isolated spikes.

The Ideal Candidate: Required

  • 8+ years in B2B marketing, including 5+ years in B2B SaaS growth or demand generation with direct ownership of pipeline targets.

  • Quantified pipeline results you can walk through in detail: what you changed, why you changed it, and what happened.

  • Hands-on proficiency in paid search and LinkedIn advertising at meaningful budget levels.

  • Experience building and running ABM programs aimed at multi-stakeholder buying committees with long sales cycles.

  • Experience building nurture programs in a marketing automation platform ([HubSpot / Marketo / Pardot]).

  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce campaigns, reporting, and lead and contact management.

  • Experience designing or rebuilding an attribution model, and a clear understanding of its limits.

  • Statistical literacy sufficient to design A/B tests and interpret results correctly.

  • Experience defining SLAs and handoff processes with SDR and sales teams.

  • Clear, concise writing, and the ability to present performance and recommendations to executives.

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, senior living, or another regulated vertical market.

  • Experience running trade publication and direct mail programs in a niche market with a finite set of target accounts.

  • Experience with intent data or ABM platforms ([6sense / Demandbase / etc.]).

  • SQL or BI tool proficiency.

  • Experience at a company at a similar growth stage ([x -Y ARR]).

How You Work

  • You verify the numbers yourself before you present them.

  • When a metric moves, you find out why before deciding what to do about it.

  • You would rather build the first version of a campaign yourself than write a brief for someone else to build it.

  • You own your results, including the ones that disappoint, and you report them plainly.

  • You are as interested in the mechanics of a lead routing rule as you are in campaign creative.

Tools You'll Likely Use

[Salesforce, marketing automation platform, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, GA4, landing page builder, ABM or intent platform, BI tool. Edit to match your stack.]

Salary Range:$155,000 - $180,000 USD commensurate with experience

Why Join Us? You Can Make a Difference!

SafelyYou offers a competitive compensation package, including but not limited to:

  • A mission-driven company culture

  • Fully remote

  • Competitive salary & benefits, including fully paid employee premiums for Medical, Dental, and Vision

  • 401k Program

  • Monthly Education, Well-being & WFH stipends

  • Non-accrual PTO

  • Growth Potential

  • Company Retreats

  • Medical & Family/Parental Leave

At SafelyYou, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace makes us a more relevant, competitive, and resilient company. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce that celebrates diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

We value all the perspectives our team members bring to the table, and that is why we don’t look for culture fit, but culture add. We want to hear from YOU! We encourage you to apply even if you do not fit 100% of the technical requirements.

jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Sr. Program Manager, Talent Development

About the job

This position is needed to design and deliver high-impact talent development experiences for Twilions globally, driving skills development and enabling professional excellence. Acting as a strategic thought partner and program lead for flagship development initiatives, you will be a key leader in the evaluation, design, and execution of learning content.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Talent Development, you will support the continued growth of Twilions by architecting and optimizing existing programming while evaluating new tools to empower learning teams across the organization. The ideal candidate operates at a strategic level while staying deeply involved in the details of day-to-day development optimization to enhance employee engagement and retention.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Design, lead, and evolve high-visibility talent development programs that drive continuous growth and professional excellence for all Twilions globally.
  • Act as a strategic advisor to HRBPs and senior leaders, establishing an organization-wide mandate to assess capability gaps and deploy targeted learning solutions globally.
  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of flagship development initiatives—from needs assessment and instructional design to global facilitation, impact measurement, and continuous iteration.
  • Define and champion a global learning strategy, collaborating with stakeholders to systematically close critical skill gaps across all business units.
  • Apply expert-level knowledge of modern learning science and AI-driven tools to architect scalable development experiences that resonate across a diverse, global workforce.
  • Maximize global engagement and participation in talent development initiatives through compelling communications, recognition, and robust support for internal career mobility.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or professional certifications in HR/OD preferred.
  • 10+ years in L&D, program design, and facilitation, with at least 7+ years in digital learning innovation.
  • 2+ years of experience specifically applying AI in L&D and 4+ years in instructional design.
  • Proven track record managing vendor partnerships and navigating the learning tech ecosystem.
  • Strong experience with learning analytics, dashboards, and KPIs to drive data-informed decisions.
  • Track record of leading cross-functional pilots from concept to scaled implementation in fast-paced environments.
  • Executive presence with the ability to communicate project plans and development outcomes to cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience managing vendor partnerships in the learning tech ecosystem.
  • Comfort operating independently and making high-impact decisions in ambiguous environments.
  • Willingness to travel for in-person training (approx. one trip per quarter).
  • Proven ability to facilitate training sessions in an engaging, effective, and inclusive manner for diverse global audiences.

Desired:

  • Advanced degree in Education, Learning Sciences, Educational Technology, or related field.
  • Experience influencing adoption of new technologies in large, complex organizations.
  • Exceptional organizational and project management skills
  • ​​Ability to effectively prioritize workload and work in a fast-paced, ever-changing culture

Location

This role will be remote and based in Ontario, British Columbia or Alberta, Canada.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Based on role, employees may also be eligible for additional compensation and benefits, including but not limited to incentive programs, commissions, equity grants, health and wellness benefits, retirement contributions, and paid time off.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

jobs.description:
About RAW Nutrition

RAW Nutrition and BUM Energy are led by entrepreneur Dr. Domenic Iacovone, six-time Mr. Olympia Champion Chris Bumstead, and renowned bodybuilding coach Matt Jansen. RAW Nutrition has been recognized as the #1 fastest-growing sports nutrition company by Inc. 5000 and recently named Brand of the Year by both GNC and The Vitamin Shoppe. 

Since its inception in 2019, every RAW Nutrition product has been made with premium, clean ingredients, free from unnecessary fillers and additives. RAW proudly carries the Informed-Sport certification, a mark of excellence that ensures our products are rigorously tested for prohibited substances and meet the highest standards of quality and safety. We are a team of athletes, creators, and innovators driven by authenticity and the relentless pursuit of being better. Whether you’re behind the barbell, behind the camera, or behind the keyboard, you’ll be joining a culture that values grit, growth, and excellence.

Role Summary

We are looking to add a Key Account Manager to be the single owner of our retail business with Walmart. You will grow sales, distribution, and profit at the account by building the annual plan, selling in new items and promotions, managing the trade budget, and keeping product in stock and on shelf. An existing relationship with, or internal knowledge of, Sam's Club retail business is preferred. This role is remote, but candidates must live in the Bentonville, Arkansas region.

Key Responsibilities

Account Strategy and Relationship

  • Build the annual business plan for your account, with sales, distribution, share, and profit goals.
  • Build and maintain relationships with the buyers, category managers, and planners at your retailer.

jobs.title: Product Engineer (100% Remote)
jobs.excerpt: In most companies a developer gets a ticket, builds it and moves on to the next one.
jobs.description:
In most companies a developer gets a ticket, builds it and moves on to the next one. Someone else talked to the customer, someone else decided what gets built, and whether it actually helped is someone else's question.

We're looking for developers who want to do the whole job: talk to the people who use the software, decide what to build, build it and stay on it until it works for them. That's what we mean by product engineer. We took the term from PostHog, who describe it well in their Product Engineer Handbook.

About us

is software for property management companies in Germany. Inbox, CRM, documents, telephony, video calls, team chat and AI agents in one platform, so property managers can do their daily work in one place. We're a small team based in Worms, Germany, working fully remote. We're self-funded and profitable.

What a product engineer does here

  • You talk to customers. You read the support requests and feedback for your area, look at how customers use it and talk to them directly. Nobody filters it for you.

  • You decide what to build. For your area you decide what comes next, based on what customers need and what matters for the company. You write down why, so the team can follow and give feedback.

  • You ship early. The first version goes to a few customers as soon as it's useful. Then you improve it based on what they say and do.

  • You build all of it. Data model, backend, frontend and UI. The result has to be clean, simple and intuitive to use, not only working.

  • You do support for your area. When something breaks or a customer is stuck, you fix it and tell them it's fixed.

  • You check whether it worked. Your job isn't done when the feature is live. You look at whether customers use it and whether it solved their problem.

  • You automate what you can. When a customer asks a support question, you add the answer to our knowledge base and update our internal agent, so next time it's handled automatically. A lot already runs on its own here, bug fixes are already processed semi-automatically, and we keep automating more.

Examples of what you could work on

  • A customer wants to bring their old file storage into our document management, with their own folder structure and thousands of documents, and it should be fast and AI-supported. You look at how they've organized their files, build the import as a general feature for all customers, set it up for them and test it with their folder structure. Then you check whether the AI assigned every document to the right building, apartment or contact and fix what doesn't fit.

  • A customer reports that the inbox agent gave a tenant a wrong answer. You look at what the agent did, fix the tool or its instructions and let the customer know.

  • Only a few customers build their own agents in the sandbox. You find out why, by looking at the data and talking to customers, make the setup simpler and check whether more customers use it afterwards.

  • Property managers do the same task fifty times a day and it takes too many clicks. You notice it, talk to them about how they work and make it faster.

Our tech stack

Everything is TypeScript, from the database schema to the frontend.

Backend: Convex (database & serverless functions)

Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui

Agents: Vercel AI SDK, LiveKit for voice

You'll build with Claude and get as many AI tokens as you need.

Salary

  • $1500 - $3000 per month before taxes with room for growth and promotion in the months & years ahead

  • Permanent employment contract in your country of residence through our partner Deel (EOR)

Benefits

  • 100% remote work

  • Flexible hours

  • Self-funded & profitable, no VC money to burn through

  • Small team, what you build goes live

  • Quick decisions, no pointless meetings and no layers of approval

Our Health Program

  • Private room in hospital, worldwide coverage

  • Free choice of doctors & specialists, no health check, pre-existing conditions don't matter

  • Partner and kids are covered as well

  • Surgery, cancer care, MRI/CT/PET scans and diagnostics fully covered

  • Dental treatment & surgery covered at 90%

  • $675/year for physio, osteopathy, chiropractic and acupuncture

  • $100 per night in-patient cash benefit, up to 20 nights

  • Prescription drugs, vaccinations, glasses/contacts, home nursing and ambulance covered

Our values

  • Get things done, every day matters

  • Transparency and honesty, especially when it's hard

  • High standards for our own work and each other's

Requirements

Requirements

  • Fluent English

  • More than a year of experience shipping production code

What we look for

  • You care more about whether customers can get their work done than about the perfect implementation.

  • You have a good eye for aesthetics and UI design. You don't just ship whatever the AI generates. You keep working on the interface until it's clean and as simple and intuitive as possible for the people using it.

  • You finish things. A feature that's 80% done doesn't help anyone, so you stay on it until it works well.

  • You have an opinion on what to build and back it up with what customers say and do. When the feedback says otherwise, you change your mind.

  • You take feedback well and give honest feedback yourself.

  • You write clearly. As a remote team we work a lot in writing: issues, short proposals, PR descriptions.

  • You understand the basics of the business: who our customers are, what they pay for and why they stay.

  • You write almost all of your code with AI and understand architecture well enough to judge what it writes.

  • You'd rather automate a task than do it twice.

  • You're a generalist and learn new things quickly.

Nice to have

  • You've built your own product or side project that real people used, or you've worked directly with customers before.

  • Experience designing databases and optimizing query performance & cost

  • Experience building production agents, queues and long-running workflows

This role is not for you if

  • you want someone else to decide what you build and hand you tickets

  • you'd rather not deal with customers or support

  • you want to polish code for weeks before anyone sees it

  • you like to move on to the next idea before the last one really works

How we hire

  1. Intro call

  2. Interview with our founder about your background and the things you've built

  3. Reference call with a previous manager

  4. Offer

For a closer look at what we're building, check out our YouTube channel (it's in German).

The role’s primary focus is the gold layer: semantic models, standardized metrics and the BI and AI experiences built on them. Data & Analytics
