jobs.title: AI Data Analyst - Merchant Acquisition
jobs.excerpt: About UsWe are an established Independent Sales Organization with seven years of experience in the credit-card-processing and merchant-services industry.
jobs.description:
About Us

We are an established Independent Sales Organization with seven years of experience in the credit-card-processing and merchant-services industry. We understand how merchants evaluate processors, why they consider switching, the objections they raise and the factors that ultimately drive conversion.

We are building a proprietary, AI-driven lead-intelligence platform to identify and prioritize merchants most likely to become customers. Our goal is to combine our industry knowledge, current sales-call recordings, operational information and external business data into a system that makes prospecting more scientific, targeted and measurable.

We are seeking an entrepreneurial data-science leader to design and lead this initiative from research and prototype development through prospective testing and commercialization.

The Opportunity

This is not a conventional data-science position in which a completed dataset and predefined model are handed to you. You will help determine what data matters, how it should be collected and labeled, and how qualitative sales intelligence can be transformed into quantitative predictions.

Because our historical labeled data is limited, the initial work will include analyzing current sales-call recordings, interviewing members of our sales organization and identifying the characteristics, circumstances and behaviors associated with merchants who are receptive to switching processors.

The successful candidate will build an initial lead-scoring methodology, test it against real-world sales results and continuously improve it as new outcome data is generated.

This is a founding-level opportunity with salary and equity participation in the resulting platform. The right candidate will have substantial autonomy and the opportunity to create a potentially valuable commercial product within an established operating business.

Responsibilities

  • Develop the overall research, data and AI strategy for a proprietary merchant lead-intelligence platform.
  • Analyze recorded sales conversations using transcription, natural-language processing, large language models and human-reviewed qualitative research.
  • Create a structured framework for extracting relevant information from calls, including merchant characteristics, processing concerns, switching triggers, objections, urgency, decision-maker engagement and sales outcomes.
  • Interview sales representatives and company leadership to capture domain knowledge that may not appear in existing structured data.
  • Design reliable labeling and quality-control procedures for call transcripts and sales outcomes.
  • Identify the signals most likely to predict meaningful sales progression, including statement submissions, follow-up meetings, proposals and signed merchant accounts.
  • Develop an initial transparent, rules-based scoring model suitable for use while labeled data remains limited.
  • Progressively develop statistical and machine-learning models as sufficient prospective data becomes available.
  • Identify and evaluate external data sources that could reveal merchant size, growth, industry, number of locations, technology, ownership changes, hiring activity and other relevant characteristics.
  • Connect internal conversation insights to externally observable business signals that can be used to identify new prospects.
  • Design controlled sales experiments comparing AI-selected leads with leads selected through our existing process.
  • Establish appropriate performance metrics, including conversion lift, precision among top-ranked leads, customer-acquisition cost and expected merchant profitability.
  • Work with sales leadership to integrate lead recommendations into the company’s existing workflow.
  • Build or manage the development of an initial working prototype and subsequent production platform.
  • Develop appropriate documentation, data-governance practices and safeguards for sensitive sales and merchant information.
  • Help evaluate and recruit additional data, engineering or research talent as the project grows.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to business leadership and nontechnical sales personnel.

Required Qualifications

  • Advanced training or equivalent professional experience in data science, applied statistics, machine learning, computer science, econometrics, quantitative marketing or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience with predictive modeling, propensity modeling, lead scoring, customer analytics or another classification/ranking problem.
  • Strong Python and SQL capabilities.
  • Experience working with unstructured text, call transcripts, conversation analytics or natural-language processing.
  • Familiarity with large language models and their use in structured information extraction, classification and research workflows.
  • Ability to work effectively with limited historical data and develop a disciplined data-collection and validation plan.
  • Understanding of experimental design, prospective validation, model evaluation and common problems such as data leakage, overfitting and selection bias.
  • Ability to combine qualitative business research with quantitative analysis.
  • Strong product judgment and an interest in building a commercial platform, not merely producing an academic model or research report.
  • Ability to work independently, define priorities and communicate directly with company leadership.
  • High standards for confidentiality, security and responsible handling of recorded conversations and merchant information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in merchant acquiring, credit-card processing, payments, fintech, banking or financial services.
  • Experience analyzing B2B sales calls or developing sales-intelligence, revenue-operations or customer-acquisition systems.
  • Familiarity with merchant categories, processing statements, pricing structures, interchange, chargebacks, point-of-sale systems and the reasons merchants change processors.
  • Experience with speech-to-text systems, embeddings, retrieval systems and LLM evaluation.
  • Experience combining internal company data with licensed or publicly available external business data.
  • Experience taking a data product from initial research through deployment and ongoing monitoring.
  • Previous startup, founding-team or entrepreneurial experience.
  • Experience managing technical contributors or outside development resources.

Initial Objectives

During the first several months, the successful candidate will be expected to:

  1. Audit the information currently available, including sales-call recordings, CRM information and business outcomes.
  2. Interview company leadership and high-performing sales representatives.
  3. Develop a taxonomy for merchant needs, dissatisfaction, switching triggers, objections and levels of sales progression.
  4. Build and validate an AI-assisted process for transcribing, reviewing and structuring sales conversations.
  5. Produce an initial rules-based lead-scoring system based on qualitative and quantitative evidence.
  6. Recommend external data sources and determine which observable merchant characteristics can support prospect identification.
  7. Design a prospective experiment comparing prioritized leads with the company’s current lead-selection process.
  8. Deliver a working prototype and a roadmap for developing a defensible production platform.

What Success Looks Like

Success will not be measured by producing an impressive demonstration or using the newest AI technology. It will be measured by whether the system consistently helps our sales organization:

  • Reach more qualified decision-makers.
  • Identify merchants with genuine reasons to reconsider their current processor.
  • Obtain more processing statements and substantive follow-up meetings.
  • Generate more proposals from the same amount of sales activity.
  • Improve close rates and merchant profitability.
  • Explain why particular leads are being prioritized.
  • Learn and improve as additional sales outcomes are generated.

Why Join Us

  • Join an established ISO with seven years of merchant-services experience and real industry knowledge.
  • Lead a strategically important initiative with direct access to company decision-makers and sales personnel.
  • Build a proprietary AI and data product around an identifiable commercial need.
  • Receive a competitive salary together with meaningful equity participation.
  • Work remotely with substantial autonomy.
  • Have the opportunity to develop the project into a broader commercial platform.

Salary

Candidates will be paid a competitive salary based on experience. Expected pay range is $70-80,000 per year. This position is full time and eligible for full benefits package as well.

jobs.excerpt: Pay: EUR 85k to 105k per yearCellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia.
jobs.description:
Pay: EUR 85k to 105k per year

Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.

Growing brands rarely break at the idea or the ad. They break in the middle: the order that ships late, the handoff that nobody owned, the warehouse that raised its rates, the process everyone assumes someone else is running. Every new market, product, and launch adds more of that middle, and the brands that keep growing are the ones where someone owns it.

This role owns the middle. You’ll make sure the whole business runs well, from the moment a customer orders to the moment the box arrives. You’ll build the systems, clear the path for the people doing the work, and run the network of fulfillment partners behind every order: knowing who’s out there, keeping the conversations open, and negotiating so our costs keep coming down. The results show up everywhere: faster delivery, lower costs, calmer weeks, and a team that moves quicker.

For a sharp, driven operator who wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: a central role in how a growing brand runs.

A few examples of your responsibilities

Build and maintain our 3PL network. Keep a living map of fulfillment partners across the markets we serve: who they are, where they ship from, what they handle, what they charge, and how they perform. Know who to call before we need them.

Negotiate all the time, not once a year. Stay in constant conversation with new and existing 3PLs, open negotiations, compare offers, and use each one to push rates, terms, and service levels in our favor. Every point you win drops straight into our margin.

Keep the whole business running. Own the day-to-day operations across fulfillment, customer support, vendors, and internal processes, and make sure nothing important falls between teams.

Build the systems that scale. Turn the way we work into clear processes, checklists, and tools that a growing team can follow without being told twice.

Make teams work as one. Connect marketing, creative, support, and logistics so that work moves smoothly from one hand to the next and blockers get cleared fast.

Own our other partners. Manage the relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, and service providers: performance, costs, contracts, and what happens when something goes wrong.

Run on real numbers. Track the operational numbers that matter, such as delivery times, cost per order, error rates, and margins, and turn them into decisions and savings.

Solve problems before they spread. Catch the small issue early, find the real cause, and fix it permanently, so the same thing doesn’t happen twice.

Keep the team in rhythm. Run a steady working rhythm for a remote, international team, including planning, follow-ups, onboarding, and clear ownership of every task.

Prepare for what’s next. Plan the operations behind new launches, new markets, and new brands before they arrive, so growth doesn’t become chaos.

Keep us in good standing. Make sure we follow the rules that apply to what we make and sell in every market, and that records and contracts are in order.

Move fast without cutting corners. Use AI tools to speed up research, reporting, and routine work, then apply your own judgment to make the final calls.

What we look for

A negotiator’s mindset. You’re comfortable asking for more, you do your homework before you sit down, and you can tell a good offer from one that only looks good. You build relationships that survive hard bargaining.

Systems thinking. You see how the pieces of a business connect, you can tell a one-off problem from a broken process, and you fix the process.

Judgment under pressure. You stay steady when things go wrong, make sound calls with incomplete information, and explain them clearly.

Fluency with numbers. You’re comfortable with costs, margins, and operational metrics, and you use them to decide, not just to report. You can compare fulfillment quotes line by line and spot what’s hiding in the fine print.

Leadership without hierarchy. You get things done through clarity, trust, and follow-through in a small, remote team, not through titles.

Ownership. You treat every process and every problem as yours until it’s solved. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.

Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.

Relevant experience. [4+] years running operations for an e-commerce or consumer brand, including sourcing, evaluating, and negotiating with 3PLs or similar partners, and managing remote teams, with results you can show, ideally with the numbers to prove it. Experience in beauty, skincare, or another consumer category is a strong advantage. Excellent English is essential.

What we offer

Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.

Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.

Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.

Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you decide how to use it.

Impact across the business. The systems you build and the deals you win touch every team and every customer. You’ll see the whole company run better because of your work.

A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.

Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.

A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the person who builds how we operate is the person best placed to lead it.

The selection process

We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That’s why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you’ve worked.

Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link:

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you’ll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we’ll invite you to interview with the team.

We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.

If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don’t talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.

Before you apply

Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.

If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Board Chair / Board Director / Trustee
Evergreen Expression of Interest — Rutherford Talent Guild™
Canada · United States · United Kingdom

Effective boards depend on prepared, independent judgement, constructive challenge and collective accountability. Rutherford International welcomes expressions of interest from experienced board professionals and accomplished executives preparing for their first board appointment.

This registration is for consideration for future mandates and Rutherford Talent Guild membership.It is not an advertisement for a current vacancy.

Who should register
  • Independent and non-executive directors of public, private, family-owned and private equity-backed organisations.
  • Board chairs, lead independent directors and committee chairs.
  • Executive directors who can distinguish their governance contribution from their management responsibilities.
  • Trustees and directors of not-for-profit, charitable, pension and other institutional bodies.
  • Experienced executives preparing for a first board appointment who can demonstrate governance-relevant judgement.

Professionals based in Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom may register. Eligibility for a particular appointment depends on the organisation, jurisdiction and requirements of the seat.

The contribution boards rely on

We welcome professionals who can demonstrate the ability to:

  • Prepare thoroughly, evaluate material information and test management’s assumptions.
  • Exercise independent judgement and challenge clearly and constructively.
  • Contribute to oversight of strategy, risk appetite, capital allocation and CEO succession.
  • Understand technology and cybersecurity exposure sufficiently to ask informed questions and recognise when specialist advice is needed.
  • Recognise, disclose and manage conflicts of interest.
  • Support effective collective decisions and follow through on agreed actions.
  • Maintain the distinction between governing an organisation and managing its operations.

Chair and committee leadership experience may also include setting effective agendas, encouraging balanced participation, managing disagreement and maintaining a productive relationship with executive leadership.

Relevant experience and qualities

Relevant experience may come from enterprise leadership, finance, law, risk, technology, operations, professional services, the public sector or previous board and trustee appointments.

What matters is evidence of sound judgement in consequential decisions, an understanding of governance responsibilities, and the availability and independence the role demands. Particular appointments may require specialist expertise, credentials or committee experience.

We value preparation, diligence, practical and strategic judgement, candour delivered with tact, openness to contrary evidence and an honest understanding of the limits of one’s expertise. There is no single ideal board personality.

Registration and consideration

Submit your résumé and a brief professional profile through“I’m interested.”Following initial review, a Rutherford curator may invite you to provide further information and undertake the RutherfordINTEL Assessment.

Assessment findings are interpreted alongside your experience, achievements, professional objectives and the requirements of potential mandates. Progression and membership remain subject to curator review.

If your interest is exclusively in advisory-board service, please indicate this when registering; those mandates are considered separately.

Registration does not guarantee membership, representation, an introduction or a board appointment.

Planned Parenthood North Central States

Minnesota, Iowa, Nebraska, North Dakota, South Dakota

Health Services Training and Development Manager – Remote within IA, MN, NE

Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant work experience, the skills required for the role, internal equity, market competitiveness, and budget considerations. We are committed to ensuring fair and competitive pay for all employees
Schedule: Full-time
Shift times: Monday-Friday, between 8:00AM-4:30PM, some weekends and evenings as necessary.
Location: Remote
Job type: Salaried/Exempt
Travel: Occasional travel for health center visits

Questions? Contact .

We are unable to hire remote employees working from the following states: Alabama, California, Delaware, Indiana, Kentucky, Maryland, Michigan, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, Nevada, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Texas, Washington, or West Virginia.

Job Summary:

The Training and Development Manager provides direct leadership in collaboration with the Vice President of Health Services, the Health Services Leadership team, and Medical Services. Primary responsibilities include: creating a culture of learning and flexibility while providing training and development support where the norm is high-functioning team(s) who provide evidenced-based quality care resulting in exceptional patient experience. Other responsibilities include assisting and supporting the Health Services team with implementation and training of new processes and initiatives, facilitating new staff onboarding, managing the business and administrative functions of the Training Team, serving as a leader across the affiliate, facilitating process improvements to create effective systems, ensuring health center staff are trained and in compliance with regulatory and quality standards, and provides project management in collaboration with partners and stakeholders within the affiliate. The Training and Development Manager is an advocate in implementing the organization mission of “Advancing and protecting sexual and reproductive healthcare for all.” They may perform other related duties as assigned.

Benefits and Perks:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance with equity-based premium tiers
  • Free, virtual primary care for all employees enrolled in a medical plan:
    • NICE HEALTHCARE. A free, virtual primary care for entire household (in-home available for qualifying locations). Services include: 80 free labs, free x-rays, and physical tests, live, virtual physical therapy, 550+ free medications and more!
    • HealthiestYou – Virtual Care for employees outside of NICE Healthcare’s network.
  • Proximal Health – Helps members access high quality, cost-effective, providers for certain services and offers $1,500 tax free benefit when members choose a designated provider for eligible services
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Continued Education Reimbursement: up to $500 per year & 2 paid CEU days.
  • Flex Spending Account
  • Life Insurance
  • Eligibility for Federal Student Loan Forgiveness
  • Paid time off: PTO starting at .05769 accrual rate per hour worked.
  • 8 hours volunteer paid time off annually.
  • 8 paid federal holidays & 2 paid floating holidays.
  • 403(b) retirement fund
  • 8 weeks Paid Parental Leave
  • Pet Insurance
  • Bereavement Leave
  • Earned Extended Leave
  • Free subscription to Headspace App
  • Time off to vote.
  • Employee discounts for electronics, appliances, hotels, gift cards, apparel, cars, fitness memberships, groceries, and at Office Depot, Verizon, AT&T, Dell & more.

We also offer:

  • Start date flexibility.
  • Travel reimbursement.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Post-secondary education in business, human services, public health, nursing related area, or 2-4 years equivalent experience.
  • Two years of experience working in a clinic or outpatient setting
  • Two years supervisory/management experience
  • Experience working with confidential information.
  • Must have the ability and willingness to travel as needed within PPNCS.
  • Must have the ability to work flexible hours that match the health center hours, which may include evenings and weekends.
  • Experience working with high risk or underserved populations (youth, women, minorities, LGBTQ, etc.)

Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities:

  • Leads Training Team in the development of a culture that fosters positive attitudes and trust among staff to achieve health center goals and objectives. Assists all staff in creating and maintaining a team-based health center plan to meet PPNCS goals and objectives. Holds all Training Team accountable to specific measurable customer service standards.
  • Maintains an innovative perspective and approach to implementing an effective training program.
  • Supports and leads team through changes in the business. Serves as a role model to staff and peers in business ethics, integrity, customer service and service recovery.
  • Responsible for the day-to-day management of all Training Team activities.
  • Facilitates the development of written training materials and procedural guides; works with Health Services Leadership to catalog and update written materials in designated Knowledge Based System.
  • Monitors and ensures compliance with our Standard Operating Procedures and Medical Standards and Guidelines, as well as HIPAA, CLIA, OSHA, and any other regulatory agencies.
  • Reinforces a patient-centered service model, by mentoring staff, and setting an example by creating an environment that stresses responsive service delivery. Anticipates customer needs and assures all staff maintain customer service standards. Responds to customers in a courteous and timely manner.
  • Promotes a safe and inclusive environment in the office and in clinic, promoting the appreciation of all forms of diversity.
  • Responsible for hiring, training, and management of Training Team staff. Responsible for ongoing training, staff development and staff meetings, to ensure all staff are aware of all new and revised PPNCS policies and procedures. Monitors and evaluates staff in their daily performance.
  • Takes proactive steps to resolve staff issues quickly and efficiently using ongoing, continual feedback. In consultation with Human Resources, responsible for staff performance plans and disciplinary actions.
  • Analyzes, prepares and submits all necessary reports and ensures that these reports are done accurately and in a timely manner. Submits additional reports as requested and meets deadlines.
  • Develops, implements, and monitors Training Team financial plan. Monitors monthly financial statements against operating plan for fluctuations in revenue and expenses and assures performance goals are met. Is accountable for expenditures including, but not limited to: salaries, travel expenses, office supplies, and training materials.
  • Assists and collaborates with health centers to utilize process improvement tools, implement activities to achieve health center goals and objectives, and evaluates results.
  • Assists staff with maintaining health center flow, performing various staff functions as needed where licensure is not required (e.g. working at the front desk, rounding on patients, stocking and cleaning rooms etc.) at least one shift per month to maintain an understanding of health center flow and stakeholder needs from a training and development perspective.
  • Manages training and orientation schedules in collaboration with the Staffing Team.
  • Works to advance all the medical services provided at PPNCS health centers including family planning, reproductive health services, abortion services, contraceptive services, vasectomies and transgender care.
  • Coordinates and oversees training components of implementation projects and initiatives with Health Services.
  • Functions in the role of Project Manager on initiatives and work groups as assigned through Health Services.

About Us:

At PPNCS, we believe all people deserve the right, the freedom, and the opportunity to follow their personal ambitions and choose their own path toward a healthier, more meaningful life. That’s why we protect, promote, and provide comprehensive and progressive sexual and reproductive health care for generations of people and families with empathy, care, and respect. We are looking for passionate, dedicated staff who are eager to make positive contributions to their community and to the Planned Parenthood mission. To learn more: Our Mission.

When you work for Planned Parenthood, you make a difference in the lives of those we serve by affirming the human right to reproductive health and freedom.

Planned Parenthood is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, sex, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, age, veteran status, marital status, religion, sexual orientation, size, disability, socioeconomic status, or status regarding public assistance. Planned Parenthood is committed to encouraging and promoting diversity as well as providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Planned Parenthood is dedicated to an equitable and inclusive work environment and encourages all interested candidates to apply regardless of initial skill set.

*Any job offer will be contingent upon the results of a background investigation.*

jobs.description:
About Dropzone AI

Dropzone’s mission is to scale cybersecurity beyond human limits, and augment every single human security engineer/analyst with an army of AI security specialists. Humans alone cannot sufficiently protect our digital future, and AI augmentation is the only way for defenders to reclaim the high ground. We are an award winning company disrupting the $200B+ cybersecurity market.

Powered by Gen AI advancements, our technology offloads repetitive day-to-day work and frees human analysts to focus on real threats and higher-value projects. We are venture-backed, and our team has a rare blend of deep experience across cybersecurity, AI/ML, and SaaS product development. Join us if you want to be on the ground floor of using Gen AI to transform cyber defense. Learn more at.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to deepen Dropzone’s integrations. You’ll design and deliver backend capabilities that expand what our product can do and make it easier for customers to connect Dropzone to their security environments.

This is a hands-on engineering role with ownership from design through production. You’ll work closely with product and security experts to build new integrations that improve our investigations and threat hunts. You should enjoy solving complex backend problems, navigating third-party systems, and building software that customers depend on.

What you'll do

  • Integrate with security tools: Develop connectors for platforms such as SIEM, EDR, SOAR, cloud security, identity, and threat intelligence systems.
  • Enable richer investigations: Build services that retrieve security telemetry, enrich alerts with context, and make relevant data available to Dropzone’s investigation workflows.
  • Design for reliability: Handle rate limits, pagination, retries, timeouts, schema changes, and partial failures across third-party APIs.
  • Build security into the platform: Apply strong authentication, authorization, credential management, tenant isolation, and audit logging.
  • Own production outcomes: Write automated tests, instrument services, monitor performance, and troubleshoot issues across APIs and integrations.
  • Collaborate and raise the bar: Partner with product and security experts, contribute to architecture decisions, review code, and mentor fellow engineers.
  • Deliver with sound judgment: Make practical tradeoffs, communicate risks early, and ship improvements that balance speed, maintainability, and customer impact.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience building backend services and production APIs.
  • Strong proficiency in Python.
  • Experience designing REST APIs, including resource modeling, versioning, authentication, authorization, and backward compatibility.
  • Experience integrating with third-party APIs and troubleshooting behavior across distributed systems.
  • A solid understanding of databases, asynchronous processing, queues, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience building automated tests and using logs, metrics, and traces to diagnose production issues.
  • Familiarity with secure development practices and handling sensitive data and credentials.
  • The ability to take an ambiguous problem from requirements through implementation, rollout, and ongoing support.
  • Clear communication, thoughtful technical judgment, and a collaborative approach to engineering.
  • Early-stage startup mindset. You thrive on ambiguity and move with lightspeed execution
  • Being data-driven is part of your DNA.

Work Environment/Travel

We are a 100% remote company where you will work from your home with company-provided equipment to set you up for success. Semi-frequent travel to professional office settings and other events locally and nationally; some overnight travel expected.

Compensation

In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share the base salary range below, exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. If you are hired at Dropzone your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. In addition, all compensation packages include significant above market new hire equity grants because we believe in rewarding long term value creation. If you are hired at Dropzone your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. In addition to those factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that hiring at the maximum of the range would not be typical to allow for future and continued salary growth. We also offer a generous benefits package, including company paid health insurance, 401K Plan with employer match, Self-Managed PTO, parental leave, and more.

The pay range for this role is:
$180,000—$200,000 USD

jobs.excerpt: Parasol Alliance is a technology solutions company exclusively serving the senior living industry.
jobs.description:
Parasol Alliance is a technology solutions company exclusively serving the senior living industry. We provide leadership and comprehensive in-house technology support, helping our clients make smart strategic technology investments and effectively use technology to achieve their business objectives.

Our strategic focus forms the core of Parasol Partnerships. These partnerships lead to increased efficiency, productivity, and profitability for our clients. We make our clients more successful – and we have the data to prove it.

Leadership defines us. We are innovative leaders in everything we do.

The IT/EMR Support Specialist supports Parasol Alliance clients with their enterprise business systems, with a focus on EMRs-providing analysis, implementation, optimization, troubleshooting, and resolution of system-related issues. A business system is defined as any vendor-provided system outside of core IT infrastructure (e.g., email, printers, Active Directory, phones) including electronic medical records, HRIS, payroll, dining, scheduling, financial, CRM, and other client-specific platforms.

The IT/EMR Support Specialist is responsible for analyzing all client systems — determining the best course of action for usage, support, implementation, and improvement. Support is delivered primarily through tickets and projects, and the Business Systems Analyst is expected to work on both in a timely, organized, and client-service-oriented manner.

Position Mission

The IT/EMR Support Specialist position is responsible for the full scope of client business system support across the Business Systems Analysis team, including break/fix ticket resolution, requirements analysis, project implementation and optimization, process improvement recommendations, vendor review and selection support, client communications, training, and collaborative team problem solving. The Business Systems Analyst partners with Project Managers, the BA team, and client stakeholders to deliver high-quality, timely outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Supports clients on break/fix tickets, system implementations, optimizations, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Analyzes client enterprise business systems — including EMR, HRIS, payroll, dining, scheduling, financials, and CRM platforms — and determines the best course of action for support or implementation.
  • Reviews vendors and evaluates solutions to identify the best fit for client needs.
  • Works on both projects and tickets concurrently, maintaining timely progress and proactive communication with Project Managers.
  • Provides training for new hires and mentoring support upon management request.
  • Monitors the BA Slack channel and participates in team meetings and one-on-ones.
  • Contribute to business system analysis, implementation and optimization projects, completing assigned tasks within established timelines and maintaining proactive communication with Project Managers.
  • Maintain clear, timely, and professional communication with clients, team members, and Project Managers — contributing to a collaborative, solution-focused BA team environment.
  • Contribute to the professional development of the BA team and new hires through knowledge sharing, training, and mentoring.
  • Operates in a fully remote work environment.

• Participates in an on-call rotation.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Equivalent combination of relevant technical experience and demonstrated business system analysis skills will be considered.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Relevant certifications in business systems, IT, or related platforms are a plus.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise business systems relevant to the senior living industry, including EMR, HRIS, payroll, dining, scheduling, financial, and CRM platforms.
  • Foundational understanding of systems supported by the Service Desk (email, networking, Active Directory, endpoints) to provide informed cross-functional support.
  • Ability to learn and analyze unfamiliar business systems quickly, identifying the best path forward for clients with limited prior knowledge of the system.
  • Ability to evaluate vendor solutions and make clear, well-reasoned recommendations aligned with client needs and organizational standards.
  • Strong analytical ability — reviews multiple approaches objectively and selects the best solution with clarity and sound judgment.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex business system issues, identify root causes, and implement effective resolutions.
  • Capability to perform requirements analysis, process improvement recommendations, and system optimization assessments for client environments.
  • Comfortable providing constructive criticism — professionally offering well-reasoned alternatives to client system decisions when a better option exists.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with clients in project meetings, phone calls, and written correspondence.
  • Highly self-motivated and self-structured with the ability to manage concurrent tickets and project tasks with minimal oversight.
  • Experience with senior living business systems such as PointClickCare, MatrixCare, Yardi, or similar EMR/HRIS/dining platforms.

Additional Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with CRM, financial, or scheduling platforms in a healthcare or senior living context.
  • Familiarity with requirements analysis frameworks, process mapping, or business analysis methodologies.
  • Experience in a managed services provider (MSP) environment strongly preferred.
  • CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) or equivalent business analysis certification a plus.

Position Expectations

Within the first 30 days:

  • Complete all required onboarding training and review The Culture File with a focus on policies and procedures relevant to the role.
  • Develop a foundational understanding of the ticket process and begin actively addressing assigned tickets with guidance from the team.
  • Begin attending BA team meetings and one-on-ones, contributing positively to team discussions.
  • Demonstrate a positive attitude, professionalism, and strong teamwork in all phone, meeting, and written interactions.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of core Business Systems Analyst functions and the types of business systems supported.

Within the first 60 days:

  • Independently address assigned tickets and project tasks within SLA guidelines and established due dates.
  • Demonstrate proactive communication with Project Managers regarding project task timelines, flagging potential delays before they occur.
  • Maintain consistent updates and documentation in all assigned tickets and project tasks.
  • Begin achieving a resolution SLA of 90% or higher across assigned tickets.
  • Demonstrate increasing system knowledge and the ability to analyze unfamiliar client business systems.

Within the first 90 days:

  • Consistently achieve a resolution SLA of 90% or higher across all assigned tickets.
  • Maintain a minimum of 30 billable hours per applicable period with accurate time records.
  • Demonstrate the ability to independently learn new client systems and processes, identifying and recommending the best approach to optimization or implementation.
  • Demonstrate solid understanding of core role functions and priorities going forward, including ticket management, project task delivery, and client communication standards.
  • Receive consistently positive client and staff feedback regarding professionalism, technical quality, and collaborative approach.

Position Metrics:

The following metrics define ongoing performance expectations for this role:

  • Resolution SLA of 90% or higher maintained on an ongoing quarterly basis.
  • Minimum of 30 billable hours per applicable period with accurate time records.
  • All project tasks addressed within assigned due dates, or proactive communication provided to the Project Manager prior to any missed deadline.
  • Consistent, detailed updates and documentation maintained in all tickets and project tasks.
  • Positive client and internal feedback regarding professionalism, communication, and technical quality.
  • At least one Business Systems Analyst monitoring the BA Slack channel during all business hours.

Company Culture

We are an IT company but believe technology support should be directly related to your business success. Technology for technology’s sake is not what we are about. We intertwine the knowledge economy with technology to transform and interconnect our expertise with your company to expand the decision-making capabilities and ensure productivity and cost effectiveness.

Our Values:

• Expertise

• Collaboration

• Empathy

• Integrity

If you want to work for a values driven, high performance company and to experience an exciting opportunity to help grow a company then this is the job for you. We are looking for our team members to take ownership and pride in their work, and to provide input and guidance into not only the clients of Parasol but the growth of Parasol itself. We are a virtual company that offers work from home, responsible time off and bonus opportunities.

jobs.excerpt: Technical Director, Applied AIGame Development, R&D & Creative Technology | RemotePosition OverviewBeffio is looking for an experienced Technical Director, Applied AI to define how emerging AI technology can be practically applied across our game development, creative, and technical production workflows.
jobs.description:
Technical Director, Applied AI

Game Development, R&D & Creative Technology | Remote

Position Overview

Beffio is looking for an experienced Technical Director, Applied AI to define how emerging AI technology can be practically applied across our game development, creative, and technical production workflows.

This is a highly hands-on R&D role sitting between Engineering, Technical Art, Creative Technology, and AI.

We are looking for someone with a strong technical foundation that existed before the current generative AI wave. You may come from software engineering, Technical Art, tools development, procedural systems, creative technology, graphics, or another deeply technical field.

AI should amplify what you were already capable of building, not be the starting point of your technical experience.

Your role will be to continuously explore new AI capabilities, identify where they can create meaningful value for Beffio, build working prototypes, validate them in real production scenarios, and turn successful experiments into workflows and tools that can be used by the wider team.

Key Responsibilities

Applied AI R&D

  • Research and evaluate emerging AI models, coding agents, frameworks, workflows, and development tools.

  • Identify practical opportunities for AI across game development, art production, engineering, and internal workflows.

  • Build prototypes and proof-of-concepts to quickly validate ideas.

  • Separate genuinely useful technology from short-lived trends and hype.

  • Turn successful experiments into robust production solutions.

Game Development & Production Integration

  • Explore and implement AI-assisted workflows across Unity3D, Unreal Engine, Houdini, Blender, and other production tools.

  • Build AI-powered tools, plugins, integrations, agents, and automation.

  • Work with Engineering, Technical Art, VFX, Animation, Environment, Character, and Production teams to identify high-value use cases.

  • Integrate AI into existing pipelines rather than treating it as a separate experimental layer.

  • Look for opportunities to improve speed, quality, iteration, automation, and creative capability.

Agentic Development & Automation

  • Explore modern agentic development workflows using tools such as coding agents, custom agents, MCP-based integrations, and multi-agent systems.

  • Develop workflows that allow developers and artists to automate repetitive or technically complex tasks.

  • Build internal tools that connect AI systems with existing production environments.

  • Experiment with new approaches to software development, technical art, validation, documentation, review, and production automation.

AI Enablement

  • Establish practical standards and best practices for using AI within Beffio.

  • Document successful workflows so they can be adopted by others.

  • Run internal workshops and demonstrations for different disciplines.

  • Help team members move beyond basic prompting toward building their own tools, agents, and AI-assisted workflows.

  • Communicate complex technology in a clear and practical way.

Requirements

  • Strong senior-level technical experience in software engineering, Technical Art, tools development, creative technology, procedural systems, game development, or a comparable field.

  • A proven track record of building real tools, systems, applications, plugins, pipelines, or production technology.

  • Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Python, C#, C++, TypeScript, or similar.

  • Strong practical understanding of modern AI models, APIs, coding agents, automation, and AI-assisted development.

  • Ability to rapidly prototype ideas and independently evaluate their technical and production value.

  • Experience taking R&D from early experimentation through to a production-ready solution.

  • Strong understanding of real-time production and game development workflows.

  • Experience with tools such as Unity, Unreal Engine, Houdini, Blender, Maya, or comparable environments.

  • Ability to work directly with both engineers and artists.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills.

  • Ability to teach complex technical concepts in a simple and practical way.

  • High degree of curiosity, ownership, and independent problem solving.

  • Fluent English.

Nice to Have

  • Professional game development experience.

  • Technical Art or creative technology background.

  • Experience with procedural content generation.

  • Houdini and procedural workflows.

  • Experience with graphics, rendering, shaders, or real-time systems.

  • Experience building custom AI agents or multi-agent workflows.

  • Experience with LLM APIs, multimodal models, local models, MCP, or similar integration technologies.

  • Experience developing internal production or developer tools.

  • Experience with AI-assisted 2D, 3D, animation, VFX, video, or content-production workflows.

  • Open-source projects, plugins, tools, or personal technical projects.

  • Experience introducing new technology or workflows into an existing production team.

What We Would Like to See

For this role, we care strongly about proof of work.

We would particularly like to understand two things:

What did you build before the current AI wave?

Show us examples of systems, games, tools, plugins, pipelines, applications, procedural solutions, or other technical work that demonstrates your underlying capabilities.

What are you building with AI today?

Show us work where AI is part of a larger technical solution rather than simply the use of an existing AI interface.

This could include:

  • AI agents

  • internal tools

  • development workflows

  • automation

  • integrations

  • plugins

  • production pipelines

  • game-development experiments

  • multimodal systems

  • creative technology prototypes

For your strongest examples, we would like to understand:

What problem were you solving?What did you build?How did it work?Which technologies did you use?What did you learn or change during development?What was the final impact?

We value demonstrated technical problem solving and working prototypes more than familiarity with a long list of AI products.

Ownership

We are looking for someone who can:

  • Go from research → prototype → validation → integration → adoption.

  • Independently investigate technologies where established best practices may not yet exist.

  • Make pragmatic decisions about which AI technologies are genuinely useful for production.

  • Build things, not only recommend them.

  • Work equally comfortably with engineers, Technical Artists, artists, and leadership.

  • Establish workflows and standards that make the wider team more capable.

  • Help shape Beffio's long-term approach to applied AI as the role develops.

What We Offer

  • Significant ownership over how AI is explored and implemented within Beffio.

  • Direct collaboration with our CTO, Creative Director, Engineers, Technical Artists, Artists, and production teams.

  • The opportunity to experiment with rapidly evolving technology and apply it to real game-production challenges.

  • Freedom to prototype new approaches and turn successful ideas into production systems.

  • A role combining R&D, engineering, game development, and creative technology.

  • The opportunity to influence workflows across multiple disciplines.

  • A fully remote international working environment.

  • Flexible contract options depending on location.

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and contract structure.

  • Annual Beffio team retreats.

  • The opportunity to help shape and potentially grow Beffio's future AI capability.

jobs.excerpt: Pay: PHP 130k to 170kCellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia.
jobs.description:
Pay: PHP 130k to 170k

Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We're a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.

In skincare, the ad is where the relationship starts. A stranger scrolling past on a phone gives us a second or two, and in that time the ad has to earn a look, a click, and the start of trust. Done well, it brings in customers who stay and reorder. Done badly, it burns budget on people who were never going to buy.

This role runs that moment. You'll own our Meta advertising: what we test, what we scale, where the budget goes, and how we know it's working. It's work where decisions turn into numbers within days, and every number tells you something.

For a sharp, driven media buyer who wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: ownership of a growing brand's biggest growth channel.

A few examples of your responsibilities

Own the Meta ad account. Plan, launch, and manage campaigns across our markets. You'll decide the structure, the audiences, the budgets, and when to scale or cut.

Build a testing engine. Run a steady stream of tests on creative, hooks, angles, audiences, and offers. Know what you're testing, why, and what you'll do with the result.

Scale what works. Find the winners, push spend up without breaking performance, and keep acquisition profitable as budgets grow.

Work hand in hand with the creative team. Turn what the data shows into clear briefs for our writers and video editors, so the next round of ads is sharper than the last.

Make the numbers trustworthy. Keep tracking and attribution clean, so every decision rests on data you can believe. Report on cost per acquisition, return on ad spend, and customer quality.

Take every market seriously. Adapt campaigns to the tastes, budgets, and buying habits of customers in Europe, the US, Canada, Australia, and beyond.

Keep the account healthy. Know Meta's ad policies, especially for skincare claims, and keep our campaigns compliant and our account in good standing.

Move fast without cutting corners. Use AI tools to speed up analysis, research, and reporting, then apply your own judgment to make the final calls.

What we look for

Analytical mind. You read the numbers and know what they mean. You can tell a real signal from noise, and explain why a campaign is working or not.

Hands-on skill. You've managed Meta ad accounts with real budgets and understand how structure, creative, and audience work together.

Creative instinct. You can tell a strong ad from a weak one before the data does, and you can explain why in words a writer or editor can use.

Ownership. You treat every campaign as yours until it performs. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.

Calm under pressure. You stay steady when performance dips, find the cause, and act without panicking or hiding the problem.

Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.

Relevant experience. [2+] years running Meta ads for e-commerce or consumer brands, with results you can show, ideally with the numbers to prove it. Experience in beauty, skincare, or another consumer category is a strong advantage. Excellent written English is essential.

What we offer

Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.

Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.

Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.

Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you decide how to use it.

Impact you can see. Campaigns go live fast here, and results come back quickly. You'll watch your decisions move the numbers.

A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.

Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.

A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the buyer who runs our growth channel is the buyer best placed to lead it.

The selection process

We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That's why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you've worked.

Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link:

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you'll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we'll invite you to interview with the team.

We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.

If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don't talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.

Before you apply

Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.

If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.excerpt: About Rivian Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever.
jobs.description:
About Rivian Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract. As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations. Role Summary The Senior Cost Engineer will play a pivotal role in the Rivian Cost Engineering organization, as a part of our team of Cost Engineers, located remotely in Mexico. The role will be responsible for completion of cost models that accurately analyze the costs associated with components across Rivian vehicles, and will require up to 25% travel. Your expertise in cost estimation will be crucial in guiding our design and procurement, ensuring competitiveness in the market, and maintaining our commitment to providing high-quality products. El/la ingeniero/a de costos sénior desempeñará un papel fundamental en la organización Cost Engineering de Rivian, como parte de nuestro equipo de Ingenieros de Costos, ubicado de forma remota en México. Esta persona tendrá la responsabilidad de realizar modelos de costos que analicen con precisión los costos asociados a los componentes de todos los vehículos Rivian, y requerirá hasta un 25% de desplazamientos. Su experiencia en la estimación de costos será fundamental para orientar nuestros diseños y adquisiciones, garantizando así la competitividad en el mercado y manteniendo nuestro compromiso de ofrecer productos de alta calidad. Responsibilities Cost Engineering: Provide guidance to the design requirements or design engineer for proposed new or modified designs to achieve required function at minimum or target cost. Develop should cost models and projections for multiple vehicle commodities specialized in mechanical content – High Pressure Die Casting, Forging, Machining, Stampings, Injection Molding. Utilize information ranging from written assumptions, sample parts, CAD models and engineering drawings. Gather details and compile data to estimate all production costs considering raw materials, labor, and tooling for estimations or should cost models. Interface with manufacturing plants and suppliers to ensure most economical tooling, processing and operations that will contribute to profitable production. Support Rivian Procurement in analysis and review of supplier cost breakdowns to drive cost reduction opportunities through negotiations with suppliers. Mentor Rivian Procurement team members based on manufacturing and process cost expertise. Perform teardown of complex automotive components to analyze parts and develop a Bill of Material (BoM) when detailed engineering CAD is not available. Create cost estimates using physical parts and in-depth process knowledge. Perform Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VAVE) activities to generate cost reduction ideas through identification of process and product efficiencies that will reduce overall costs. Work with all stakeholders to support cost reduction targets. Support competitive vehicle benchmarking to provide input for future model development and target costs. Project Management: Assume ownership of projects; plan milestones and identify potential risks to ensure timely delivery of cost models within agreed completion dates. Proactively manage task completion and regularly update cross-functional teams on project status, timing, resource allocation, challenges, and the likelihood of on-time, high-quality delivery. Ingeniería de costos: Orientar a los responsables de los requisitos de diseño o a los ingenieros de diseño sobre diseños nuevos o modificados propuestos, a fin de lograr la función requerida a un costo mínimo u objetivo. Desarrollar modelos y proyecciones de costos (should-cost) para múltiples productos automovilísticos especializados en contenido mecánico: fundición a alta presión, forja, mecanizado, estampación y moldeo por inyección. Aprovechar información diversa: hipótesis escritas, piezas de muestra, modelos de CAD y planos de ingeniería. Recopilar detalles y reunir datos para estimar todos los costos de producción, tomando en cuenta las materias primas, la mano de obra y las herramientas a la hora de realizar estimaciones o modelos de costos (should-cost). Interactuar con las plantas de manufactura y los proveedores para garantizar que las herramientas, procesos y operaciones sean lo más económicos posible, a fin de contribuir a una producción rentable. Apoyar a Procurement de Rivian en el análisis y la revisión de los desgloses de costos de los proveedores para impulsar oportunidades de reducción de costos mediante negociaciones con los mismos. Mentorear a los miembros del equipo de Procurement de Rivian apoyándose en su experiencia en costos de manufactura y procesos. Realizar el desmontaje de componentes automovilísticos complejos para analizar las piezas y desarrollar una lista de materiales (BoM) cuando no se disponga de un CAD de ingeniería detallado. Crear estimaciones de costos utilizando piezas físicas y un profundo conocimiento del proceso. Realizar actividades de análisis de valor / ingeniería de valor (VAVE) para generar ideas de reducción de costos mediante la identificación de eficiencias de procesos y productos que reduzcan los costos globales. Trabajar con todas las partes interesadas para apoyar los objetivos de reducción de costos. Apoyar la evaluación comparativa competitiva de vehículos para proporcionar información de cara al futuro desarrollo de modelos y objetivos de costos. Gestión de proyectos: Asumir la responsabilidad de los proyectos; planear hitos e identificar riesgos potenciales para garantizar la entrega puntual de los modelos de costos dentro de las fechas de finalización acordadas. Gestionar de forma proactiva la finalización de tareas e informar periódicamente a equipos multifuncionales sobre el estado del proyecto, los plazos, la dotación de recursos, los desafíos y la probabilidad de una entrega a tiempo y de alta calidad. Qualifications Required: Candidates must be permanently based in Mexico and possess valid Mexican work authorization at the time of application. Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or Finance. Minimum of 3 years of automotive or manufacturing related experience at an OEM or Tier 1 Manufacturer. Proficiency in navigating CAD models in CATIA or similar software. Ability to interpret and understand design and manufacturing drawings. Practical knowledge of Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VAVE) techniques and a strong understanding of financial principles. Capability to independently create a Bill of Materials (BoM) for a given commodity or design and allocate costs. Entrepreneurial, ambitious, independent, detail-oriented, structured thinker, goal-oriented, flexible, and resilient—exhibiting the qualities of a start-up personality. Collaborative team member, ensuring effective communication among colleagues, and providing regular contributions to meetings and briefings. Video Editor – Corporate & Short-Form Content (Remote)

Work From Home | Full-Time | AU Hours

About the Role

We are hiring a high-end Video Editor to produce premium, performance-driven content for Australian clients across real estate, government, and commercial sectors.

This is a top-tier role — not basic social edits.
You will craft polished, brand-aligned, high-impact video content that reflects corporate standards while still driving engagement across modern platforms.

You must understand the balance between:

Professional corporate storytelling
High-performing short-form content

Key Responsibilities

  • Edit corporate and short-form videos for:
    • Real estate (listings, project showcases, agent branding)
    • Government & infrastructure communications
    • Commercial and corporate marketing content
  • Produce clean, premium, brand-consistent edits (not over-edited / gimmicky)
  • Apply:
    • Precise cuts and pacing
    • Clean transitions and motion
    • Professional captions and subtitles
    • Subtle sound design and audio balancing
  • Repurpose:
    • Long-form content into high-performing short clips
    • Corporate footage into engaging digital assets
  • Implement:
    • Strong hooks (first 1–3 seconds)
    • Retention-focused pacing without compromising brand tone
  • Follow brand guidelines strictly across multiple clients
  • Manage feedback and revisions with speed and accuracy

Requirements

  • 4–7+ years video editing experience (corporate/commercial essential)
  • Strong portfolio across:
    • Corporate video
    • Real estate content
    • Commercial/brand work
  • Advanced proficiency in:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro (essential)
    • After Effects (strong advantage)
    • DaVinci Resolve / Final Cut (optional)
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Corporate storytelling
    • Visual hierarchy
    • Branding consistency
    • Audience engagement vs professionalism
  • Experience working with Australian or Western clients (preferred)
  • High attention to detail — pixel-perfect output expected

What We're Looking For

  • Someone who can deliver agency-level output consistently
  • Strong sense of timing, polish, and visual quality
  • Ability to elevate raw footage into premium content
  • Understands when to:
    • Keep it clean (corporate)
    • Push engagement (digital content)
  • Reliable, fast, and takes ownership

Bonus Skills

  • Motion graphics (clean corporate style – not flashy)
  • Real estate video editing experience
  • Experience with government or infrastructure content
  • Basic color grading and audio mastering
  • Storyboarding or scripting understanding

Output Expectations

  • 5–12 high-quality videos per week
  • Fast turnaround without sacrificing quality
  • Clean file structure and delivery standards

Why Join Us

  • Work with high-value Australian clients
  • Stable, full-time remote role
  • Performance-driven environment
  • Opportunity to work on premium commercial and government-grade content

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

VP Sales - Europe

In this critical sales role, you will have a successful track record and relevant experience selling hardware/software to CPOs, fleet operators and other enterprise customers. If you have experience selling EV charging solutions, particularly DC fast charging and depot charging, and existing relationships with German charging networks and fleet operators, that would be a major advantage.

You will be developing your territory directly and with our channel partners, installers and vehicle OEMs. You must be able to thrive in a fast paced sales environment, be creative, independent, focused and an excellent problem solver.

Le spécialiste en fraude du BMO Virtual Connect est responsable de répondre aux appels entrants des clients liés à des activités frauduleuses.

Il ou elle mène des enquêtes afin d’identifier, d’évaluer, de statuer sur les cas et de signaler toute activité indiquant une exposition à des crimes financiers. Il ou elle veille à ce que les menaces potentielles et les enquêtes soient évaluées, documentées, gérées et escaladées conformément aux procédures opérationnelles normalisées. La personne fournit une expertise et une supervision en matière de risques criminels en adoptant une approche rigoureuse fondée sur le renseignement pour la détection et l’analyse des activités et des événements, conformément aux cadres et aux normes de gestion des risques criminels, afin d’assurer la conformité et de soutenir l’analyse des tendances, la production d’informations et la génération d’insights.

Responsabilités

  • Fournir des commentaires et élaborer des recommandations visant à améliorer les processus et le service à la clientèle.
  • Se tenir informé(e) des tendances en matière de risques liés aux crimes financiers, ainsi que des réglementations et normes de conformité applicables.
  • Surveiller et analyser les renseignements provenant de systèmes de détection, d’outils, de rapports ou de vérifications manuelles afin d’évaluer, d’enquêter et de déterminer les mesures à prendre.
  • Appuyer la collecte de preuves et d’informations destinées à diverses fins, notamment les rapports d’incident, la prévention des pertes, les litiges, les poursuites criminelles, les rapports de gestion, les statistiques et l’amélioration des processus.
  • Documenter les mesures prises et les renseignements recueillis tout au long de l’enquête afin de constituer et de maintenir les dossiers de comptes ou de cas.
  • Développer et maintenir une compréhension approfondie des processus, cadres et techniques de gestion des crimes financiers.
  • Recueillir et mettre en forme les données pour produire des rapports et des tableaux de bord, tant réguliers qu’occasionnels.
  • Analyser les données et les informations afin de fournir des recommandations et des perspectives pertinentes.
  • Exécuter des tâches courantes telles que les demandes de service, les transactions et les requêtes, conformément aux ententes sur les niveaux de service (SLA).

  • Réaliser des tâches complexes et variées dans le respect des règles et des limites établies, y compris la gestion d’escalades provenant d’autres employés.
  • Analyser les problèmes et déterminer les prochaines étapes appropriées.
  • Assumer d’autres responsabilités ou mandats au besoin.

Qualifications

  • Une connaissance des exigences réglementaires et des risques liés aux crimes financiers constitue un atout.
  • Une connaissance des produits, services, processus et de l’organisation bancaire constitue un atout.
  • Connaissances spécialisées.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite.
  • Bonnes aptitudes organisationnelles.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

About the role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer, you will take backend features and improvements from clarifying the problem through shipping them and following up in production. You will work within a product area, partnering with Product Management, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Security to deliver predictably and contribute to the quality, security, performance, and maintainability of shared backend code and services. You will be trusted to work with minimal guidance, to know when to seek help, and to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment — with other tenured engineers alongside you to review your work, think through hard problems with you, and help you grow.

Why you’ll love this role

  • Ownership: You'll take features from requirements through delivery and follow-up; your code will run on a platform used by millions of users.
  • Learning and Growth : You’ll work alongside your engineering team, who treat code review and design review as a learning loop rather than a gate — one of the fastest ways to grow your engineering judgment.
  • Innovative Culture: You’ll use AI as a genuine part of daily engineering work, developing the judgment to know when to trust it and when not to.
  • Autonomy: You’ll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.
  • User-Centric Collaboration: You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, so you understand why you’re building something, not just what.

What you’ll do

  • Own and Ship Features: Design, implement, test, and ship backend features and improvements with minimal guidance, working in Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern languages.
  • Build for Production: Write maintainable, secure, observable, and performant code. Design and maintain APIs, background jobs, integrations, and bounded service functionality, and work with data models, migrations, indexes, and query behavior.
  • Test and Review: Add and improve automated coverage — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end where appropriate — and review others’ code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risk.
  • Operate What You Build: Investigate build, test, deployment, and runtime failures at the feature boundary, identify technical debt and propose practical improvements, and take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
  • Leverage AI: Use AI productively in daily work, validate what it produces, and understand where its limitations matter.

What you’ll bring

  • Backend Fundamentals: Professional experience building and shipping production backend applications, with strong programming, API, database, testing, debugging, and performance fundamentals.
  • Adaptability: Experience with Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern backend language. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language.
  • Feature Ownership: The ability to take a feature from clarification through delivery and follow-up, working independently while seeking input at the right time.
  • Practical Judgment: Sound instincts about security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational risk, plus an understanding of modular backend boundaries and the consequences of coupling.
  • Clear Communication: Strong written communication and effective collaboration in a remote, asynchronous environment.
  • AI Fluency: Practical experience with AI coding tools, including the ability to review and correct what they generate.

Helpful experience

  • Production Go services, APIs, concurrency, profiling, or gRPC.
  • Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD, or cloud deployment.
  • Rust, particularly for systems, security, performance, or platform work.
  • PostgreSQL, schema evolution, caching, queues, messaging, or event-driven workflows.
  • Observability using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Contributing to a modular monolith, bounded context, shared component, or independently operated service.
