jobs.description:
About Nexcess

Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

Overview

The New Business Account Executive is a hunter. This role exists for one reason: to win net-new small and mid-sized business (SMB) customers for our cloud, backup, and disaster recovery (DR) services. You will target SMB organizations that need reliable infrastructure, data protection, and business continuity but don't have the in-house resources to run it themselves. You will build your own pipeline from scratch, using LinkedIn, outbound calls and email, events, referrals, and partner relationships to open doors with companies that do not do business with us today. You will have support from our Business Development Representative (BDR) team, but you are expected to drive your own pipeline. You own the strategy, the pipeline, and the number. You don't sell and disappear. You stay available to your new customers through onboarding to support what you sold and the commitments you made. Once the customer is live, the account moves to the install base Account Management team so you can get back to hunting. This role does not manage existing accounts, renewals, or expansion sales.

The compensation range for this position is between $200k-$250k OTE

Responsibilities

New Logo Prospecting and Pipeline Generation

  • Build and work a target account list of SMB organizations that need cloud, backup, and DR services and are not current customers.
  • Self-source opportunities through LinkedIn (including Sales Navigator), cold calling, email, video, events, and referrals.
  • Build a credible presence on LinkedIn with target buyers by posting, engaging, and starting conversations with decision makers.
  • Run multi-touch, multi-threaded outbound campaigns to reach SMB decision makers, including owners, IT managers, and operations and finance leaders.
  • Generate the majority of your pipeline from your own outbound activity rather than relying on inbound leads.

Working with the BDR Team

  • Work alongside the BDR team on target accounts, messaging, and outreach to add to the pipeline you build yourself.
  • Share clear qualification criteria and what a good first meeting looks like.
  • Run the meetings the BDR team books and give feedback on meeting quality.
  • Treat BDR support as an addition to your own prospecting, not a replacement for it.

Discovery, Solution Selling, and Closing

  • Lead discovery to understand each prospect's current infrastructure, backup and recovery approach, business continuity risks, decision process, budget, and timeline.
  • Partner with Solution Engineers to scope requirements and design solutions across cloud, backup, disaster recovery, and managed infrastructure.
  • Build business cases that show the cost of downtime and data loss, and the value of our services versus the prospect's current provider, a hyperscaler, or a do-it-yourself approach.
  • Present proposals, handle objections, negotiate terms, and close.
  • Win competitive displacements by knowing competitor offerings, pricing, and weaknesses.

Deal Management

  • Maintain accurate activity, opportunity, and forecast records in the customer relationship management system.
  • Deliver a reliable weekly forecast and communicate deal progress, risks, and support needs.
  • Coordinate Procurement, Legal, Finance, and technical teams to move deals to signature.

Customer Support Through Go-Live

  • Stay available to new customers during onboarding as a point of support for what was sold and the commitments made in the sales process.
  • Work with the Onboarding, Solution Engineering, and Support teams when questions or gaps come up about scope or commitments.
  • Hand the customer off to the install base Account Management team at go-live, sharing what was sold, the commitments made, key contacts, and customer goals.
  • Return focus to new logo acquisition once the customer is live. Expansion, renewals, and ongoing account growth are owned by Account Management.

Additional Expectations

  • Demonstrates and promotes the company's Impact Behaviors in all interactions and decision-making.
    • Design
    • Ownership
    • First Team
    • Performance
  • Maintains a professional, collaborative, and client-focused approach while supporting team and organizational objectives.
  • Performs other duties, responsibilities, and special projects as assigned to meet business needs.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in a quota-carrying new business (hunter) closing role, with a track record of meeting or exceeding net-new logo targets.
  • Proven ability to self-source pipeline through outbound prospecting. You can show how you built a pipeline from zero.
  • Strong command of LinkedIn and LinkedIn Sales Navigator for prospecting, account research, and social selling.
  • B2B sales experience selling cloud, backup, disaster recovery, or managed infrastructure services. Web hosting sales experience will also be considered.
  • Experience selling to SMB organizations and understanding how small and mid-sized businesses buy infrastructure and data protection services.
  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, business continuity, and related concepts such as RPO and RTO.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value for technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable with cold outreach, rejection, and high activity. Motivated by winning new customers, not managing existing ones.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and organization skills, with experience using Salesforce (or similar CRM) and sales engagement tools such as Outreach, Salesloft, or Apollo.
  • Ability to participate in limited travel to prospect sites and industry events.

Preferred

  • Experience working alongside a BDR/SDR team while still self-sourcing the majority of pipeline.
  • Track record of competitive displacements against other managed service providers, cloud providers, or hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Background at a managed service provider (MSP), managed cloud provider, or data protection vendor.
  • Experience selling backup and DR solutions built on platforms such as Veeam, Acronis, or Zerto.
  • An existing professional network within the SMB IT and managed services market.
  • Experience using AI-assisted research and prospecting tools to increase outbound efficiency.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Net-new logo bookings (new MRR/ARR) against quota.
  • Number of new logos closed.
  • Self-sourced pipeline created, measured by value and number of qualified opportunities.

  • Forecast accuracy and CRM hygiene.

General Information

Location
Work at Home

14257

Description & requirements

Description
Nous sommes passionnés par l’expérience client (CX) et nous mettons autant de passion à prendre soin de nos clients que leurs fans en mettent à les soutenir. C’est pourquoi les marques les plus appréciées au monde nous font confiance. Nous contribuons au succès de fintechs innovantes, de grandes références technologiques et de nombreuses autres marques de renommée internationale.
Aujourd’hui, nous recherchons des Conseiller·ère·s clientèle francophones (H/F/X) pour accompagner les clients d’une marque internationale spécialisée dans les chaussures et la mode, avec une date de début de formation prévue le 11 novembre 2026.
Vous aimez aider les autres, résoudre des problèmes et offrir une expérience client de qualité ? Alors, nous serions ravis de vous accueillir dans notre équipe !
Ce que nous offrons
  • Type de contrat : contrat temporaire du 18 novembre 2026 au 19 février 2027.
  • Temps de travail : temps plein, 39 heures par semaine.
  • Salaire : 1 559,24 € brut par mois.
  • Mode de travail : 100 % télétravail.
  • Localisation obligatoire : vous devez résider dans l’une des villes suivantes en Espagne : Alicante, Málaga, León, Madrid, Barcelone ou Séville.
  • Horaires du service client : du lundi au vendredi, de 9 h à 18 h. Les horaires précis des équipes seront communiqués pendant le processus de recrutement.
  • Formation : 5 jours ouvrés, du 11 au 17 novembre 2026 (hors week-end).
  • Rémunération de la formation : la formation est rémunérée après validation de la période d’essai de 30 jours. Les modalités exactes de rémunération seront confirmées pendant le processus de recrutement.
  • Possibilités d’évolution : 90 % de nos managers et directeurs ont commencé leur carrière en tant qu’agents, ce qui témoigne des possibilités de développement professionnel offertes par Transcom.
Vos missions au quotidien
  • Fournir une assistance téléphonique aux clients.
  • Traiter les demandes reçues par e-mail.
  • Résoudre les problèmes liés aux expéditions.
  • Répondre aux questions des clients et clarifier leurs éventuels doutes.
  • Suivre l’état des expéditions.
  • Transmettre les demandes spécifiques aux autres services lorsqu’elles ne peuvent pas être résolues pendant l’appel.
  • Assurer un traitement efficace des demandes et la résolution des problèmes rencontrés par les clients.
Le profil que nous recherchons
Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous devez répondre aux critères suivants :
  • Français de niveau natif obligatoire, aussi bien à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.
  • Anglais niveau C1 et/ou espagnol niveau C1 obligatoire. La maîtrise d’au moins une de ces deux langues est nécessaire.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication, avec une expression claire, professionnelle et naturelle.
  • Sens du service client, empathie et capacité à trouver des solutions.
  • Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques.
  • Capacité à travailler de manière autonome en télétravail tout en collaborant efficacement avec une équipe.
  • Résidence obligatoire à Alicante, Málaga, León, Madrid, Barcelone ou Séville.
  • Disponibilité obligatoire pour commencer la formation le 11 novembre 2026, puis le contrat de travail le 18 novembre 2026.
  • Autorisation de résidence et de travail en Espagne obligatoire : conformément à la politique de Transcom, nous ne proposons pas de parrainage de visa (visa sponsorship). Vous devez donc déjà disposer du droit légal de résider et de travailler en Espagne, avec les autorisations nécessaires en cours de validité, sans avoir besoin d’un parrainage de l’employeur.
La vie chez Transcom !
Chez Transcom, nous nous investissons pleinement dans tout ce que nous faisons, tant pour nos clients que les uns pour les autres. Chaque jour, quelqu’un commence son parcours chez Transcom, en transformant son potentiel d’aujourd’hui en compétences pour demain.
Nous valorisons l’engagement, l’esprit d’équipe et la volonté d’aider les autres. Nous encourageons des changements positifs et durables au sein de nos équipes et des communautés dans lesquelles nous évoluons.
C’est cela, l’esprit Transcom : nous prenons soin les uns des autres et nous nous soutenons mutuellement. Dès le premier jour, vous avez votre place parmi nous, exactement comme vous êtes. Et avec le bon état d’esprit, il n’y a aucune limite à ce que nous pouvons accomplir ensemble.
Chez Transcom, vous pouvez être vous-même. Postulez dès maintenant : nous avons hâte de vous rencontrer !

You’ll partner with our sales team to guide prospects through the technical evaluation of PhoenixAI, delivering compelling presentations or demos, architecting tailored AI-native solutions, and securing technical wins. This customer-facing role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, strong communication skills, and a passion for solving complex data challenges.

What you'll do

As a Presales Solutions Architect, you’ll partner with sales to secure technical wins by showcasing PhoenixAI’s Agentic Database value and driving successful evaluations. Your responsibilities include:

Qualifications

  • Ambition & Curiosity: A driven, inquisitive mindset—eager to learn PhoenixAI Agentic Database product’s intricacies, tackle tough challenges, and grow into the role, even if starting with less experience or specific skills.

About Throne

Throne is a fast growing Series C startup transforming local communities by delivering clean, safe, accessible restrooms to cities, transit agencies, and public spaces. Our mission is to provide peace of mind to the millions of people who set out on an adventure on any given day. That adventure may be big or small. It may involve taking your toddler to the park, driving a stranger to the airport, running a half marathon, or exploring a new city for the first time.

About the Job

We are looking for a full-time Head of Talent Acquisition to join our team, reporting to the Head of People Operations. As Throne’s first dedicated Talent Acquisition hire, you will be responsible for building and running our hiring engine for professional and managerial roles across engineering, product, sales, and corporate functions. You will partner closely with Finance, People Operations, our Founders and executive team, and hiring managers to connect hiring decisions to their tangible impact. While this role is being hired as an individual contributor given the nimble nature of our team, as Throne’s business needs grow, you may have the opportunity to build out a team to further support specialized recruiting efforts, high-volume field staffing, and other disciplines.

This role can be performed remotely within the United States, with flexibility expected to work across timezones to support hiring teams. Minimal domestic travel (less than 10%) will be required.

Vollzeit | Remote möglich | 4.000–4.700 Euro brutto pro Monat

Du möchtest verstehen, wie Unternehmen arbeiten, und daraus bessere Abläufe entwickeln? Bei Flow Factor hilfst du unseren Kunden, ihre Anforderungen an digitale Lösungen greifbar zu machen. Du arbeitest dabei direkt mit unseren Kunden und unserem Entwicklungsteam zusammen.

Wir unterstützen mittelständische Unternehmen im deutschsprachigen Raum bei der Prozessautomatisierung und beim Einsatz von KI.   • Du klärst in Kundengesprächen Ziele und Anforderungen und hältst offene Fragen sowie Entscheidungen fest.

  • Du klärst Rückfragen mit Kunden und dem Entwicklungsteam und hältst die Dokumentation aktuell.

  • Du prüfst umgesetzte Funktionen anhand der vereinbarten Anforderungen und unterstützt bei Kundenterminen und Abnahmen.

  • Du übernimmst eigene Themenbereiche und baust deine Verantwortung mit zunehmender Erfahrung aus.

Requirements

Das bringst du mit

  • Du kannst dich in neue Abläufe einarbeiten und erkennst, wenn Informationen fehlen oder nicht zusammenpassen.

  • Du hörst aufmerksam zu, fragst konkret nach und kannst Ergebnisse verständlich auf Deutsch formulieren.

  • Du interessierst dich für Software, Automatisierung und KI und möchtest verstehen, wie diese im Arbeitsalltag eingesetzt werden.

  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig und behältst Vereinbarungen und offene Aufgaben im Blick.

Programmieren gehört nicht zu deinen Kernaufgaben. Technische Detailfragen klärst du gemeinsam mit unseren Entwicklern. Für den Einstieg ist uns wichtiger, wie du denkst und kommunizierst, als wie viele Werkzeuge du bereits kennst.

Das erwartet dich

  • 4.000–4.700 Euro brutto pro Monat in Vollzeit.

  • Die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten; unser Standort ist Grevenbroich.

  • Eine schrittweise Einarbeitung an echten Kundenprojekten und fachlichen Austausch mit dem Entwicklungsteam.

jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) is hiring a Senior Pre-Sales Systems Engineer to support our Higher Education business, with a focus on R1 research universities.

R1 institutions are not one customer. A single campus can behave like a dozen different organizations at the same time: central IT running enterprise applications, research computing and HPC teams, genomics and imaging cores, AI and machine learning labs competing for GPU time, an academic medical center with its own rules and its own budget, and faculty groups buying infrastructure directly with grant money. Decisions move through CIOs, research computing directors, principal investigators, sponsored programs offices, procurement, and consortium contract vehicles, often in parallel and not always in agreement.

That environment rewards someone who can hold a lot of context at once, translate between very different audiences, and connect technology to the outcomes these institutions actually care about: time to result for researchers, compliance with sponsor and grant requirements, data that stays usable for a decade or more, and budgets that have to stretch further every year.

You will be the technical lead on these accounts, working alongside account managers, specialists, and partners to build solutions customers can defend internally, both technically and financially.

Location: Michigan or Indiana

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop a real understanding of what drives each institution: research priorities, funding cycles, capital versus operating constraints, and who actually makes the decision
  • Connect technology, including the Everpure portfolio and the broader ecosystem, to measurable research and institutional outcomes
  • Move fluently between principal investigators, research computing staff, central IT, CIOs, finance, and procurement, adapting the conversation to each audience instead of delivering the same presentation
  • Build the business case alongside the technical one: total cost of ownership, power and cooling, data center footprint, staff time, and the real cost of the current environment
  • Support research workloads end to end, from instrument and sequencer output through HPC and AI pipelines to long-term retention and archive
  • Help customers work through data management questions: lifecycle and retention, reproducibility, sponsor and funding agency data sharing expectations, research data governance, and security requirements such as NIST 800-171 and CMMC where they apply
  • Partner closely with account managers, specialists, channel partners, and higher education purchasing consortia and contract vehicles
  • Take ownership of evaluations, benchmarks, proofs of concept, and system configurations, and secure the technical win
  • Capture requirements and translate them into solutions that help institutions grow their research capability rather than just their capacity
  • Author responses to RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, which in this segment are frequent and detailed
  • Stay current on the competitive landscape and make sure our positioning reflects it honestly
  • Follow market and research computing trends closely enough to bring that thinking back into our organization
  • Lead by example living the Pure Values: Persistence, Creativity, Teamwork, Ownership and Customer-first

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Required

  • 8 or more years of relevant experience across technology, solution design, and customer-facing communication
  • Pre-sales or customer-facing technical experience
  • Experience with higher education, research computing, academic medical centers, or the public sector
  • Familiarity with HPC and AI environments: parallel and distributed file systems, GPU-attached storage, schedulers such as Slurm, and data pipelines for genomics, imaging, or simulation
  • Broad technical depth across two or more of: cloud, HPC, AI and machine learning infrastructure, data management, core infrastructure, analytics, or financial and business applications. A career built entirely inside storage is not what we are looking for
  • A track record of selling on value: uncovering what the customer is trying to accomplish and connecting technology to business, operational, and financial outcomes
  • The ability to hold credible conversations with engineers, architects, executives, data scientists, researchers, finance teams, and procurement, and to adjust the message for each
  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to challenge assumptions and help customers think through complicated decisions
  • Curiosity, empathy, an open mind, and a genuine appetite for continuous learning
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • BS in CS, EE, another technical degree, or equivalent experience

Helpful, but not required

  • Knowledge of current and emerging storage architectures (FC, iSCSI, NAS, SAN, object) and file systems
  • Linux, NFS, and distributed Linux environments
  • VMware, Ethernet, TCP/IP, and general networking
  • AWS, Azure, or GCP, and hybrid or cloud-native architectures
  • Containers, Kubernetes, and microservices
  • Data-intensive applications such as structured databases (SQL, Oracle) and analytics platforms
  • Experience with grant-funded procurement, consortium purchasing, or public sector contract vehicles
  • Experience with higher education, research computing, academic medical centers
  • Familiarity with HPC, research and AI environments: parallel and distributed file systems, GPU-attached storage, schedulers such as Slurm, and data pipelines for genomics, imaging, or simulation

If you meet most of the required list and few of the second list, we would still like to hear from you.

Salary ranges are determined based on role, level and location. For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations.

This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity.

There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.

The annual base salary range is:
$141,400—$212,100 USD

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out for more information.

ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at if you’re invited to an interview.

OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.

Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

We boldly go.

Virtual

What's in it for you:

As the Product Manager, Data Center Hydronic Systems, you will lead a strategic and growing segment of the portfolio for the North America Data center business unit. This starts with understanding market trends, customer needs, gaps in Trane’s portfolio and the competitive landscape to initiate new offerings through engineering development and production. The role will also manage potential sourced product relationships to augment internal capabilities.

You will be responsible for helping define the product strategy, cross-functional team leadership (both internally as well as with sourced partners), life-cycle management, multi-generational product plans, new product development programs, commercialization, customer research, cultivating strong supplier relationships, and go-to market strategy. In addition, you will be responsible for – and accountable to – meeting or exceeding Trane’s revenue growth targets, maintaining or growing market share and expanding margin.

We are seeking a high-energy, results driven product management professional capable of articulating a strategic vision and executing that vision to deliver business results. You will have excellent communication and executive presence and be seeking an opportunity to grow and develop on a general manager track with a leading climate innovation company.

What you will do:

  • Integral team member of the larger Data Center Product Management team focused on expanding Trane’s presence and participation in the Data Center vertical.
  • Leader of a Product Growth Team (PGT) managing the Hydronic Solutions segment of Trane’s portfolio.
  • Actively engaged in the rapidly evolving Data Center ecosystem, exploring and understanding new technologies
  • Be an integral team member in evaluating both Make vs Buy decisions as well as possible M&A acquisition/partnership opportunities supporting this segment of the Data Center vertical.
  • Lead product line strategy and long-range plan development, P&L and annual operating plan for the newly created product line. Effectively manage tradeoffs between short- and long-term product line performance as measured in revenue, margin, and market share.
  • Develop and execute channel strategy aimed at developing and maturing channel capability to drive growth in market coverage and closure rate to enable product line to reach its entitlement in the market.
  • Actively manage day to day needs of product line and strategic supplier, with particular focus on identifying and delivering profitable growth opportunities.
  • Develop and execute a multigenerational product plan (MGPP) for product line, ensuring that the product positioning, pricing, cost, margins and customer value proposition support the overall equipment strategy and direction.
  • Collaborate with other leaders and product managers to ensure product line strategy is aligned with peer portfolio’s roadmaps and supports broader system, services and contracting initiatives.
  • Collaborate with market research team to understand customer needs, and define the customer “Critical to Quality” specifications (CTQs) for product line and associated systems to support new product development programs (NPDs)
  • Initiate and support business cases for NPDs that execute elements of MGPP.
  • Collaborate, create and execute the marketing and commercialization for new products offerings and exiting product enhancement with strategic suppliers.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, marketing, business and/or equivalent.
  • 5+ years of experience in product management, new product development, or strategic marketing.
  • Knowledge in liquid cooling, heat rejection, HVAC systems, data centers and IT equipment is a plus.
  • Self-starter that can be hands-on and work independently without day-to-day oversight.
  • Must have strong financial literacy and technical proficiency
  • Must have strong planning, organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills.

jobs.title: Salesforce Solution Architect Marketing Cloud Engagement & Marketing Cloud Next
jobs.excerpt: About Offprem Technology Offprem Technology is a Salesforce Summit Partner and Claude Certified firm, with consultants certified in both.
jobs.description:
About Offprem Technology

Offprem Technology is a Salesforce Summit Partner and Claude Certified firm, with consultants certified in both. We help organizations across industries implement, run, and get more from Salesforce and Claude, together or on their own, and we use Claude in our own delivery. Starting fresh or already live, our clients work with people who guide every decision.

We stay close to what Salesforce is shipping, from Agentforce and Data 360 to Marketing Cloud Next, so our recommendations reflect what the platform can do today. We build around your CRM, connecting marketing, sales, and service data so AI and automation work from a single view of the customer.

We’re headquartered in Indiana, remote friendly, and hire across the United States. Whether you’re an experienced consultant or want to deepen your expertise in Salesforce’s marketing and AI platforms, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role

Salesforce’s marketing platform is evolving, and our clients need an architect who can guide them through it. In this role you’ll design and deliver solutions on Marketing Cloud Engagement and Marketing Cloud Next, helping each client choose the right path and build it well. That includes planning how Marketing Cloud works with Salesforce CRM and Data 360, and how clients move from one platform to another over time.

You’ll lead solution design, oversee build work and quality assurance. You’re equally comfortable in a discovery workshop with a marketing leader and in a working session on journeys, data, and code.

What You’ll Do

Lead the engagement

  • Manage implementation projects from kickoff to go-live, keeping scope, timeline, and budget on track
  • Lead discovery and consulting sessions with marketing, sales, operations, and technical stakeholders
  • Assess a client’s current marketing technology, data, and processes, and recommend the right platform and roadmap
  • Run solution walkthroughs, user acceptance testing, and enablement sessions
  • Support go-live and early adoption, and hand off cleanly to client teams or managed services

Architect solutions across Marketing Cloud

  • Design and document the solution architecture for Marketing Cloud Engagement and Marketing Cloud Next implementations, and get client approval on the design
  • Advise on platform strategy, including coexistence, sequencing, and migration between Marketing Cloud products
  • Design audience and data models, including segmentation and identity
  • Design customer journeys and cross-channel programs across email, mobile, and other channels, with personalization and dynamic content
  • Define consent, preference, and compliance approaches that fit each client’s requirements
  • Architect integrations between Marketing Cloud, Salesforce CRM, and Data 360, and define campaign measurement and reporting
  • Identify where Agentforce and AI-assisted capabilities can improve content, segmentation, and campaign performance

Build, test, and improve

  • Oversee build work and quality assurance, and build or test solutions yourself when needed
  • Configure and review core components, such as journeys, automations, content, data extensions, segments, and integrations
  • Write and review SQL, AMPscript, and other scripting where Marketing Cloud Engagement solutions call for it
  • Support data migration, sender authentication and deliverability setup, and cutover planning
  • Review the work of other consultants and give constructive technical feedback

Grow the practice

  • Build reusable accelerators, templates, and best practices for Offprem’s marketing practice
  • Mentor consultants as they build skills across the Marketing Cloud products
  • Contribute to pre-sales conversations, scoping, and statements of work when needed

What You’ll Need

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • Hands-on experience implementing Marketing Cloud Engagement, including Journey Builder, Email Studio, Automation Studio, Contact Builder, and data extensions
  • Working knowledge of SQL and AMPscript
  • Experience with or knowledgeable about Marketing Cloud Next. We expect you to earn the Marketing Cloud Next certificationshortly after joining.Candidates who already hold it or are well on their way will stand out.
  • Previous experience as an Implementation Consultant, Business Analyst, Solution Architect, or Systems Consultant
  • Experience leading client-facing discovery, solution design, and project delivery from kickoff to go-live
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce CRM data model and how marketing data connects to Sales Cloud and Service Cloud
  • Familiarity with Marketing Cloud Growth, including how Growth Edition and Advanced Edition differ
  • Strong business acumen and excellent technical ability
  • Strong presentation, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to business leaders
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects in a remote consulting environment
  • Consulting or partner firm experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Marketing Cloud Next certification already earned, or in progress
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud certifications such as Marketing Cloud Engagement Administrator, Consultant, Specialist or Developer
  • Salesforce Administrator certification, plus additional certifications such as Data 360 Consultant
  • Experience with Data 360 (formerly Data Cloud), including unification, segmentation, and activation
  • Experience with Flow, Agentforce, or AI-driven marketing capabilities
  • Experience planning or leading migrations between marketing platforms
  • Interest in or experience with Claude and AI-assisted delivery

Company Benefits and Perks

  • Remote first culture - yes we have an office, but we don’t force you to come in!
  • Unlimited PTO
  • 4% 401k match
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance from day one!
  • Company paid STD, LTD and life insurance
  • 11 paid holidays, including the day after the Superbowl!
  • Volunteer Program, including volunteer time off and matching donations
  • Tuesday start dates for new hires, because who wants to start on a Monday?
  • Bonus or commission eligible, depending upon your role

Authenticity & Verification Notice

Salesforce certifications will be verified during the application process.
As a client facing organization we value integrity and authenticity throughout our hiring process.
Candidates may be asked to validate technical knowledge, experience, education, and certifications through structured assessment and credential verification prior to hire.

*Offprem Technology provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or protected veteran status.

Position Summary

The School Certifying Official (SCO) is responsible for advising and assisting students to navigate the use of their Veteran Education Benefits (VEB), certifying student enrollment statuses to the Department of Veterans Affairs, and liaising with students, other University teams, and the Veteran’s Affairs. SCOs provide exceptional customer service and quality responses to eligible veterans, civilians, military students, and family members applying for and receiving VEB. Duties are performed with an emphasis on accuracy, timeliness, customer service, compliance with federal and state regulatory agencies, and adherence to University policies and procedures. Interpret, explain, and analyze VA regulatory changes and evaluate and monitor student eligibility for benefits processing associated with this designation. Serves as a student’s key point of contact regarding VA benefits, providing in-depth, quality service to students from the time they enter the first course until they graduate. The majority of the day focuses on certifying student enrollments and communicating with students via the phone, email, text messaging, and chat providing support while working with students to resolve complaints, troublehoot issues, and assist students in overcoming challenges that could hinder progress to graduation.


Essential Functions:

  • Evaluate the requirements for the University’s receipt of a student’s military benefit(s) by: analyzing and monitoring the student’s enrollment, financial account, other financial aid, and academic records; and interpreting and explaining while staying abreast of the changing regulatory environment that may impact the University’s policies and procedures for receiving and processing of military benefits.
  • Process veteran’s affairs (VA) enrollment certifications for eligible students by coordinating with applicable University departments (Registrar, Financial Aid, Student Accounts) and ensuring all benefits and related documentation including certification forms and status change forms are processed timely and accurately.
  • Interview students/veterans, coordinate benefits delivery with central/regional VA processing office, process advance payments requests as appropriate, update the system (Peoplesoft), reconcile with VA certification records, research history of benefits received, review enrollment reports, and update student accounts, as required.
  • Coordinate timely filing of all VA documentation ensuring all paper and computer records are adequately safeguarded and properly retained.
  • Assist in the development and revision of office policies and procedures, as necessary.
  • Reconcile all incoming payments and prepare deposits for the University Cashier.
  • Attend the necessary Military meetings/workshops, and webinars that impact students benefits and success as well as the University’s compliance.
  • Troubleshoot student issues and assist leaders in working with the military funding sources to investigate and resolve student complaints.
  • Disseminate Shopping Sheets to prospective students and proactively communicate to continuing students regarding regulatory changes that impact a student’s eligibility for military benefits.
  • Ensure quality improvements in all aspects of office policies and procedures as well as the regulations for delivering benefits to students.
  • Reasonable and consistent attendance to fulfill requirements of the position.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:N/A

Requirements:

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • An Associate’s degree from an accredited college or university and/or its equivalent in work experience will be considered.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of related experience as an SCO, VEB specialist, financial aid specialist, or student facing position at an accredited college or University, or equivalent, is preferred.
  • Experience with VA Once preferred.
  • Experience in higher education preferred.
  • Experience working in a technology-driven enterprise preferred.
  • All skills, abilities and education will be considered for minimum qualifications.

Competencies/Technical/Functional Skills:

  • Knowledge of Veteran Education Benefits and other financial aid programs, e.g., Federal Student Aid (FSA), Tuition Assistance (TA), and private education loan, etc.
  • Knowledge of certifying the enrollment status of students utilizing their VEBs.
  • Knowledge of VA Once.
  • Knowledge of academic and business practices in an online environment.
  • Knowledge of University policies and procedures.
  • Skill in using Microsoft Office products; especially MS Outlook, Excel, and Word.
  • Skill in supporting a collaborative work environment to ensure the best results for the team and University.
  • Skill in using effective communications, listening sensitively, and adapting communication style to the audience, especially during escalated situations.
  • Skill in being perceptive and decisive with the ability to perceive the situation and impact of responses and decisions to make well‐informed, effective, and timely decisions; even when data is limited, or solutions produce unpleasant consequences.
  • Skill in de-escalating students as well as mitigating and resolving student complaints.
  • Excellent customer service; especially with oral and written communications.
  • Skill in operating equipment, such as computer, fax, scanner/copier, and texting/phone systems.
  • Skill in utilizing technology, including the ability to navigate web sites, perform word processing, create spreadsheets, send e-mail, and electronic messages.
  • Ability to recognize when to reach out to leadership, directly or indirectly, to ask for help and/or seek guidance when needed and as appropriate.
  • Ability to comprehend difficult student situations and complex regulatory information in accordance with University policies and procedures and VA regulations, respectively, and communicate in terms the respective audiences understand.
  • Ability to travel to conferences, as necessary.
  • Ability to use and facilitate online communications using email and /or other technology-based communication media.
  • Ability to problem-solve and resolve student complaints.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality.
  • Ability to provide VEB services to students in a physical campus and/or on-line environment.
  • Ability to prepare letters, reports, and business correspondence in a professional manner.
  • Ability to collaborate with other enrollment management and financial aid teams regarding other financial aid programs and options, i.e., Federal Student Aid loans and grants, private education loans, internal and external scholarship opportunities, etc

Job Title: IRT Project Manager, Remote US

Job Location: Durham

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Overview:


The IRT Project Manager is accountable for the client’s study specific Interactive Response Technology (IRT) implementation, ongoing conduct support, closeout and decommission. Provides subject matter expertise, leads study specific implementation, ensures on time delivery, and remediation of support issues.

Summary of Responsibilities:


  • Lead study-specific IRT Implementation Teams, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders including Clinical Trial Supply, Global Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, and vendors.
  • Create and manage IRT-related timelines and deliverables.
  • Conduct internal review meetings for vendor-written specifications and integration documents.
  • Plan, facilitate, and lead IRT study review meetings.
  • Ensure completion and approval of all IRT documentation, including specifications.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the IRT vendor for study-specific matters.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant regulations such as GxPs and ICH E6.
  • Provide guidance to the IRT Implementation Team on optimal system utilization.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on IRT best practices and share lessons learned across teams.
  • Define and complete initial documentation for scope of work requests from vendors.
  • Review and provide expert input on User Requirement Specifications and other IRT-related documents.
  • Review and approve UAT schedules aligned with URS.
  • Create study-specific IRT Test Plans and test scripts.
  • Facilitate UAT execution, coordinate issue resolution with vendors, and ensure proper documentation.
  • Define and oversee data exchange requirements between IRT and other systems.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to determine integration solutions.
  • Manage initial and ongoing testing to ensure efficient and error-free data transfers.
  • Guide study teams on site-initiated data changes and vendor implementation.
  • Facilitate collection of closeout deliverables from IRT vendors.
  • Maintain a study-specific issue and risk log, documenting root causes, corrective actions, and preventive measures.
  • Advise on system changes post-launch to ensure alignment with study and program needs.
  • Manage study-specific IRT contracts, budgets, and change orders.
  • Support the Global IRT Lead in process governance and standardization.
  • Maintain consistency in IRT terminology, functionality, and reporting across studies.
  • Assist in metrics collection and reporting.
  • Recommend improvements to quality procedures and best practices.
  • Conduct or develop IRT-related training for internal teams.
  • Foster collaboration across internal stakeholders including Clinical Trial Supplies, eClinical Technology, Global Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, Clinical Quality, Regulatory, and Outsourcing.
  • Provide regular updates to the Line Manager and escalate issues as needed.
  • Perform all other duties as needed or assigned.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):


  • University / college degree (life sciences, health sciences, information technology or related subjects preferred) or a certification in allied health professions from an appropriate accredited institution.
  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.

Experience (Minimum Required):


  • 5–6 years of relevant experience in clinical systems project management, with a strong focus on or IRT and/or eCOA platforms
  • Hands-on experience in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including planning, execution, defect tracking, and system go-live support.
  • Proven ability to manage outsourced technology vendors and collaborate with sponsors and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive and detail-oriented approach to issue resolution and system validation.
  • Effective oral and written communication skills for stakeholder engagement, documentation, and reporting.
  • Solid understanding of the clinical trial lifecycle, including system implementation, data flow, regulatory compliance, and TMF documentation.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment with minimal supervision.
  • Strong time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to meet tight deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards.
  • Demonstrated self-motivation, accountability, and ownership of assigned tasks.
  • A cooperative and team-oriented mindset, with a willingness to support peers and contribute to shared goals.

jobs.title: Dean of Academics
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreAoPS Institute is a new nonprofit creating a first-of-its-kind pathway for the most mathematically advanced students in the country.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

AoPS Institute is a new nonprofit creating a first-of-its-kind pathway for the most mathematically advanced students in the country. We give students who are ready for college-level math years before college somewhere serious to go: a multi-year sequence of rigorous math and computer science courses, delivered by Art of Problem Solving, together with access to research, competition, and applied programs, run by world-class partners, and a community of exceptional peers.

We're building this at a moment when the frontier itself is moving. AI is changing what mathematicians and scientists do, how research gets done, and what a student who is years ahead should spend time on. Our first cohort will finish college around 2035. We want them to arrive at the frontier with the judgment to decide what's worth proving, building, or asking.

We are a partial enrollment program that commits to working with students' schools to replace standard coursework and with top universities to ensure that the coursework is recognized.

The AoPS Institute is designed for the most exceptional students in the country and seeks to ensure that students have access to the program regardless of what zip code they reside in by being virtual-first, administering need-blind admissions, and offering significant financial support.

We are targeting a 2027 public launch with the first cohort beginning in the 2027-28 school year. The program is backed by AoPS and by committed philanthropic partners.

The founding team for the organization is a Dean of Academics and a Dean of Students & COO who together report to the Board, chaired by Richard Rusczyk (Founder and CEO of AoPS) and Josh Taylor (President at Carina Initiatives).

The Role

The Dean of Academics owns the academic identity, design, and credibility of the Institute. Art of Problem Solving builds and delivers the core mathematics and computer science courses. The Dean of Academics owns everything else that makes the program exceptional: what our students should be doing beyond those courses, whether the strongest university departments in the country recognize what they've done, and who is admitted to the Institute.

The hardest question we have to answer is what a student who is years ahead in mathematics should spend the rest of high school doing, and the answer is broader than mathematics. Some of our students will pursue mathematical research, but many may not, and they deserve a program just as serious: in computer science, in the sciences, in applied and professional settings, and in the seminars and electives that surround the core. The Dean of Academics designs that program, partnering first with the strongest organizations in the ecosystem and building only where no partner meets our bar.

The second half of the role is external. University recognition of our coursework will come from faculty who trust the program and advocate for it inside their own departments. The Dean of Academics personally carries those relationships.

We are looking for a visionary program leader. We're building something that doesn't exist yet, and the partners we'll work with are strong, established, and have their own ways of working. This Dean needs a clear view of what our students should be doing and what they're capable of, and the credibility to bring faculty, researchers, and partner programs along with it.

The Dean of Academics reports to the Board and works in close partnership with the Dean of Students & COO.

Responsibilities

  • Design and own the academic program beyond the core courses: seminars, electives, research experiences, and applied programs across mathematics, computer science, and the sciences, for every Institute student. Partner first with the strongest existing programs in the ecosystem; build original programs only where partnership cannot meet our quality bar or no partner exists.
  • Own the relationships with mathematics and computer science faculty at the most selective universities (MIT, Stanford, Princeton, Caltech, and their peers), both as academic partners and as the audiences who validate the rigor of our coursework and, in turn, its standing for placement and credit at those institutions.
  • Set the admissions bar: define what "ready for this program" means and design a fair, rigorous readiness assessment that works for thousands of applicants who all have access to strong AI.
  • Be the Institute's academic voice with AoPS on what universities need from the core courses: assessment design, instructor quality, and the enrollment, engagement, and assessment data the Institute needs to see.
  • Set the arc toward research: what has to come first, when a student is ready, and what research means for high school students in an AI world.
  • Develop corporate and professional partnerships with trading firms, technology companies, research labs, and others that give students substantive experiences beyond the classroom.
  • Bring every partner program into alignment with the Institute's vision and philosophy for our students, hold partners to shared expectations on quality, data, and the student experience, and make the program-by-program calls about which experiences the Institute credits and which it merely helps students reach.
  • Bring academic recommendations to the Board and own the quality bar across the whole program.

Skills and Experiences You'll Need to Bring

  • Exceptional math or computer science achievement, including a PhD in mathematics or computer science
  • At or near the research frontier, and fluent in how AI is changing it
  • Experience working with mathematically extraordinary middle and high school students, and a clear vision of how to support them
  • A strong communicator who can explain what our students should be doing, and what they're capable of, to a department chair, a research partner, an admissions office, and a family alike
  • Breadth beyond mathematics: you've thought seriously about what exceptional students should do in computer science and the sciences, not only in mathematical research
  • Ability to design rigorous, fair academic processes and programs, especially at scale; you've built or run admissions or assessments before
  • Lived this gap yourself: a mathematically extraordinary student whose local school could not serve you, with firsthand knowledge for what it costs a family to assemble the right program from fragments
  • Comfortable bringing prestigious external partners into alignment with our vision, and holding them to shared quality standards
  • Senior leadership in an academic, research, or enrichment organization
  • Experience teaching math and/or computer science to mathematically extraordinary high school students
  • Startup or 0-to-1 experience preferred: you have built, or been part of building, an organization or program from nothing, and are comfortable operating without infrastructure that does not yet exist

Location: Remote, with regular travel for partner and board meetings

Salary: $200K–$250K

We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Salary: $200,000 – $250,000 / year

jobs.description:
Career Category

Human Resources

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Live

What you will do

Amgen is one of the world’s leading independent biotechnology companies. For over 4 decades, Amgen has pioneered biotechnology breakthroughs, to bring state-of-the-art medicines from laboratory to the patient. Amgen has not only discovered and developed innovative human therapeutics but has invested in cutting edge manufacturing capability and support services to deliver these exciting therapies to medical teams around the world. Japan and Asia Pacific (JAPAC) is the fastest growing region in Amgen. Now we are hiring for a Staff Relations Manager supporting Japan based in Amgen Malaysia or Japan.

Live

What you will do

The Staff Relations Manager will be responsible for conducting HR investigations and for providing staff relations guidance and support to managers and staff of Amgen’s Japan Asia-Pacific (“JAPAC”) region, specifically for Japan. In their investigator role, the Staff Relations Manager will conduct investigations into potential violations of HR policies (such as allegations of harassment, discrimination, and retaliation) involving staff based at Amgen Japan. In this role, the Staff Relations Manager will act as a thought partner to managers on a variety of staff relations issues, such as performance management, disciplinary action, and workplace accommodation.

The Staff Relations Manager will report to the Regional Staff Relations Lead. Staff Relations is a specialized HR function that partners closely with managers, Compliance, Legal (in-house and external), and stakeholders in HR to protect Amgen values, investigate potential violations of HR policies, provide practical advice and guidance on coaching staff and managers, and to advise on performance and behaviors management, involuntary terminations, and workplace accommodations.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Conduct and/or direct thorough, timely, and impartial HR related investigations in countries in the JAPAC region, specifically Japan, involving staff members at all levels of the organization. Maintain confidentiality and sensitivity to all issues and conduct investigations objectively.
  • Create professional, well-drafted investigation records, including investigation plans and summaries.
  • Report investigation findings to HR colleagues, legal partners, and business leaders in a clear, concise manner.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with key partners at Amgen Japan.
  • Develop and recommend solutions to managers on a variety of staff relations issues including managing poor performance, documenting and implementing disciplinary action, and managing conflict.
  • Partner with the local Human Resources Business Partners in managing and provide counsel on employee relations issues.
  • Participate or counsel (as needed) in corrective counseling and termination conversations with staff and managers.
  • Maintain positive work environment by responding to staff members' concerns, proactively addressing issues, and advising management team regarding best practices.
  • Document all cases and issues in tracking systems in a timely manner. Provide regular updates to site leadership and Staff Relations leadership.
  • Assist the Staff Relations Lead to identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities and best practices for internal HR processes.
  • Assist the Staff Relations Lead to partner with regional/local HR, Compliance, and Learning & Development to create and deliver training on key HR policies and on reporting suspected violations of policies.

Win

What we expect of you

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above and 5 years of Investigations/Employee Relations experience
  • Knowledge of applicable employment laws, regulations, and business practices related to the field of HR
  • Excellent written and oral communication and presentation skills
  • Demonstrated ability to learn and fairly apply company policy, investigation procedures, and regulatory guidelines within scope of duties
  • Ability to spot potential HR, Compliance, and Legal issues when presented with complex fact patterns, and to escalate accordingly
  • Experience working with unions or in the field of “labor relations”
  • Strong analytical, problem solving, collaboration, and project management skills
  • Ability to manage multiple cases and projects, and to prioritize effectively – oriented on results
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment and work independently
  • Experience managing difficult conversations and interactions, and conducting non-confrontational interviews
  • Experience working across different countries and cultures, with a commitment to educating oneself on cultural norms and varying laws
  • Exceptional integrity and demonstrated ability to maintain confidential information
  • Given the geographical focus of this role, fluency in Japanese and English (written, spoken, reading, and comprehension) is required to effectively support employee relations in Japan, ensuring culturally and linguistically appropriate communication and execution of HR processes.

Thrive

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, so we work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well-being

  • Vast opportunities to learn and move up and across our global organization
  • Diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where teammates are empowered to bring ideas to the table and act
  • Generous Total Rewards Plan comprising health, finance and wealth, work/life balance, and career benefits

Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.excerpt: JOB SUMMARYTo serve the Lord by advancing Forest Home’s mission through marketing that broadens our reach and brings quality leads to Guest Retreats and Forest Home programs.
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

To serve the Lord by advancing Forest Home’s mission through marketing that broadens our reach and brings quality leads to Guest Retreats and Forest Home programs. The Marketing Coordinator plays a key role in helping more families, churches, and groups discover Forest Home and come experience life-changing time with Jesus.

This is a lead generation role. The primary purpose of the Marketing Coordinator is to generate quality leads for Guest Retreats and Forest Home programs and to reach new audiences who have not yet experienced Forest Home. Branding, content, communications, graphics, email, CRM, SEO, website, and analytics all serve that goal. This role manages the day-to-day work of Forest Home’s marketing, keeps outsourced agencies and vendors focused on lead results, and uses data to bring insight and recommendations to leadership on how to reach more people and turn interest into inquiries and registrations.

The Marketing Coordinator works closely with the sales team, who turn leads into bookings and registrations, and with the in-house photo/video team, balancing creative execution with organization, follow-through, and a ministry-minded approach to every guest and partner.

Working under the direction of the Senior Director of Sales & Marketing, this role is expected to:

  • Generate a steady flow of quality leads for Guest Retreats and Forest Home programs
  • Broaden Forest Home’s reach to new families, churches, and groups
  • Coordinate and execute marketing plans for each program and Guest Retreats with lead and registration goals in mind
  • Steward Forest Home’s brand so every piece of content, graphic, and message is consistent and on-mission
  • Track, analyze, and report lead volume, lead quality, and marketing performance across paid ads, website, SEO, and email
  • Manage day-to-day work with outsourced agencies and vendors, holding them to deadlines, budgets, and lead goals
  • Partner closely with sales so leads are handed off quickly and followed up well
  • Reflect Forest Home’s mission, values, and Christ-centered culture in every interaction and internal partnership

This is a full-time, non-exempt, hourly position (40 hours per week) at $25–$28 per hour. The role is remote, with a strong preference for candidates in the Pacific time zone. Occasional on-site presence at Forest Home in Forest Falls is required for photo/video shoots, events, and team meetings.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Lead Generation & Audience Growth

  • Lead Generation: Plan and run campaigns across paid ads, email, social, website, and SEO that generate quality leads for Guest Retreats and Forest Home programs
  • Lead Quality: Focus on leads that are a good fit and likely to book or register, not just lead volume, using feedback from the sales team
  • Audience Growth: Identify and reach new audiences, such as churches, ministries, schools, homeschool groups, and families who have not yet experienced Forest Home
  • Lead Capture: Create and improve landing pages, forms, and offers that turn website visitors and ad clicks into inquiries and registrations
  • Lead Handoff: Make sure every lead is captured in HubSpot and routed to the right sales team member quickly
  • Paid Advertising: Work with outsourced vendors on Meta ads and Google search ads, reviewing targeting, creative, and results to improve lead quality and cost per lead

Branding & Creative

  • Brand Stewardship: Maintain and apply Forest Home’s brand standards (logos, colors, fonts, and tone of voice) across all programs, channels, and vendors
  • Graphic Design: Create graphics for social media, email, web, digital ads, and print using Canva and Adobe tools
  • Creative Review: Review creative from vendors and staff for brand consistency, accuracy, and quality before it is published
  • Brand Assets: Organize and maintain a library of logos, templates, photos, and video that the team can easily use

Content & Communications

  • Content Planning: Build and maintain a marketing content calendar covering email, blog, and website updates for every program and Guest Retreats, coordinated with the social media calendar
  • Copywriting: Write and edit clear, engaging copy for emails, social posts, web pages, ads, and promotional materials
  • Internal Communications: Keep staff informed about upcoming campaigns, promotions, and key messages

Social Media

  • Platforms: Manage Forest Home’s social media presence on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, and TikTok, tailoring content to each platform and audience
  • Strategy & Calendar: Plan and schedule social content for every program and Guest Retreats in a consistent posting calendar
  • Content Creation: Create posts, stories, reels, short-form video, and YouTube content in partnership with the in-house photo/video team
  • Community Engagement: Respond to comments and messages in a timely, gracious way, and turn social interest into inquiries by routing leads to the sales team
  • Audience Growth: Grow followers and reach new audiences, including churches, ministries, groups, and families who are new to Forest Home
  • LinkedIn: Use LinkedIn to reach church leaders, ministry staff, and organizations who plan group retreats
  • Performance: Track reach, engagement, follower growth, and leads from each platform, and include social results in regular marketing reports

Email Marketing

  • Campaigns & Newsletters: Plan, build, and send email campaigns and newsletters in HubSpot for every program and Guest Retreats
  • Automated Journeys: Build and maintain automated email sequences, such as inquiry follow-up, lead nurturing, registration reminders, pre-arrival information, and post-event rebooking
  • Segmentation: Segment lists by program, audience, and past attendance so each person receives relevant messages
  • Testing & Optimization: Test subject lines, content, and send times to improve open, click, and conversion rates
  • List Health: Grow the email list and keep it clean, including managing unsubscribes and bounces
  • Performance: Track opens, clicks, and conversions, and include email results in regular marketing reports

Photo & Video Collaboration

  • Creative Planning: Work with the in-house photo/video team to plan shoots and shot lists that meet program and campaign needs
  • On-Site Shoots: Attend shoots and events on-site as needed to direct content and support the team
  • Content Use: Turn photo and video into finished assets for web, social, email, and ads

Website & SEO

  • Website Management: Update and maintain the Forest Home WordPress website, including program pages, dates, pricing, and registration links
  • Accuracy: Keep program and Guest Retreats information current and correct across the site
  • SEO: Apply SEO best practices to site content, monitor search performance, and recommend improvements
  • User Experience: Identify broken links, outdated pages, and friction points that keep visitors from registering or inquiring, and recommend fixes

CRM & Marketing Automation

  • HubSpot Management: Maintain contact lists, properties, forms, and workflows in HubSpot so data stays clean and usable
  • Lead Follow-Up: Build and maintain automated follow-up for inquiries and registrations in partnership with the sales team
  • CRM Hygiene: Keep contact records, lists, and campaign tracking accurate and organized

Analytics & Reporting

  • Performance Tracking: Track marketing results using Google Analytics, HubSpot, and paid advertising platform reporting
  • Paid Ad Analysis: Read, interpret, and weigh performance data from Meta ads and Google search ads, including cost per lead, cost per registration, and return on ad spend
  • Reporting: Provide regular reports to leadership on campaign performance, website traffic, email results, and leads and registrations by program
  • Insight: Turn data into clear takeaways on what is working, what is not, and where to shift effort or budget

Program & Guest Retreats Marketing

  • Marketing Plans: Coordinate and execute marketing plans for each program and Guest Retreats, aligned with registration and booking goals
  • Campaign Timelines: Keep promotional calendars and launch timelines on track so every program is marketed at the right time
  • Audience and Messaging: Help identify target audiences and messaging for each program and for church and group partners

Vendor & Agency Coordination

  • Day-to-Day Management: Serve as the main point of contact for outsourced marketing agencies and vendors
  • Accountability: Hold vendors to deadlines, budgets, and agreed deliverables, and review their reporting
  • Evaluation: Assess vendor performance and share recommendations with leadership

Sales Partnership

  • Sales Alignment: Work closely with the sales team so marketing supports bookings, registrations, and rebooking efforts
  • Sales Materials: Create and update sales collateral such as brochures, one-pagers, and presentations
  • Feedback Loop: Gather feedback from sales on lead quality and common guest questions, and use it to improve marketing

Performance Metrics & Accountability

The Marketing Coordinator is responsible for measurable contribution to lead generation and audience growth for Guest Retreats and Forest Home programs. Performance will be evaluated based on the following standards:

  • Meet or exceed monthly and annual lead goals for Guest Retreats and each program
  • Improve lead quality, measured by the share of leads that convert to inquiries, bookings, and registrations
  • Grow reach to new audiences, measured by new contacts, first-time groups, and first-time families
  • Monitor and improve cost per lead and return on ad spend for paid advertising
  • Deliver campaigns and content on time according to the marketing calendar
  • Provide timely, accurate lead and marketing reports and insights to leadership
  • Keep vendors on schedule, on brief, and within budget
  • Maintain clean, organized lead data in HubSpot

Strategy & Recommendations

  • Make data-informed recommendations on channels, messaging, timing, and budget
  • Identify gaps and opportunities in how Forest Home reaches families, churches, and groups, and bring ideas to leadership
  • Stay current on marketing trends and tools, especially in camp, ministry, and hospitality settings
  • Proactively identify bottlenecks in marketing processes and recommend improvements

Training and Professional Development

  • Property Tour: Complete a guided tour of Forest Home during onboarding to learn programs, lodging, and facilities
  • Program Knowledge: Learn each program and Guest Retreats offering well enough to market it accurately
  • Coaching: Participate in regular check-ins with the Senior Director of Sales & Marketing and implement feedback
  • Skill Development: Pursue ongoing growth in marketing, analytics, design, and digital tools

QUALIFICATIONS:

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Faith & Character

  • Support Forest Home's mission and values
  • Signed statement of faith
  • Ability to pray for others both in-person and on the phone
  • Participate in staff spiritual activities
  • Christ-like attitude and servant heart

Education and/or Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience
  • 2+ years of experience in marketing, communications, or a related field
  • Experience generating leads through digital marketing, such as paid ads, email, landing pages, or SEO
  • Portfolio or work samples showing design, writing, and/or digital marketing work
  • Experience in ministry, nonprofit, camp, or hospitality marketing a plus

Professional Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with strong copywriting and editing skills
  • Working knowledge of HubSpot or a similar CRM
  • Experience updating websites in WordPress
  • Design skills in Canva and/or Adobe Creative Suite
  • Experience managing social media for an organization across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, and/or TikTok, including short-form video
  • Working knowledge of Google Analytics and SEO best practices
  • Ability to read, interpret, and weigh analytics from Meta ads and Google search ads
  • Comfortable turning data into clear reports and recommendations
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines
  • Detail-oriented with good organizational skills
  • Comfortable learning and implementing new software tools

Work Style

  • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting
  • Proactive communicator who keeps leadership and teammates informed
  • Strong teamwork abilities
  • Creative, with a good eye for design and brand consistency
  • Flexibility and willingness to perform a variety of tasks

Availability

  • Ability to work a consistent 40-hour weekly schedule
  • Pacific time zone preferred
  • Reliable home workspace with high-speed internet
  • Occasional travel to Forest Home in Forest Falls for shoots, events, and meetings
  • Occasional evening or weekend availability as needed

Interpersonal

  • Ability to relate to all types of individuals in a gracious manner
  • Gracious manner and integrity
  • Ability to streamline processes

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with a disability to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to sit and use a computer for extended periods. On-site visits may involve walking on uneven, mountainous terrain and occasionally lifting or carrying equipment up to 20 pounds. Requires visual acuity to read words and numbers and to review design and video work, and speaking and hearing ability sufficient to communicate by phone, video call, and in person.

Reasonable efforts are made to accommodate disabilities. This job description will be reviewed periodically as duties and responsibilities change with business necessity.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Work is performed primarily remotely in a home office setting with a usually quiet to moderate noise level. During on-site visits to Forest Home, work may involve outdoor exposure to weather, temperature changes, dirt, and dust, and a noise level that can be loud at times during events.

FOREST HOME EMPLOYMENT STATEMENT: Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. All terms and conditions of employment, duties, and responsibilities are subject to the Forest Home Employee Handbook.

FOREST HOME CORE VALUES

Surrender to Christ (Romans 12:1-2)

  • Abide with the Lord daily through study of His Word and prayer
  • Surrender to the Lord daily through obedience to His Word
  • Worship the Lord with the Forest Home Community
  • Commit to grow in your faith through regular attendance at a local church
  • Prioritize God, Family, and Work appropriately
  • Be prepared to share your testimony with staff or guests.
  • Walk in Biblical purity (1 Timothy 4:12) by rejecting one’s sinful nature

Love (I Corinthians 13)

  • Display the fruit of the Spirit: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control (Galatians 5:22)
  • Be respectful to others
  • Demonstrate compassion

Serve (Philippians 2:3-11)

  • Give generously to God and others through time, talent and treasure
  • Seek to put others’ needs above your own
  • Demonstrate humility in both spirit and deed
  • Actively look for ways to serve

Walk in Integrity (Titus 2:11-12, Proverbs 4:23-27)

  • Show loyalty to others, even when they are not present
  • Do the right thing, even when others are not present
  • Extend trust and seek to believe the best in others
  • Ask for forgiveness quickly when necessary
  • Be truthful and transparent with others

Strive for Excellence (Colossians 3:23-24)

  • Demonstrate accountability with time and resources
  • Request and receive training
  • Desire to improve, and challenge others to do the same
  • Commit to exceeding guest expectations
  • Refuse mediocrity

Engage in Community (I Thessalonians 5:11-13)

  • Seek first to understand before being understood

  • Work through conflict Biblically (Matthew 18:15-17)

Innovate (Ephesians 3:20-21)
