jobs.description:
Why Anchor Loans?

Anchor Loans is one of several operating companies owned by Pretium Partners (+$60B AUM Financial Services Entity) and is working diligently to expand and grow its lending footprint.

Anchor Loans, established in 1998, is the nation’s leading private, direct lender to experienced residential real estate investors and builders, and the first to surpass $10 billion in total fundings. Renowned for expediting financing for developers and investors, we specialize in bridge loans, ground-up construction, and single-family rental solutions for non-owner-occupied projects. Headquartered in beautiful Thousand Oaks, California, Anchor Loans currently lends in 48 states and is expanding into new markets and service lines to better serve our current and future borrowers.

Position Summary:

Anchor Loans is looking for Regional Loan Originator who are passionate about the customer experience and focused on finding and nurturing strategic relationships. Regional Loan Originator are responsible for meeting specific loan production goals through the establishment of on-going business relationships with real estate investors located within specified territory and should expect travel to conferences and client meetings. Regional Loan Originator will work with their teams (sales and ops) to support customers throughout the loan cycle, from lead through closing.

Territory Residence: To effectively support the assigned territory, the Regional Loan Originator must reside in the Central Region (TX, OH, IN, MI, WI, MN, TN, AL, LA, KY, MO)

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Identify new customers and lending opportunities with property investors, and/or referral partners like brokers, realtors, buildings and other referral sources.
  • Primary focus on driving sales, building and strengthening relationships with property investors, brokers and real estate agents from a variety of sources including company leads, referrals, industry events, etc.
  • Cultivate strong relationships with existing and new potential borrowers via in-person meetings, calls and emails and other means; assume responsibility as primary escalation point to resolve customer issues and roadblocks.
  • Develop and maintain in the CRM a client database for effective use of contact management tools and customer relationship management.
  • Reach out to existing and new customers regularly to stay on top of industry trends and in front of your customers to build relationships and sell.
  • Attend industry events and conferences, leveraging pre- planning, onsite meetings and post outreach to find and convert leads.
  • Leverage the CRM marketing campaigns to nurture and stay in contact with all customers.
  • Evaluate all transactions using standardized tools to size the deal(s), create quotes and terms sheets.
  • Work with the Sales and Marketing team to identify all potential business sources towards the goal of meeting monthly loan volume goals.
  • Facilitate the borrower approval process by collecting and providing the necessary information required for submission to loan processing.
  • Pre-qualify loan packages when borrower or brokers require assistance.
  • Work directly with potential borrowers to obtain initial documentation.
  • Monitor pipeline reports to determine status of all loans and act to alleviate any potential problems.
  • Grow the Brand (Anchor’s and yours) with Blog posting, online posts and re-posts and marketing strategies to be in front of your current and future customer bases.
  • Maintain constant and transparent dialogue with customers to keep them informed of status on submitted loans.
  • Create strong partnerships with Valuations, Construction and Underwriting Department Leaders; provide overall loan pipeline prioritization and collaborate to solve inter department roadblocks.
  • Stay up to date on industry and competitor trends; Using this information to inform product, sales and/or pricing

Essential Job Requirements and Required Skills:

  • Ability to prioritize workload and manage time in a remote environment
  • Highly analytical with strong attention to detail
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal supervision
  • Comfortable with outbound communication with a majority of cold leads
  • Ability to adapt quickly to new procedures and systems
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work as a dependable teammate in a fast-paced start-up environment
  • Highly self-motivated and disciplined
  • Experience with CRM is preferred
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, with aptitude to learn new software and systems
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time.

Why Keyrus, Why Now!

Keyrus is an international group of 3,000 experts across 30 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work, designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalize intelligence.

As AI becomes part of everyday business operations, organizations need more than intelligent models. They need reliable applications, secure integrations, and production-ready software that connects AI capabilities with real business processes.

At Keyrus, you will help turn intelligent capabilities into scalable applications that people and organizations can use with confidence.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.

What you'll architect

As a Software Engineer, AI Applications, you will design, develop, and maintain production-ready software applications that integrate AI capabilities into enterprise systems and business workflows.

Your primary focus will be software engineering, building reliable backend services, APIs, integrations, and application components that support AI-enabled solutions.

You will collaborate with AI Engineers, Data Engineers, Architects, and client teams to transform technical requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable applications.

    • Troubleshoot application issues, optimize performance, and support deployment and ongoing improvements.
    • Collaborate with AI Engineers, Data Engineers, and Architects to implement integrations and reusable software components.
    • Work closely with clients to understand technical requirements, discuss implementation options, and deliver solutions aligned with business needs.

Who you are

You are a hands-on Software Engineer who enjoys building reliable applications and solving complex technical challenges.

You understand that integrating AI into business applications requires strong software engineering foundations, including secure APIs, reliable integrations, testing, and production operations.

You combine technical expertise with practical problem-solving and enjoy collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver solutions that create real business value.

What you bring

Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience developing, integrating, and maintaining production software applications, particularly backend services and APIs.
    • Experience designing enterprise integrations and connecting applications with databases, cloud services, and external systems.
    • Experience applying software engineering practices, including testing, version control, CI/CD, and production monitoring.
    • Understanding of application security, scalability, performance, and maintainability in production environments.
    • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly, collaborate with stakeholders, and build relationships with clients and internal teams.

Technical skills

  • Strong programming skills in at least one backend ecosystem, such as Java/Spring, Python/FastAPI, Node.js/TypeScript, .NET/C#, or Go.
    • Experience designing and developing REST APIs, backend services, and enterprise application integrations.
    • Hands-on experience with databases, data access patterns, and application-level data processing.
    • Experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
    • Knowledge of Git, automated testing, CI/CD, authentication, application security, and production software engineering practices.

Nice to have

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or AI services into enterprise applications, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure AI, or comparable technologies.
    • Familiarity with RAG, AI agents, tool calling, and AI-enabled application workflows.
    • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, or distributed application architectures.
    • Experience with event-driven systems, messaging platforms, asynchronous processing, or complex enterprise integrations.
    • Familiarity with observability, infrastructure automation, or cloud-native application development.
    • Experience working directly with clients in consulting or professional services environments.

What makes you successful

  • You build reliable, secure, and maintainable applications that support real business needs.
    • You apply strong software engineering practices to ensure application quality and production readiness.
    • You make practical technical decisions that balance performance, scalability, security, and maintainability.
    • You collaborate effectively with technical teams and clients, communicate clearly, and develop reusable solutions.

Role Details

• Contract: Full-time, indefinite term

  • Work Model: 100% Remote

Rewards - What We Offer at Keyrus

• 100% remote work

  • International and multicultural projects
    • Opportunities to work with leading technologies in Data, Cloud, and AI ecosystems
    • Access to training programs and continuous professional development
    • Professional growth opportunities and internal mobility
    • A culture built on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning

About Keyrus

At Keyrus, we help organizations move from experimental to industrialized AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution.

As Architects of Intelligence, we design the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, embedding intelligence into business processes so that it creates sustainable, measurable value.

Powered by our proprietary Human Orchestrated Model™ (HOM), we architect reliable:

• Intelligence Foundations

With over 30 years of expertise and 3,000 experts across 30 countries, we build adaptive, resilient intelligent environments where technology amplifies human capability and performance compounds over time.

AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryThe Director, Country Deployment Lead USA, is responsible for leading the enterprise-wide deployment of Fresenius Kabi’s ELEVATE Global Template as part of the company’s strategic business transformation and SAP S/4HANA implementation under the #FutureFresenius initiative in the US.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Director, Country Deployment Lead USA, is responsible for leading the enterprise-wide deployment of Fresenius Kabi’s ELEVATE Global Template as part of the company’s strategic business transformation and SAP S/4HANA implementation under the #FutureFresenius initiative in the US. This role provides global leadership and governance for the successful rollout of standardized business processes, systems, and operating models across regions, countries, sites, and business units.

The Director serves as the primary bridge between global program leadership and country execution teams, ensuring alignment with transformation objectives while addressing local business, regulatory, validation, and operational requirements. This position drives deployment strategy, oversees cross-functional readiness activities, and directs business and IT resources through planning, testing, cutover, go-live, hyper care, and transition to sustained operations.

Working in close partnership with senior business leaders, Global Deployment Teams, Global Process Owners, IT, Validation, Change Management, and external implementation partners, the Director ensures consistent adoption of global standards, mitigates deployment risks, accelerates value realization, and delivers measurable business outcomes across the enterprise. This role is accountable for deployment excellence, stakeholder engagement, organizational readiness, and the successful execution of one of Fresenius Kabi’s most critical transformation initiatives.

*While this position may be worked remotely, priority will be given to Chicago area candidates.
*This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship either now or in the future.

• Salary Range: $170,000-190,000

• Position is eligible to participate in an annual bonus plan with a target of 16% of the base salary.
• Position is eligible to participate in our medium-term incentive plan.
• Final pay determinations will depend on various factors, including, but not limited to experience level, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities.
• Our benefits and programs are comprehensive and thoughtfully crafted to ensure our colleagues live healthy lives and have support when it matters most. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with company contributions, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, employee assistance program, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage.

Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic leadership for the end-to-end deployment of SAP S/4HANA and ELEVATE program solutions across assigned countries, business units, and deployment waves, ensuring successful execution from planning and localization through go-live, stabilization, and transition to support organizations.
  • Direct the translation of the approved Global Template into scalable deployment strategies and execution plans, balancing global standardization objectives with local business, regulatory, compliance, and operational requirements while maintaining governance over deviations and design integrity.
  • Establish and lead deployment governance frameworks, including decision-making structures, accountability models, readiness assessments, escalation pathways, quality controls, and performance monitoring to ensure consistent execution across global deployments.
  • Drive organizational readiness and adoption strategies by aligning business leaders, mobilizing regional, country and local resources, overseeing deployment planning activities, and ensuring effective training, communication, risk mitigation, and contingency planning.
  • Provide cross-functional leadership across Local Process Owners, IT, Validation, Data Migration, Testing, Integration, Change Management to ensure alignment, execution excellence, and achievement of deployment milestones and quality standards.
  • Oversee deployment quality and readiness, ensuring successful execution of data migration, integrations, security and authorization models, testing cycles, user acceptance testing, cutover preparations, and go-live readiness reviews in accordance with SAP S/4HANA standards and program governance requirements.
  • Lead enterprise cutover planning and execution activities, ensuring clear accountability, effective issue resolution, disciplined command-center operations, and informed go/no-go recommendations to senior program and business leadership.
  • Provide executive leadership during hypercare and stabilization phases, ensuring rapid issue resolution, business continuity, knowledge transfer, operational readiness, and successful transition to long-term support and sustainment organizations.
  • Proactively identify, assess, and manage deployment risks, issues, dependencies, and scope impacts, providing clear and concise reporting, recommendations, and escalation pathways to program leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Drive continuous improvement of deployment methodologies, governance processes, tools, templates, and best practices by capturing lessons learned and incorporating insights across successive deployment waves.
  • Champion ELEVATE program communications, engagement initiatives, and culture-building activities in partnership with Change Management to strengthen stakeholder alignment and transformation adoption.
  • Serve as a mentor and advisor to country and local deployment resources, building organizational capability and promoting best practices in large-scale ERP transformation and deployment management.
  • Ensure deployment activities meet applicable audit, validation, compliance, and regulatory requirements by maintaining appropriate documentation, controls, and evidence supporting program governance and quality standards.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in business administration, business informatics, IT management, industrial engineering or comparable field required; master’s degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of experience in ERP delivery, deployment management or transformation leadership within complex enterprise environments; 12+ years preferred for senior global scope.
  • Proven experience with SAP S/4HANA or large SAP ERP rollouts, ideally in multi-country, multi-site or multi-business environments.
  • Strong understanding of SAP landscape components, core S/4HANA processes/modules, data migration, testing, integrations, extensions, authorizations and cutover concepts.
  • Experience in Pharma/Life Science or another regulated/validated industry; familiarity with GxP, validation, quality gates and audit expectations is strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Clinical Associate - Medical Assistant
jobs.excerpt: Job Description This is a full-time, 40 hour/week role with working hours from M-F 9am-5:30pm ET.
jobs.description:
Job Description

This is a full-time, 40 hour/week role with working hours from M-F 9am-5:30pm ET.


Weekend Availability: This position will require weekend work based on business needs, operational priorities, or member demand. Team members will be provided advance notice whenever possible, and schedules will be communicated in accordance with organizational guidelines.


A bit about this role:

The Clinical Associate is an integral part of our interdisciplinary virtual-first medical practice called Devoted Medical (DM). Devoted Medical is focused on delivering multiple clinical services to our Devoted Health members including comprehensive wellness visits, transitions of care visits, monthly longitudinal visits for our most complex and frail members, and on-demand urgent care visits. This role may include occasional weekend hours, through optional overtime.


In the role of Clinical Associate, you will be a vital liaison between our healthcare services, providers, and Devoted members. You will work closely with our clinicians to provide high-touch telehealth visits, facilitate virtual patient onboarding, and proactively support our clinical team by identifying care gaps and navigating members through a fragmented healthcare system. This includes coordinating across primary care (PCP) offices and specialty networks, managing electronic prescription requests and pharmacy communications, driving referral workflows, and tracking durable medical equipment (DME), home health care, imaging, and laboratory orders through completion. Through these efforts, you will be a strong advocate for our members, eliminating barriers to care and improving adherence to care plans. At the end of the day, your goal in this position is to ensure that every member receives the prompt, empathetic, high-quality care that you would want for a beloved family member—driving measurable clinical outcomes and a superior member experience.


Responsibilities and Impact will include:

Responsibilities will vary based on the clinical program you will be supporting: Devoted Medical Primary Care Program, Devoted Medical Acute Care Program, and Devoted Medical Devoted to Me Program!


Order Management & Care Coordination

  • Collaborate with home health agencies to establish Start of Care (SOC) dates, process skilled nursing orders, and coordinate DME requests—tracking authorizations diligently until delivery is confirmed.
  • Coordinate member lab and diagnostic imaging orders, diligently tracking electronic results and documents to ensure timely clinician review and avoid backlogs or patient safety risks.
  • Manage inbound and outbound referral workflows, identifying high-quality in-network specialists and obtaining required clinical records or authorizations.
  • Assist with prescription refill requests, medication clarification routing, an
  • d adverse event/clinical inquiry escalation under provider guidance.
  • Coordinate with DM Providers on medical record collection, information gathering, setting up and confirming appointments, and submitting outbound communications from Devoted Medical.

Disclaimer: This role does not include clinical decision-making or any activity requiring licensure, and all clinical tasks are delegated by, and performed under the supervision of, licensed professionals. Clinical Associates should direct clinical concerns raised by members to the appropriate licensed team.


Quality Improvement & STARS/HEDIS Care Gap Closure

  • Review member panels and disease registries to identify and close preventive care gaps, including A1c control, blood pressure monitoring, Colorectal Cancer Screenings (CRC), Diabetic Retinal Eye Exams, Mammograms, and Kidney Health Evaluations.
  • Educate members on the importance of routine preventive screenings and coordinate in-home testing kits, mobile diagnostics, or clinic appointments to improve quality measures.

Member Advocacy & Communication

  • Serve as an advocate and reliable point of contact for members reaching out with care coordination needs via inbound calls, outreach queues, and digital messaging portals.
  • Break down complex medical instructions, plan benefits, and health system navigation into clear, compassionate, and easily understandable guidance for members and their families.
  • Review internal program referrals, initiate welcome outreach, and distribute educational materials and care kits.

Required skills and experience:

  • MA Certification (highly preferred); expired MA certifications are OK! Verification: A copy of your active or expired certification (CMA, RMA, CCMA) will be required. No Certification: If you have significant MA experience/background, we may request copies of your MA school diploma/transcripts if needed.
  • Two (2) years of patient-facing healthcare experience, with strong preference for experience in virtual care, outpatient ambulatory clinics, or telehealth settings.
  • Experience utilizing Electronic Health Record (EHR/EMR) systems (e.g., Epic, AthenaHealth, eClinicalWorks, Cerner) for clinical documentation and order tracking.
  • Thorough understanding of HIPAA regulations, patient privacy standards, and clinical documentation compliance.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Proven experience in care coordination and quality metric improvement, particularly assisting Medicare Advantage populations in closing STARS/HEDIS preventive care gaps (A1c, Colorectal Cancer, Diabetic Retinopathy, Mammography, KED and Blood Pressure).
  • Fully bilingual in English and Spanish (written and verbal communication) preferred
  • Highly organized and adaptable, able to prioritize and manage a high-volume member panel (100+ members) across multiple channels (Inbound, Outbound queues, Advanced Dialer, digital task queues, and CRM/case management workflows).
  • Prior experience with order workflows: DME authorization tracking, home health coordination, lab/imaging requisition follow-through, and specialist referral routing.

Attributes to success:

  • Agile & Growth-Minded: Thrive in a fast-paced, high-energy, and rapidly growing organization—adapting quickly to evolving business priorities, supporting process roll-outs within a given month or quarter, and maintaining composure through organizational shifts.
  • Empathetic Communicator: Skilled at de-escalating member anxiety, actively listening, and delivering warm, compassionate support to vulnerable seniors during stressful healthcare moments.
  • Strong Interdisciplinary Collaborator: Highly effective at communicating across diverse stakeholders, including physicians, advanced practice providers (APPs), registered nurses, community pharmacies, and family caregivers.
  • Versatile & Entrepreneurial: Self-starter who takes initiative and thrives as a collaborative team player—willing to be cross-trained to support sister teams across clinical programs and operational queues as needs arise.
  • Tech-Savvy Learner: Quick to adopt and navigate modern tech tools, dual-monitor workflows, electronic health records, Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs), AI-assisted documentation tools, CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), and automated telephony/dialer systems.
  • Mission-Driven: Deeply committed to delivering healthcare with the same quality, urgency, and heart you would expect for your own family.

Salary Range:

$23.00 – $27.00 / hour

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

Overview

Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success. Our dynamic community of experts is fully committed to advancing our customers' missions, fostering professional growth, and making a positive impact on our communities.

By joining our supportive community, you will find that Kentro is dedicated to your personal and professional development. Together, we can drive meaningful change, spark innovation, and achieve extraordinary milestones.

Kentro is hiring for a Remote Business Process Consultant to support the VA ESOM contract. The Business Process Consultant (BPC) / Business Analyst (BA) serves as the primary bridge between VA business stakeholders and the ESOM ServiceNow delivery teams. Working across ITSM, CSM, ITOM, and the VA ESM platform, this role is responsible for eliciting and translating complex process requirements into well-defined platform solutions, managing the product backlog in partnership with Scrum Masters and developers, and ensuring delivered capabilities align with validated business outcomes. The ideal candidate brings 5-8 years of business analysis experience in enterprise ServiceNow environments and a working knowledge of ITIL frameworks, VA IT service management practices, and Agile delivery.

Location: Remote - This position can be performed remotely within the United States and will support Eastern Time working hours.

Compensation Range: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $125,000 –$145,000 annually and reflects Kentro’s good-faith expectations at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined based on the role’s requirements, relevant skills, experience, education, certifications, work location, applicable security clearance requirements, market conditions, internal equity, and contract requirements.

This Job Description reflects the primary duties of the role; however, it is not intended to be all‑inclusive. Team members may be asked to take on additional responsibilities in alignment with customer expectations, business needs, and Kentro’s culture of collaboration and adaptability.


Responsibilities

  • Partner with VA stakeholders, product owners, and platform teams to elicit, document, and prioritize requirements across ITSM, CSM, ITOM, SPM, and platform operations.
  • Lead process discovery and gap analysis sessions, producing clear process maps, user stories, and acceptance criteria suitable for sprint execution.
  • Own and manage the product backlog in collaboration with the Scrum Master and development team, ensuring stories are well-defined and sprint-ready.
  • Actively participate in all Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, representing the business perspective throughout.
  • Translate business processes into functional specifications, workflow diagrams, and ServiceNow configuration requirements.
  • Validate delivered solutions against defined acceptance criteria and facilitate UAT with VA business stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization and platform-native automation within the VA ESM ServiceNow environment.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on ServiceNow capabilities, advising stakeholders on platform-native solutions versus custom development.
  • Manage and communicate project status, risks, and dependencies across both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Contribute to BA standards, templates, and documentation best practices in support of program-wide quality and consistency.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or equivalent. 8 years of relevant experience may be substituted for the education requirement for a total of 13+ years of relevant experience.
  • 5 years of experience as a Business Process Consultant, Business Analyst, or equivalent role supporting enterprise IT platforms.
  • Hands-on experience working on ServiceNow implementations or enhancements across ITSM, CSM, and/or ITOM modules.
  • Strong Agile/Scrum experience including active participation in Scrum ceremonies, backlog management, and sprint execution.
  • Proven ability to write clear, testable user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
  • Experience facilitating requirements workshops and process mapping sessions with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong working knowledge of ITIL frameworks and IT service management concepts.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with demonstrated ability to translate between business and technical audiences.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and diagramming tools (Lucidchart, Visio, or equivalent).

 Preferred Qualifications: 

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or equivalent platform familiarity sufficient to demo and validate configurations.
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe, or equivalent Agile certification.
  • ITIL Foundation v4 certification or higher.
  • Familiarity with CMDB, CSDM, or ITOM service mapping concepts.
  • Background in process improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma.
  • Prior experience on federal IT programs or within a VA or DHS enterprise ServiceNow environment.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale ServiceNow instances (10,000+ users).

Clearance Requirement:

  • US Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident (Green Card)
  • Willing and able to obtain and maintain Public Trust Clearance
  • Must meet updated ID requirements:
    • If you do not currently meet the ID requirements outlined, you must be willing and able to update your current forms of ID in a timely manner to complete the suitability process successfully.

Benefits

The Company

We believe in generating success collaboratively, enabling long-term mission success, and building trust for the next challenge. With you as our partner, let’s solve challenges, think innovatively, and maximize impact. As a valued member of our team, you have the unique opportunity to work in a diverse range of technology and business career paths, all while supporting our nation and delivering innovative technology solutions. We are a close community of experts that pride ourselves on creating an environment defined by teamwork, dedication, and excellence.

We hold three ISO certifications (27001:2013, 20000-1:2011, 9001:2015), two CMMI ML 3 ratings (DEV and SVC) and CMMC Level 2 Certification.

Industry Recognition

Culture | Northern Virginia Technology Council Tech 100 Honoree; Virginia Best Place to Work; Washington Business Journal: Best Places to Work, Corporate Diversity Index Winner – Mid-Size Companies, Companies Owned by People of Color; Department of Labor’s HireVets for our work helping veterans transition; SECAF Award of Excellence finalist; Victory Military Friendly Brand; Virginia Values Veterans (V3); Cystic Fibrosis Foundation Corporate Breath Award

We invest in our employees – Every employee is eligible for education reimbursement for certifications, degrees, or professional development. Reimbursement amounts may fluctuate due to IRS limitations. We want you to grow as an expert and a leader and offer flexibility for you to take a course, complete a certification, or other professional growth and networking.   • You have a strong understanding of data products, analytics and measurement, with the ability to translate complex data into meaningful business outcomes.

  • You are technically fluent enough to collaborate effectively with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Analysts and software engineers while understanding and challenging technical requirements.

  • You have a working understanding of SQL, data modelling, reporting or BI tools. Hands-on expertise is beneficial but not essential.

  • You demonstrate strong stakeholder management and can confidently navigate competing priorities across technical and commercial teams.

  • You understand advertising performance and commercial measurement, and you are focused on delivering measurable value rather than simply shipping features.

  • Previous experience as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist or Analytics Engineer.

  • Familiarity with digital advertising and auction mechanics.

  • Exposure to Retail Media, AdTech or marketing analytics.

In order to provide our employees with the best possible support for their individual needs, we offer a wide range of benefits:

  • Sports & Health: Your well-being is our top priority. Therefore, we offer you a range of opportunities to improve your health. Profit from a membership (M) package at Urban Sports Club, providing a variety of sports offers tailored to your interests.

About Redcare Pharmacy:
As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision “Until every human has their health”. If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values join us and start your #Redcareer today.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to help shape the data, measurement and auction strategy supporting Redcare Pharmacy’s Retail Media business. As our Retail Media business grows, we are investing in scalable capabilities that improve how campaigns are delivered, measured and optimised. This includes evolving our auction strategy, strengthening advertising data flows, and developing reliable reporting and attribution.

With our Retail Media data being consolidated into our Unified Data Platform, the next step is to turn this foundation into trusted measurement, reporting and decision-making products. You’ll play a key role in defining and delivering these products, working closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Analysts, software engineers and commercial stakeholders. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About us

Fever is the leading global live-entertainment discovery platform, helping millions of people every month find and enjoy the best experiences in their cities. We combine technology, data and creativity to power experiences in hundreds of cities worldwide, and we work with creators and partners to bring them to life.

The Data and AI team sits at the core of Fever's data-driven philosophy, driving how Fever makes rigorous decisions and builds bleeding-edge technology. We are growing a new group of Design Engineers who will design and build across all of Fever's products, from B2C to B2B, using data to guide every decision and making those products not just correct, but delightful, fast and genuinely useful.

About the role

Think. Design. Build. If that's how you like to work, this role could be for you.

As a Design Engineer you'll shape Fever products end to end, from B2C to B2B: understanding the problem, defining the solution and designing it with real craft. Some projects will end in a polished design. In others, the right call is to take it into code, whether that's a working prototype or a production-ready feature you ship yourself. You'll move comfortably across both, choosing what each problem needs.

What you'll do

  • Work on high-impact projects across Fever: discovery surfaces like the feed and our AI-powered assistant, critical reports and data-driven decision-making tools for our partners and internal teams, immersive funnels, and innovative initiatives that drive the business and raise the quality of our products.
  • Frame problems with users and PMs, decide what's worth building and validate your own hypotheses with data (SQL, dashboards, metrics).
  • Design and prototype interfaces for any Fever product, from B2C to B2B, with a high bar for craft.
  • When it makes sense, take your designs into code, from working prototypes to production-ready features, and work with engineers through GitHub, development and production environments.
  • Use AI as part of your everyday workflow to explore more ideas, prototype and move faster.

About you

  • Experience: 8+ years of experience in product design, with a strong background and solid knowledge of front-end development.
  • Product thinker: you know what building product means, starting from user problems, business needs and impact rather than features, and you can explain your trade-offs.

  • Strong front-end: solid HTML/CSS, responsive layouts and design systems, plus JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern framework such as React. You feel at home with Git, pull requests and dev/prod environments.
  • Data-fluent: you're comfortable using SQL, dashboards and metrics to test your ideas and make decisions.
  • Technologist: you love technology and building software, and you always want to understand the why behind things.
  • AI-native with judgment: you've adopted AI as a superpower, not an obligation. You verify what it produces, protect sensitive data and never ship code you don't understand.

jobs.excerpt: For 30 years, Surgical Information Systems (SIS) has empowered surgical providers to Operate Smart™ by delivering innovative software and services that drive clinical, financial, and operational success.
jobs.description:
For 30 years, Surgical Information Systems (SIS) has empowered surgical providers to Operate Smart™ by delivering innovative software and services that drive clinical, financial, and operational success. For ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs), SIS provides comprehensive software and services, including ASC management, electronic health records (EHRs), patient engagement capabilities, compliance technology, and revenue cycle management and transcription services, all built specifically for ASCs. For hospital perioperative teams, SIS offers an easy-to-use anesthesia information management system (AIMS).

Serving over 2,900 surgical facilities, SIS is committed to delivering solutions that enable surgical providers to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional patient care and outcomes.

Recognized as the No. 1 ASC EHR vendor by Black Book for 11 consecutive years and honored with the Best in KLAS Award for ASC Solutions in 2026, 2025, 2023, and 2022, SIS remains the trusted choice for surgical providers seeking to enhance their performance.

Discover how SIS can help you Operate Smart™ at sisfirst.com.

Surgical Information Systems (SIS) is seeking a Chief Marketing Officer to lead marketing across its healthcare SaaS and revenue cycle management portfolio. As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, the CMO will prioritize product marketing—strengthening positioning, packaging, pricing, launches, and sales enablement—while advancing the SIS brand and driving pipeline, revenue growth, and customer engagement. The CMO will align Marketing, Sales, Product, and Customer Success around a unified go-to-market strategy. Partnering with the Chief Growth Officer, you will set market direction, messaging, and enablement strategy while supporting sales execution and revenue delivery. The role also presents marketing strategy, performance, and investment recommendations to the Board of Directors.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Go-to-Market and Product Marketing

  • Lead go-to-market strategy for SIS, owning its creation and execution for new and existing products, services, and market segments. Establish target customer profiles, positioning, launch plans, and measures of success, and align marketing, sales, product, and customer success against them.
  • Lead product marketing for the full SIS portfolio, including product positioning, value propositions, buyer-specific messaging, competitive differentiation, and launch readiness.
  • Own pricing and packaging recommendations in partnership with the CEO, product, and finance leaders, informed by market research, competitive intelligence, and customer feedback.
  • Direct market research, competitive intelligence, and customer insights to identify growth opportunities and inform product strategy and investment decisions with business leaders.
  • Lead sales enablement, ensuring the sales team has clear value propositions, buyer-specific messaging, customer evidence, and tools that support the sales process.

Executive Leadership and Marketing Strategy

  • Set the enterprise marketing vision, annual plan, and long-term priorities in support of SIS business strategy and growth objectives. Serve as the executive voice of the market and customer in company decisions.
  • Present to the Board of Directors on market opportunities, brand strategy, marketing performance, and return on investment. Recommend priorities, resources, and adjustments based on results.
  • Partner with the Chief Growth Officer, who leads the sales organization, to translate go-to-market strategy into pipeline goals, customer acquisition, and expansion priorities. The CMO owns go-to-market strategy, messaging, and enablement content; the Chief Growth Officer owns sales execution and quota attainment.

Brand and Corporate Communications

  • Own SIS brand strategy, positioning, and standards, including leading brand evolution or rebranding from research and brand architecture through messaging, visual identity, rollout, and measurement, aligning internal and external audiences.
  • Direct corporate communications, public relations, analyst relations, thought leadership, and executive visibility. Partner with executive leadership on reputation management and sensitive external communications.

Demand Generation and Customer Marketing

  • Oversee integrated demand generation across digital, content, email, search, social media, events, account-based marketing, and partner channels to generate qualified pipeline and support revenue goals.
  • Align with sales on lead qualification, handoffs, conversion, and pipeline reporting. Adjust campaign and channel investment based on performance and customer acquisition costs.
  • Partner with customer success, product, and sales to strengthen customer engagement, advocacy, retention, and expansion through education, customer stories, reference programs, and lifecycle marketing.

Marketing Operations and Investment

  • Own the marketing budget, resource allocation, and agency investments. Balance near-term growth needs with long-term brand development and demonstrate financial discipline.
  • Set performance measures for marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline, revenue contribution, conversion, acquisition efficiency, brand awareness, and customer engagement. Provide clear reporting and use results to improve execution.
  • Oversee marketing operations, technology, automation, analytics, and data quality. Establish consistent processes and responsible use of customer data in partnership with IT and other stakeholders.
  • Ensure marketing claims, content, and data practices meet healthcare regulatory and customer requirements, including HIPAA and the protection of patient information, in partnership with Legal, Compliance, and IT.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop the marketing team, which reports directly to the CMO and translates strategy into coordinated execution. Set priorities, expectations, and accountability for the marketing organization.
  • Build the team’s capabilities, succession plans, and operating structure, including product marketing depth. Oversee agency and vendor relationships and promote effective collaboration across SIS business units.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: Assess current product positioning, the competitive landscape, the marketing team, and results to date. Align with the CEO and Chief Growth Officer on go-to-market priorities and the metrics used to measure marketing’s contribution.
  • By month 6: Deliver refreshed positioning and messaging for priority products, a sales enablement program in active use by the sales team, and a marketing plan and budget tied to agreed pipeline targets.
  • By month 12: Execute go-to-market and launch plans for priority products and segments, show measurable growth in marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline, and have the right team structure and capabilities in place.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred.
  • 15 or more years of progressive marketing experience, including significant senior leadership responsibility for a broad marketing function in a B2B SaaS, technology, or services business. Healthcare technology experience preferred.
  • Proven leadership of product marketing, including product launches, positioning, competitive differentiation, and pricing and packaging input, ideally in healthcare technology.
  • Proven success creating and executing go-to-market strategies in close partnership with sales, building qualified pipeline, and delivering measurable revenue growth across multiple products or services.
  • Experience presenting to boards and executive teams, managing budgets, and leading senior marketing leaders through organizational change.
  • Experience leading a company rebrand or brand repositioning from strategy through implementation, with demonstrated results in brand positioning, market recognition, or business performance, strongly preferred.

Knowledge and Leadership Skills

  • Strong command of product marketing, go-to-market strategy, brand strategy, demand generation, customer marketing, communications, and marketing operations.
  • Commercial and financial judgment; ability to turn market insights and analytics into clear investment decisions and measurable priorities.
  • Clear executive communication, sound judgment, and the ability to influence across functions.

Benefit package including:

  • Medical, Vision, Dental, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Vacation/Sick time
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid Holidays
  • SIS Cares Day

Academic Success Manager


Are you skilled in driving meaningful engagement to achieve client success?

The Academic Success Manager (ASM) is responsible for driving customer retention, renewals and account growth for Elsevier Health's education solutions across Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and South Korea.

With a primary focus on protecting and renewing existing business and identifying upselling opportunities, the ASM works closely with academic institutions to ensure successful adoption, continued engagement and value realization of Elsevier's education solutions. Serving as a trusted advisor to universities, medical schools, nursing schools and other healthcare education institutions, the ASM builds strong relationships with academic stakeholders, supports faculty enablement and demonstrates the ongoing value of Elsevier's solutions.

Position Title

Care Management NurseDays - Full TimeBroadmoor Campus, Remote

The Care Management Nurse provides intervention for patients enrolled in the care management program; develops comprehensive plan of care for patient's individual needs that transition across the health care delivery system.Responsibilities and Essential Job Functions
  • Accurately gathers and interprets information obtained to identify patients suitable for effective intensive care management intervention.
  • Develops relationships with patients enrolled in the care management program and competently uses assessment skills to identify physical, psycho-social, financial, and environmental health care needs of the patient.
  • Assesses and identifies appropriate resource utilization, level of care, and treatment options to develop a comprehensive plan of care that is specific to the member’s individual needs with the goal of optimizing the member’s health status, self-management, and promotion of safe transitions of care.   • Collaborates with the clinical staff in the development and execution of the plans of care and achievement of goals.
  • Researches, secures, and links resources, services and supports with/for the patient and family.
  • Coordinates care of patients, focusing in particular on transitions of care across the healthcare delivery system.
  • Utilizing available electronic tools, such as EMR, to efficiently document assessments, clinical finds, multiple and completed needs, plans of treatment and progress toward goals.
  • Actively participates in safety initiatives and risk mitigating measures where appropriate and completes all position safety related competencies and requirements on a timely basis.
  • Must be able to perform the professional, clinical and or technical competencies of the assigned unit or department.

  • High School Graduate

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Als zentrale technische Ansprechperson baust du eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung zu deinen Kunden auf und berätst sie rund um das Thema IT-Sicherheit

Erfahrung:

  • Zusätzlich hast du mindestens 3 Jahre in der System-, Netzwerk- oder Cloud-Administration gearbeitet
  • Du kennst dich bestens mit IT-Netzwerken, Netzwerksicherheit, Cloud-Infrastruktur und SaaS-Lösungen aus
  • Risikomanagement und Schwachstellenbewertung gehören zu deinem Repertoire
  • Kommunikation liegt dir – schriftlich wie mündlich, auf Deutsch und Englisch
  • Mit Kunden pflegst du professionelle Beziehungen und verstehst es, Vertrauen aufzubauen

Technische Kenntnisse in mind. 4 der Bereiche:

  • Netzwerksicherheit: Umfassendes Wissen in Netzwerkarchitekturen, Firewalls, IDS/IPS und VPN-Technologien
  • Betriebssysteme: Du bist versiert in der Härtung von Windows-, Linux- und Unix-Systemen
  • Verschlüsselung: Gängige Verfahren und Protokolle sind dir vertraut
  • Penetrationstests: Die Auswertung von Pentests liegt dir, ebenso wie die anschließende Beratung
  • Sicherheitstools: Der Umgang mit SIEM, SOAR, EDR, UTM und Honeypots ist dir vertraut
  • Cloud Security: Du verstehst die Sicherheitsmechanismen moderner Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS, Azure)
  • Security Frameworks: Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse von Frameworks wie MITRE ATT&CK und NIST
  • Vulnerability Assessment: Umgang mit Tools wie Nmap, Nessus oder OpenVAS.

Beratungskompetenz:

  • Im Risikomanagement kannst du Risiken fundiert bewerten und Maßnahmen kundenorientiert ableiten
  • Du entwickelst Sicherheitsstrategien, die auf die Geschäftsziele deiner Kunden abgestimmt sind
  • Auch komplexe Sachverhalte bringst du klar auf den Punkt – besonders im Austausch mit nicht-technischen Ansprechpartnern

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr
  • Hochwertige technische Ausstattung (Mac) und ein modernes Büro im Herzen Frankfurts oder komplett aus dem Home Office heraus
  • Vielfältige Weiterbildungsangebote und Unterstützung bei Zertifizierungen

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf – gern ergänzt durch Referenzen oder Arbeitsproben. Werde Teil eines der innovativsten und am schnellsten wachsenden Cybersecurity-Unternehmen weltweit.

When every company can compete, the market changes. Candidates have more options and employers can compete, and win, on what actually matters. Rockstar is laying the foundation for an employment system that works, one where it’s easy for wonderful companies to build winning teams, and where every single person has the opportunity to build an extraordinary career.

About the Role

Rockstar is looking for a hungry, high-potential Growth Associate to help run its go-to-market engine. This is a part-time role requiring approximately 10–15 hours per week. Rockstar is looking for someone who can manage their time effectively, work independently, and consistently deliver results within that commitment. The job is to take ownership of existing growth initiatives, from LinkedIn outreach to reactivation campaigns, and turn them into repeatable systems that consistently generate business. Rockstar is open to folks from a variety of backgrounds and will teach the platform, processes, and tools. What matters most is how the candidate thinks, how quickly they learn, and what they do when given ownership of a problem.

What You’ll Do

Own Customer Acquisition

  • Run LinkedIn and email outreach campaigns, from prospecting and connection requests to follow-ups and ongoing engagement
  • Manage the prospect pipeline and ensure opportunities are tracked and followed through

Own Reactivation Channels

  • Run campaigns to re-engage existing and past clients and uncover business opportunities
  • Execute repeatable processes that turn client relationships into a consistent source of business

Who You Are

  • Hungry and driven: You want to do great work, take on responsibility, and see the results of your efforts. You are willing to put in the work, including the unglamorous parts.
  • Smart and resourceful: You learn quickly, think critically, and can figure things out even when there’s no obvious answer.
  • Analytical and curious: You want to understand why something works, not just whether it does. You notice patterns, ask good questions, and look for ways to improve.
  • Organized and reliable: You can juggle recurring responsibilities, manage details, and make sure important things don’t slip through the cracks.
  • A strong communicator: You can write clearly and communicate proactively.

You don’t need prior experience in growth, sales, or marketing. Rockstar is open to candidates from any background and cares much more about potential, work ethic, and ability to learn than resume.

What Rockstar Is Looking For

  • 1–3 years of work experience. Exposure to growth, sales, marketing, or business development is a plus but is not required.
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to write clear, engaging, and natural-sounding messages.
  • Availability for some overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) to coordinate with the team and support time-sensitive growth activities.

What You’ll Gain

jobs.description:
*CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED IN THE UNITED STATES OR CANADA**

About SafelyYou

SafelyYou’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person-centered care across senior living through world-leading AI, industry-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities.

Originating in 2015 as the doctoral research of CEO George Netscher—and inspired by his own family's experience with Alzheimer's disease—SafelyYou was spun out of UC Berkeley’s Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, one of the top five AI research groups in the world. And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. All helping ensure that communities can focus on improved care for residents while still reaching their financial goals.

SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation.

Your Role at SafelyYou

As an API Architect at SafelyYou, you will be responsible for designing, building, and operating our core backend services and platform infrastructure. You will be the primary architect and technical owner of the External Data API, designing and improving the critical bridge between SafelyYou's data systems and our customers.

This is a fully remote, senior-level role. You are expected to bring stories of ways that APIs have gone well and poorly, technical expertise, operate with minimal guidance, and proactively mentor other engineers while shaping the future of our data and API platforms.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the design, development, and operation of scalable APIs, microservices, and backend platform infrastructure using Python and AWS.

  • Own the architecture, continuous improvement, and lifecycle of the External Data API, serving as the technical bridge between our internal data systems and our customers.

  • Support and evolve data governance tooling including registries and data dictionaries, such as the Event Registry. Establishing patterns and best practices for schema governance, versioning, documentation, and compatibility as our architecture evolves.

  • Support and evolve internal APIs used to provide information from data systems to applications built by other SafelyYou engineers, such as the feature enablement cache. Providing documentation, implementation examples, and support while enforcing best practices and driving adoption.

  • Architect and implement streaming data pipelines, driving the transition from batch processing to real-time data streaming architectures.

  • Draft and maintain comprehensive Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), API specifications, and system documentation to establish robust engineering patterns.

  • Improve developer workflow and experience by optimizing CI/CD pipelines, updating repository documentation, and establishing best practices.

  • Introduce and leverage AI agent workflows to enhance engineering efficiency and keep the team updated on industry trends.

  • Develop AI skills that third-parties may use when interacting with SafelyYou APIs and data products.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical strategy with business goals, supporting new product launches and cross-team tiger initiatives.

  • Mentor team members, share deep technical expertise, and participate in on-call rotations to ensure high availability of critical services.

  • This is a hands-on development role. You will be expected to not only drive architecture and best practices, but will also be hands-on in implementing and supporting the systems you design.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in software, backend, or platform engineering, preferably in a startup environment.

  • Deep expertise in designing, building, operating, and scaling RESTful APIs, web services, and distributed backend systems.

  • Experience with designing and implementing API gateways and management systems such as Kong Hybrid, Apigee, Gravitee, or other similar systems. Have strong opinions around authentication, routing, policy enforcement, observability and deployment of these solutions.

  • Strong programming proficiency in Python, with a focus on writing clean, scalable, and maintainable backend code.

  • Proven experience with streaming data architecture and technologies (e.g. Kafka, AWS Kinesis, Spark Streaming). Experience making architectural and cost trade offs between batch streaming and synchronous processing.

  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and light DevOps practices, including containerization and deployment tools (e.g., Kubernetes, Helm charts).

  • Strong technical communication skills with a track record of writing ADRs, API specs, and comprehensive architectural documentation.

  • Experience managing CI/CD pipelines and improving developer environments.

  • Prioritize quality over speed. When it is done, it is really done.

The Ideal Candidate:

  • Hands-on experience with modern AI-assisted and agentic development workflows, including coding agents, MCP, AI pair programming, and LLM-powered research

  • Advanced proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools, such as Terraform.

  • Experience designing data models and architectures across ETL/ELT, warehouses, lakehouses, event-driven systems, and backend APIs and how these intersect with backend API design. With strong foundations in data quality, reliability, governance, and scalability.

  • Experience with electronic health records (EHR), healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR, and associated data privacy regulations such as HIPAA.

  • Experience with remote work and distributed, async-first engineering teams.

Why Join Us? You Can Make a Difference!

Salary Range:$190-210k base USD / $180-200k base CDNdepending on experience, plus a bonus plan, stock options and benefits.

SafelyYou offers a competitive compensation package, including but not limited to:

  • A mission-driven company culture

  • Fully remote

  • Competitive salary & benefits, including fully paid employee premiums for Medical, Dental, and Vision

  • 401k Program

  • Monthly Education, Well-being & WFH stipends

  • Non-accrual PTO

  • Growth Potential

  • Company Retreats

  • Medical & Family/Parental Leave

At SafelyYou, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace makes us a more relevant, competitive, and resilient company. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce that celebrates diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

We value all the perspectives our team members bring to the table, and that is why we don’t look for culture fit, but culture add. We want to hear from YOU! We encourage you to apply even if you do not fit 100% of the technical requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise.
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer who thrives at the intersection of data, AI, and complex enterprise architecture. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the data challenges of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, deliver compelling data-driven demonstrations, and support enterprise Proof of Concepts that showcase measurable business outcomes.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion for transforming how organizations use data — from raw ingestion to real-time analytics to AI-powered applications. You thrive in a dynamic environment, are equally comfortable whiteboarding a medallion architecture with a data engineering team and presenting data ROI to a C-suite, and you bring deep opinions about what good data platform design looks like.

Location Requirement: Must be in North Carolina or South Carolina.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Present Snowflake's Data Cloud vision to data engineering leaders, analytics teams, data scientists, and executive stakeholders at prospects and customers

  • Lead hands-on technical discovery to map a customer's existing data architecture — pipelines, warehouses, lakehouses, governance gaps — and design a Snowflake-native path forward

  • Build and deliver tailored demos and proof of concepts across Snowflake's full data platform: data engineering (Snowpark, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe), AI/ML (Cortex AI, ML model registry), and data sharing (Data Clean Rooms, Marketplace listings)

  • Guide customers through modern data architecture patterns including Data Mesh, Data Lakehouse, real-time streaming pipelines, and unified governance frameworks

  • Translate ambiguous business problems — churn prediction, supply chain visibility, financial consolidation, operational analytics — into concrete Snowflake data solutions

  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Field teams to feed customer data architecture patterns back into the product roadmap

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 3–8 years of industry experience, in a pre-sales or solutions architecture role focused on data platforms

  • Deep hands-on expertise with SQL, Python, and cloud data warehouse / data lakehouse architectures; able to write working code in a customer session without hesitation

  • Broad experience across the modern data stack: ETL/ELT tools (dbt, Fivetran, Informatica, Spark), streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis), orchestration (Airflow, dbt Cloud), BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI), and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Proven ability to conduct deep data architecture discovery — understanding a customer's source systems, transformation layers, consumption patterns, and governance requirements — and connect those findings to a Snowflake reference architecture

  • Experience positioning AI and ML capabilities within a data platform context: feature stores, model training pipelines, LLM-powered applications, and AI governance

  • Strong intuition for data governance, quality, and compliance challenges (GDPR, CCPA, PCI) and how platform design decisions affect them

  • Ability to quantify the business value of a modern data architecture — cost reduction, time-to-insight, pipeline reliability, data product monetization

  • A demonstrated track record using AI code generation tools to accelerate prototyping and proof-of-concept delivery

  • University degree in computer science, data science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's in Data Science or Business Analytics is a plus

  • Experience working with GSIs (EY, Deloitte, Accenture, Slalom, etc.) on large data platform programs is beneficial but not required

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

  • $220,000 - $288,000 OTE (On Target Earnings = Base Salary + Commission/Quota)

  • Snowflake offers competitive base salary, variable compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits including 401(k), health/dental/vision, flexible PTO, and professional development budget.

ABOUT OUR TEAM:

Our Solution Engineers are customer-obsessed data practitioners. We believe in rigorous discovery before prescribing solutions, we stay honest about what Snowflake can and can't do, and we hold ourselves accountable to outcomes — not just demos. We love to learn, give and receive direct feedback, and are relentless about making our customers' data more accessible, reliable, and valuable. If you have strong opinions about data architecture and enjoy proving them with working code, you'll fit right in.

ABOUT SNOWFLAKE:

Snowflake started with a clear vision: make modern data warehousing effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. Today the Snowflake Data Cloud goes far beyond warehousing — it's where organizations build data pipelines, run ML workloads, share live data across the ecosystem, and power AI applications, all on a single governed platform. Our built-for-the-cloud architecture delivers the performance of a data warehouse, the flexibility of a data lake, and the elasticity of the cloud at a fraction of traditional costs.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information:

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • This role is eligible to participate in Snowflake's commission plan and it is common for employees in this role to receive total on-target earnings of $220,000 - $288,750. The estimated base salary for this role is $165,000 - $216,562.
  • Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s equity plan.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending & health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

jobs.excerpt: Wir sind eine schnell wachsende Marketing-Agentur aus Frankfurt und suchen neue Mitarbeiter (m/w/d), die uns Remote in den Bereichen Grafikdesign und Mediengestaltung Digital & Print unterstützen!
jobs.description:
Wir sind eine schnell wachsende Marketing-Agentur aus Frankfurt und suchen neue Mitarbeiter (m/w/d), die uns Remote in den Bereichen Grafikdesign und Mediengestaltung Digital & Print unterstützen!

Was macht die Roman Mayer GmbH genau?

Wir sind eine Marketing-Agentur, die Werbekampagnen für bekannte Coaches, Berater, Experten und Personenmarken konzipiert. Unser Fokus liegt dabei auf der Erstellung von Werbetexten für Websites, Print-Marketing, E-Mail-Marketing, Büchern und Social Media.

Aufgabengebiete:

  • Als Teil unseres Teams kreierst du zielgruppengerechten Content für unsere Kunden sowie unsere eigenen Kommunikationskanäle, sowohl online als auch offline.

  • Du orientierst dich dabei an vorgegebenem Corporate Design und Branding und bringst deine Kreativität ein, um bei der Entwicklung neuer Kampagnen mitzuwirken.

  • Erstellung von Print-Objekten, u.a. Broschüren, Flyer, Verpackungen, Bücher, Postkarten, etc.

Wenn du weitere Informationen zu unserem Unternehmen und deiner Karriere bei der Roman Mayer GmbH haben möchtest, findest du diese auf .

Gehalt Grafikdesigner/-in (m/w/d): 3.500 Euro pro Monat (brutto)

Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten in den nächsten Jahren sind vorhanden.

Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme.

  • Gute Vergütung: Deine Arbeit wird bei uns fair und leistungsgerecht bezahlt.

  • Tolles Team: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig, Bestleistungen zu erzielen und persönlich zu wachsen.

  • Spannendes Aufgabenfeld: Bei uns arbeitest du an spannenden Werbekampagnen für einige der größten Personenmarken im deutschsprachigen Raum.

  • 100 % Remote: Du wählst deinen Arbeitsort frei und arbeitest dort, wo du am konzentriertesten und produktivsten bist.

  • Gleitzeit: Neben einer festen Kernzeit für die Abstimmung im Team teilst du dir deine Arbeitszeit flexibel ein. So arbeitest du dann, wenn du am leistungsfähigsten und produktivsten bist.

  • Erstklassige Ausstattung: Du bekommst von uns ein MacBook und moderne Technik gestellt. So hast du alles, was du brauchst, um produktiv zu arbeiten.

Requirements

Stellenanforderungen:

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium / Ausbildung oder bist Autodidakt und hast bereits Erfahrungen in einer Agentur oder in einer selbstständigen Tätigkeit gesammelt.

  • Du hast bereits umfassende Kenntnisse der Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom, inDesign...).

  • Du hast bereits mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Mediengestaltung/Grafikdesign und weißt wie du neue Ideen und Konzepte im Corporate Design umsetzt.

  • Du bist kreativ, teamfähig und hast ein Gespür für Details.

  • Du hast eine saubere und fehlerfreie Ausdrucksform in Deutsch.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, organisierst & finalisierst eigene Projekte termingerecht.

  • Du hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und hohe Disziplin.

  • Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, bestehenden Prozessen zu folgen.

  • Vorkenntnisse in den Themen Online-Marketing, Coaching, Beratung etc. sind von Vorteil, aber nicht notwendig.

Wenn die Stellenbeschreibung dein Interesse geweckt hat, klicke einfach auf den Bewerben-Button, fülle das Formular aus, und schicke deine Bewerbung ab. Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen!
