jobs.title: SVP,  Enrollment
jobs.excerpt: Who is American College of Education Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs.
jobs.description:
Who is American College of Education

Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs. The mission of ACE is to deliver high-quality, affordable, and accessible online programs grounded in evidence-based content, real-world experience and relevant application that places our students’ needs first.

ACE is a mission-driven institution continually recognized for its commitment to social responsibility and positive impact. As an Impact Institution, we believe we have a responsibility to our students, alumni, employees, communities, and society as a whole. Guided by our core values, we strive to create meaningful impact that extends well beyond our bottom line.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please note that all official communication will only come from our verified company email domain @Rippling.com

Who You Are

You are passionate about helping students achieve their educational goals. You thrive in a competitive and

collaborative team environment. You are comfortable working remotely and have experience collaborating

with others in a virtual environment. You possess a strong attention to detail.

As the Senior Vice President (SVP) of Enrollment, you are responsible driving enrollment growth and building

a high-performing, scalable enrollment organization at ACE. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will own the

student acquisition journey from lead through enrollment, including Enrollment Operations and related

enrollment support functions, with leadership responsibility for an organization of approximately 70

employees.

You will be accountable for achieving ACE’s enrollment growth objectives while continuously improving

conversion, productivity, service levels, and the prospective student experience. You possess the ability to

anticipate prospective student needs, define service standards, and measure experience quality. You will

combine deep enrollment expertise with strong operating discipline, evolving ACE’s processes, systems,

organizational structure, and capabilities as the institution scales.

You will work closely with the CMO to optimize lead quality and funnel performance, with the CIO and IT

organization to ensure technology and data enable enrollment performance, and with other functional

leaders across ACE to drive coordinated execution.

Compensation

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high quality,

affordable programs for our students. The starting salary range for this position is $175,000 plus all full-time

employees are eligible for an annual bonus. Offers vary depending on education, prior experience, and

expertise being applied to the role.

What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate

  • Demonstrates self-reliance by meeting/exceeding workflow needs.
  • Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills.
  • Follows established processes as outlined by organization and leadership.
  • Completes assigned duties based on daily business needs and individual skill set.
  • Consistently produces a high volume of quality work.
  • Capable, adapts as needed, to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proven ability to work independently with limited supervision and with other department personnel.
  • Must support and embrace the College’s Impact mission to improve the people and communities we serve through our civic engagement initiatives.
  • Must have exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills.
  • Must be "self-motivated" as well as creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time-critical problems.
  • Must be collaborative in driving decisions and a team-player.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
  • Builds and maintains student satisfaction.
  • Recognizes and anticipates student needs.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

In this role you will wear different hats, but your skills will be especially essential in the following areas:

  • Develop and execute the College's enrollment strategy to achieve enrollment growth and long-term institutional objectives.
  • Lead and optimize the end-to-end enrollment organization, ensuring alignment of people, processes, technology, and resources.
  • Establish enrollment goals, forecasting models, performance metrics, and accountability frameworks that drive measurable results.
  • Partner with Marketing leadership to maximize lead quality, conversion performance, and enrollment funnel effectiveness.
  • Build and develop a high-performing enrollment leadership team and culture focused on accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee enrollment budgeting, workforce planning, and resource allocation to support growth and operational excellence.
  • Champion enrollment transformation through technology, automation, AI, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to align enrollment strategies with institutional priorities, market opportunities, and long-term growth plans.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • 15+ years of relevant professional experience, including 7+ years leading scaled enrollment, admissions, or analogous student/customer acquisition organizations.
  • Deep enrollment leadership experience within primarily online higher education or a closely adjacent
  • environment, such as an OPM or EdTech organization with a comparable high-touch, high consideration go-to-market model.
  • Experience leading a sizable enrollment/contact-center organization, including frontline enrollment teams and supporting capabilities such as operations, analytics, workforce management, training, or quality.
  • Expertise in training and quality, including the strategy and oversight of a training and quality program that includes scalable counselor onboarding, coaching, program knowledge, interaction quality standards, and quality assurance.
  • Proven track record of delivering enrollment growth, with direct accountability for enrollment targets and measurable improvement across the lead-to-enrollment funnel.
  • Track record of materially improving enrollment productivity and funnel economics, such as conversion rates, speed-to-lead, advisor effectiveness, lead utilization, yield, or cost efficiency.
  • Demonstrated ability to evolve and scale an enrollment organization, including improving processes, workflows, organizational structures, systems, and talent to support growth and efficiency.
  • Experience owning enrollment operations and governance, including counselor expectations, inquiry management standards, policies, procedures, controls, and responsible and compliant recruitment practices.
  • Strong data and analytics orientation, with experience establishing dashboards, operational KPIs, forecasting processes, performance-management cadences, and clear accountability for results.
  • Expertise in enrollment operations business acumen, including direct ownership of the enrollment budget, headcount plan, resource allocation, and workforce/capacity planning that is aligned with inquiry volume and enrollment goals.
  • Experience change leader and people leader who can upgrade capabilities, develop strong leaders, make necessary talent decisions, and build a culture of accountability, collaboration, urgency, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to partner effectively with Marketing, IT, and other functions while maintaining clear ownership of enrollment outcomes.
  • Strong technology and systems orientation, with experience defining business requirements and improving CRM, lead-management, workflow, reporting, and automation capabilities in partnership with technology teams.
  • Extensive experience with student information systems and end-to-end integration to positively impact the lead-to-enrollment handoff across the CRM, SIS, telephony, workflow, reporting, and related systems.
  • Executive presence and enterprise mindset, with the maturity and credibility to operate effectively with the CEO, board, and executive leadership team while remaining hands-on enough to drive execution.
  • Mission-oriented, believes in the transformative value of accessible, high-quality higher education.

Strong Preferred Qualifications

  • A mix of large- and small-company experience, ideally having brought structured operating rigor, systems, processes, and management disciplines from a scaled organization into a leaner, faster moving environment.
  • Familiarity with the online higher education ecosystem, including academic calendars, accreditation, regulatory considerations, and working-adult student populations.
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics, Power BI, Salesforce, or comparable CRM and business intelligence platforms.
  • Experience using AI, automation, or advanced analytics to improve lead prioritization, advisor productivity, workflow efficiency, forecasting, or enrollment conversion.
  • Experience working in a Private Equity-backed or similarly performance-oriented environment.

Our Commitment to Employees

Just as we strive to empower our students for success, we also aim to enrich the lives of our employees. For 6

consecutive years, ACE was recognized as one of Indiana’s Best Places to Work, winning the #1 spot for

medium-sized companies in 2020. In addition, ACE has earned national recognition since 2022 for being a

USA Today Top Workplace. As a virtual first organization, we celebrate diversity and are committed to

creating a family-like inclusive work environment. For our full-time employees, we offer the following

benefits:

  • Medical, dental, & vision Insurance
  • HSA and FSA options
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Tuition reimbursement & reduction programs
  • Generous PTO
  • 401k and employer match
  • Full-service wellness and EAP program
  • Employee recognition and awards programs
  • Employer paid life & AD&D insurance
  • Short-term disability
  • Employer paid long-term disability
  • And more…

Physical Demands

The physical demand described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to

successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee

is regularly required to communicate with and receive communications from students and ACE employees in

real time using online and other electronic media.

Commitment to Culture

At American College of Education, we’re all about building a one-of-a-kind, supportive community where

everyone—students, faculty, and staff—can thrive. Guided by our mission and values, we focus on everything

from innovative curriculum design to personalized instruction and student support to intentional planning,

inclusive initiatives, and strategic resource allocation. We’re dedicated to creating an environment that

celebrates freedom of expression, diversity of thought, open dialogue, and mutual respect. We believe in

fostering a sense of belonging and wellness so that every member of our ACE family feels empowered,

valued, and ready to reach their full potential. Together, we’re creating a vibrant, resilient, and connected

learning community where everyone matters.

Additional Notes

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or

responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may

change at any time with or without notice.

Employees are increasingly integrating AI into their roles, demonstrating its potential to boost efficiency,

accuracy, and productivity. By utilizing AI technologies, we can streamline processes, gain valuable insights

from data, and automate routine tasks, which allows employees to concentrate on more strategic and

creative aspects of their work. While AI is a beneficial tool in the workplace, if its use—such as ChatGPT,

Grammarly, Copy.ai, etc.—accounts for more than 50% of any work assignments or job responsibilities, it will

need to be reported to a direct leader.

Internet bandwidth speeds from an employee's remote work location must be a minimum of 50Mbps

download speeds and 5Mbps upload speeds. Please note if the bandwidth is shared across multiple devices

(tablets, computer, streaming, phone, etc.) you will need higher overall speeds. You can test the speed of

your connection by visiting speedtest.net Purchase, setup, installation, support, and ongoing maintenance of

reliable internet service is the responsibility of the individual.

American College of Education seeks to attract and retain a diverse staff consistent with its diverse student

body and surrounding communities. At this time we cannot consider candidates residing in Alaska,

Washington D.C., Massachusetts, South Dakota, or Alabama.

ACE is an Equal Opportunity Employ

jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryThe Software Development Engineer II is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and enhancing applications across all layers of the software stack, from database development through front-end functionality.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Software Development Engineer II is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and enhancing applications across all layers of the software stack, from database development through front-end functionality. Working within an Agile development environment, this role partners with business and technical teams to gather requirements, prototype solutions, implement enhancements, and perform unit testing to support application quality, reliability, and performance.

The Software Development Engineer II works across multiple projects and technical environments while collaborating with Product, UX, Engineering, and Architecture teams throughout the software development lifecycle. This position requires strong technical and problem-solving skills, adaptability to changing business and technology needs, and the ability to develop effective solutions to business and client challenges.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The essential duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Design, develop, maintain, and enhance applications across multiple tiers of the software architecture.
  • Support complex and highly visible development initiatives across multiple projects and technical environments.
  • Gather and evaluate business and technical requirements to develop effective application solutions.
  • Prototype, develop, test, and implement software solutions that address business and client needs.
  • Design, develop, and extend back-end web services using JSON, .NET web services, SQL, and related technologies.
  • Create, consume, maintain, and enhance RESTful APIs.
  • Develop and execute unit tests to support application quality, reliability, and performance.
  • Support application releases and development activities using Agile software development practices.
  • Apply Test Driven Development (TDD) and Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with Product, UX, and Engineering teams throughout requirements gathering, design, development, testing, and implementation.
  • Work closely with architects to ensure applications and technical solutions align with Fleet Response IT's long-term strategy and architectural standards.
  • Participate in solution scoping by identifying technical requirements and developing solutions to business and client challenges.
  • Apply knowledge across multiple technical environments and business areas when developing and supporting applications.
  • Troubleshoot application issues and identify appropriate technical solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to development standards and best practices.
  • Maintain technical documentation related to applications, enhancements, and development activities.
  • Manage multiple development priorities while adapting to changing business requirements, technologies, and project needs.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Employees may be required to perform duties outside their normal responsibilities as business needs dictate.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Three to five years of software development experience.
  • Proficiency with API and web application development technologies.
  • Proficiency with C#, Angular 10+, TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, LESS, Node.js, or similar development technologies.
  • Experience creating and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Experience with Docker and/or Kubernetes.
  • Experience using Azure DevOps, Git, or other source control and code repository tools.
  • Experience working within a predominantly .NET-based codebase.
  • Ability to work effectively within a predominantly Windows-based development environment.
  • Experience writing T-SQL and working with Microsoft SQL Server.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure or AWS, with Microsoft Azure preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of full-stack application development across database, back-end, API, and front-end technologies.
  • Strong understanding of API and web development concepts and practices.
  • Knowledge of Agile software development methodologies and the software development lifecycle.
  • Understanding of Test Driven Development (TDD) and CI/CD practices.
  • Ability to gather and evaluate business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
  • Ability to design and develop solutions across multiple technical environments.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to develop, test, implement, and support reliable software applications.
  • Ability to identify technical solutions to complex business and client challenges.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, UX, Engineering, Architecture, business partners, clients, and vendors.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a development team.
  • Ability to adapt to changing technologies, business priorities, and technical requirements.
  • Demonstrated initiative, accountability, and commitment to continuous improvement.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

  • Work is performed primarily in a professional indoor office or home-office environment.
  • Requires prolonged periods of sitting, typing, computer use, reading, and technical analysis.
  • Requires close visual attention when reviewing code, technical documentation, data, and computer screens.
  • Must be able to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, through video conferencing, and through electronic communication.
  • Regular use of wrists, hands, and fingers is required for computer and office-related tasks.
  • This is primarily a sedentary position with occasional walking and standing.
  • Must occasionally be able to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects weighing up to 10 pounds.
  • Work is performed in a fast-paced, collaborative environment requiring adaptability to changing business and technical requirements.

Work Schedule

Flexible scheduling options and work arrangements are available based on departmental needs, business requirements, and performance expectations.

Employees may be eligible to work from home as part of their regularly scheduled work arrangement.

jobs.description:
We Are:

About Accenture
Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.

Who You Are:

You are a cross-Financial Services skilled Functional Solution Architect within Accenture’s Financial Services Salesforce Business Group practice, operating at the layer between architecture and execution. You translate what senior architects design into what delivery teams build — owning solution design documents, leading technical workstreams, and making sure the architecture holds through the full program lifecycle.

You are fluent in Salesforce Data 360, Agentforce, and FS CRM platforms. You thrive in complexity: multi-workstream programs, distributed teams, and client environments where the data is messy, the timelines are tight, and the architecture decisions matter. You bring clarity to ambiguous technical problems and lead junior team members without waiting to be asked.

The Work:

  • Solution design ownership — lead end-to-end solution design across assigned workstreams, including data model, integration patterns, security model, and platform configuration; keep SDDs, architecture decision records, and data flow diagrams current throughout delivery
  • Agentforce & AI delivery — own technical design and build for Agentforce use cases across active Banking, Capital Markets, & Insurance programs
  • Integration delivery — design and implement integrations between Data Cloud, CRM, external data sources, and Agentforce capabilities; make architecture tradeoffs across middleware options (MuleSoft, REST/SOAP, Salesforce Connect)
  • Bridge function — serve as the connective layer between functional requirements and technical delivery; align architects, developers, and client stakeholders on design decisions and scope boundaries
  • Technical leadership — lead design sessions, code reviews, and deployment governance; manage solution risks, design gaps, and cross-workstream dependencies; escalate proactively
  • Team development — guide and mentor junior architects and set technical standards across the team
  • Pre-sale contribution — support estimation, scoping, and staffing conversations during pursuit phases; contribute to architecture sections of RFP responses and orals
  • Practice contribution — build accelerators, methodology assets, and FS-specific AI use case patterns that scale across the practice

What You Need:

  • Minimum of 8 years of progressive Salesforce delivery experience, with demonstrated tenure in solution architecture or senior platform leadership roles.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience architecting and delivering multiple large-scale, complex Salesforce programs in the Financial Services industry.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience with Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC) or equivalent Financial Services CRM platforms and expertise in how these clouds are applied across varying use cases.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience leading delivery using Agile, hybrid, or scaled Agile frameworks at program scale (e.g., SAFe, multi-team Scrum) and shaping methodology decisions for the engagement.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience leveraging AI/ML capabilities (e.g., Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, generative AI tools), including ability to advise clients on AI strategy and adoption.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience supporting Financial Services clients at a senior delivery or advisory level.
  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years’ work experience).

Bonus Points:

  • Salesforce Certified Application Architect, System Architect, or CTA (Certified Technical Architect) designation.
  • Experience operating as a functional and technical hybrid — with enough depth on both sides to design end-to-end solutions without siloing into one lane.
  • Deep integration architecture experience including MuleSoft, event-driven architectures, or enterprise API strategy in complex Life Sciences environments.
  • Pre-sales leadership experience including owning architecture narrative for competitive RFP responses and executive-level solution presentations.
  • Relationship management experience at the Director and VP level with Financial Services clients, with a track record of building trust and repeat engagement.
  • Experience building and leading high-performing, geographically distributed delivery teams at Senior Manager level or above.

jobs.title: Chargé(e) de Clientèle – Logistique Import Chine - Freelance
jobs.excerpt: À propos de notre clientNotre client est une agence francophone de sourcing et de logistique import, implantée en Chine depuis plusieurs années.
jobs.description:
À propos de notre client

Notre client est une agence francophone de sourcing et de logistique import, implantée en Chine depuis plusieurs années. Elle accompagne les TPE et PME francophones qui achètent en Chine, du premier échange avec une usine jusqu'à la livraison des marchandises : recherche de fournisseurs, négociation, suivi de production, contrôle qualité, puis logistique internationale (fret maritime, aérien et ferroviaire, dédouanement, livraison, entreposage). Plusieurs milliers d'entreprises ont déjà été accompagnées.

L'activité logistique génère un flux quotidien de demandes de devis (formulaire de devis du site, e-mails, messagerie) émanant de dirigeants de petites structures, souvent primo-importateurs, qui attendent réactivité, pédagogie et un interlocuteur unique. C'est pour structurer ce suivi que notre client crée ce poste.

À propos du rôle

Au sein de l'équipe de notre client, vous êtes le premier point de contact des clients et prospects qui sollicitent l'agence pour un transport depuis la Chine. Vous prenez en charge chaque demande dès son arrivée, la qualifiez, l'enregistrez dans le CRM et la faites avancer jusqu'à la clôture du dossier, en assurant le relais permanent entre le client et les différents agents concernés. Le poste est très majoritairement téléphonique et e-mail, en lien avec une clientèle française.

Vos missions

Traitement des demandes entrantes

▪Réceptionner et traiter l'ensemble des demandes entrantes (formulaire de devis du site, e-mails, messagerie, appels) dans les délais fixés.

▪Prendre contact rapidement avec chaque prospect pour qualifier le besoin : nature de la marchandise, volume/poids, origine et destination, Incoterm, délais souhaités, documents disponibles.

▪Renseigner la fiche client dans le CRM Zoho, puis maintenir les données à jour tout au long du dossier (contacts, échanges, statut, pièces).

▪Orienter chaque demande vers le bon agent (cotation transport, sourcing, douane) avec un dossier complet, puis relayer la réponse ou le devis au client, répondre à ses questions et assurer les relances jusqu'à la décision.

Suivi des dossiers et relation client

▪Être l'interlocuteur(trice) unique du client pendant toute la durée du dossier : point d'avancement, informations sur les étapes (enlèvement, départ, transit, dédouanement, livraison), réponses aux sollicitations.

▪Faire le relais entre le client et les opérateurs internes et externes (agents en charge des cotations, équipe sourcing, etc.) et s'assurer que chaque demande trouve une réponse.

▪Collecter et vérifier les documents nécessaires à l'expédition et au dédouanement (facture, liste de colisage, certificats, mandats) et relancer les parties concernées.

▪Suivre la clôture des dossiers (livraison effectuée, facturation réglée) et contribuer à la satisfaction client, en transmettant les informations nécessaires à la personne en charge de la satisfaction client.

▪Tenir à jour le pipeline des demandes et des dossiers en cours dans le CRM et alerter sur les points bloquants.

▪Partager avec l'équipe un point régulier sur l'activité : demandes reçues, devis en attente, dossiers en cours, incidents.

Point d'attention

Son rôle est d'être l'interface entre le client et l'ensemble des agents concernés, de garantir la réactivité et la qualité du suivi, et de faire avancer chaque dossier jusqu'à sa clôture.

Profil recherché

Formation et expérience

▪Formation Bac +2 à Bac +5 en logistique, transport ou commerce international.

▪Expérience confirmée en logistique et transport international (transitaire, commissionnaire de transport, service import/export, ADV ou Chargé de Clientèle d'un importateur), avec une bonne compréhension des flux depuis l'Asie : fret maritime et aérien, Incoterms, documents d'expédition, dédouanement.

▪Expérience de la relation client à distance (téléphone, e-mail) auprès d'une clientèle de dirigeants de TPE/PME.

▪Maîtrise d'un CRM – la connaissance de Zoho CRM est un vrai plus – et aisance avec les outils bureautiques et collaboratifs.

Compétences clés

▪Excellent français, à l'oral comme à l'écrit : élocution claire et neutre, orthographe irréprochable, aisance au téléphone avec une clientèle française.

▪Organisation et rigueur : suivre plusieurs dossiers en parallèle, ne rien laisser sans réponse, documenter chaque étape.

▪Réactivité et disponibilité : horaires alignés sur la France, traitement rapide des demandes.

▪Sens du service, pédagogie et autonomie : savoir rassurer un client qui importe pour la première fois, et travailler seul(e) à distance avec une équipe répartie entre la France et la Chine.

jobs.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

What You’ll Do

  • Case Evaluation: Review and assess the merits of clients’ Personal Injury claims by analyzing records, documents, and evidence to determine liability and potential value
  • Legal Representation: Represent clients in Personal Injury matters, including filing claims, gathering evidence, representing a client’s legal position to the adverse insurer, preparing demand letters, negotiating potential settlements, and advocating for clients
  • Legal Strategy: Develop and implement effective strategies to protect clients’ rights and interests. Conduct legal research, analyze medical records, gather evidence, and negotiate with insurance companies to achieve favorable settlements
  • Client Communication: Maintain consistent communication with clients, providing updates, explaining legal processes, and advising them on their rights and options
  • Medical and Vocational Assessment: Collaborate with medical and vocational experts to evaluate the extent of injuries, their impact on clients’ ability to work, and appropriate future treatment requirements
  • Case Management: Organize and maintain case files, track deadlines, coordinate with medical providers and experts, and oversee related legal and administrative tasks
  • Ethical Standards: Uphold professional ethics, confidentiality, and compliance with all applicable rules and regulations

How This Role Drives the Business

  • Maximizes case value through strong case development, sound evaluation, and effective negotiation prior to litigation
  • Moves cases efficiently through the pre-litigation lifecycle, supporting faster resolutions and improved cash flow
  • Identifies cases that should be escalated to litigation early, enabling better strategy, resource allocation, and outcomes
  • Enhances client satisfaction and trust through proactive communication and consistent follow-through
  • Reduces risk and rework by spotting issues early, making decisive recommendations, and ensuring alignment across teams
  • Supports scale by holding case managers accountable to performance metrics and ensuring consistent, high-quality work product
  • Strengthens operational efficiency by reinforcing clear workflows between case managers and the medical records team to avoid delays in case development

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6–12 months, success in this role looks like:

  • You independently manage a robust pre-litigation caseload, moving matters efficiently from intake through resolution while maintaining high quality and attention to detail
  • You consistently maximize case value through strong case evaluation, strategic guidance, and effective negotiation
  • You identify cases that require escalation to litigation and make timely, well-reasoned recommendations to ensure optimal outcomes
  • You collaborate closely with case managers, holding them accountable to performance metrics by setting clear expectations, reviewing work product, and ensuring deadlines are met
  • You take ownership of outcomes by maintaining the same level of accountability you expect from your case managers
  • You review, refine, and approve demand packages prepared by case managers, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and strong positioning for negotiation
  • You ensure case managers are effectively coordinating with the medical records team to obtain all necessary records and bills in a timely manner
  • You maintain proactive, consistent communication with clients, ensuring they feel informed and supported throughout the process
  • You identify issues early, make timely recommendations, and help prevent bottlenecks
  • You build strong cases that, if needed, can be taken into litigation and through trial

Qualifications

  • Active admission to the Georgia Bar
  • 5 - 10 years of experience in Personal Injury law
  • Strong communication, negotiation, research, and writing skills
  • Ability to manage a robust case load independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of Georgia laws, regulations, and procedures required
  • Must be located in or near the State of Georgia
  • Strong communication skills—written and verbal
  • Ability to think critically, prioritize effectively, and execute with speed

Nice to Have:

  • Active Admission to one or more districts of the Georgia Federal Court
  • Experience in a fast-growing or high-volume environment
  • Comfort with ambiguity and evolving systems
  • Experience in legal, professional services, or client-centric organizations

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.

  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

You’ll take ownership of your client portfolio—from identifying opportunities and preparing competitive quotes to negotiating with suppliers and subcontractors, overseeing delivery and ensuring payment. Success means winning profitable work, delivering on your promises and giving clients reasons to come back.

We’re building our own system with AI and automations to reduce routine administration and help our team work more effectively. This will give you more time to focus on sales, client relationships and commercial decisions.

We want someone who already uses tools such as ChatGPT, actively explores new AI capabilities and is keen to help improve how we work. You’ll also bring practical trade knowledge and a commitment to keep learning about property maintenance and refurbishment.

Key responsibilities:

Win work and grow client accounts

  • Proactively identify and win new clients through outbound sales, referrals and networking.
  • Convert inbound enquiries into booked work through responsive communication, persuasive proposals and consistent follow-up.
  • Build strong client relationships, understand their properties and priorities, and become their trusted point of contact.
  • Generate new quote opportunities by identifying maintenance and refurbishment needs within existing accounts.
  • Follow up confidently, handle objections and move opportunities towards a decision.
  • Take ownership of your sales pipeline, quote conversion and client revenue growth.

Build competitive, profitable quotes

  • Understand client requirements and coordinate engineers, subcontractors or suppliers for surveys and specialist input where needed.
  • Prepare clear, itemised quotes with accurate scope, pricing and exclusions.
  • Negotiate competitive prices, availability and terms with suppliers and subcontractors while maintaining quality and protecting profit margins.
  • Develop a reliable supply chain and build relationships that support competitive pricing and dependable delivery.
  • Use your trade knowledge to challenge costs, identify gaps and propose practical solutions.
  • Seek technical advice where needed before committing to a scope or price.

Own the client experience and project delivery

  • Act as the client’s main point of contact throughout the job lifecycle.
  • Coordinate engineers, subcontractors, materials and access so work runs smoothly.
  • Ensure work is allocated to the right trade, location and availability.
  • Provide clear work instructions and keep clients informed of progress.
  • Resolve issues proactively and escalate when necessary.
  • Verify completed work through photos, client feedback and completion checks.
  • Agree changes to scope and additional costs before extra work proceeds.

Manage invoicing, profitability and payments

  • Ensure jobs are invoiced within 24 hours of completion.
  • Follow up on outstanding payments and resolve billing queries promptly.
  • Monitor project profitability and identify where costs or scope changes affect margins.
  • Take responsibility for commercial outcomes, from the initial enquiry through to payment.

Use AI and automation to improve productivity

  • Use tools such as ChatGPT to support quote drafting, client communication, meeting preparation and sales follow-up.
  • Check AI-generated outputs for accuracy, particularly technical scope, costs and commitments to clients.
  • Learn and adopt our own system as its AI and automation capabilities develop.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive work and improve speed, accuracy and the client experience.
  • Keep up with useful developments in AI, test practical applications and share improvements with the team.
  • Keep client, opportunity and job records accurate, and use approved tools responsibly.

Keep developing your trade knowledge

  • Continually build your understanding of maintenance and refurbishment trades, materials, labour requirements and pricing.
  • Learn from engineers, suppliers and completed projects to improve future quotes and decisions.
  • Ask practical questions, recognise gaps in your knowledge and seek specialist input when needed

How we measure success:

    • New clients won and quote opportunities generated.
    • Revenue and gross profit growth.
    • Quote conversion rates and turnaround times.
    • Repeat business and client retention.
    • Jobs booked and quality of project delivery.
    • Timely invoicing and payment collection.

Requirements

  • At least two years’ experience in property maintenance, refurbishment or a closely related trade services business.
  • A track record of winning work, converting quotes or growing client accounts.
  • Strong sales and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to approach new clients and develop repeat business.
  • Confident negotiation skills and a sound understanding of pricing, costs and profit margins.
  • Practical trade knowledge and a commitment to continually developing it.
  • Hands-on experience using ChatGPT or similar AI tools, with examples of how they improve your productivity.
  • Curiosity about AI and a willingness to keep learning and adapting as our systems evolve.
  • Experience coordinating clients, engineers, suppliers and subcontractors.
  • Strong organisation, clear written and verbal communication, and reliable follow-through.
  • Confidence using CRM systems, job tracking software and Microsoft Office.
  • Experience working towards targets, participating in daily stand-ups and contributing to process improvements.
  • A proactive approach—you follow up, solve problems and take responsibility for results.
  • A degree in any field and occasional weekend availability are advantages.

Additional requirements for remote roles

You must have:

  • A suitable home office: A dedicated, quiet and professional workspace where you can focus and take client calls without interruptions.
  • Availability aligned with UK operations: The ability to work agreed hours supporting our UK clients and delivery teams.

You must be comfortable working independently, staying accessible to colleagues and clients, and taking ownership of your targets and results.

Benefits

jobs.title: Sr. Security Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreAddepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

We are currently seeking a Sr. Manager, Security Operations to lead our Global Security Operations team within Addepar’s Information Security & Risk organization. In this role, you will own the day-to-day running of our detection and response function, act as incident commander for security incidents, and partner with our 24/7 MSSP to ensure threats are identified and handled quickly. You will set the operational objectives and strategy for Security Operations, lead and grow a global team, and shape our detection strategy for threats specific to Addepar’s environment. Beyond the immediate response, you will make sure we learn from every incident by driving post-incident follow-through, turning incident trends into lasting fixes with partners across the business, and reporting on the health of the program to Security leadership. We also want this leader to modernize how Security Operations works, applying AI and automation (AIOps) to speed up triage, investigation and response so the team can focus on the highest-impact work. The successful candidate is a hands-on leader who brings structure, calm and accountability to high-pressure situations.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

  • Operational Leadership: Lead the day-to-day operations of Addepar’s Global Security Operations team, and serve as incident commander for major security incidents
  • People Management: Manage and develop a globally distributed team. Provide mentorship and training, set the team’s roadmap and OKRs, and manage on-call coverage across time zones
  • MSSP Partnership: Own the relationship with our 24/7 Managed Security Services Provider (MSSP), including escalation paths, service quality, vendor performance and cost, and handoffs to the internal team
  • Detection & SIEM: Own our detection strategy and the health of our SIEM environment. This includes building custom detections for threats unique to Addepar, tuning alerts to improve fidelity and reduce noise, expanding log source coverage, and ensuring the platform scales as Addepar grows
  • AI-Driven Modernization: Lead the modernization of our SecOps function through AIOps, using AI and automation to streamline alert triage, enrichment, investigation and response, reduce manual toil, and scale the team’s impact
  • Documentation & Playbooks: Build and own our incident response documentation, including playbooks, runbooks and training materials, and keep it current as threats and our environment evolve
  • Post-Incident Accountability: Maintain our post-incident process so action items are clearly owned, tracked and closed across teams, covering both immediate fixes and longer-term improvements
  • Root Cause Remediation: Use incident trends to identify recurring root causes, and partner with Engineering, Infrastructure, Security and Product teams to prioritize and deliver preventive fixes
  • Metrics, KPIs & Reporting: Define and track key SecOps metrics and KPIs, and present a holistic monthly view of the Security Operations function to senior leadership
  • Security Awareness: Champion security awareness across the company through tabletop exercises, training sessions and talks
  • On-Call: Participate in a global on-call rotation, including responding to critical security events outside of standard working hours

Who You Are

  • You have 8+ years of experience in security operations, detection engineering, or incident response
  • You have 3+ years of people management experience, with a track record of mentoring and developing security teams
  • You have proven experience as an incident commander for security incidents: leading the response, coordinating multiple workstreams, running postmortems and driving action items to completion
  • You have hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), including investigating and responding to security events in the cloud
  • You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, or a related field, or have equivalent experience
  • You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership, and can influence peers and leaders to build agreement in sensitive situations
  • You bring structure to ambiguous, fast-moving situations and stay composed under pressure

Addepar takes a market-based approach to pay. A successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for this role within the United States.

Compensation for this role includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

Base Salary Range
$172,000—$269,000 USD

Our Values

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
  • Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to .

jobs.excerpt: Senior 3D Character Artist (Stylized Games | Unity3D)Location: Remote | International Team Employment: Full-Time / Long-Term Position OverviewWe are looking for experienced Senior 3D Character Artists with exceptional artistic skills and a passion for creating expressive, appealing, and memorable stylized characters for our game development and co-development projects.
jobs.description:
Senior 3D Character Artist (Stylized Games | Unity3D)

Location: Remote | International Team

Employment: Full-Time / Long-Term

Position Overview

We are looking for experienced Senior 3D Character Artists with exceptional artistic skills and a passion for creating expressive, appealing, and memorable stylized characters for our game development and co-development projects.

We believe outstanding character art goes beyond technical execution. Every silhouette, proportion, material, and subtle design detail should reinforce a character's personality and make them instantly recognizable.

As part of our character art team, you will create high-quality, production-ready characters from concept through final in-engine implementation, collaborating closely with concept artists, animators, technical artists, and creative leadership.

This is a senior, hands-on role for artists who combine outstanding artistic taste with strong production skills and a deep understanding of real-time game development.

Key Responsibilities

Character Art Creation

  • Create high-quality stylized 3D characters with strong silhouettes, appealing proportions, and distinctive personalities.

  • Model, sculpt, UV, texture, and refine characters from early blockout through final production.

  • Translate 2D concepts into compelling 3D characters while preserving artistic intent and visual storytelling.

  • Develop convincing stylized materials, textures, and surface details.

  • Maintain a consistent visual language across characters while supporting individuality and creative variety.

Game-Ready Character Production

  • Prepare optimized character assets for real-time engines, particularly Unity3D.

  • Work with appropriate polygon budgets, UV layouts, texture atlases, LODs, and material constraints.

  • Collaborate with rigging and animation teams to ensure characters deform well and support expressive performances.

  • Integrate and review character assets in-engine, ensuring visual quality and technical correctness.

  • Balance artistic ambition with gameplay readability, mobile performance, and production requirements.

Collaboration & Quality

  • Work closely with Character Art Directors, Concept Artists, Animators, and Technical Artists.

  • Participate in artistic reviews and contribute to maintaining high character quality standards.

  • Provide constructive feedback and support other artists when needed.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve character appeal, visual consistency, and production workflows.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a 3D Character Artist in game development.

  • Experience contributing to commercially released game productions.

  • Exceptional portfolio demonstrating high-quality stylized 3D characters and strong artistic fundamentals.

  • Excellent understanding of anatomy, stylized proportions, shape language, color, and character appeal.

  • Strong skills in 3D modeling, sculpting, UV mapping, texturing, and material creation.

  • Proficiency in Maya, Blender, ZBrush, Substance 3D Painter, or equivalent professional tools.

  • Experience preparing optimized characters for real-time game engines.

  • Understanding of character deformation, rigging requirements, and animation-friendly topology.

  • Ability to interpret concepts and maintain a consistent artistic style.

  • Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and independent problem-solving.

  • Fluency in English.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with Unity3D and mobile game development.

  • Familiarity with pixel-inspired, simplified, or highly stylized visual aesthetics.

  • Experience creating humanoids, creatures, and non-human characters.

  • Knowledge of stylized shaders and character material workflows.

  • Experience with procedural workflows or character customization systems.

  • Experience mentoring other character artists.

  • Previous experience working in a co-development environment.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to contribute to visually distinctive game projects.

  • High artistic ownership and influence over character quality and presentation.

  • Collaboration with experienced character artists, animators, and international creative teams.

  • Remote-friendly working environment.

  • Competitive compensation and flexible contract options.

  • Long-term collaboration and opportunities for professional growth.

  • Annual Beffio team retreats and a supportive studio culture.

Ready to Create Characters Players Will Love?

Send us your portfolio and a short introduction. We would love to see stylized characters that demonstrate exceptional artistic quality, personality, and production-ready execution.

jobs.excerpt: Who we are:Glydways is reimagining what public transit can be.
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Glydways is reimagining what public transit can be. We believe that mobility is the gateway to opportunity—connecting people to housing, education, employment, commerce, and care. By making transportation more accessible, affordable, and sustainable, we empower communities to thrive and unlock economic and social prosperity.

Our mission is to revolutionize transit with a solution that delivers high capacity, exceptional user experiences, unmatched affordability, and minimal environmental impact.

The Glydways system is a groundbreaking network of carbon-neutral, interconnected transit pathways powered by standardized autonomous vehicles on dedicated roadways. Operating 24/7 with on-demand access, it offers personalized and efficient mobility—without the burden of heavy upfront infrastructure costs or ongoing taxpayer subsidies.

With Glydways, we’re building more than a transportation system; we’re creating a future where everyone, everywhere, has the freedom to move.

Meet the team:

The Embedded Software team is where the vehicle comes to life. We write and load the firmware that turns raw hardware—sensor kits, custom boards, and main compute—into a reliable, safety-critical machine. Because our software touches nearly every subsystem, we collaborate with engineers from across the company and get hands-on with the newest hardware in the building.

About the Role:

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will own critical firmware domains, lead complex cross-functional projects, and help shape our embedded platform and engineering best practices. This is firmware that carries real passengers—on a Glydways vehicle, reliability is a safety requirement, not just a performance goal, and the code you ship is part of the safety case.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Design, prototype, build, and test production vehicle firmware for safety-critical systems.
  • Develop and optimize applications in RTOS environments, tuning for reliability, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and power on resource-constrained platforms.
  • Own and evolve the communication architecture between MCUs, sensors, and main compute, across both standard and custom protocols (SPI, UART, I2C, CAN, TCP/UDP, and more).
  • Lead bring-up and debugging for new boards and SoCs—bootloaders, drivers, and low-level diagnostics—partnering with electrical engineers and software developers to take new sensor and compute platforms from prototype to production.
  • Define and build automated testing frameworks and harnesses at the unit, integration, and system levels alongside test and platform engineers.
  • Mentor other embedded engineers, give thorough code reviews, and help set engineering standards, tools, and best practices across the team.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Core technical skills

  • Expert-level C and/or C++ for embedded systems; additional languages and tooling are a plus.
  • Strong command of communication protocols, from low level (SPI, UART, I2C, CAN) to higher level (TCP/UDP).
  • Experience developing on RTOS environments (e.g., PX5 or other POSIX/pthreads-based real-time OSes such as embedded Linux with pthreads, QNX, VxWorks, or RTEMS).
  • Experience with MCU bootloaders, device drivers, and new board or SoC bring-up.
  • Experience deploying firmware to multi-device systems or vehicles in a power-safe, fault-tolerant way.
  • Demonstrated speed and size optimization for resource-constrained platforms.

Process and quality

  • Experience with safety-critical systems and processes (e.g., ISO 26262 or similar standards) is highly valued.
  • Solid understanding of the embedded software development life cycle—version control, code review, CI, and automated testing.

Nice to have

  • Experience in automotive and/or transit domains.
  • Experience with automotive-grade safety MCUs — ideally the NXP S32K3 family, or comparable lockstep/ASIL-rated parts (e.g., Infineon AURIX, TI TMS570).
  • Familiarity with kernel internals and low-level OS concepts.
  • Experience with deterministic timing and networking, such as NTP, PTP, or time-sensitive networking (TSN).
  • Experience with CAN tooling and DBC-based workflows.
  • Comfort with electronics test equipment and hardware debugging (multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, etc.).
  • Scripting experience (e.g., Python) for test automation and tooling.

Typical experience

  • Typically 7+ years developing embedded software for production systems, including substantial work on safety-critical or highly reliable platforms (automotive, aerospace, medical, industrial, robotics, etc.).

*If you’re excited about this work but don’t check every box, we’d still love to hear from you. We know the best candidates don’t always match every line of a job description.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleRecurly Commerce is one of the company's most important growth bets, and we're looking for a Principal Product Manager to run it like a business — not just a product.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Recurly Commerce is one of the company's most important growth bets, and we're looking for a Principal Product Manager to run it like a business — not just a product. This is a founder-style role for someone who thinks like a mini General Manager: you'll own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Commerce, and you'll also roll up your sleeves to drive it forward across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer teams.

You'll thrive here if you've taken a B2B product from 0 to 1 at a startup, know the Shopify ecosystem inside and out, and are energized — not intimidated — by wearing whatever hat the day requires: strategist in the morning, deal-closer in the afternoon, and hands-on problem-solver by evening.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the Business, Not Just the Backlog — Act as a mini GM for Commerce: define the vision, product strategy, and roadmap, and take direct accountability for the commercial success of the product line, not just feature delivery.
  • Build the 0-to-1 Playbook — Bring proven instincts for taking a B2B product from early bets to scaled traction. Move fast, validate cheaply, and know when to double down versus cut losses.
  • Go Deep on Shopify — Use hands-on knowledge of the Shopify ecosystem (APIs, Shopify Plus, app/partner requirements) to build a roadmap that differentiates Recurly Commerce from native Shopify capabilities and third-party competitors.
  • Lead Cross-Functionally, Without the Authority — Be the connective tissue across Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. Align stakeholders, unblock decisions, and keep everyone rowing in the same direction.
  • Drive GTM as a Partner, Not a Bystander — Work side-by-side with Sales and Marketing on positioning, pricing, and enablement. Get in front of customers and prospects directly to pressure-test ideas and build pipeline confidence.
  • Execute with Discipline — Break big strategic bets into shippable, high-value increments. Own the end-to-end lifecycle from discovery through launch, with a bias toward speed-to-market and reliable delivery.
  • Measure What Matters — Define and own the KPIs that tell you whether Commerce is winning (subscriber growth, retention, merchant health, ACV). Use data to inform roadmap trade-offs and to communicate impact to leadership.
  • Do Whatever It Takes — Whether that's writing a spec, jumping on a customer escalation, drafting sales talk tracks, or debugging a webhook issue with Engineering — you don't wait for it to be "your job" to help solve it.

Why This Role

This isn't a maintenance role on an established line — it's a build role on a product with real momentum and real stakes. You'll have the autonomy of a founder with the resources and distribution of an established company behind you.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 0-to-1 Startup Experience: You've built and scaled a B2B product from the ground up in a startup environment, and you know what it takes to go from an unproven idea to a product customers rely on.
  • Shopify Expertise: Deep, hands-on familiarity with the Shopify ecosystem — API architecture, Shopify Plus, partner/app requirements — ideally with experience in subscription, billing, or commerce-adjacent products.
  • Entrepreneurial, GM Mindset: You think like an owner. You're comfortable with ambiguity, move without waiting for perfect information, and take full accountability for outcomes, not just outputs.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: A track record of driving alignment and results across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer teams — influencing without relying on formal authority.
  • Core Product Management Craft: Strong fundamentals in vision-setting, strategy, and roadmapping, paired with the execution skill to actually ship what you plan.
  • Technical Fluency: Comfortable in technical conversations with Engineering (APIs, infrastructure, data) — you don't need to write code, but you can credibly reason about technical trade-offs.
  • Communication & Executive Presence: Able to flex your message for a customer, a sales rep, an engineer, or an executive — and to build confidence and trust with each.
  • 7+ years of B2B SaaS product management experience, including direct 0-to-1 ownership.

Benefits

As a full-time employee, Recurly offers competitive benefits programs, perks and options designed to fit your needs and the needs of your family. We offer medical, dental and vision benefits and a menu from which to choose options that work best for you and eligible dependents. We also offer life insurance, short and long-term disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness coverage, employee accident protection, health savings account (HSA) with company contribution & flexible spending account (FSA) options, employee assistance program, Legal and Pet Insurance.

Other perks may include:

401(k) Retirement Plan and company match

Flex Time Off

Company Events

Training/Development

Tuition reimbursement

Commuter benefits

Volunteer opportunities

jobs.description:
AlphaGov is seeking a Construction Research Scientist to support research and consulting opportunities involving construction schedules, workforce capacity, labor costs, and project delivery risk.

We are looking for someone who can evaluate how delays, competing projects, and limited skilled labor affect a project’s cost and completion date—and translate those findings into practical recommendations.

Scope of Work

  • Analyze how project delays change workforce requirements, crew availability, and labor costs.
  • Model resource constraints across multiple projects, including situations where crews remain on one project longer than planned.
  • Develop and test scheduling, simulation, and forecasting methods using historical project data.
  • Evaluate alternatives such as resequencing work, reallocating crews, overtime, and subcontracting.
  • Define data requirements, validation methods, and measurable research objectives.
  • Contribute technical methods, work plans, and findings to proposals and client deliverables.

Requirements

  • PhD preferred in construction engineering, civil engineering, construction management, operations research, industrial engineering, or a related field. Comparable applied research experience will be considered.
  • Experience with construction scheduling, resource allocation, project controls, or construction productivity research.
  • Demonstrated experience with quantitative modeling, simulation, optimization, or statistical analysis.
  • Familiarity with Primavera P6, critical path scheduling, resource-loaded schedules, or comparable methods.
  • Ability to explain technical findings clearly to project leaders and nontechnical decision-makers.

Experience with electrical and mechanical construction, data centers, utilities, energy, or major infrastructure projects is especially relevant.

Benefits

Assignments are scoped individually, with compensation and time commitments agreed upon before work begins. Opportunities may include proposal development and delivery of awarded projects. Project delivery assignments depend on contract or funding awards and confirmed availability.

Applicants may opt into consideration for future AlphaGov proposals and consulting engagements. Applying does not guarantee an assignment. Any opportunity with a separate affiliated company would be discussed and confirmed separately.

To apply: Submit your résumé or CV highlighting relevant projects, research methods, publications, and your specific contribution.

It’s inspiring to work with a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they’re doing!

When you become part of the Chapters Health Team, you’ll realize it’s more than a job. It’s a mission. We’re committed to providing outstanding patient care and a high level of customer service in our communities every day. Our employees make all the difference in our success!

Job Profile Summary
The Resource Nights & Weekend (ReNW) Nurse Practitioner (NP) is an active member of Chapters Health System’s Medical Staff and provides fully remote virtual serious illness care management to patients and families throughout our continuum of care. This continuum may include but is not limited to home-based, facility-based, and inpatient adult and pediatric hospice; palliative care; PACE, and additional service lines and programs offered or supported by Chapters Health System.

Experience Requirements:

Must have a minimum of 3 years of recent clinical experience, including substantial experience in hospice, palliative care, and/or acute inpatient care.

Education Requirements:

Must hold a Masters or Doctors degree in Nursing from an accredited Family or Adult Nurse Practitioner Program.

Certificates and/or Licenses:

The ReNW NP must hold national certification, licensure, and prescriptive authority from the appropriate governing body for advanced nursing practice in their home state and in additional state(s) where care is provided. Licensure and prescriptive authority must be obtained and maintained for all required jurisdictions. Applications for required licenses must be submitted within 60 days of the date of hire and/or receiving notification. Must hold and maintain Basic Life Support certificate from an approved organization and compact RN license in their home stateby date of hire.

Schedule:

Shifts may vary and can include nights, evenings, weekends, and/or holidays based on the needs of the business.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Quality Provision of Services:

  • Provides fully remote virtual serious illness care management to patients and families throughout our continuum of care; This continuum may include but is not limited to home-based, facility-based, and inpatient adult and pediatric hospice; palliative care; PACE, and additional service lines and programs offered or supported by Chapters Health System.
  • Consults with medical staff, and/or other members of the IDT as indicated to ensure optimal patient care in an effective and efficient manner.
  • Performs virtual assessment of patient/family/caregiver needs.
  • Identifies, manages, orders, and prescribes medication and equipment as appropriate.
  • Adjusts and supports the plan of care in accordance with Chapters policies and procedures and within the guidelines of the corresponding nurse practice act.
  • Assesses the caregiver’s ability to meet the patient’s immediate needs and confidence in the patient’s plan of care.
  • Provides education to increase the caregiver’s confidence as necessary and appropriate.
  • Supports staff by answering clinical questions, entering orders and prescriptions, and supporting the clinical needs of patients and families.

  • Supports with discharge planning including prescribing medications, entering discharge orders and instructions, etc.
  • Participates in Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement (QAPI) activities as needed, including regular medical record reviews and medical peer reviews. Seeks to continually improve the care practices of Chapters to assure compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards.
  • Keeps knowledge base and skill levels current to assure quality patient care and professional growth.

2.Organization/Regulatory Compliance:

  • Maintains current knowledge of the latest research and trends in Hospice and Palliative Medicine.
  • Maintains continuing education as required for licensure and to ensure specialty level expertise in end-of-life care.
  • Obtains & maintains hospital/facility credentialing as required.
  • Participates in departmental and medical staff activities as requested.

  • Communicates and collaborates with team members, patients/families/caregivers, partnering providers and staff as required & appropriate within HIPAA guidelines to help provide comfort & deliver upon Chapters core values.

  • Participates as a member of the interdisciplinary team to develop by implementing a patient-directed individualized plan of care and assures the availability of information to team members. Provides teaching to staff as required.
  • Functions as a role model in providing exceptional customer service to patients and families through effective and timely communication. Supports organizational changes.
  • Demonstrates flexibility in providing coverage and/or availability,

4.Financial Stewardship:

Achieves expected productivity standards as defined by the organization and in alignment with best practices/the Chapters model. If /when Telemedicine billing is accepted, implements time-based billing procedures using the electronic medical record system software and other appropriate methods to capture timely billing (weekly for home and nursing home; daily for inpatient and clinic charges).

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart.

About the Role

We are seeking a Manager, Patient Safety Operations (Pharmacovigilance Operations Manager, Drug Safety Operations Manager) to join our team in a remote capacity.

As a Manager, Patient Safety Operations, you will manage and supervise Patient Safety staff supporting assigned projects, guiding day-to-day performance, quality, timeline compliance, and training. You will provide process expertise across project-specific safety activities, including Individual Case Safety Report processing, signal and risk management, and safety medical writing, while maintaining compliance with applicable regulations and Standard Operating Procedures. You will also communicate directly with clients to address questions, feedback, and escalations.

You will join a collaborative environment where you can strengthen team capabilities, improve pharmacovigilance operations, and support technology-enabled ways of working.
