With regulatory expertise and transparent, human-in-the-loop AI at its core, Reveleer supports organizations working to advance care quality, strengthen documentation integrity, and sustain the operational readiness needed to navigate audits with confidence.

About the role

Reveleer is hiring a senior actuary to lead health plan and risk adjustment analytics for each line of business for Reveleer customers across Medicare Advantage (MA), Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug (MAPD), Affordable Care Act (ACA), Medicaid, and provider value-based contracts. This role builds member-level actuarial models that quantify risk adjustment performance, HCC (Hierarchical Condition Category) capture, medical economics, utilization, and population health trends, and translates those models into customer-facing dashboards that inform pricing, forecasting, and program strategy.

This actuary works directly with customer success, analytics, product, operations, and clinical teams to convert raw claims, encounter, member, provider, and clinical data into decision-ready outputs. The role requires both technical model-building skill and the ability to explain actuarial and risk adjustment concepts to non-actuarial stakeholders, including provider and health plan executives.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain member-level actuarial models covering risk adjustment (RAF) performance, HCC capture and recapture, medical economics, utilization patterns, and population health metrics across MA, MAPD, ACA, and Medicaid populations.
  • Develop analytics that can support rate-setting for Medicare Advantage Bids, ACA rate filings, Medicaid capitation arrangements, and value-based contract terms.
  • Reconcile RAF calculations against source files, including the Monthly Membership Report (MMR), Model Output Report (MOR), MAO-004, and the Beneficiary-Level file, and extend that reconciliation logic into customer-facing reporting.
  • Design the actuarial and analytic logic behind customer-facing dashboards, partnering with data engineering and product teams to translate member-level models into usable, accurate, and timely visualizations.
  • Produce forecasting and accrual models that support midyear and final settlement estimates, transfer payments, capital planning, and financial reporting for risk adjustment programs.
  • Analyze utilization trends, medical loss ratio (MLR) drivers, and cost-of-care patterns to identify actionable opportunities for customers managing value-based contracts.
  • Support MA and HHS RADV (Risk Adjustment Data Validation) readiness by modeling audit exposure and prioritizing chart review and coding efforts based on financial impact.
  • Communicate model methodology, assumptions, and results clearly to actuarial and non-actuarial audiences, including customer executives.
  • Partner with clinical, coding, retrieval, and provider engagement teams to align analytic outputs with chronic HCC recapture, care gap closure, and quality initiatives.

What you bring

Required qualifications

  • Seven or more years of actuarial or actuarial-adjacent analytics experience in health plan pricing, risk adjustment, or medical economics.
  • Direct pricing or performance modeling experience across at least three of the following: Medicare Advantage, MAPD, ACA, Medicaid, and value-based contracts.
  • Working knowledge of the CMS-HCC and ACA risk model, RAF score calculation, and the relationship between ICD-10 diagnosis coding and risk adjustment revenue.
  • Demonstrated experience building member-level data models that feed reporting or dashboard tools, such as Tableau or Power BI.
  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one statistical or scripting language, such as SAS, R, or Python.
  • Proficiency in utilizing AI tools to support modeling
  • Bachelor's degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting actuarial findings to executive audiences.

Preferred qualifications

  • Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) designation or Fellowship (FSA) or progress toward.
  • Experience with CMS files, including the MMR, MOR, MAO-004, and Beneficiary-Level file.
  • Experience with EDPS & EDGE encounter submissions and encounter data quality processes.
  • Prior experience supporting RADV & IVA audit readiness or chart review prioritization.
  • Familiarity with provider incentive program design tied to chronic HCC recapture or quality performance.
  • Experience with financial forecasting, including ACA transfer payments and MA settlement accruals

Tools and technical skills

SAS (Enterprise Guide), SQL, Tableau, Microsoft Excel, R and RStudio, Python, Microsoft Access, and Microsoft Visual Basic (VBA) are all relevant to this role. Reveleer does not require proficiency in every tool listed; candidates should be strong in at least three of these and comfortable learning the rest on the job.

WHAT YOU’LL RECEIVE:

• Medical, Dental and Vision benefits 

• 401k match

jobs.description:
Student Success Specialist

MedSchoolCoach | Full-Time | Remote

About the Role

MedSchoolCoach is seeking a compassionate, organized, and solutions-oriented Student Success Specialist to join our Student Success team. In this role, you will serve as a trusted point of contact for students and families, helping ensure they receive exceptional service, timely support, and a positive experience throughout their journey with MedSchoolCoach.

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who brings patience, empathy, and professionalism to every interaction, particularly when navigating sensitive situations or resolving concerns. This individual should be comfortable managing competing priorities, addressing challenging conversations with confidence, and balancing a supportive approach with the ability to set clear expectations and drive resolutions. We are especially interested in candidates with backgrounds in higher education, admissions, student affairs, academic advising, counseling, or other student-facing roles who understand the unique pressures students and families face throughout the academic and medical education journey.

Key Responsibilities

Student & Family Support

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for students and families, providing thoughtful, responsive, and professional support via email and phone.
  • Manage incoming student inquiries, concerns, and complaints, ensuring timely acknowledgment and follow-up, typically within 24–48 hours.
  • Approach sensitive or emotionally charged situations with patience, empathy, and sound judgment, recognizing when conversations require additional time, care, or escalation.
  • Build positive relationships with students and families, establishing trust and confidence in

MedSchoolCoach's services.

  • Conduct proactive check-ins with students, particularly during onboarding and early stages of service, to ensure satisfaction and address potential concerns.

Issue Resolution & Relationship Management

  • Investigate and resolve student concerns related to service delivery, scheduling, communication, and other aspects of the student experience.
  • Serve as a liaison between students, families, advisors, tutors, and internal teams to facilitate effective communication and timely resolutions.
  • Exercise sound judgment when addressing complaints, balancing student satisfaction with company policies and service expectations.
  • Identify situations requiring escalation and collaborate with leadership to determine appropriate next steps.
  • Maintain a calm, professional, and confident approach during difficult conversations while setting clear boundaries and expectations.

Student Success Operations

  • Coordinate student onboarding and transitions between internal teams, advisors, and tutors to ensure a seamless experience.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of student interactions, concerns, follow-up actions, and resolutions.
  • Monitor ongoing student needs and proactively identify opportunities to improve satisfaction and engagement.
  • Assist with student satisfaction surveys, feedback collection, and other initiatives designed to evaluate the student experience.
  • Identify recurring concerns or service gaps and recommend improvements to processes, policies, and communication practices.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures and documentation to support consistent service delivery.
  • Collaborate with Student Success leadership and cross-functional teams on additional projects and initiatives as needed.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
  • Experience in a student-facing, client services, customer support, or relationship management role.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and thoughtfully with diverse audiences.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, and the ability to build rapport with students and families.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate difficult conversations, manage complaints, and resolve conflicts with empathy and confidence.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting established response timelines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to exercise independent judgment when evaluating situations and determining appropriate next steps.
  • Ability to remain composed under pressure and adapt communication styles based on individual needs and circumstances.
  • Proficiency with common productivity and communication tools, including Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
  • Willingness to learn about MedSchoolCoach's services, medical education pathways, and the unique needs of our students.

Preferred

  • Experience working in higher education, college admissions, student affairs, academic advising, enrollment services, or counseling.
  • Advanced degree in education, higher education administration, counseling, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting students and families through academically demanding or high- stakes processes.
  • Previous experience in complaint resolution, student advocacy, or service recovery.
  • Familiarity with student support systems, CRM platforms, or case management tools.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

Our ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys helping people and understands that exceptional student support requires more than simply answering questions. It requires listening carefully, communicating clearly, following through consistently, and knowing when to offer reassurance versus when to take decisive action. You will thrive in this role if you are naturally patient and approachable, but also confident and comfortable taking ownership of challenging situations. You recognize that students and families may be navigating stressful or uncertain circumstances, and you take pride in helping them feel heard, supported, and confident in the services they receive. Above all, you are a strong writer, a thoughtful problem solver, and someone who can be trusted to manage sensitive student concerns with professionalism, discretion, and care.

Compensation & Benefits

MedSchoolCoach offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

- Up to four weeks of vacation

- Health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance

- 401(k) with company match

- Flexible work schedule

- Remote work environment

Work Location: Remote

Salary: $55,000 – $62,000 / year

Our clients include Fortune 500 enterprises and high-growth companies across commercial real estate, financial services, healthcare technology, and other data-intensive industries. We partner with Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, GCP, and Azure to deliver solutions that drive measurable ROI.

Note:Please submit your resume in English, as all application materials must be in English for review and consideration.

Location: Remote (United States)

Level:Senior

Service Line:Analytics & BI / Data Strategy / Embedded Delivery

Employment:Full-time

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Business Data Analyst who acts as the connective tissue between our clients' business stakeholders and the data they need to run their companies. You will own client engagements end to end: sitting in the room with operators and executives, translating their messiest business questions into clean analytical problems, and delivering data products that change how decisions get made.

This is not a ticket-taker role. You will lead engagements. You will set the agenda for client working sessions, push back when requirements are vague, propose better questions than the ones being asked, and own the outcome from discovery through adoption. Our best analysts pair deep SQL and modeling skills with the instincts of a consultant: you read the room, manage the room, and ship work the room actually uses.

You will also lean hard on AI. We expect every analyst at BOD to be fluent with the current generation of AI tools and to know where they help, where they hurt, and how to apply them responsibly to client work. Analysts who treat AI as an accelerator move three times faster than analysts who do not, and we are building the practice around that reality.

What You Will Do

  • Lead client-facing discovery sessions to elicit, document, and prioritize business requirements with operators, analysts, and executives

  • Translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical work: data models, dashboards, KPI frameworks, and decision-support tools that get adopted

  • Write production-quality SQL against Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift, and build trusted models in dbt or the client's modeling layer

  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting in Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or the tool the client lives in

  • Drive proactive analysis: surface trends, anomalies, and opportunities the client did not ask about but needs to see

  • Apply AI tooling (LLM-based analysis, natural language to SQL, agentic data exploration, AI-assisted documentation) to compress timelines and raise the quality bar on every deliverable

  • Set the cadence for client communication: status updates, demos, working sessions, and stakeholder reviews

  • Mentor junior analysts on the engagement and contribute to BOD's analytics playbooks, templates, and internal tooling

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience as a business analyst, data analyst, BI analyst, or analytics consultant, with at least 2 years in a client-facing or embedded role

  • Expert SQL: window functions, CTEs, performance tuning, and the ability to sanity-check your own numbers before anyone else has to

  • Strong data modeling fundamentals (dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, dbt or equivalent transformation tooling)

  • Hands-on experience with at least one cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift) and at least one modern BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, Mode)

  • Demonstrated ability to lead client conversations: running requirements workshops, pushing back constructively, and driving alignment across stakeholders with different priorities

  • Working fluency with AI tools for analytical work (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, AI features inside BI and SQL tools) and a clear point of view on where they speed you up vs. where they introduce risk

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the judgment to scale your message to the audience in front of you

  • Bias toward action: You would rather draft a working hypothesis and a v1 dashboard than wait for perfect requirements

Nice to Haves

  • Domain experience in commercial real estate, financial services, healthcare technology, or insurance

  • Python for analytical workflows (pandas, notebooks, light scripting against APIs)

  • Experience scoping and pricing analytics work, or contributing to SOWs and statements of work

  • Familiarity with data quality frameworks, observability tools, or governance practices

  • Prior consulting or agency experience and comfort with utilization, billing, and multi-client context switching

  • Experience implementing or evaluating AI-native analytics tools (text-to-SQL platforms, AI BI assistants, semantic layers)

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Work on diverse, high-impact engagements across industries

  • Direct access to leading-edge data and AI stacks (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Builder culture where analysts lead engagements and ship work, not slides

  • Professional development budget and certification support

jobs.excerpt: About ReapReap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries.
jobs.description:
About Reap

Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries. We enable financial connectivity and access for businesses worldwide by combining traditional finance with stablecoins for efficient money movement.

Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services—from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments.

Backed by leading investors including Acorn Pacific, Index Ventures and HashKey Capital, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance.

Why Reap

This team owns the shared security and identity foundations that every other engineering team at Reap builds on: authentication and identity, fraud and account takeover protection, access governance, data residency and routing, and notifications infrastructure. As we expand into new markets and products, these foundations must help teams ship faster while protecting our business and clients from unnecessary loss.

This role is a senior individual contributor position, acting as the Tech Lead for our Security and Identity Platform. You'll own technical direction, architecture, and delivery while staying hands-on with the code — no people management is required. You'll build these capabilities as one connected, trusted platform, rather than separate solutions that each product team has to reinvent. It's an opportunity to make security an enabler of growth in a regulated, global fintech.

Your Mission Awaits

  • Authentication & identity: Architect, build, and operate the shared identity layer across Reap's products, including login, session management, and multi-factor authentication. Design secure, reusable APIs and services that other engineering teams can adopt confidently.

  • Fraud & account protection: Build platform capabilities that detect and prevent unauthorised access and account takeover before funds move. Partner with product and risk stakeholders to translate threats into practical controls that protect clients without unnecessary friction.

  • Access governance & auditability: Develop consistent authorisation and access controls, with reliable audit trails that support access reviews, incident investigation, and regulatory, partner, and client security requirements.

  • Data residency & routing: Design secure data and traffic routing that supports jurisdiction-specific requirements as Reap enters new markets, working with relevant stakeholders to turn those requirements into reusable platform capabilities.

  • Notifications infrastructure: Build reliable, correctly targeted infrastructure for security, risk, and transaction alerts, with the delivery speed and visibility needed when something goes wrong.

  • Secure delivery & reliability: Build and operate services on AWS using CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code (IaC). Embed threat modelling, security testing, monitoring, logging, and alerting into delivery; investigate incidents and address root causes to prevent recurrence.

  • Technical leadership & platform adoption: Own architecture and design reviews, set engineering standards, and mentor engineers while remaining hands-on. Partner with the Knox PM and other engineering teams to prioritise work that reduces risk, unlocks markets, and removes duplicated effort. Provide clear APIs, defaults, and documentation that make the secure path easy to adopt.

  • AI-assisted engineering: Use AI tools responsibly for coding, debugging, tests, and documentation, with appropriate review and safeguards for sensitive data and security-critical code.

Your Superpowers

  • Experience: 8–10+ years in backend or platform engineering, including hands-on ownership of security-critical services or shared identity and access infrastructure in production.

  • Leadership: At least 2+ years in a technical leadership role (Tech Lead or Engineering Manager), with a track record of owning architecture decisions, mentoring engineers, and delivering complex projects end to end. Comfortable leading through technical expertise in an individual contributor role.

  • Security & identity engineering: Strong understanding of authentication, authorisation, session security, MFA, and access control. Experience implementing identity standards such as OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, and applying secure-by-design practices, threat modelling, and least privilege.

  • Backend: Preferably Node.js + TypeScript, with strong experience building APIs and event-driven/serverless systems. Open to strong backend engineers using other languages (e.g., Go, Java, Python) who can ramp up quickly.

  • Cloud & delivery: Strong AWS experience, including securing and operating production services, with solid CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices.

  • Data & auditability: Hands-on experience with relational databases (AWS Aurora, PostgreSQL, MySQL), schema design, and ORM frameworks such as TypeORM. Able to design for sensitive data protection, traceability, and reliable audit trails.

jobs.description:
Background

Fusion energy promises clean, abundant power by recreating the process that fuels the sun. The science is maturing, and the bottleneck is now building the machines: thousands of precision components that only a few suppliers worldwide can make.

Our client is an early, well-funded fusion startup built to close that gap. It connects global fusion developers with world-class manufacturers as a single point of contact, while expanding into adjacent businesses such as fusion AI, superconducting materials and fuel supply.

The Chief Operating & Strategy Officer will join as the CEO's closest counterpart, building Finance, HR and Legal to scale ahead of the business while shaping strategy on partnerships, M&A and capital allocation.

Key Responsibilities

Back Office Leadership

  • Lead and integrate Finance, HR and Legal operations, building scalable processes, systems and governance that support rapid growth.
  • Partner with the CFO on budgeting, financial planning and operational controls, ensuring the back office enables rather than slows the business.
  • Build the talent strategy, organization design and culture needed to scale the team, including senior hiring and leadership development.
  • Oversee contracts, corporate legal matters, compliance and risk management across multiple jurisdictions.

Corporate and Business Strategy

  • Define and drive company strategy together with the CEO, including market and segment prioritization, long-term planning and annual objectives.
  • Lead strategic partnerships, alliances and evaluation of M&A or strategic investment opportunities.
  • Develop business model analysis and unit economics to guide where the company invests and how it scales.
  • Run the company operating rhythm, including OKRs, performance reviews and cross-functional execution of strategic initiatives.
  • Tech Sales Strategy Support
  • Build the sales operations foundation for the commercial team, including deal approval processes, contract structures, forecasting and sales enablement.
  • Provide pricing guidance from a margin and unit economics perspective, working closely with the Chief Commercial Officer, who retains ownership of pricing decisions, customer relationships and revenue delivery.
  • Support the strategic narrative and strategy content used in investor communications, in close coordination with the Chief Commercial Officer.

Key Qualifications

  • 15 or more years of progressive experience in operations, strategy, general management or a comparable senior leadership role, with a proven record of running multiple corporate functions.
  • Experience as COO, Head of Strategy, Chief of Staff to a CEO, or business unit head at a high-growth technology company, or equivalent experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm followed by an operating role.
  • Hands-on experience overseeing or closely partnering with Finance, HR and Legal functions in a scaling organization.
  • Strong understanding of technology or B2B enterprise sales cycles, with the ability to build sales operations and strategy without owning client-facing selling.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate vision into measurable plans and drive cross-functional execution at the executive level.
  • Business fluency in English and Korean, with comfort working in a global environment.
  • Experience in M&A, strategic partnerships or investment evaluation. (Preferred)
  • Experience taking a company through a major growth stage such as global expansion, a funding round or IPO preparation. (Preferred)
  • MBA or an equivalent advanced degree. (Preferred)

At ServiceNow, we put AI to work for people. Our AI platform connects any AI, any data, and any workflow to help organizations work smarter, move faster, and reinvent how business gets done. Role Overview

The Executive Administrative Assistant (EAA) to the GPC Leader is a highly trusted administrative partner responsible for maximizing the effectiveness, productivity, and operating capacity of a global executive leading one of ServiceNow’s most strategic and fast-moving organizations.

This is an AI-forward executive support role requiring demonstrated proficiency with AI-enabled Executive Assistant (AI EA) tools and platforms, in addition to broader AI and automation capabilities. The successful candidate already uses AI EA tools as an integrated part of how they manage executive calendars, scheduling, meeting preparation, follow-up, travel, communications, task management, and executive-office workflows.

We are looking for someone who can show how they have personally used AI EA technology to improve the way an executive office operates—not simply someone who is familiar with AI, uses a general-purpose AI assistant, or is interested in learning these tools.

The GPC Leader operates at an exceptionally fast pace across a global ecosystem of ServiceNow executives, customers, partners, industry leaders, and employees. Priorities can shift rapidly and often require immediate action. The EAA must operate with exceptional agility, adaptability, flexibility, judgment, and precision while maintaining accuracy and continuity across a constantly changing executive agenda.

This role goes well beyond traditional calendar administration. The EAA is a force multiplier for the executive, combining exceptional executive support capabilities with AI EA technology, automation, and modern productivity practices to anticipate needs, eliminate friction, create operating leverage, and continually improve how work gets done.

AI EA Tools, Automation & Executive Productivity

  • Demonstrate advanced, hands-on proficiency using AI-enabled Executive Assistant tools and platforms specifically designed to support executive administration and executive-office workflows.

Executive Calendar, Time & Priority Management

  • Own a highly complex, dynamic global executive calendar involving C-suite leaders, senior internal executives, customers, strategic partners, industry leaders, and employees.

  • Manage the calendar as a strategic business tool, ensuring executive time is aligned to the highest-value business, customer, partner, talent, and leadership priorities.

  • Make rapid, thoughtful decisions when priorities change, understanding what can move, what cannot, who needs to be informed, and what downstream implications must be addressed.

  • Anticipate conflicts, preparation requirements, decision points, travel implications, and follow-up needs before they become issues.

  • Reprioritize quickly and confidently in an environment where the executive’s schedule may change multiple times in a day.

  • Protect focus time while preserving the flexibility required of a highly visible global leader.

Internal & External Executive Engagements

  • Orchestrate internal and external executive engagements from initial request through preparation, execution, and follow-up.

  • Coordinate engagements with ServiceNow executives, customers, partners, industry leaders, external organizations, and other high-priority stakeholders.

  • Ensure the executive enters critical engagements with the right context, objectives, participants, materials, logistics, and preparation.

  • Maintain visibility to commitments and follow-up resulting from executive engagements and ensure actions move forward quickly.

  • Coordinate across executive offices and external organizations to create a highly professional, responsive, and seamless stakeholder experience.

  • Represent the GPC Leader with discretion, confidence, sound judgment, and strong executive presence.

GPC Leadership & Operating Rhythm

  • Enable the operating rhythm of the GPC leadership team, including leadership meetings, business reviews, planning sessions, executive offsites, talent discussions, company events, and key partner engagements.

  • Partner closely with the Chief of Staff to translate business priorities into an effective executive cadence and use of the leader’s time.

Cross-Functional Executive Office Partnership

Global Travel & Executive Logistics

  • 7+ years of progressive experience supporting senior executives, preferably at the SVP, EVP, or C-suite level in a global technology, high-growth, or similarly fast-paced environment.

  • Demonstrated proficiency with AI-enabled Executive Assistant (AI EA) tools and platforms. This is a core requirement of the role—not simply general familiarity or fluency with AI.

  • Proven experience personally incorporating AI EA tools into executive administrative workflows such as complex calendar and scheduling management, meeting preparation, executive briefing, action tracking, follow-up, travel, communications, and productivity management.

  • Ability to provide specific examples of AI EA tools used, the executive-administration problems addressed, how the tools were incorporated into daily workflows, and the resulting improvements in speed, efficiency, accuracy, or executive capacity.

  • Broader proficiency with generative AI, workflow automation, and productivity technologies, with the ability to combine these capabilities with specialized AI EA tools.

  • Demonstrated success supporting a global executive operating at exceptional speed, with complex stakeholder demands and priorities that can change rapidly.

  • Exceptional agility, adaptability, and flexibility, including the ability to reprioritize and execute quickly without sacrificing accuracy.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and a demonstrated record of accuracy in high-volume, high-velocity executive environments.

  • Advanced ability to manage highly complex global calendars and make independent prioritization decisions with limited direction.

  • A productivity and continuous-improvement mindset: instinctively identifies opportunities to simplify, automate, standardize, eliminate unnecessary work, and improve how the executive office operates.

  • Exceptional judgment, discretion, executive presence, and ability to manage highly sensitive and confidential information.

What Success Looks Like

  • The GPC Leader has more capacity because of this partnership. Executive time is focused on the highest-value priorities, administrative friction is reduced, and the executive office operates at extraordinary speed without sacrificing accuracy or stakeholder experience.

Global Partnerships & Channels is central to how ServiceNow expands customer value, scales innovation, and brings the power of the ServiceNow AI platform to market through a global partner ecosystem. Job Title: Executive Director, Product Communications & Engagement – MariTide

Job Location: Thousand Oaks, California, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you are a part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

What you will do

At Amgen, our mission is to serve patients by transforming the promise of science into life-changing medicines. Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead the Corporate Affairs product communications strategy for MariTide, translating the Obesity & Related Conditions Corporate Affairs vision into integrated communications that support launch readiness, commercialization, lifecycle management, and future indication expansion. Reporting to the Associate Vice President, Corporate Affairs, you will serve as the Corporate Affairs lead for MariTide, ensuring product communications, content, digital, and executive communications work together as one cohesive strategy. You will partner closely with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Market Access, Enterprise Communications, and other cross-functional leaders to align Corporate Affairs priorities with business objectives while preserving the function's trusted role in scientific communications, disease education, stakeholder engagement, and reputation.

Key Responsibilities

Product Communications Leadership

  • Lead the Corporate Affairs product communications strategy for MariTide across launch readiness, commercialization, lifecycle management, and future indication expansion

  • Develop differentiated product narratives grounded in science, patient insights and unmet need that reinforce MariTide's value and long-term impact

  • Translate the broader Corporate Affairs strategy into integrated communications plans that engage patients, healthcare professionals, policymakers, and other stakeholders

  • Provide strategic counsel to senior leaders on product communications opportunities, risks, and reputation

Communications Governance & Cross-Functional Integration

  • Lead integrated communications planning for MariTide, establishing priorities and ensuring alignment across Corporate Affairs and cross-functional partners.

  • Represent Corporate Affairs within cross-functional launch planning and governance forums

  • Partner with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Advocacy, Market Access, and Enterprise Communications to ensure coordinated execution around key product milestones

  • Identify opportunities to amplify scientific, regulatory, and commercial milestones through strategic Corporate Affairs communications

Content, Digital & Engagement Leadership

  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight for the Product Communications, Content and Digital Communications organization

  • Lead the teams responsible for editorial strategy, executive thought leadership, internal product communications, owned channels, patient storytelling, scientific storytelling, and digital engagement

  • Drive an integrated content ecosystem across earned, owned and digital channels while leveraging analytics, audience insights, and emerging technologies to optimize impact

  • Coach and develop direct reports while fostering a collaborative, high-performing and innovative team culture

Strategic Partnership with Media Relations

  • Partner closely with the Senior Director, Global Media Relations to ensure product communications strategy informs earned media engagement, executive visibility, thought leadership and issues preparedness

  • Ensure seamless coordination between product communications and media relations to deliver a consistent external narrative for MariTide across all stakeholder audiences

Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and influence decisions across a complex global matrix organization

  • Lead agency partners and communications investments with clear accountability for measurable business outcomes

  • Build strong partnerships across the Obesity Corporate Affairs leadership team to deliver an integrated communications approach

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The candidate we seek is an experienced leader with the following qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree & 6 years of product communications experience OR

  • Master’s degree & 10 years of product communications experience OR

  • Bachelor’s degree & 12 years of product communications experience AND

  • 6 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs or directing the allocation of resources

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Executive-level experience leading Corporate Affairs or Product Communications for a late-stage or commercial biopharmaceutical product

  • Experience supporting major product launches, commercialization, and lifecycle communications

  • Experience leading integrated product communications in partnership with Commercial, Medical, and other cross-functional functions

  • Experience leading and developing high-performing communications teams.

  • Experience overseeing content strategy, digital communications, executive thought leadership, and internal product communications

  • Experience partnering with media relations leaders to deliver coordinated product communications strategies

  • Ability to translate complex science into compelling communications for diverse stakeholder audiences

  • Ability to influence senior executives and lead through a highly matrixed global organization

  • Executive presence, organizational leadership, and business acumen consistent with an Executive Director role at Amgen

  • Experience using communications analytics, audience insights, and AI-enabled communications tools to optimize strategy and impact

They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:

  • Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive

  • Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection

  • Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders

  • Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is $266,637 to $360,745. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • Comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts.

  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan

  • Stock-based long-term incentives

  • Award-winning time-off plans and bi-annual company-wide shutdowns

  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease. Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable law. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

We are seeking a Big Data Developer to build and optimize large-scale data solutions that help identify and disrupt malicious threats across the Internet. In this role, you'll leverage cutting-edge technologies, work alongside talented engineers and security professionals, and play a key role in protecting critical digital infrastructure.

As part of a collaborative, mission-driven team, you'll have the opportunity to lead innovative projects, influence technical direction, and grow your expertise while solving complex cybersecurity challenges at scale.

Location

This is a remote position open to candidates based anywhere in the US.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of big data solutions that allow the organization to identify and disrupt malicious threats on the Internet.
  • Architect and build scalable and reliable data pipelines using technologies like Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, and other big data technologies
  • Collaborate with cross functional teams to understand data requirements and provide solutions to achieve business objectives
  • Extract, transform, and load data from various sources and formats, such as relational databases, APIs, JSON, XML, CSV, etc.
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, and security across all data processes
  • Develop scalable systems that enable real-time validation of identified resources
  • Mentor and guide junior developers fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement
  • Explore, evaluate, and conduct PoC to determine new technology solutions that would improve our ability to detect newer threats or add efficiency to current data processing pipelines

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Master’s or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field, or equivalent work experience
  • Prior experience in developing data ingestion, data processing and analytical pipelines with big datatechnologies, such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, Hive, etc.
  • Proficient in programming languages, such as Python, Java, Scala, or SQL
  • Experience with DevOps practices and tools
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and attention to detail
  • Strong communication, leadership, and teamwork skills
  • Eager to learn new skills and technologies, and willing to take on challenges

Compensation

jobs.title: Director of Marketing
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced Director of Marketing to provide strategic and operational leadership across our marketing organization.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Director of Marketing to provide strategic and operational leadership across our marketing organization. The Director of Marketing is responsible for leading the teams that plan, develop, and execute marketing strategies across the firm’s industry verticals and firm services. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Marketing, this leader will oversee the Strategic Marketing Managers and Marketing Production team, ensuring marketing priorities are translated into coordinated, high-quality execution that drives pipeline, revenue growth, and measurable business results.
This role requires a strong people and operational leader who can create alignment across teams, establish clear priorities and accountability, allocate resources effectively, and ensure marketing initiatives move efficiently from strategy through execution.

The Director will also serve as a strategic partner to the Vice President of Marketing, helping translate firmwide, industry, service-line, and international priorities into actionable marketing plans.
This is an ideal opportunity for a strong marketing leader who can move seamlessly between strategy, people leadership, and execution, building an accountable, high-performing team focused on driving meaningful business outcomes.
Ultimately, this leader will give the Vice President of Marketing greater strategic capacity by owning the day-to-day leadership, performance, and execution of the marketing organization while ensuring the team delivers against the firm’s growth strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the Marketing Organization
  • Directly manage and develop 3–4 Strategic Marketing Managers responsible for industry vertical and firm services marketing.
  • Own the operational success and performance of the Marketing Production Team, a team of 6.
  • Provide clear direction, priorities, expectations, and accountability across the marketing organization.
  • Develop team capabilities through coaching, performance management, hiring, development, and succession planning.
  • Create an environment centered on collaboration, accountability, efficiency, executional excellence, and measurable business impact.
Drive Industry & Firm Services Marketing
  • Ensure industry vertical and firm services marketing strategies are consistently and effectively executed across the organization.
  • Hold Strategic Marketing Managers accountable for developing and executing marketing plans that align with business priorities and growth objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen coordination across industries and services and leverage successful marketing strategies across the firm.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders to ensure marketing priorities remain aligned with evolving business needs and growth opportunities.
Ensure Executional & Operational Excellence
  • Oversee the connection between marketing strategy and production, ensuring priorities move efficiently from planning into market.
  • Establish processes, workflows, timelines, and standards that enable marketing teams to operate efficiently and deliver consistently high-quality work.
  • Manage competing priorities and allocate people, budget, and production capacity to the initiatives with the greatest strategic and business value.
  • Identify execution gaps, resource constraints, and process inefficiencies and take action to resolve them.
  • Establish clear accountability for deadlines, deliverables, quality, and business results.
Drive Pipeline & Revenue Growth
  • Build a performance-oriented marketing organization focused on creating demand, generating pipeline, supporting revenue growth, and strengthening market position.
  • Ensure marketing strategies define clear business objectives and measures of success.
  • Partner with business and sales leaders to connect marketing priorities with growth opportunities.
  • Monitor marketing performance and use data and insights to optimize programs, investments, and resource allocation.
  • Raise the organization’s focus from marketing activity and output to measurable business outcomes and growth.
Strategic Partnership & Resource Leadership
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to the Vice President of Marketing, translating firm strategy into actionable priorities across the marketing organization.
  • Support the execution of firmwide, industry vertical, firm services, and international marketing strategies.
  • Provide recommendations regarding marketing priorities, organizational structure, capabilities, resources, and investment.
  • Manage resources across the function, including personnel, budget, external partners, and production capacity.
  • Step into broader marketing leadership responsibilities in the absence of the Vice President of Marketing, as appropriate.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Significant progressive marketing experience, including leadership of multidisciplinary marketing teams.
  • Demonstrated experience managing managers and developing high-performing teams.
  • Experience leading industry, service-line, B2B, or professional services marketing strategies and programs.
  • Strong understanding of demand generation, pipeline development, integrated marketing, and revenue-oriented marketing.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business strategies into marketing plans and drive those plans through execution.
  • Strong operational leadership with experience managing priorities, resources, budgets, workflows, and organizational capacity.
  • Ability to use marketing performance data to evaluate effectiveness and make informed investment and prioritization decisions.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to build effective relationships with senior business, sales, and marketing leaders.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, decision-making, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related discipline.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means industry vertical and firm services marketing is consistently being executed at a high level, the marketing organization is operating efficiently, and marketing activity is translating into measurable pipeline and revenue growth.
The Director will create clear accountability from strategy through execution. Strategic Marketing Managers will operate as strong business partners, the Production team will deliver high-quality work efficiently, and marketing resources will be focused on the initiatives with the greatest potential business impact.

Compensation & Benefits

This role offers a competitive base salary along with a comprehensive benefits package. Salary ranges for U.S.-based positions are determined by geographic location and fall into one of three pay zones, which reflect the cost of labor in that area. The anticipated salary ranges for this position are outlined below and are subject to change:
  • US 1: $168,800 - $211,000
  • US 2: $153,600 - $192,000
  • US 3: $138,400 - $173,000
When determining compensation, we consider a variety of factors such as a candidate’s professional experience, skills, and qualifications. Please note that final offer amounts may vary from the ranges listed above and may be adjusted over time.

There are many reasons to join the Sensiba team: generous benefits, competitive compensation, professional advancement opportunities, and above all — our people. If you're looking for an environment that offers you growth, success, and professionalism without compromising your family, passions, and life outside of work, apply today!
Sensiba has a robust offering of benefits, including:
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage – Medical, dental, and vision.
  • Retirement & Financial Planning Support – 401(k) with match, financial wellness programs.
  • Generous Paid Time Off – Vacation, sick time, holidays, parental leave and volunteer days.
  • Flexible Work Arrangements – Hybrid or remote options, flexible hours.
  • Performance-Based Bonus – Recognition for your contributions through discretionary bonuses.
  • Professional Development Opportunities – Tuition reimbursement, certifications, mentorship.
  • Career Growth & Internal Mobility – Clear paths for advancement and role transitions.
  • Inclusive & Supportive Culture – DEI initiatives, employee resource groups, wellness programs.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description The Executive Lead for Global SMB Engineering is the senior technology executive for Global Payments' SMB business worldwide.
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Executive Lead for Global SMB Engineering is the senior technology executive for Global Payments' SMB business worldwide. The role reports to the Global CTO, sits on the CTO's leadership team and is the engineering counterpart to the President of SMB. It carries full accountability for technology strategy, engineering delivery and platform health across a global organization of around 3,500 people.


This role sets the leadership direction for SMB engineering and owns the platforms behind our SMB products, which serve over 6 million merchants.

The role has two priorities: keep delivering the products merchants rely on today, and modernize the platforms behind them for the next decade.


Modernization includes standardizing and simplifying our product estate to remove duplication. It also means moving to API first, cloud native, event driven architecture, setting one standard for how software is built, tested and operated across SMB, and making a step change in developer productivity.


The role partners closely with Product leadership and the business to decide what we build, what we buy, and which technology partners we work with. It leads engineering delivery against those plans and is measured on results against growth, reliability and security targets.


What you'll own

  • SMB engineering strategy, with every major investment tied to growth, reliability or security outcomes.
  • A global engineering organization of around 3,500 people, including its operating model and the strength of its leadership team.
  • Standardizing and simplifying the SMB product estate, and moving it to API first, cloud native, event driven design.
  • One standard for SDLC, testing and SRE practice across every SMB team, with developer productivity measured and improved.
  • Delivery of the largest SMB programs in modernization, resiliency, performance and cost, with the organization held to its commitments on scope, quality and timelines.
  • PCI DSS compliance and data privacy across all SMB platforms, working with Risk and Security on threat modeling and fraud mitigation.
  • Build or buy decisions, made together with Product leadership and the business, plus governance and performance management of strategic technology vendors.
  • Joint delivery with Product, Operations, Finance and Sales so that engineering work shows up in commercial results.
  • A clear point of view on unified commerce, embedded payments and AI in risk and operations, built into the roadmap.
  • Hiring, developing and keeping strong engineering leaders, with successors in place for senior roles.
  • Representing SMB engineering to the CTO, the President of SMB and the Senior Leadership Team.

What you bring:

  • You've led engineering at global scale on large, customer-facing platforms, at or close to the top technology seat.
  • You've led large engineering organizations and set their vision, plan and roadmap.
  • You have a strong product engineering background and know how to run platforms that customers depend on every day.
  • You have a record of delivering complex integrations and APIs, with results you can show on resiliency, security and performance.
  • You've owned enterprise and platform architecture, including a large cloud modernization.
  • You make sound build or buy calls across development, corporate applications and cloud.
  • You've moved a legacy estate onto a modern platform while keeping the business running.
  • You turn business goals into technology priorities and make trade-offs in the open.
  • You've changed engineering culture at scale.
  • You build teams by growing internal talent and hiring leaders others want to work for.

What sets you apart

  • You've led engineering through an acquisition, from diligence to post-merger integration.
  • You've applied AI and machine learning to fraud and risk, routing or developer productivity.
  • You've scaled a platform used by millions of small businesses.
  • You have experience in payments, POS or omnichannel commerce.

Leadership Competencies

This leader helps decide where Global Payments competes and how it wins. The role needs deep business knowledge, a global view and the ability to keep changing as the business and the market change.

  • Shape direction. Read change early, challenge assumptions and make the calls that set the company up for what comes next.
  • Transform to win. Redesign how work gets done, combining people, AI, automation and systems to make better decisions faster and raise performance.
  • Strengthen connection. Build trust through consistency and accountability, rally people around a shared purpose and develop successors.

Global Payment Perks - what we'll bring for you

We know it’s bigger than just your career. It’s your life, and your world. That’s why we offer global benefits and programs to support you at every stage. Here’s a taste of what you can expect.

  • A competitive salary and benefits.
  • Time to support charities and give back to your community.
  • Parental leave policy.
  • Global recognition platform.
  • Global employee assistance program.

What makes a Globalpayer

At Global Payments, we take our Values seriously, and we live them every day. Think like a client, Act like an owner, and Win as one team.


  • Caring. Curious. Passionate. We care deeply about our clients' success. We ask, listen and learn – curious to understand first. Our passion drives excellence in everything we set out to do.​
  • Accountable. Empowered. Innovative. We take accountability – working at pace to own our outcomes. We empower each other to make decisions. We're innovative - always finding better ways to deliver impact.
  • Connected. Inclusive. Determined. We value personal connections - moving forward together with clarity. We build inclusive and global teams – embracing different perspectives and ideas. It’s always ‘we,’ and never ‘me.’ We're determined to succeed together.

Our Vision & Mission

We envision a world in which all people have access to high quality and enduring solutions to improve and maintain their health and well-being. MCD Global Health aspires to be a premier partner of choice and a recognized leader, innovator, and trusted partner in healthcare and public health program development, implementation and evaluation. Our mission is to improve the health and well-being of people worldwide through enduring, high-quality, cost-effective, and universally accessible public health solutions. MCD operates impactful programs both in the U.S.A. and internationally.

MCD seeks a Digital Health Program Manager for its new program that leads the administration and implementation of technology and innovation initiatives under the state of Maine’s new Rural Health Transformation Program.

This position is a remote position based in Maine; relocation expenses will not be provided. Some travel within the State of Maine will be required.

Requirements

Digital Health Program Managers

Grade Level: 6

Anticipated Salary: $74,000-$88,000

Reporting Relationship: Senior Program Manager, Augmented Intelligence (AI)

The Digital Health Program Managers will partner with sub-awardees and contractors to implement digital health projects and programs in varying topic areas and technical approaches, including but not limited to: telehealth integration in schools, long-term care facilities, acute care, oral health, maternal and perinatal behavioral health, implementation of peer-to-peer telehealth models, remote patient monitoring programs and digital health navigation. This will include provision of technical assistance and training where relevant and ensuring that sub-awardees are achieving project milestones on time and within budget allowances.  

The essential functions of the position include:

Program Management:

  • Support sub-awardees and contractors in implementing digital health projects across multiple domains. 

  • Provide technical assistance and training to ensure effective adoption of digital health tools. 

  • Monitor and report on project milestones, budgets, and deliverables. 

  • Facilitate integration of telehealth and digital health solutions into diverse healthcare environments. 

  • Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation in Maine’s digital health initiatives. 

Teamwork:

  • Participate in relevant workgroups and/or committees

  • Participate in MCD Global Health strategic planning as required.

  • Lead by example, foster a sense of teamwork, inspire a sense of personal and professional accountability and promote positive morale that supports productivity and high quality of work for the individual team, the US Programs and MCD Global Health as a whole.

  • Work to ensure that project activities and planning are directed toward the advancement of the US Programs and MCD Global Health as a whole.

Business Development:

  • Partner with the US Programs Business Development team to assist in the development and submission of grant and contract requests to sustain and grow MCD activities pertaining to telehealth and other areas of interest, including both US Programs and international.

  • Stay current in the field by participating in available trainings related to current grants and contracts, reading and reviewing relevant literature, and subscribing to relevant listserv(s) as appropriate. Strive to ensure that project implementation is responsive to the latest research and innovations and facilities growth in MCD Global Health's portfolio.

  • Participate regularly in conferences and meetings to develop and maintain relationships with current and prospective donors, clients, contractors, or government officials while keeping abreast of trends in the field.

Position Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Public Health, Health Informatics, Healthcare Administration, or a related field. 

  • Training or certification in project/program management (e.g., PMP, CAPM) preferred. 

  • Familiarity with digital health technologies and telehealth integration strongly desired. 

Experience:

  • 5–7 years of experience in program management within healthcare, public health, or digital health initiatives. 

  • Demonstrated success managing multi-stakeholder projects with contractors, sub-awardees, and provider organizations. 

  • Experience implementing telehealth programs across diverse settings (schools, long-term care, acute care, oral health, maternal/perinatal behavioral health). 

  • Background in providing technical assistance and training to healthcare organizations or community partners.

jobs.description:
About Swanky

Swanky is one of the UK's leading Shopify ecosystem partners, helping ambitious retailers and global brands design, build and optimise modern commerce experiences on Shopify.

Following recent investment from YFM Equity Partners, we are entering the next phase of our growth journey. As Shopify continues its move into the enterprise, we believe there is a significant opportunity to build one of Europe's leading commerce consultancies.

We have an established reputation, a talented team and an outstanding ecosystem of technology partners. Now we're looking for an exceptional Chief Growth Officer to accelerate our commercial performance and help lead the next phase of our growth journey.

This is an opportunity for a proven commercial leader to make a transformational impact, both on our business today and on what Swanky becomes over the coming years.

About the Role

As Chief Growth Officer, you will join Swanky's Executive Board and take overall responsibility for our new business strategy and performance, including sales, marketing, strategic partnerships and the development of our go-to-market organisation.

Your primary objective will be to significantly increase the value, volume and quality of new business wins, building a high-performing commercial organisation capable of delivering consistent, predictable and profitable growth.

We're looking for somebody who combines strategic vision with exceptional commercial execution. You'll know how to build and inspire winning teams, develop a sophisticated sales engine and create genuine competitive advantage.

Crucially, you'll also be a highly accomplished commercial operator in your own right. You'll be equally comfortable developing our long-term growth strategy, leading an important enterprise pitch, negotiating with a prospective client or rolling up your sleeves to help your team close a deal.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll work closely with our Chair, investors and wider leadership team to deliver our growth ambitions.

Key Responsibilities

1. New Business Growth & Commercial Performance

  • Take ownership of Swanky's new business performance, delivering ambitious targets for new client acquisition and growth opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Personally lead and close strategically important opportunities, particularly complex, high-value enterprise engagements.
  • Increase the quantity, quality and value of new client wins through improved prospecting, qualification, proposition development and conversion.
  • Build a consistent and predictable pipeline, supported by effective forecasting, commercial reporting and performance management.
  • Ensure new business growth delivers strong commercial outcomes, with appropriate attention to pricing, profitability, client quality and long-term value.

2. Building a High-Performance GTM Organisation

  • Develop and execute a market-leading go-to-market strategy, covering sales, marketing, partnerships and revenue operations.
  • Build, recruit, coach and inspire an exceptional commercial team, establishing a culture of ambition, accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Lead and coordinate outstanding multidisciplinary pitch teams, bringing together commercial, strategic, creative and technical expertise to deliver compelling proposals and win major engagements.
  • Introduce new approaches, capabilities and best practices that materially improve our commercial effectiveness.
  • Establish scalable systems, processes and operating rhythms that support growth without unnecessary bureaucracy.

3. Marketing, Partnerships & Market Leadership

  • Own Swanky's marketing strategy, aligning brand development, demand generation and thought leadership with our commercial objectives.
  • Strengthen our positioning and reputation within the Shopify ecosystem and the broader enterprise commerce market.
  • Further develop our high-value strategic relationships with Shopify, technology partners, industry leaders and prospective clients.
  • Increase partner-sourced opportunities and build a more effective, diversified pipeline across inbound, outbound, referrals and partnerships.
  • Identify new market opportunities, propositions and growth channels that strengthen our competitive position.

4. Executive Leadership & Strategic Growth

  • Contribute to the overall strategy and leadership of Swanky as a member of the Executive Board.
  • Work closely with the CEO, Chair and investors to deliver the business plan and create long-term shareholder value.
  • Collaborate with our operational and delivery leadership teams to ensure commercial commitments translate into successful, profitable client relationships.
  • Support future growth initiatives, including the commercial integration of potential acquisitions and the development of new service capabilities.
  • Build a commercial organisation capable of supporting Swanky's ambitions through the current investment period and beyond.

What Success Looks Like

You'll ultimately be measured by the quality and value of the business Swanky wins.

Key measures will include:

  • Achievement of ambitious new business sales targets, including new client wins and account expansion.
  • Increased average deal value, improved win rates and stronger commercial outcomes.
  • Growth in high-quality pipeline, with greater predictability and diversification of opportunity sources.
  • Increased contribution from strategic partnerships and marketing-led demand generation.
  • Development of a high-performing commercial team with the capability to consistently win complex, high-value engagements.
  • The creation of a scalable and sustainable commercial engine capable of supporting Swanky's longer-term ambitions.

About You

Above all, you know how to win business, and you have the track record to prove it.

You'll likely bring:

  • An outstanding commercial track record.
    You've personally won significant, complex client engagements and built or led teams that consistently outperform.
  • Proven leadership capability.
    You know how to attract exceptional commercial talent, build a winning culture and get the best out of the people around you.
  • Experience driving transformational growth.
    You've helped take a business through a meaningful period of commercial expansion and understand what needs to change as organisations scale.
  • Strategic and operational excellence.
    You're comfortable developing ambitious growth plans, but equally capable of translating them into practical action and measurable results.
  • Deep understanding of consultative selling.
    You know how to sell complex technology, consulting or professional services propositions, where credibility, relationships, commercial judgement and delivery confidence really matter.
  • Entrepreneurial energy and ownership.
    You bring new ideas, fresh perspectives, valuable relationships and the determination to make things happen.
  • Executive presence and sound judgement.
    You're a compelling communicator, a confident negotiator and a collaborative leader, comfortable operating with senior clients, colleagues and Board members.

Experience within the Shopify, Adobe, Salesforce, commerce, CX or digital transformation ecosystems would be particularly attractive. Experience scaling a technology services, consultancy or digital agency business would also be highly relevant. Prior experience working with Private Equity would be advantageous but is not a requirement.

You'll be ambitious, commercially driven and excited by the prospect of helping build something exceptional.

The Opportunity

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of a successful, ambitious and fast-growing business.

You'll join Swanky at a pivotal stage, with the backing of an established private equity investor, a strong market position and significant potential for growth.

We're looking for somebody who wants to take real ownership, make a lasting impact and play a central role in building the next chapter of Swanky.

Rattaché-e à la Direction de l'Engagement, vous êtes responsable de la gestion contractuelle, financière et relationnelle d’un ou plusieurs contrats Cloud porteurs d’engagements. Passionné-e de nouvelles technologies, vous êtes titulaire d'une formation supérieure Bac +4/5 (école d’ingénieur ou de commerce), avec une expérience réussie dans la gestion de contrats ou de projets IT au forfait ou avec engagements.
